paras.en: Another key U.S. trading partner, Mexico, was not included in Wednesday’s tariff proposals.
paras.zh: 美国另一个主要贸易伙伴墨西哥并未包含在周三的关税提案中。

paras.en: “I think the most important one where we’re still going through the investigation process, is Mexico,” Greer told CNBC. “I think it’ll be a little bit more time before we release that report,” he said.
paras.zh: 格里尔告诉 CNBC：“我认为我们仍在进行调查过程的最重要的国家是墨西哥。” “我认为我们还需要一段时间才能发布该报告，”他说。

articles.title: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers killed in Ukraine war, new estimate suggests
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in Ukraine, according to a new projection based on leaked official data, an estimate that sheds new light on the staggering cost of President Vladimir Putin’s war.
paras.zh: 根据泄露的官方数据的最新预测，超过 70 万俄罗斯士兵在乌克兰丧生，这一估计让人们对弗拉基米尔·普京总统的战争造成的惊人成本有了新的认识。

paras.en: The grim assessment comes more than 4½ years after the Kremlin’s invasion of its neighbor, an all-out war that has consumed Russian society. The death toll has been mounting with each painstaking ground assault, with no end to the conflict in sight despite pressure from President Donald Trump for Kyiv to make a deal.
paras.zh: 这一严峻的评估是在克里姆林宫入侵邻国4年半多之后提出的，这场全面战争已经耗尽了俄罗斯社会的精力。随着每一次艰苦的地面进攻，死亡人数一直在增加，尽管唐纳德·特朗普总统向基辅施压要求达成协议，但冲突仍看不到尽头。

paras.en: The leak from Russia’s state statistics agency, Rosstat — released by Belarusian and Ukrainian hackers earlier this month — reveals that at least 490,000 Russian soldiers had been killed in Ukraine based on registered deaths as of the end of September. That’s according to breakdowns by a range of independent media, including the BBC and others, that were published this week. But one exiled Russian media outlet, Meduza, also used the leaked mortality data to project the total number of military deaths, including those that have not yet been recorded.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，白俄罗斯和乌克兰黑客发布了俄罗斯国家统计机构 Rosstat 的泄密信息，显示截至 9 月底，至少有 49 万名俄罗斯士兵在乌克兰被杀。这是根据包括 BBC 等在内的一系列独立媒体本周发布的细分数据得出的。但一家流亡的俄罗斯媒体 Meduza 也利用泄露的死亡率数据来预测军人死亡总数，包括尚未记录的死亡人数。

paras.en: Meduza estimates that number to be 720,000.
paras.zh: Meduza 估计这个数字为 720,000。

paras.en: NBC News did not have access to the leaked data and could not authenticate it or independently confirm these numbers.
paras.zh: NBC News无法访问泄露的数据，也无法对其进行验证或独立确认这些数字。

paras.en: Neither Moscow nor Kyiv provide regular updates on their battlefield losses.
paras.zh: 莫斯科和基辅都没有定期更新其战场损失情况。

paras.en: Mediazona, along with the BBC Russian Service and a team of volunteers, has been compiling a separate named list of Russian war dead using open-source data for years, given the difficulty of gauging the true impact of the war on Russian society.
paras.zh: 鉴于难以衡量战争对俄罗斯社会的真正影响，Mediazona 与 BBC 俄罗斯台和一组志愿者多年来一直在使用开源数据编制一份单独的俄罗斯战争死难者名单。

paras.en: In its analysis, Mediazona said it arrived at the 490,000 war dead number from the 29.7 million records it obtained from the hackers that covered nearly all death registrations in Russia from early 2021 through September this year, based mainly on records with an “explicit military cause of death” and court rulings declaring people dead.
paras.zh: Mediazona 在分析中表示，它从黑客处获得的 2970 万条记录中得出了 49 万人的战争死亡人数，这些记录几乎涵盖了俄罗斯从 2021 年初到今年 9 月的所有死亡登记，主要依据的是“明确的军事死因”记录和宣布死亡的法院裁决。

paras.en: The leaked data was cross-checked against Mediazona’s own named list and matched 95% of the records, as well as the publicly accessible national Probate Registry, a database of inheritance cases, and Rosstat’s own official mortality statistics, the outlet said.
paras.zh: 该媒体称，泄露的数据与 Mediazona 自己的名单、可公开访问的国家遗嘱认证登记处、继承案件数据库以及 Rosstat 自己的官方死亡率统计数据进行了交叉核对，并与 95% 的记录相匹配。

paras.en: Mediazona said it also checked against possible data tempering and fake military death injections by cross-referencing a unique vital record number that every death registration carries, and court rulings, which often cite death record numbers.
paras.zh: Mediazona 表示，它还通过交叉引用每个死亡登记所携带的独特生命记录编号以及法院裁决（通常引用死亡记录编号）来检查可能的数据篡改和虚假的军事死亡注射。

paras.en: “We are confident that this data is genuine,” the outlet said, adding that fabricating a dataset of this scale from scratch would be “impossible” especially as it checks out against official registries.
paras.zh: 该媒体表示：“我们相信这些数据是真实的。”他补充说，从头开始制作如此规模的数据集是“不可能的”，尤其是在与官方登记处进行核对时。

paras.en: The hackers shared leaked data with a number of other exiled Russian media outlets and the BBC, who all arrived at a figure close to the 490,000 reported by Mediazona. A similar estimate of half a million Russian troops killed was also shared by a senior British defense official in September.
paras.zh: 黑客与其他一些流亡的俄罗斯媒体和 BBC 分享了泄露的数据，这些媒体得出的数据接近 Mediazona 报道的 49 万。 9月份，一位英国高级国防官员也做出了类似的估计，有50万俄罗斯士兵被杀。

paras.en: Before the new analysis of the data in the Rosstat leak, the verified named list of Russia’s war dead compiled by Mediazona and the BBC stood at just over 289,000. It was based on obituaries, local news and official registries, and was the only publicly available database containing the fallen soldiers’ names.
paras.zh: 在对 Rosstat 泄露的数据进行新分析之前，Mediazona 和 BBC 编制的经核实的俄罗斯战死者名单刚刚超过 289,000 人。它基于讣告、当地新闻和官方登记，是唯一包含阵亡士兵姓名的公开数据库。

paras.en: The Russian Defense Ministry has not officially updated its death toll in Ukraine since the early months of the war, when then-Defense Minister Sergei Shoigu said it stood at nearly 6,000.
paras.zh: 自战争爆发的最初几个月以来，俄罗斯国防部一直没有正式更新乌克兰境内的死亡人数，当时时任国防部长谢尔盖·绍伊古称乌克兰死亡人数接近 6,000 人。

paras.en: Mediazona warned that due to a considerable lag in military death registrations, Rosstat may not yet have finished capturing deaths from 2025. “That means the leaked records through late September — however authentic and reliable they are — still fall short of the true death toll,” it said.
paras.zh: Mediazona 警告说，由于军事死亡登记存在相当大的滞后性，Rosstat 可能尚未完成 2025 年以来的死亡人数统计。“这意味着截至 9 月底的泄露记录——无论它们多么真实可靠——仍然低于真实的死亡人数，”它说。

paras.en: It was this that prompted Meduza to try and calculate an estimate of total Russian losses to date — 720,000 people, a figure that includes deaths it predicts will be registered later.
paras.zh: 正是这一点促使 Meduza 尝试计算迄今为止俄罗斯总损失的估计数——72 万人，其中包括预计稍后登记的死亡人数。

paras.en: “Since 2024, the share of late registrations has grown dramatically, and it continues to rise,” the outlet said in its own analysis, adding that the 2026 data is extremely incomplete for both missing service members and other military deaths. It said it used epidemiology and tools like the “chain-ladder method” from actuarial science, which uses mathematics to help measure the probability and risk of future events, to arrive at the projected estimate. These methods allowed Meduza to calculate the number of military deaths that it estimates have happened but haven’t yet shown up in the data, the outlet said.
paras.zh: 该媒体在自己的分析中表示：“自 2024 年以来，延迟登记的比例急剧增加，而且还在继续上升。”并补充说，2026 年的数据对于失踪军人和其他军人死亡来说都极其不完整。该公司表示，它使用了流行病学和精算科学中的“链梯法”等工具，利用数学来帮助衡量未来事件的概率和风险，以得出预计的估计。该媒体称，这些方法使 Meduza 能够计算出其估计已发生但尚未显示在数据中的军人死亡人数。

paras.en: “Today, it’s simply impossible to leave this category out of an overall estimate of the dead,” it added.
paras.zh: 报告补充说：“今天，根本不可能将这一类别排除在对死亡人数的总体估计之外。”

paras.en: The Kremlin dismissed the analysis Wednesday.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫周三驳回了这一分析。

paras.en: “The only department authorized to officially release data on casualties is the Ministry of Defense of the Russian Federation,” spokesman Dmitry Peskov told NBC News during a call with reporters, when asked if the Kremlin was aware of the 700,000 projected estimate by Meduza.
paras.zh: 当被问及克里姆林宫是否知道 Meduza 预计的 70 万人伤亡时，发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫 (Dmitry Peskov) 在与记者通话时告诉 NBC 新闻：“唯一有权正式发布伤亡数据的部门是俄罗斯联邦国防部。”

paras.en: “I suggest disregarding any other data,” he added.
paras.zh: “我建议忽略任何其他数据，”他补充道。

paras.en: It is similarly difficult to ascertain the true number of Ukrainian soldiers killed fighting against Russia. Kyiv has been slightly more forthcoming, with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy volunteering some estimates of battlefield losses in recent years, the latest in July putting the total at around 50,000 killed.
paras.zh: 同样难以确定在与俄罗斯的战斗中阵亡的乌克兰士兵的真实人数。基辅的态度稍显坦诚，总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基(Volodymyr Zelenskyy)自愿提供了对近年来战场损失的一些估计，最近一次是在7月，死亡总数约为5万人。

paras.en: But analysts say this is likely an undercount.
paras.zh: 但分析人士表示，这可能是低估的。

paras.en: An assessment by the Washington-based Center for Strategic and International Studies earlier this year said up to 150,000 Ukrainian soldiers have been killed, based on estimates from Britain’s military, Mediazona’s named war dead list, its own estimates and interviews with U.S., European, Ukrainian and other government officials.
paras.zh: 总部位于华盛顿的战略与国际研究中心今年早些时候的一项评估称，根据英国军方的估计、Mediazona 公布的战争死亡名单、该中心自己的估计以及对美国、欧洲、乌克兰和其他政府官员的采访，多达 15 万名乌克兰士兵被杀。

articles.title: A rising political star in China is the latest victim of Xi’s purge
articles.author: Max Burman

paras.en: He was on the rise among China’s political elite, hosting tech leaders and senior American officials. But now Shanghai party chief Chen Jining, a member of the country’s influential politburo, appears to be the latest senior official brought down by President Xi Jinping’s sweeping purge.
paras.zh: 他在中国政治精英中崭露头角，接待过科技领袖和美国高级官员。但现在，具有影响力的中国政治局委员、上海市委书记陈吉宁似乎是习近平主席全面清洗下台的最新一位高级官员。

paras.en: The hammer unexpectedly came down on Chen in the form of a two-line bulletin on the Xinhua news agency Tuesday: He is “suspected of serious violations of Party discipline and law and is currently under disciplinary review and supervisory investigation” — a common euphemism for corruption crackdowns on ruling Communist Party officials under Xi.
paras.zh: 新华社周二发布的两行公报出人意料地对陈进行了打击：他“涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受纪律审查和监察调查”——这是习近平领导下的反腐败行动的常见委婉说法。

paras.en: Public announcements such as these usually mark the end of a political career in China. Chen has made no public statement.
paras.zh: 诸如此类的公开声明通常标志着中国政治生涯的结束。陈没有发表公开声明。

paras.en: He is the fourth politburo member to be purged in less than two years, part of a broader crackdown that has swept aside top military leaders as Xi consolidates power. He is set to extend his rule next year, at a party congress that is held once every five years and looms over the preceding months.
paras.zh: He is the fourth politburo member to be purged in less than two years, part of a broader crackdown that has swept aside top military leaders as Xi consolidates power.他计划在明年召开的党代表大会上延长他的统治，党代表大会每五年举行一次，并在前几个月举行。

paras.en: But Chen’s abrupt downfall took many close observers of China by surprise, given his profile and career path would usually point to a bright future.
paras.zh: 但陈的突然垮台让许多密切关注中国的观察人士感到惊讶，因为他的个人资料和职业道路通常预示着光明的未来。

paras.en: “He was potentially going to the highest level, which would be the standing committee. And I think from a lot of Western observers, people thought he had even better prospects,” Damien Ma, the Singapore-based director of the Carnegie China think tank, told NBC News.
paras.zh: “他有可能晋升到最高级别，即常务委员会。我认为，从很多西方观察家的角度来看，人们认为他有更好的前景，”卡内基中国智囊团驻新加坡主任马达明告诉美国全国广播公司新闻。

paras.en: Some analysts have speculated that Xi, increasingly viewed as likely to rule for life, may have been purging a viable replacement. Steve Tsang, director of the SOAS China Institute in London, said however that Chen was “someone who could rise further but not as a successor.”
paras.zh: 一些分析人士推测，越来越被认为有可能实现终身统治的习近平可能正在清除一个可行的替代者。然而，伦敦亚非学院中国研究所所长曾锐生表示，陈是“可以进一步晋升的人，但不是接班人”。

paras.en: Chen, a 62-year-old technocrat known as a friend of foreign business and an advocate for AI, was an environmental scientist who studied in London and swiftly rose through the party’s ranks. He served as China’s environmental minister, Beijing’s mayor and the party secretary in Shanghai — a post once held by Xi and widely considered a stepping stone to bigger things.
paras.zh: 陈是一位 62 岁的技术官僚，被誉为外国企业的朋友和人工智能的倡导者，他是一位环境科学家，曾在伦敦学习并迅速在党内晋升。他曾担任中国环境部部长、北京市市长和上海市委书记——习近平曾担任过这一职位，并被广泛认为是实现更大目标的垫脚石。

paras.en: Just last month, Chen hosted Apple Chairman Tim Cook, welcoming the U.S. tech giant to “make full use of Shanghai’s strengths” and bring more products to the city, a financial and cultural hub that has long served as a connection between China and the international community.
paras.zh: 就在上个月，陈云接待了苹果公司董事长蒂姆·库克，欢迎这家美国科技巨头“充分利用上海的优势”，为这座长期作为中国与国际社会联系的金融和文化中心的城市带来更多产品。

paras.en: In his last public appearance last week, during a tour of a shipping facility, Chen called for advancing the industry’s digital transformation.
paras.zh: 在上周视察一家航运设施时，陈吉宁在最后一次公开露面中呼吁推进该行业的数字化转型。

paras.en: By Wednesday, Chen’s name has been removed from some official websites. A webpage on the Shanghai government site showing that meeting with Cook is now showing a 404 message, or not found.
paras.zh: 截至周三，陈的名字已从一些官方网站上删除。上海市政府网站上显示与库克会面的网页现在显示404消息，或者没有找到。

paras.en: Chen is just the latest senior official in the crosshairs of Xi’s long-running anti-corruption campaign and emphasis on party discipline, which analysts say is as much about loyalty as it is about reform.
paras.zh: 陈只是习近平长期反腐运动和强调党纪的最新一位高级官员，分析人士表示，这既关乎改革，也关乎忠诚。

paras.en: “It is a warning to all technocrats, as Chen was a rising star among technocrats and had no apparent failures in a technocratic way. So, message is: adhere to strict party discipline and demonstrate unquestionable loyalty to Xi or else,” Tsang said.
paras.zh: “这是对所有技术官僚的警告，因为陈是技术官僚中的后起之秀，在技术官僚方面没有明显的失败。因此，传达的信息是：遵守严格的党纪，并对习近平或其他人表现出毫无疑问的忠诚，”曾荫权说。

paras.en: The party’s Central Committee, which has about 200 mostly male leaders, vowed to “ensure more rigorous discipline enforcement, and make full use of discipline as a guide, restraint, guarantee, and incentive” at its closed-door gathering, the fifth plenum, last month.
paras.zh: 由约200名主要领导人组成的党中央在上个月举行的五中全会闭门会议上誓言要“更加严格执行纪律，充分发挥纪律的引领作用、约束作用、保障作用和激励作用”。

paras.en: “What they’ve been building as part of this discipline machine over the last 15 years is to kind of implement their sort of internal operating system of how they deal with, let’s say, bad eggs within the party,” Ma, of Carnegie China, said.
paras.zh: 卡内基中国的马云表示：“过去 15 年里，他们一直在建立一套纪律机制，以实施他们如何处理党内坏蛋的内部操作系统。”

paras.en: “The top leadership is normalizing this anti-corruption, this self-cleansing,” Ma said. “It is now a normal part of what the party expects, and they’re trying to embed that over time and down to every single level,” he added.
paras.zh: 马云表示：“最高领导层正在将这种反腐败、这种自我净化常态化。” “现在，这是党期望的正常部分，他们正试图随着时间的推移将其融入到各个层面，”他补充道。

paras.en: The Chinese government has not announced any charges against Chen, who was the youngest member of the country’s elite decision-making body. The 24-member Politburo was unveiled in 2022 but is now down to 21 members after the purges. Last month, top general Zhang Shengmin was elevated to the body in a rare addition.
paras.zh: 中国政府尚未宣布对陈提出任何指控，他是中国精英决策机构中最年轻的成员。由 24 名成员组成的政治局于 2022 年揭晓，但在清洗后目前已减少至 21 名。上个月，最高将领张胜民罕见地晋升为正职。

paras.en: Chen’s undoing comes a year before the party’s top leadership is reshuffled at the 21st Communist Party Congress, when Xi is expected to solidify control even further and cement another five-year term at the helm of the country.
paras.zh: 陈的下台发生在中共第二十一次全国代表大会上对党的最高领导层进行改组的一年前，届时习近平预计将进一步巩固控制权，并巩固国家的另一个五年任期。

paras.en: Born in 1964, Chen studied at the prestigious Tsinghua university, long a major pipeline for senior party officials and where he served as president from 2012 to 2015. His name has now been removed from Tsinghua’s online list of former presidents.
paras.zh: 陈出生于 1964 年，曾就读于著名的清华大学，清华大学长期以来一直是党的高级官员的主要培养人才，并于 2012 年至 2015 年担任校长。他的名字现已从清华大学的在线前校长名单中删除。

paras.en: After studying at Tsinghua in the 1980s, he moved for a decade to Britain, where he obtained a doctorate from Imperial College London in 1993.
paras.zh: 20世纪80年代在清华大学学习后，他移居英国十年，并于1993年在伦敦帝国理工学院获得博士学位。

paras.en: Chen returned to Tsinghua’s environmental science and engineering department in 1998 before being named the university’s president in 2012, according to an official biography.
paras.zh: 据官方传记称，陈于 1998 年回到清华大学环境科学与工程系，并于 2012 年被任命为清华大学校长。

paras.en: He’s authored dozens of papers, including on carbon emission reduction and water quality monitoring.
paras.zh: 他撰写了数十篇论文，包括有关碳减排和水质监测的论文。

paras.en: The relatively young Chen would ride around campus on his bike and built a reputation for pushing institutional reforms in his three years at the helm of the university, according to an article in People’s Digest, a magazine affiliated with the People’s Daily, the community party’s official newspaper.
paras.zh: 据共产党官方报纸《人民日报》旗下杂志《人民文摘》上的一篇文章称，相对年轻的陈经常骑着自行车在校园里骑车，并在执掌大学的三年里因推动体制改革而建立了声誉。

paras.en: The article, titled “From University President to Cabinet Minister,” was published in 2015, the same year he was picked to lead the Environmental Protection Ministry. In 2017, Chen became mayor of the capital, Beijing, where he oversaw the 2022 Winter Olympics during the Covid pandemic.
paras.zh: 这篇题为《从大学校长到内阁部长》的文章发表于 2015 年，同年他被选为环境保护部部长。 2017年，陈就任首都北京市市长，并在新冠病毒大流行期间监督了2022年冬季奥运会的举办。

paras.en: Later that year he was transferred to Shanghai and became the party chief, a coveted role that Xi took on himself in 2007 before becoming the country’s leader in 2013.
paras.zh: 同年晚些时候，他被调到上海，成为市委书记，这是习近平在 2013 年成为国家领导人之前于 2007 年亲自担任的令人垂涎的职位。

paras.en: There, he became heavily involved with the tech industry, regularly hosting CEOs and advocating for more investment into Shanghai, where the World AI Conference was hosted earlier this year.
paras.zh: 在那里，他积极参与科技行业，定期接待首席执行官，并倡导对今年早些时候举办世界人工智能大会的上海进行更多投资。

paras.en: Chen hosted Elon Musk in 2023 to discuss Tesla’s operations in the city. Last year, he accompanied Xi to an AI hub there. And last month, Chen met with several European tech leaders, in addition to hosting Cook.
paras.zh: 2023 年，陈接待了埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk)，讨论特斯拉在该市的运营情况。 Last year, he accompanied Xi to an AI hub there.上个月，陈除了接待库克外，还会见了几位欧洲科技领袖。

paras.en: Alongside the top post in Shanghai, Chen also was elected for a five-year term as a member of the Politburo, China’s elite decision-making body headed by Xi.
paras.zh: 除了上海的最高职位之外，陈还当选为中央政治局委员，任期五年，中央政治局是由习近平领导的中国精英决策机构。

paras.en: While the Politburo is not the absolute apex of power, he was seen as a contender the much-smaller Politburo’s Standing Committee, which is made up of the country’s highest ranking officials.
paras.zh: 虽然政治局并不是绝对的权力最高层，但他被视为规模小得多的政治局常务委员会的竞争者，该常务委员会由该国最高级别的官员组成。

paras.en: “If you’re party secretary of one of the four big municipalities, Beijing, Shanghai, Chongqing and Tianjin, you have pretty good prospects. That’s sort of an indication that you’re on your way up,” Ma said.
paras.zh: “如果你是北京、上海、重庆和天津这四大直辖市之一的党委书记，你的前景相当不错。这在某种程度上表明您正在步入高位。”马说。

paras.en: Whether or not Chen’s ousting deals a blow to the country’s technology ambitions and its race for dominance in artificial intelligence, remains to be seen, Ma said. But either way, his downfall will force a rethink among those seeking to predict the route to power in modern China.
paras.zh: 马说，陈一舟的下台是否会对中国的科技雄心及其在人工智能领域的霸主地位之争造成打击，还有待观察。但无论如何，他的倒台都将迫使那些试图预测现代中国掌权之路的人重新思考。

paras.en: “Part of it is thinking through what is really the new criteria to get to the top, and they may not be what we thought just a few months ago,” Ma added.
paras.zh: 马云补充道：“其中一部分是思考登上顶峰的真正新标准是什么，它们可能与我们几个月前的想法不同。”

articles.title: Copper theft costing SEQ ratepayers a small fortune
articles.author: Ellen-Maree Elliot

paras.en: Brisbane, Ipswich, Logan, Redland and Moreton Bay City councils are experiencing a rise in copper thefts, with incidents in one area quadrupling from the year before.
paras.zh: 布里斯班、伊普斯威奇、洛根、雷德兰和莫顿湾市议会的铜盗窃案正在增加，其中一个地区的案件比前一年增加了四倍。

paras.en: Copper thefts cost ratepayers about $1.7 million last financial year.
paras.zh: 上一财年，铜盗窃给纳税人造成了约 170 万美元的损失。

paras.en: Councils are replacing stolen copper wire with aluminium cables and hope new state government legislation will make a difference.
paras.zh: 议会正在用铝电缆替换被盗的铜线，并希望新的州政府立法能够发挥作用。

paras.en: Bikeways, neighbourhood streets, sporting fields, and community facilities are being plunged into darkness across south-east Queensland as copper thefts cost ratepayers about $1.7 million last financial year.
paras.zh: 上一财年，铜盗窃案给纳税人造成了约 170 万澳元的损失，昆士兰州东南部的自行车道、社区街道、运动场和社区设施正陷入黑暗。

paras.en: Brisbane, Ipswich, Logan, Redland and Moreton Bay City councils are experiencing a big rise in copper thefts, with incidents in one area quadrupling from the year before.
paras.zh: 布里斯班、伊普斯威奇、洛根、雷德兰和莫顿湾市议会的铜盗窃案大幅增加，其中一个地区的案件比前一年增加了四倍。

paras.en: The Greater Brisbane councils are being forced to replace the stolen copper with aluminium cabling, and at least one is even considering proactive replacements to prevent thefts.
paras.zh: 大布里斯班议会被迫用铝布线替换被盗的铜缆，至少有一个议会甚至正在考虑主动更换以防止盗窃。

paras.en: It comes as the Queensland government accelerates rectification works through a $40 million investment and progresses legislation to disrupt the theft and sale of stolen scrap metal.
paras.zh: 与此同时，昆士兰州政府投资 4000 万澳元加速整顿工作，并推进立法以打击盗窃和销售被盗废金属的行为。

paras.en: Brisbane darkness takes away 'feeling of safety'
paras.zh: 布里斯班的黑暗带走了“安全感”

paras.en: Brisbane City Council had 44 copper cable thefts in 2025–26, more than double the 15 in 2024–25, with estimated repairs costing a whopping $1.2 million.
paras.zh: 布里斯班市议会在 2025-26 年发生了 44 起铜缆盗窃案，是 2024-25 年 15 起的两倍多，估计维修费用高达 120 万澳元。

paras.en: Infrastructure chair Ryan Murphy (LNP) said the 2025–26 thefts spanned parks, sports fields and public spaces, and the council was installing CCTV in high-risk locations.
paras.zh: 基础设施主席 Ryan Murphy (LNP) 表示，2025-26 年的盗窃事件遍及公园、运动场和公共场所，该委员会正在高风险地点安装闭路电视。

paras.en: He said 17 thefts from the past financial year are still awaiting repair, with most expected to be complete by March next year.
paras.zh: 他表示，上一财年发生的 17 起盗窃案仍在等待修复，大部分预计将于明年 3 月完成。

paras.en: "Right now, we've got 109 lights out across the city, in Rochedale, Calamvale, Boondall, Deagon, Carina, Wynnum, there's no rhyme or reason to where these copper thieves strike," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“目前，全市有 109 盏灯熄灭，包括罗奇代尔 (Rochedale)、卡拉姆维尔 (Calamvale)、邦德尔 (Boondall)、迪根 (Deagon)、卡里纳 (Carina)、温纳姆 (Wynnum)，这些铜窃贼的袭击地点没有任何规律或理由。”

paras.en: "Copper theft has been happening on and off since 2023, but the rise of copper theft has tracked pretty neatly with the rise of the copper price.
paras.zh: “自 2023 年以来，铜盗窃事件时断时续地发生，但铜盗窃案的增加与铜价的上涨非常一致。

paras.en: "As organised crime makes this a focus of their money-making schemes, there are also other people opportunistically copying."
paras.zh: “由于有组织犯罪将其作为他们赚钱计划的焦点，因此也有其他人伺机复制。”

paras.en: He said there was a particular problem of bikeways and paths, which had less surveillance than community facilities.
paras.zh: 他说，自行车道和小路存在一个特殊的问题，它们的监控比社区设施少。

paras.en: "Some paths are really important local connections between schools, businesses, public transport and losing the lights takes away that feeling of safety, particularly for people using public transport to get home in the evening," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“有些道路是学校、企业、公共交通之间非常重要的当地连接，失去灯光会让人失去安全感，特别是对于晚上使用公共交通回家的人来说。”

paras.en: He said that, as well as the direct cost of replacing the copper wire with aluminium cables, there was the indirect cost of delayed new projects.
paras.zh: 他说，除了用铝电缆取代铜线的直接成本外，还有新项目推迟的间接成本。

paras.en: "We don't want to have these lighting sites become an ATM for copper thieves. We want them to have so much less value that thieves won't bother going back,"
paras.zh: “我们不想让这些照明地点成为铜窃贼的自动提款机。我们希望它们的价值大大降低，以至于窃贼不会再费心回去。”

paras.en: "We'll also likely start proactively replacing copper on the city's bikeways with aluminium. It's something we've thought about, but it's not something we'd like to do.
paras.zh: “我们也可能会开始主动用铝取代城市自行车道上的铜。这是我们考虑过的事情，但这不是我们愿意做的事情。

paras.en: "It's not an upgrade. The best thing we could do is leave the copper that's in existing lights in place."
paras.zh: “这不是升级。我们能做的最好的事情就是保留现有灯中的铜。”

paras.en: Developers using aluminium wire in new builds
paras.zh: 开发商在新建建筑中使用铝线

paras.en: Ipswich Mayor Teresa Harding said the council had already spent more than $100,000 on copper streetlight theft in the 2025–26 financial year up to April.
paras.zh: 伊普斯威奇市长Teresa Harding表示，截至4月，市政厅已在2025–26财年因路灯铜线被盗而花费超过10万澳元。

paras.en: "Over the past five years, that figure has exceeded $1.25 million," she said.
paras.zh: “在过去的五年里，这个数字已经超过了 125 万美元，”她说。

paras.en: "Council is fighting back against copper thefts by progressively replacing copper streetlight cabling with aluminium, and we're already seeing positive results.
paras.zh: “市议会正在通过逐步用铝取代铜路灯电缆来打击铜盗窃行为，我们已经看到了积极的成果。

paras.en: "Developers are also increasingly using aluminium cabling in new estates from the outset, which has helped reduce thefts in areas that were previously being targeted repeatedly."
paras.zh: “开发商也越来越多地从一开始就在新楼盘中使用铝质电缆，这有助于减少此前屡屡成为目标的区域的盗窃事件。”

paras.en: She said while this was helping, thieves were still targeting isolated copper cable sections, with recent thefts from Mount Juillerat Drive in Redbank Plains, and repeated thefts in some of the newer estates in Redbank Plains.
paras.zh: 她说，虽然这有所帮助，但窃贼仍然以孤立的铜缆部分为目标，最近在雷德班克平原的朱勒拉特山大道上发生了盗窃事件，并且在雷德班克平原的一些较新的庄园中也多次发生盗窃事件。

paras.en: Cr Harding said people attempting to steal copper were often accessing or cutting into live electrical infrastructure and placing themselves in "serious danger".
paras.zh: 哈丁议员表示，试图窃取铜的人经常接触或切断带电的电力基础设施，并将自己置于“严重危险”之中。

paras.en: "To help reduce that risk, council has installed signage in a number of locations identifying where aluminium cabling has been installed," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“为了帮助降低这种风险，市政府在多个地点安装了标牌，标明铝制电缆的安装位置。”

paras.en: Earlier this year, in March, a man in Toowoomba attempted to steal copper wire from an Ergon Energy site and received life-threatening injuries; the irony was that there was no copper wire, only aluminium.
paras.zh: 今年 3 月初，图文巴的一名男子试图从 Ergon Energy 站点偷铜线，结果受伤，危及生命；讽刺的是，没有铜线，只有铝线。

paras.en: Logan copper thefts quadruple in just one year
paras.zh: 洛根铜盗窃案在短短一年内翻了四倍

paras.en: In Logan City, copper thefts from streetlights more than quadrupled from three incidents costing $53,379.61 in 2024–25, to 13 in 2025–26 costing $234,633.88.
paras.zh: 在洛根市，路灯铜盗窃案增加了四倍多，从 2024-25 年发生的 3 起事件（损失 53,379.61 美元）增至 2025-26 年的 13 起事件（损失 234,633.88 美元）。

paras.en: Redland City Council has spent more than $152,000 on copper wiring theft from pathways and sports fields in 2025–26 and this financial year.
paras.zh: 雷德兰市议会在 2025-26 财年和本财年花费了超过 152,000 美元用于处理道路和运动场的铜线盗窃问题。

paras.en: "Council now installs aluminium cabling instead of copper cabling at sports fields and uses lockable electrical pits for pathway lighting," a spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 一位发言人表示：“市议会现在在运动场上安装铝电缆而不是铜电缆，并使用可上锁的电坑作为通道照明。”

paras.en: A Moreton Bay spokesman said the council had spent about $500,000 on copper wire theft since 2021.
paras.zh: 莫顿湾发言人表示，自 2021 年以来，该委员会已在铜线盗窃案上花费了约 50 万美元。

paras.en: "This obviously does not consider the costs incurred by clubs, schools, shopping centres and the like across City of Moreton Bay who have also paid for repairs or received insurance payouts," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这显然没有考虑莫顿湾市俱乐部、学校、购物中心等机构所产生的费用，这些机构也支付了维修费用或收到了保险赔付。”

paras.en: "City of Moreton Bay welcomes the recent passing of new state anti-copper theft laws following councils' push for legislative change."
paras.zh: “在议会推动立法改革之后，莫顿湾市欢迎最近通过新的州反铜盗窃法。”

paras.en: Hundreds of thefts on Queensland-owned roads
paras.zh: 昆士兰州道路上发生数百起盗窃案

paras.en: Multiple councils noted they did not control all streetlights in their local government areas, with many of them the responsibility of Energex or the Department of Transport and Main Roads.
paras.zh: 多个议会指出，他们并没有控制当地政府区域内的所有路灯，其中许多路灯由 Energex 或交通和主要道路部负责。

paras.en: Throughout Queensland, more than 350 incidents of copper theft affected lighting on state-owned roads from July 2024 to June 2026.
paras.zh: 2024年7月至2026年6月，整个昆士兰州发生了350多起铜盗窃事件，影响了国有道路的照明。

paras.en: A Transport and Main Roads spokesperson said: "The Queensland government is committed to cracking down on metal theft, recently passing legislation that delivers stronger protections, tougher enforcement powers and increased penalties for those committing copper theft."
paras.zh: 交通和主要道路发言人表示：“昆士兰州政府致力于打击金属盗窃行为，最近通过了立法，为铜盗窃行为提供更强有力的保护、更严厉的执法权力和更严厉的处罚。”

articles.title: Renegades WBBL player bowled without facing a ball

paras.en: The Melbourne Renegades have pipped Brisbane Heat by three wickets in a last-ball thriller highlighted by a bizarre diamond duck to Deandra Dottin.
paras.zh: 墨尔本叛徒队在最后一球惊心动魄的比赛中以三个三柱门击败了布里斯班热火队，迪安德拉·多丁 (Deandra Dottin) 的奇异钻石鸭让比赛更加精彩。

paras.en: Chasing 138, Dottin came in at 4-97 and was adjusting her helmet strap and was gloveless on arrival at the crease outside the allotted 75 seconds time limit.
paras.zh: 追赶 138 杆的多丁以 4 比 97 的成绩进入比赛，当时她正在调整头盔带，在规定的 75 秒时间限制之外到达折痕处时没有戴手套。

paras.en: She was ordered by umpires to stand aside while Heat spinner Sarah Glenn had a free bowl at the stumps. She was on target and Dottin departed without facing a ball.
paras.zh: 裁判员命令她靠边站，而热火旋转队的莎拉·格伦则在树桩上获得了一个免费的碗。她击中目标，多丁没有面对球就离开了。

paras.en: The drama preceded a tense final over when the Renegades required nine runs from Lucy Hamilton's bowling.
paras.zh: 这场闹剧发生在一场紧张的决赛之前，当时叛徒队要求露西·汉密尔顿的保龄球得九分。

paras.en: Annie Wikman smacked the first ball for four, and five singles followed, including Wikman's winning run from an inside edge.
paras.zh: 安妮·威克曼 (Annie Wikman) 打出了第一个球，打出了四分，随后又打出五次单打，其中包括威克曼在内线的制胜分。

paras.en: Tess Flintoff top-scored in the chase with 30 from 32 balls and Georgia Wareham made a valuable 29 from 26 against a Heat bowling attack led by Glenn's 2-15 and Sienna Ginger's 2-13.
paras.zh: 苔丝·弗林托夫 (Tess Flintoff) 在这场追逐中以 32 球中的 30 分获得最高分，乔治亚·韦勒姆 (Georgia Wareham) 在格伦 (Glenn) 2-15 和西耶娜·金格 (Sienna Ginger) 2-13 领先的热火保龄球进攻中，26 球中拿下宝贵的 29 分。

paras.en: The Renegades (nine points) replaced the Heat (eight points) in fourth spot and, if they beat the Melbourne Stars on Saturday, will feature in the finals.
paras.zh: 叛徒队（9分）取代热火队（8分）排名第四，如果他们在周六击败墨尔本星队，将进入决赛。

paras.en: Renegades captain Sophie Molineux was instrumental in Wednesday night's win at Melbourne's Junction Oval, taking 4-20.
paras.zh: Renegades队队长Sophie Molineux在周三晚于墨尔本Junction Oval举行的比赛中发挥了关键作用，以4-20的成绩帮助球队取胜。

paras.en: Earlier, Molineux produced her superb bowling spell to stymie the Heat batters.
paras.zh: 早些时候，莫利纽克斯用她出色的保龄球咒语阻碍了热火队的击球手。

paras.en: The Australian captain claimed a wicket in her first over, bowling dangerous opener Grace Harris for a golden duck, and another in her second.
paras.zh: 这位澳大利亚队长在她的第一轮比赛中就获得了一个三柱门，她向危险的揭幕战格雷斯·哈里斯投出了一只金鸭子，在她的第二轮比赛中又获得了一个三柱门。

paras.en: Molineux returned to bowl the 13th over and took two more wickets in three balls, while Orla Prendergast top-scored with 23 from 15 balls, and Lucy Hamilton (21 from 15) and Sienna Ginger (21 from 21) played handy knocks.
paras.zh: 莫利纽克斯在第 13 轮比赛中回归，并在三个球中再拿下两个三柱门，而奥拉·普伦德加斯特 (Orla Prendergast) 以 15 个球中的 23 个得分最高，露西·汉密尔顿 (15 个球中的 21 个) 和西耶娜·金格 (21 个球中的 21 个) 打得得心应手。

paras.en: Brisbane must now hope the Renegades are defeated by the Stars on Saturday to have any hope of reaching the play-offs.
paras.zh: 布里斯班现在必须希望叛徒队在周六被星队击败，才有希望进入附加赛。

paras.en: The Heat will know their fate by the time they host the Perth Scorchers on Sunday.
paras.zh: 当热火队在周日主场迎战珀斯热火队时，他们就会知道自己的命运。

paras.en: Sydney Thunder, on six points, remain the only other chance to reach the finals. They meet the finals-bound Adelaide Strikers on Thursday and the Sydney Sixers on Saturday.
paras.zh: 积六分的悉尼雷霆队仍然是唯一有机会进入决赛的球队。他们将在周四迎战即将进入决赛的阿德莱德前锋队，并在周六迎战悉尼七六人队。

paras.en: The Thunder must win both games but, even then, they're relying on the Renegades and Heat to both lose their respective last matches.
paras.zh: 雷霆队必须赢得两场比赛，但即便如此，他们仍依赖叛徒队和热火队输掉各自的最后一场比赛。

articles.title: Breaking: Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor dies aged 65

paras.en: Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of the 1980s English new wave band Duran Duran, has died aged 65.
paras.zh: 20 世纪 80 年代英国新浪潮乐队 Duran Duran 的原吉他手安迪·泰勒 (Andy Taylor) 去世，享年 65 岁。

paras.en: Taylor's death was confirmed by his family and bandmates in a statement posted on social media and Duran Duran's website.
paras.zh: 泰勒的家人和乐队成员在社交媒体和杜兰·杜兰的网站上发布的一份声明中证实了泰勒的去世。

paras.en: The band's pop hits include Hungry Like the Wolf. Its rise up the charts was inextricably linked to the launch of MTV.
paras.zh: 该乐队的流行歌曲包括《Hungry Like the Wolf》。它在排行榜上的崛起与MTV的推出有着千丝万缕的联系。

articles.title: NATO's No. 2 commander strikes different tone on Canada than Pentagon
articles.author: Murray Brewster

paras.en: NATO's No. 2 commander strikes different tone on Canada than Pentagon
paras.zh: 北约二号司令对加拿大的态度与五角大楼不同

paras.en: Deputy commander welcomes Canadian military investments, acknowledges alliance-wide challenges
paras.zh: 副司令欢迎加拿大军事投资，承认联盟范围内的挑战

paras.en: The deputy commander of NATO said he's happy with Canada's contribution to the Western allies' deterrence mission in Eastern Europe and offered qualified praise on Wednesday for the country's efforts to rebuild its forces.
paras.zh: 北约副司令表示，他对加拿大为西方盟国在东欧的威慑任务所做的贡献感到高兴，并于周三对该国重建部队的努力表示了有保留的赞扬。

paras.en: British Air Chief Marshal Sir John Stringer sat down with CBC News in Ottawa for an exclusive broadcast interview amid the ongoing political fight between the Pentagon and the government of Prime Minister Mark Carney over defence spending and military readiness.
paras.zh: 英国空军元帅约翰·斯金格爵士在渥太华接受了 CBC 新闻的独家广播采访，此时五角大楼与马克·卡尼首相的政府就国防开支和军事准备问题正在进行政治斗争。

paras.en: Senior officials at the U.S. Department of War have been waging an increasingly public campaign to force Canada to spend more on defence in the short term, saying the country is not meeting its NORAD and NATO commitments because of a poor readiness among its forces.
paras.zh: 美国陆军部高级官员一直在发动越来越多的公开运动，迫使加拿大在短期内增加国防开支，并表示，由于加拿大军队的战备状态不佳，该国没有履行其对北美防空司令部和北约的承诺。

paras.en: Separately, a senior U.S. Department of War official, speaking on background, warned the Pentagon was prepared to "up the ante" on recent restrictions it had imposed on interaction with the Canadian military unless Ottawa took Washington's concerns more seriously.
paras.zh: 另外，美国战争部一名高级官员在接受采访时警告说，五角大楼准备“加大赌注”，限制其最近与加拿大军方的互动，除非渥太华更认真地对待华盛顿的担忧。

paras.en: "I won't get drawn on what other nations may say," said Stringer.
paras.zh: “我不会关注其他国家可能会说什么，”斯金格说。

paras.en: "What I do look at in Canada now is a nation putting significant forces into Europe, most obviously, but not exclusively the multinational brigade in Latvia. I look at a nation that is recapitalizing its investments in its forces."
paras.zh: “我现在所看到的加拿大是一个向欧洲投入大量力量的国家，最明显的是，但不仅仅是拉脱维亚的多国旅。我看到的是一个正在对其部队投资进行资本重组的国家。”

paras.en: Asked directly whether he was satisfied with the readiness of the Canadian-led brigade in Latvia, Stringer responded: "I'm happy when I look at Canada."
paras.zh: 当被直接问及他对加拿大领导的拉脱维亚旅的准备情况是否满意时，斯金格回答说：“当我看到加拿大时，我很高兴。”

paras.en: At the moment, there are roughly 2,200 Canadian troops in Latvia with a plan to increase the number to 2,600 in the near term.
paras.zh: 目前，拉脱维亚约有2,200名加拿大军人，并计划在短期内将这一数字增加至2,600人。

paras.en: Aside from contributing a battle group, Canada serves as the commander of the 3,000-strong NATO multinational brigade, a deployment which Carney recently extended until 2031.
paras.zh: 除了派遣一个战斗群外，加拿大还担任 3000 人的北约多国旅的指挥官，卡尼最近将这一部署延长至 2031 年。

paras.en: The commitment to Operation Reassurance, according to the recent federal budget, will amount to $7 billion during that timeframe.
paras.zh: 根据最近的联邦预算，在此期间对“安心行动”的承诺将达到 70 亿美元。

paras.en: Canada isn't alone in terms of where it is on the curve of rebuilding its forces and is making the necessary investments, said Stringer, who is next in line to NATO Supreme Allied Commander Europe (SACEUR), U.S. Gen. Alexus Grynkewich.
paras.zh: 斯金格表示，加拿大并不是唯一一个正在重建军队并进行必要投资的国家。斯金格是北约欧洲盟军最高指挥官（SACEUR）的下一任美国将军亚历克苏斯·格林克维奇。

paras.en: "Everybody had that wonderful moment of — we won the Cold War and it created both physical disinvestment and it also created a bit of conceptual disinvestment," Stringer said.
paras.zh: “每个人都经历过这样的美妙时刻——我们赢得了冷战，它造成了物质上的投资减少，也造成了一些概念上的投资减少，”斯金格说。

paras.en: "A bunch of nations now are coming out of some relatively low spends and I look at Canada as one of those nations that's spending well."
paras.zh: “现在许多国家的支出都相对较低，我认为加拿大是支出良好的国家之一。”

paras.en: On Monday, the Pentagon publicly released a "fact sheet" that said Canada is not a credible defence partner and that military spending is unfocused. The document pointed to subpar Canadian military readiness statistics and deferred modernizations of key equipment.
paras.zh: 周一，五角大楼公开发布了一份“情况说明书”，称加拿大不是可信的国防伙伴，而且军费开支没有重点。该文件指出，加拿大的军事战备统计数据低于标准，关键装备的现代化也被推迟。

paras.en: "Ottawa's prioritization of parochial economic and commercial interests over military optimization introduces further uncertainty for NORAD and will further burden our Joint Force and the American taxpayer," the fact sheet said.
paras.zh: 情况说明书称：“渥太华将狭隘的经济和商业利益置于军事优化之上，这给北美防空司令部带来了进一步的不确定性，并将进一步加重我们的联合部队和美国纳税人的负担。”

paras.en: But Canada is hardly alone among NATO allies in struggling with military readiness, including the United States itself.
paras.zh: 但在北约盟国中，加拿大并不是唯一一个在军事准备方面苦苦挣扎的国家，其中也包括美国本身。

paras.en: The U.S. Government Accountability Office told Congress in March that American military readiness had deteriorated over the past two decades. Twenty-five of 27 types of its army and air force aircraft failed to meet their operational availability targets in 2024.
paras.zh: 美国政府问责办公室三月份告诉国会，美国的军事准备状态在过去二十年里有所恶化。其陆军和空军的 27 种型号飞机中有 25 种未能达到 2024 年的作战可用性目标。

paras.en: A separate audit, published in June, found the mission-capable rate for the American F-35 fleet had plunged from 67 per cent in 2021 to 44 per cent last year. Only 25 per cent were capable of performing all their assigned missions.
paras.zh: 6 月发布的另一项审计发现，美国 F-35 机队的执行任务率已从 2021 年的 67% 骤降至去年的 44%。只有 25% 的人能够执行所有分配给他们的任务。

paras.en: Senior U.S. Navy officials said last year that readiness across their fleet of ships, submarines and aircraft hovered between 67 and 70 per cent.
paras.zh: 美国海军高级官员去年表示，其舰艇、潜艇和飞机舰队的战备状态徘徊在 67% 至 70% 之间。

paras.en: Britain, meanwhile, refuses to publicly disclose detailed military readiness figures, citing national security. Parliamentary research published this year showed all three branches were below their trained personnel targets.
paras.zh: 与此同时，英国以国家安全为由，拒绝公开披露详细的军事准备数据。今年发布的议会研究显示，所有三个分支机构都低于其受过培训的人员目标。

paras.en: France has similarly restricted publication of readiness data. Its 2023 figures projected operational availability of 69 per cent for combat aircraft, 59 per cent for frigates and 87 per cent for battle tanks.
paras.zh: 法国也同样限制发布战备数据。其2023年的数据预计战斗机的作战可用性为69%，护卫舰的作战可用性为59%，主战坦克的作战可用性为87%。

paras.en: Germany has also classified detailed equipment readiness figures, making direct comparisons with Canada's military particularly difficult.
paras.zh: 德国还对详细的装备战备数据进行了分类，这使得与加拿大军队的直接比较变得特别困难。

paras.en: "If I look at where Canada is in that mix, it looks a lot like a lot of other nations," said Stringer.
paras.zh: “如果我看看加拿大在这个组合中的位置，它看起来很像许多其他国家，”斯金格说。

paras.en: "Readiness can always be improved. You can always be better tomorrow than you are today. And indeed that's one of the focuses we've got with all the nations in the alliance."
paras.zh: “准备工作总是可以提高的。明天总是可以比今天更好。事实上，这是我们与联盟中所有国家共同关注的焦点之一。”

paras.en: Going into a meeting of the Liberal caucus on Wednesday, the prime minister weighed in and dismissed the controversy with the Pentagon.
paras.zh: 周三，在参加自由党核心小组会议时，首相发表了意见并驳回了与五角大楼的争议。

paras.en: "I can assure you that in my discussions with the president of the United States, we're focused on conflict resolution around the world and he has not raised issues such as has been reported recently," Carney said.
paras.zh: 卡尼说：“我可以向你们保证，在我与美国总统的讨论中，我们的重点是解决世界各地的冲突，他没有提出最近报道的问题。”

paras.en: "Canada is taking responsibility for our defence. We're at the front lines of NATO's defence, Operation Reassurance in Latvia. We're working with our NATO partners, including the U.S. but very much with the Nordics — with Germany, with France — through the High North, the Arctic."
paras.zh: “加拿大正在为我们的国防承担责任。我们处于北约国防的前线，即拉脱维亚的保证行动。我们正在与包括美国在内的北约伙伴合作，但在很大程度上与北欧国家——与德国、法国——穿过高北地区、北极合作。”

paras.en: As Canada and the U.S. debate commitment and investment, Stringer and the rest of NATO's supreme command has focused on Russia's rising campaign of grey zone warfare in Europe.
paras.zh: 当加拿大和美国就承诺和投资进行辩论时，斯金格和北约最高指挥部的其他成员将注意力集中在俄罗斯在欧洲不断升级的灰色地带战争上。

paras.en: Last week, three Russian KH-101 cruise missiles crashed in southeastern Poland during a large-scale overnight Russian attack on Ukraine. There were no injuries or infrastructure damage. One missile landed about 35 kilometres from where troops from 11 allied countries were conducting military exercises to prepare for a potential postwar mission in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 上周，三枚俄罗斯 KH-101 巡航导弹在俄罗斯夜间大规模袭击乌克兰期间在波兰东南部坠毁。 There were no injuries or infrastructure damage.一枚导弹落在距离 11 个盟国军队正在进行军事演习的地方约 35 公里处，为可能在乌克兰执行的战后任务做准备。

paras.en: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk called the airspace violation an "intentional provocation" by Russia.
paras.zh: 波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克称此次侵犯领空事件是俄罗斯的“蓄意挑衅”。

paras.en: Stringer was not prepared to go that far, saying an investigation was still being conducted.
paras.zh: 斯金格不准备走那么远，称调查仍在进行中。

paras.en: "What we're really looking at is, why did they go there? And fundamentally … was it deliberate or was it accidental?" Stringer told CBC News.
paras.zh: “我们真正关心的是，他们为什么去那里？从根本上来说……这是故意的还是偶然的？” Stringer told CBC News.

paras.en: "And by the way, even if it's accidental, what does it tell us about a recklessness in warfare five years into their three-day special military operation?"
paras.zh: “顺便说一句，即使这是偶然的，但在为期三天的特别军事行动五年后，它告诉我们什么是鲁莽的战争行为？”

paras.en: He said Russia is always seeking to provoke. The question for NATO is how to respond.
paras.zh: 他说，俄罗斯总是寻求挑衅。北约面临的问题是如何应对。

paras.en: "What we don't need to do is do Mr. Putin's job for him by overreacting," Stringer said. "What we need to do is be calm and measured and resolute in the approach to provocations. And by the way, not every military act needs, even warrants, some form of military response."
paras.zh: “我们不需要做的是通过反应过度来为普京先生完成他的工作，”斯金格说。 “我们需要做的是在应对挑衅时保持冷静、谨慎和坚决。顺便说一句，并不是每一次军事行动都需要，甚至是必要的，某种形式的军事反应。”

articles.title: Canada partners with Qatar for consular services to Canadians in Afghanistan
articles.author: Dylan Robertson

paras.en: Canada partners with Qatar for consular services to Canadians in Afghanistan
paras.zh: 加拿大与卡塔尔合作，为阿富汗的加拿大人提供领事服务

paras.en: Qatar appointed 'protecting power' for Canada
paras.zh: 卡塔尔被任命为加拿大的“保护国”

paras.en: Qatar is partnering with Ottawa to provide consular services to Canadians in Afghanistan that have been unavailable since the Taliban retook the country five years ago.
paras.zh: 卡塔尔正在与渥太华合作，为在阿富汗的加拿大人提供领事服务，这些服务自五年前塔利班重新夺回该国以来一直无法提供。

paras.en: In Ottawa on Wednesday, Qatari officials signed an investment protection pact that had been discussed publicly for months.
paras.zh: 周三在渥太华，卡塔尔官员签署了一项已公开讨论数月的投资保护协议。

paras.en: The news release said the two countries also agreed to appoint Qatar as Canada's "protecting power" in Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，两国还同意任命卡塔尔作为加拿大在阿富汗的“保护国”。

paras.en: A protecting power is a country that acts on another country's behalf to offer consular services in places without a diplomatic mission.
paras.zh: 保护国是代表另一国在没有外交使团的地方提供领事服务的国家。

paras.en: Ottawa lists the Taliban as a terrorist organization and does not have an embassy in Kabul. The Taliban overthrew Afghanistan's government in August 2021 after the United States military pulled out of the country.
paras.zh: 渥太华将塔利班列为恐怖组织，并且在喀布尔没有大使馆。 2021 年 8 月，美国军队撤出阿富汗后，塔利班推翻了阿富汗政府。

paras.en: Canada has similar agreements with other countries — mostly democratic ones. Italy responds to Canadian consular cases in Iran, while Sweden does the same for Canadians in North Korea; Canada has no embassies in those countries. Romania also covered consular services for Canadians in Syria in 2014.
paras.zh: 加拿大与其他国家也有类似的协议——主要是民主协议。意大利对加拿大在伊朗的领事案件做出回应，而瑞典对在朝鲜的加拿大人也采取了同样的做法；加拿大在这些国家没有大使馆。 2014 年，罗马尼亚还为加拿大人在叙利亚提供领事服务。

paras.en: Minister of Foreign Affairs Anita Anand shakes hands with Ahmad bin Mohammed Al Sayed, Qatar minister of state for foreign trade affairs during a signing ceremony earlier this month. (Adrian Wyld/The Canadian Press)
paras.zh: 外交部长安妮塔·阿南德在本月早些时候的签字仪式上与卡塔尔外贸事务国务大臣艾哈迈德·本·穆罕默德·赛义德握手。 （阿德里安·怀尔德/加拿大新闻社）

paras.en: While Ottawa has advised against travel to Afghanistan for years, its arrangement with Qatar might allow it to extend consular services to Canadians detained there.
paras.zh: 尽管渥太华多年来一直建议不要前往阿富汗，但其与卡塔尔的安排可能允许其向被拘留在那里的加拿大人提供领事服务。

paras.en: Ben Rowswell, a former deputy ambassador to Afghanistan, said that might involve having a Qatari diplomat visit a Canadian in jail to check on their condition.
paras.zh: 前驻阿富汗副大使本·罗斯韦尔表示，这可能涉及让一名卡塔尔外交官探访一名在监狱中的加拿大人，以检查他们的状况。

paras.en: He said Qatar could also help Canadian aid workers who get in trouble with local authorities and perhaps work to resettle the former Afghan interpreters Ottawa has been trying to bring to Canada.
paras.zh: 他说，卡塔尔还可以帮助那些与地方当局发生麻烦的加拿大援助人员，或许还可以努力重新安置渥太华一直试图带往加拿大的前阿富汗翻译。

paras.en: "This might open up some possibilities for doing something a bit more concrete on social and economic issues affecting the Afghan population," said Rowswell, a consultant with the Toronto firm Catalyze4.
paras.zh: “这可能会为在影响阿富汗人民的社会和经济问题上采取一些更具体的行动开辟一些可能性。”多伦多Catalyze4公司顾问罗威尔表示。

paras.en: "The Qataris have become quite a trusted partner of the Afghan government over the years and so have excellent access inside Afghanistan."
paras.zh: “多年来，卡塔尔人已成为阿富汗政府相当值得信赖的合作伙伴，因此可以轻松进入阿富汗境内。”

paras.en: - Analysis Canadians fought a war in Afghanistan. Why do we struggle to talk about it?
paras.zh: - 分析 加拿大人在阿富汗打过仗。为什么我们很难谈论它？

paras.en: - Five years after Kabul fell, the reckoning over Afghanistan is far from over
paras.zh: - 喀布尔陷落五年后，对阿富汗的清算还远未结束

paras.en: Rowswell oversaw Canadian policy in Iran when Ottawa cut off diplomatic relations in 2012. He said Italy ended up holding the cash Canada's embassy held to pay the local Iranians who lost their jobs when the embassy was closed down.
paras.zh: 2012年渥太华与伊朗断绝外交关系时，罗斯韦尔负责监督加拿大对伊朗的政策。他说，意大利最终持有加拿大大使馆持有的现金，用于向因大使馆关闭而失业的当地伊朗人支付工资。

paras.en: Global Affairs Canada did not have an immediate response when asked when the new arrangement takes effect, what it will cost Ottawa and whether any Canadian diplomats will be deployed to Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 当被问及新安排何时生效、渥太华将付出什么代价以及加拿大是否会向阿富汗部署外交官时，加拿大全球事务部没有立即做出回应。

paras.en: "In the absence of being on the ground, you need someone else to help protect your interests," said Arif Lalani, Canada's former ambassador to Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 加拿大前驻阿富汗大使阿里夫·拉拉尼 (Arif Lalani) 表示：“在无法到达现场的情况下，你需要其他人来帮助保护你的利益。”

paras.en: "We do have some Canadians working there and some (charities) working there, and they need consular access. So the protection agreement allows Canada to cover that issue."
paras.zh: “我们确实有一些加拿大人在那里工作，还有一些（慈善机构）在那里工作，他们需要领事访问。因此保护协议允许加拿大解决这个问题。”

paras.en: Lalani, now a senior fellow with the Centre for International Governance Innovation, said countries normally reimburse each other for these services.
paras.zh: 现任国际治理创新中心高级研究员的拉拉尼表示，各国通常会相互报销这些服务的费用。

paras.en: Qatar is an autocratic state that Washington, D.C.-based Freedom House says has a troubling human rights record and tightly restricts civil liberties.
paras.zh: 卡塔尔是一个独裁国家，总部位于华盛顿特区的自由之家称其人权记录令人不安，并严格限制公民自由。

paras.en: "It's probably not among the countries that we normally have had agreements with of this type. But clearly, it's a country that has an embassy on the ground that has a relationship with the government that we don't," said Lalani.
paras.zh: 拉拉尼说：“它可能不在我们通常与之签订此类协议的国家之列。但显然，这个国家在当地设有大使馆，但与我们没有关系的政府有关系。”

paras.en: "It does strengthen Qatar's international standing as a trusted country, especially to have a G7 country trust you as a protecting power."
paras.zh: “这确实增强了卡塔尔作为值得信赖国家的国际地位，特别是让七国集团国家信任你作为保护国。”

paras.en: Rowswell said he doesn't expect Ottawa to arrange many similar deals with other autocracies. He said Kabul is one of the few places where democracies are unlikely to have diplomatic representation.
paras.zh: 罗斯韦尔表示，他预计渥太华不会与其他独裁国家达成许多类似的协议。他说，喀布尔是民主国家不可能拥有外交代表的少数几个地方之一。

paras.en: "It's a pragmatic solution in this particular case. And the range of issues in which it might pose a problem, I think would be limited by the very low volume of diplomatic or consular activity that we'll see in Afghanistan," he said.
paras.zh: “在这种特殊情况下，这是一个务实的解决方案。我认为，它可能造成问题的范围将受到我们在阿富汗看到的外交或领事活动数量非常少的限制，”他说。

paras.en: In January 2025, Ottawa praised Qatar for helping to secure the release of former Canadian soldier David Lavery after weeks of Taliban detainment.
paras.zh: 2025 年 1 月，渥太华赞扬卡塔尔帮助确保前加拿大士兵戴维·拉弗里 (David Lavery) 在被塔利班拘留数周后获释。

paras.en: In 2022, Ottawa asked to use the European Union's compound in Kabul to help with tasks such as fingerprinting for those fleeing Afghanistan, but ended up deciding the arrangement would be too difficult.
paras.zh: 2022年，渥太华要求使用欧盟在喀布尔的大院来帮助完成诸如为逃离阿富汗的人采集指纹等任务，但最终认为这种安排太困难了。

paras.en: Rowswell and Lalani both argue Ottawa is limiting its ability to advance its interests in Kabul by not having an embassy there.
paras.zh: 罗斯韦尔和拉拉尼都认为，渥太华在喀布尔没有设立大使馆，从而限制了其在喀布尔推进利益的能力。

paras.en: "It's very hard to protect the human rights of girls, boys and others in Afghanistan if we're not on the ground ourselves," Lalani said.
paras.zh: 拉拉尼说：“如果我们自己不在现场，就很难保护阿富汗女孩、男孩和其他人的人权。”

paras.en: Rowswell said having people on the ground and speaking with Taliban officials could give Canada more influence and better intelligence.
paras.zh: 罗斯韦尔表示，派人到现场并与塔利班官员交谈可以给加拿大带来更大的影响力和更好的情报。

paras.en: He gave the example of Canada's "heroic" advocacy against apartheid in South Africa, which relied in part on maintaining a high commission in Pretoria.
paras.zh: 他举了加拿大“英勇”倡导反对南非种族隔离的例子，这在一定程度上依赖于在比勒陀利亚维持高级专员公署。

paras.en: Others, including former diplomats, have argued that any sort of diplomatic relations with the Taliban would compromise Canada's values and might require official recognition of the government.
paras.zh: 其他人，包括前外交官，则认为与塔利班的任何形式的外交关系都会损害加拿大的价值观，并可能需要官方承认政府。

paras.en: The Taliban is undertaking what some activists call "gender apartheid" by severely restricting women's freedoms. Rights groups continue to report shocking incidents of gender-based violence in multiple provinces.
paras.zh: 塔利班正在通过严格限制妇女的自由来实行一些活动人士所说的“性别种族隔离”。人权组织继续报告多个省份发生的令人震惊的性别暴力事件。

paras.en: Canadian officials have had some discussions with Taliban representatives in Qatar over the years on a range of issues, including education for girls.
paras.zh: 多年来，加拿大官员与卡塔尔的塔利班代表就一系列问题进行了一些讨论，其中包括女童教育。

articles.title: Final Avengers: Doomsday trailer racks up over 500 million views in 1st day
articles.author: Philip Drost

paras.en: Final Avengers: Doomsday trailer racks up over 500 million views in 1st day
paras.zh: 最终版《复仇者联盟：世界末日》预告片首日浏览量突破 5 亿次

paras.en: While many fans are hyped, some have called out some of the trailer's visuals
paras.zh: 尽管许多粉丝都大肆宣传，但有些人还是对预告片的一些视觉效果表示不满

paras.en: It's safe to say there's a fair amount of hype around the upcoming release of Avengers: Doomsday.
paras.zh: 可以肯定地说，围绕即将上映的《复仇者联盟：世界末日》有相当多的炒作。

paras.en: Marvel released the final trailer for the upcoming superhero movie on Tuesday, and after just 24 hours it had already generated 563 million views.
paras.zh: 周二，漫威发布了这部即将上映的超级英雄电影的最终预告片，仅仅 24 小时后，该片的观看次数就已达到 5.63 亿次。

paras.en: That makes it the most viewed Disney trailer of all time, beating out the previous Avengers: Doomsday teaser, which hit 503 million views in the first 24 hours. It's also already the second most viewed movie trailer of all time, just below Spider-Man: Brand New Day, which has over 718 million views.
paras.zh: 这使其成为有史以来观看次数最多的迪士尼预告片，击败了之前的《复仇者联盟：世界末日》预告片，该预告片在前 24 小时内观看次数达到 5.03 亿次。它也已经成为有史以来观看次数第二多的电影预告片，仅次于《蜘蛛侠：全新的一天》，观看次数超过 7.18 亿。

paras.en: The film, directed by Anthony Russo and Joe Russo — who also directed Avengers: Infinity War and Avengers: Endgame — is set to hit theatres Dec. 18.
paras.zh: 这部电影由安东尼·罗素和乔·罗素执导，他们还执导过《复仇者联盟：无限战争》和《复仇者联盟：终局之战》，预计将于 12 月 18 日上映。

paras.en: The trailer starts by showing Steve Rogers, played by Chris Evans, as he talks about fatherhood, and if he should tell his son about his past life as Captain America and an Avenger. He's then approached by Reed Richards, played by Pedro Pascal, and the rest of the Fantastic Four.
paras.zh: 预告片首先展示了克里斯·埃文斯饰演的史蒂夫·罗杰斯谈论父亲身份，以及他是否应该告诉儿子他作为美国队长和复仇者的前世。随后佩德罗·帕斯卡饰演的里德·理查兹和神奇四侠的其他成员找到了他。

paras.en: That's followed by a shot of Doctor Doom, played by Robert Downey Jr., accompanied by three mysterious masked women.
paras.zh: 接下来是由小罗伯特·唐尼饰演的末日博士的镜头，由三名神秘的蒙面女子陪伴。

paras.en: More heroes meet each other (and in some cases fight) including Canadian Simu Liu as Shang-Chi, Ian McKellen as Magneto and Chris Hemsworth as Thor. Though he doesn't appear in this trailer, Doomsday will be the final big-screen role for Patrick Stewart, who plays Charles Xavier, the leader of the X-Men.
paras.zh: 更多英雄相遇（有时甚至打架），包括加拿大人刘思慕饰演上气、伊恩·麦凯伦饰演万磁王和克里斯·海姆斯沃斯饰演雷神。尽管他没有出现在这部预告片中，但《世界末日》将是帕特里克·斯图尔特在大银幕上的最后一个角色，他饰演 X 战警领袖查尔斯·泽维尔。

paras.en: "My family and I have booked the entire movie theatre for ourselves for the premiere of Avengers: Doomsday," posted X user @JesabelRaay. "They all couldn't stop talking about the new trailer."
paras.zh: X 用户@JesabelRaay 发帖称：“我和我的家人已经为自己预订了整个电影院，以观看《复仇者联盟：世界末日》的首映。” “他们都不停地谈论新预告片。”

paras.en: In the final scene, many of the heroes come together on a sort of battleground, and viewers weren't impressed.
paras.zh: 在最后的场景中，许多英雄聚集在战场上，观众并没有留下深刻的印象。

paras.en: "Avengers: Doomsday looks hideous … it visually looks awful," said @constantine_james7 in a video on Instagram.
paras.zh: “《复仇者联盟：世界末日》看起来很可怕……它在视觉上看起来很糟糕，”@constantine_james7 在 Instagram 上的一段视频中说道。

paras.en: Another Instagramer, @screened_scored, said it looked like "they took a bunch of individual characters, cut them out, and placed them against a digital background."
paras.zh: 另一位 Instagram 用户 @screened_scored 表示，看起来“他们把一堆单独的角色剪下来，然后把它们放在数字背景下。”

paras.en: The last Avengers film, 2019's Avengers: Endgame, made $2.9 billion US at the box office (With a bump from the recently released slightly updated version) making it the highest-grossing movie of all time, not accounting for inflation.
paras.zh: 上一部《复仇者联盟》电影，即 2019 年的《复仇者联盟：终局之战》，票房收入为 29 亿美元（较最近发行的略有更新的版本有所增加），使其成为有史以来票房最高的电影（不考虑通货膨胀）。

paras.en: But other recent films with high trailer views have done well.
paras.zh: 但最近其他预告片观看次数较高的电影也表现不错。

paras.en: While many fans are excited for the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday movie, some took to social media to complain about some of the visuals in the latest trailer. (Marvel Studios)
paras.zh: 虽然许多粉丝对即将上映的《复仇者联盟：世界末日》电影感到兴奋，但有些人在社交媒体上抱怨最新预告片中的一些视觉效果。 （漫威影业）

paras.en: The hype around Spider-Man: Brand New Day translated into box office success, with the movie pulling in $2.52 billion US worldwide
paras.zh: 围绕《蜘蛛侠：全新一天》的炒作转化为票房成功，该电影全球票房收入达 25.2 亿美元

paras.en: Deadpool & Wolverine's 2024 Super Bowl teaser scored 365 million views if you include those who watched the trailer during the Super Bowl broadcast, and that movie took in $1.3 billion US globally.
paras.zh: 如果算上在超级碗转播期间观看预告片的观众，《死侍与金刚狼》的 2024 年超级碗预告片获得了 3.65 亿次观看，该电影在全球的票房收入为 13 亿美元。

paras.en: Keen-eyed viewers believe they aren't exactly seeing everything in these trailers.
paras.zh: 敏锐的观众相信他们并没有看到这些预告片中的所有内容。

paras.en: At the end of the recent release, many of the heroes team up for a classic "Avengers, assemble" shot that often accompanies these big team-up movies when all the heroes unite to fight against common enemy.
paras.zh: 在最近上映的影片结尾处，许多英雄联手打造了一个经典的“复仇者联盟，集结”镜头，这个镜头经常伴随着这些大型团队电影，当所有英雄联合起来对抗共同的敌人时。

paras.en: But some viewers have pointed out that there are some gaps where they believe characters have been digitally edited out.
paras.zh: 但一些观众指出，他们认为角色已被数字化剪辑，存在一些空白。

paras.en: While much of the cast has been announced, there are still some unknowns around who will appear in the movie, such as three characters pictured here. (Marvel Studios)
paras.zh: 虽然大部分演员阵容已经公布，但仍然有一些未知的人物将出现在电影中，例如图中的三个角色。 （漫威影业）

paras.en: In a trailer for Spider-Man: No Way Home, Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield playing their versions of Spider-Man were edited out of the trailer that otherwise would've shown them swinging into action with Tom Holland's Spider-Man.
paras.zh: 在《蜘蛛侠：无路回家》的预告片中，托比·马奎尔和安德鲁·加菲尔德扮演的蜘蛛侠版本被从预告片中删除，否则他们将与汤姆·赫兰德扮演的蜘蛛侠一起行动。

paras.en: In trailers for Endgame, Thor and Bruce Banner's Smart Hulk were edited out of scenes, so it wouldn't give away their appearance.
paras.zh: 在《终局之战》的预告片中，雷神托尔和布鲁斯·班纳饰演的聪明绿巨人被剪掉了场景，因此不会泄露他们的外表。

paras.en: Tickets for the Dec. 18 release of Avengers: Doomsday have been on sale since July. It will premier the same day as Dune: Part Three directed by Canadian Denis Villeneuve.
paras.zh: 12 月 18 日上映的《复仇者联盟：世界末日》门票自 7 月起开始发售。该片将与加拿大人丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦执导的《沙丘：第三部分》同一天首映。

articles.title: Why Indian nationals are still ending up in Russia's war on Ukraine

paras.en: But instead of finding work as a driver, he was sent to fight in Ukraine for the Russian armed forces.
paras.zh: 但他没有找到司机的工作，而是被派往乌克兰为俄罗斯武装部队作战。

paras.en: After escaping from his unit, he surrendered to Ukrainian forces in November. He is now being held as a prisoner of war.
paras.zh: 逃离部队后，他于 11 月向乌克兰军队投降。他现在被作为战俘关押。

paras.en: In an interview with Ukrainian YouTuber Volodymyr Zolkin, Randhawa described how, after arriving in Russia, he was taken to a military facility, made to sign a contract and sent for training. He said they confiscated his passport and phone. His account has not been independently verified.
paras.zh: 在接受乌克兰 YouTuber Volodymyr Zolkin 采访时，Randhawa 描述了他抵达俄罗斯后如何被带到一个军事设施，被迫签署合同并被送往训练。他说他们没收了他的护照和手机。他的账户尚未得到独立核实。

paras.en: He is the second Indian national known to have escaped the Russian military. Sahil Majothi, a 23-year-old from Gujarat, surrendered to Ukrainian forces in October 2025. He had joined the Russian military while serving a prison sentence in Russia, reportedly believing that military service would help him secure his release.
paras.zh: 他是已知的第二位逃离俄罗斯军队的印度国民。来自古吉拉特邦的 23 岁男子萨希尔·马乔蒂 (Sahil Majothi) 于 2025 年 10 月向乌克兰军队投降。他在俄罗斯服刑期间加入了俄罗斯军队，据报道，他相信服兵役将有助于他获释。

paras.en: The cases underline how little has changed since Prime Minister Narendra Modi raised the issue with Russian President Vladimir Putin during his visit to Moscow in July 2024.
paras.zh: 这些案件突显出，自印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪 (Narendra Modi) 在 2024 年 7 月访问莫斯科期间向俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京 (Vladimir Putin) 提出这一问题以来，情况几乎没有发生任何变化。

paras.en: At the time, Putin assured him that Indians who were misled into joining the Russian army would be discharged. But the recruitment of Indians has continued.
paras.zh: 当时，普京向他保证，被误导加入俄罗斯军队的印度人将被解雇。但招募印度人的活动仍在继续。

paras.en: In an October filing before the Supreme Court, India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said approximately 267 Indians have joined the Russian armed forces since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 印度外交部 (MEA) 在 10 月份向最高法院提交的一份文件中表示，自俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以来，已有约 267 名印度人加入了俄罗斯武装部队。

paras.en: Of these, 139 were discharged and 51 were killed. The whereabouts of the 77 others were unknown. Russian authorities have confirmed that seven of them are missing.
paras.zh: 其中139人出院，51人死亡。其他 77 人下落不明。俄罗斯当局证实其中七人失踪。

paras.en: The problem extends beyond Indians who travel to Russia seeking civilian employment, only to find themselves exposed to recruitment networks and the dangers of a war zone.
paras.zh: 这个问题不仅限于印度人前往俄罗斯寻求平民就业，却发现自己暴露在招募网络和战区的危险之中。

paras.en: The MEA has also highlighted cases of Indians knowingly enlisting in the Russian military for the supposed financial benefits on offer, believing they could later secure release through government intervention.
paras.zh: 多边环境协定还强调了一些印度人故意加入俄罗斯军队的案例，以获取所谓的经济利益，并相信他们随后可以通过政府干预获得释放。

paras.en: Some had also approached Indian authorities to renounce their citizenship and obtain Russian passports. "This is a dangerous path and is strongly discouraged by the government," the ministry said.
paras.zh: 一些人还向印度当局提出放弃公民身份并获得俄罗斯护照。该部表示：“这是一条危险的道路，政府强烈反对。”

paras.en: Former diplomat Anil Trigunayat said the growing movement of Indian workers to Russia presents both economic opportunities and new challenges for their protection.
paras.zh: 前外交官阿尼尔·特里古纳亚特表示，越来越多的印度工人涌入俄罗斯，这既带来了经济机遇，也给他们的保护带来了新的挑战。

paras.en: "Inadequate oversight of recruitment networks could leave vulnerable workers exposed to exploitation," Trigunayat told DW.
paras.zh: 特里古纳亚特告诉德国之声：“对招聘网络的监管不力可能会让弱势工人面临剥削。”

paras.en: He said Indian workers were often burdened by substantial recruitment fees and continued deductions from their salaries by intermediaries.
paras.zh: 他说，印度工人常常背负着巨额招聘费，而且中介机构不断从他们的工资中扣除。

paras.en: "Some of them had paid between 300,000 to 500,000 Indian rupees [$5,400 /€4,900] to Indian recruitment agents, and even while working in Russia, more than 30% of their agreed monthly salary was taken away by local and foreign agents," Trigunayat said.
paras.zh: “他们中的一些人向印度招聘代理支付了 30 万至 50 万印度卢比（5,400 美元/4,900 欧元），即使在俄罗斯工作，他们约定的月薪也有超过 30% 被当地和外国代理拿走，”特里古纳亚特说。

paras.en: The former diplomat added that some Indians who had overstayed their visas in Russia were particularly vulnerable. Military service was allegedly offered to earn substantial wages and regularize their immigration status.
paras.zh: 这位前外交官补充说，一些在俄罗斯签证过期的印度人特别容易受到伤害。据称，服兵役是为了赚取可观的工资并使他们的移民身份合法化。

paras.en: Mohammad Sufiyan, from Hyderabad in the southern state of Telangana, said he was lured to Russia under false pretences and forced into active combat in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 来自南部特伦甘纳邦海得拉巴的穆罕默德·苏菲扬 (Mohammad Sufiyan) 表示，他被虚假借口引诱到俄罗斯，并被迫在乌克兰积极作战。

paras.en: He had traveled abroad in search of employment and a better livelihood, but ended up in a war zone. He has since returned home to India.
paras.zh: 他曾出国寻找工作和更好的生计，但最终却来到了战区。此后他回到了印度的家。

paras.en: "Many people are duped. Some decide it is better to seek citizenship than come back to India. It's a tough life, and people will go to any lengths to get some sort of employment," Sufiyan told DW.
paras.zh: 苏菲扬告诉德国之声：“很多人都被骗了。有些人认为寻求公民身份比回到印度更好。生活很艰难，人们会不遗余力地寻找某种工作。”

paras.en: Sufiyan's experience points to the economic desperation that makes such offers attractive, even when they carry the risk of being caught up in a war.
paras.zh: 苏菲扬的经历表明，经济的绝望使得此类提议具有吸引力，即使它们面临着陷入战争的风险。

paras.en: Rajan Kumar, a professor at the Center for Russian and Central Asian Studies at Jawaharlal Nehru University's School of International Studies, said some Indians who traveled to Russia for work could find themselves caught up in the fighting without having joined the military.
paras.zh: 尼赫鲁大学国际研究学院俄罗斯和中亚研究中心教授拉詹·库马尔表示，一些前往俄罗斯工作的印度人可能会发现自己在没有参军的情况下陷入了战斗。

paras.en: "Some of them, they don't join the army, but they end up in the army region. They're caught in the crossfire," Kumar told DW.
paras.zh: 库马尔告诉德国之声：“他们中的一些人并没有参军，但他们最终进入了军区。他们陷入了交火之中。”

paras.en: He said India was negotiating with Moscow to secure the return of its citizens caught up in such situations. "Russia is very cooperative so far," he said.
paras.zh: 他说，印度正在与莫斯科进行谈判，以确保陷入这种情况的印度公民回国。 “到目前为止，俄罗斯非常合作，”他说。

paras.en: Moscow prioritizes military aims over strategic diplomacy
paras.zh: 莫斯科将军事目标置于战略外交之上

paras.en: India has been pressing Russia to take action, but the issue persists.
paras.zh: 印度一直敦促俄罗斯采取行动，但问题仍然存在。

paras.en: The recruitment efforts reflect Russia's need for more manpower for its nearly five-year war in Ukraine , and the limited influence New Delhi can exert over Moscow, despite the close political relationship between the two countries.
paras.zh: 这些招募工作反映出，俄罗斯需要更多人力来应对乌克兰近五年的战争，而且尽管两国政治关系密切，新德里对莫斯科的影响力有限。

paras.en: Mohsin Raza Khan, a professor at the Jindal School of International Affairs, told DW that Putin's need to sustain the war effort was taking precedence over the concerns of a strategic partner.
paras.zh: 金达尔国际事务学院教授莫辛·拉扎·汗 (Mohsin Raza Khan) 告诉德国之声，普京维持战争努力的需要优先于战略伙伴的担忧。

paras.en: He points out that the Russian president was reluctant to impose another mobilization on his own population for fear of domestic unrest.
paras.zh: 他指出，由于担心国内动荡，俄罗斯总统不愿对本国民众再次进行动员。

paras.en: "In these circumstances, sustaining the war effort appears to take precedence over concerns raised by India. Neither Modi nor New Delhi has sufficient leverage to change that," said Khan.
paras.zh: “在这种情况下，维持战争努力似乎优先于印度提出的担忧。莫迪和新德里都没有足够的影响力来改变这一点，”汗说。

paras.en: Khan also said the willingness of some Indians to enlist, and even consider giving up their citizenship, is down to the lack of decent employment opportunities at home.
paras.zh: 汗还表示，一些印度人愿意入伍，甚至考虑放弃公民身份，是因为国内缺乏体面的就业机会。

paras.en: "For young, educated men without contacts or connections, the chances of respectable employment are so low that the risks of a high casualty war are preferable," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“对于没有人脉或关系的受过教育的年轻男性来说，获得体面就业的机会非常低，因此更愿意冒发生高伤亡战争的风险。”

articles.title: Nigeria's upcoming election marred by rising AI disinformation

paras.en: Nigeria has just over two months to go until its general election, with incumbent Bola Tinubu running on a ticket focused on combating raging insecurity and resolving the nation's economic crisis. He faces off against former Vice President Atiku Abubakar and senior opposition figure Peter Obi.
paras.zh: 距离尼日利亚大选只剩下两个多月的时间，现任总统博拉·蒂努布的竞选重点是消除严重的不安全局势并解决该国的经济危机。他与前副总统阿提库·阿布巴卡尔和高级反对派人物彼得·奥比对峙。

paras.en: The country's electoral body, the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC), recently released its preliminary voter's register, which reportedly is riddled with images believed to have been generated using artificial intelligence (AI).
paras.zh: 该国选举机构国家独立选举委员会（INEC）最近发布了初步选民登记册，据报道，登记册上充斥着据信是使用人工智能（AI）生成的图像。

paras.en: Among the telltale signs of AI usage were exaggerated facial features in images and inconsistencies on the electoral registers, such as duplicates of names and even identities of people who since the previous election had died.
paras.zh: 人工智能使用的明显迹象包括图像中夸张的面部特征和选举登记册上的不一致，例如自上次选举以来已去世的人的姓名甚至身份重复。

paras.en: The development raises concerns about the body's overall preparedness ahead of the country's upcoming 2027 general election. Instead of making the upcoming vote more transparent by allowing access to its procedures, INEC has come under fire amid broader controversies about the expanding influence of AI in elections across the continent.
paras.zh: 这一事态发展引发了人们对该机构在该国即将到来的 2027 年大选之前的整体准备情况的担忧。由于人工智能在非洲大陆选举中影响力不断扩大的广泛争议，INEC 并没有通过允许访问其程序来使即将到来的投票更加透明，而是受到了批评。

paras.en: Joash Amupitan, the chairman of the electoral commission, said the body is now investigating the development, focusing on discrepancies potentially created by AI use.
paras.zh: 选举委员会主席乔什·阿穆皮坦表示，该机构正在调查事态发展，重点关注人工智能的使用可能造成的差异。

paras.en: To this end, he announced the establishment of a dedicated unit to monitor AI-related threats, detect deepfakes and strengthen the integrity of the electoral process, warning that the credibility of the upcoming election could otherwise be under attack.
paras.zh: 为此，他宣布成立一个专门部门来监控人工智能相关威胁、检测深度造假并加强选举过程的完整性，并警告说，否则即将举行的选举的可信度可能会受到攻击。

paras.en: However, even prior to the proliferation of AI across Africa and the globe, this would not be the first time that Nigeria has found itself in the unfortunate position of having to deal with the circulation of fabricated images, doctored audio and fake videos online. In the run-up to the 2023 election, deepfakes falsely linking candidates to terror-related activities filled social media platforms.
paras.zh: 然而，即使在人工智能在非洲和全球范围内扩散之前，尼日利亚也不是第一次发现自己处于不得不应对网上伪造图像、篡改音频和虚假视频传播的不幸境地。在 2023 年大选前夕，社交媒体平台上充斥着将候选人与恐怖相关活动错误联系起来的深度造假内容。

paras.en: These are often designed to promote certain candidates or to discredit opponents in a bid to influence public perception, which now with the use of AI could create disinformation campaigns of new proportions.
paras.zh: 这些通常旨在宣传某些候选人或抹黑对手，以影响公众的看法，而现在，随着人工智能的使用，这可能会造成新规模的虚假信息活动。

paras.en: Artificial intelligence has various effects on voter behavior
paras.zh: 人工智能对选民行为有多种影响

paras.en: Lois Ugbede, the assistant editor at the factchecking platform DUBAWA, told DW that "based on our monitoring so far, AI-driven disinformation is serious and is becoming commonplace."
paras.zh: 事实核查平台 DUBAWA 的助理编辑洛伊丝·乌格贝德 (Lois Ugbede) 告诉德国之声，“根据我们迄今为止的监测，人工智能驱动的虚假信息非常严重，而且正在变得司空见惯。”

paras.en: "This could influence political discourse and voter behavior ahead of 2027 because we are already seeing parties using inflated crowds to show that they have a large followership or support," she added.
paras.zh: “这可能会影响 2027 年之前的政治言论和选民行为，因为我们已经看到政党利用膨胀的人群来表明他们拥有大量的追随者或支持，”她补充道。

paras.en: At the same time, rather than influencing the vote in favor of any particular candidate, "the deeper danger is that people may begin to doubt authentic information simply because they know convincing AI-generated fakes are possible," said Akintunde Babatunde, executive director of the Abuja-based Centre for Journalism, Innovation and Development.
paras.zh: 与此同时，阿布贾新闻、创新与发展中心执行主任阿金通德·巴巴通德 (Akintunde Babatunde) 表示，“更深层次的危险是，人们可能会开始怀疑真实信息，因为他们知道人工智能可能会生成令人信服的虚假信息，而不是影响对任何特定候选人的投票”。

paras.en: "We often focus on the risk of people believing an AI-generated falsehood, but there is another problem where genuine evidence can be dismissed as AI-generated," he noted, citing instances of a lawmaker who recently made inflammatory remarks during a campaign rally — but then claimed the clips were manipulated.
paras.zh: 他指出：“我们经常关注人们相信人工智能生成的谎言的风险，但还有另一个问题，即真实的证据可能会被视为人工智能生成而被驳回。”他引用了一位立法者的例子，该议员最近在一次竞选集会上发表了煽动性言论，但随后声称这些剪辑被操纵了。

paras.en: Further pitfalls behind a lack of safeguards against AI
paras.zh: 缺乏人工智能保障措施背后的更多陷阱

paras.en: Chibuike Mgbeahuruike, an election consultant at the Centre for Democracy and Development, told DW that apart from the spread of synthetic content online, AI intrusion into the electoral commission's portal could also "undermine its institutional credibility, especially with the low level of confidence that we are already witnessing."
paras.zh: 民主与发展中心的选举顾问奇布伊克·姆贝阿鲁伊克 (Chibuike Mgbeahuruike) 告诉德国之声，除了网上合成内容的传播之外，人工智能对选举委员会门户网站的入侵也可能“损害其机构可信度，尤其是在我们已经目睹的信任度较低的情况下”。

paras.en: He added, however, that AI itself is not inherently a threat to electoral integrity. The real threat lies in "the absence of effective accountability for its deployment," as innovations in tech increasingly appear to infiltrate governments and their democratic processes.
paras.zh: 不过，他补充说，人工智能本身并不是对选举公正性的固有威胁。真正的威胁在于“缺乏对其部署的有效问责”，因为技术创新似乎越来越多地渗透到政府及其民主进程中。

paras.en: "Voters must have confidence … that the technology is also transparent, accountable and independently scrutinized, and ultimately subject to human and institutional oversight," said Mgbeahuruike.
paras.zh: Mgbeahuruike 表示：“选民必须有信心……该技术也是透明的、负责任的、独立审查的，并最终受到人类和机构的监督。”

paras.en: Mallam Jibrin Baba Ndace, the director-general of state-owned broadcaster Voice of Nigeria, agrees, urging journalists at a recent conference also to not fall into the trap of believing reports, which later could turn out to be false due to AI manipulation.
paras.zh: 国有广播公司尼日利亚之声的总干事马拉姆·吉布林·巴巴·恩达斯 (Mallam Jibrin Baba Ndace) 对此表示同意，他在最近的一次会议上敦促记者不要陷入相信报道的陷阱，这些报道后来可能会因人工智能操纵而被证明是虚假的。

paras.en: He stressed the importance of protection measures and due diligence in news media, with the growing inability of public institutions like INEC to provide impartial information due to the use and influence of AI and other election-related tech.
paras.zh: 他强调了新闻媒体保护措施和尽职调查的重要性，由于人工智能和其他选举相关技术的使用和影响，像INEC这样的公共机构越来越无力提供公正的信息。

paras.en: Nigeria's marred relationship with new tech
paras.zh: 尼日利亚与新技术的关系受损

paras.en: Beyond AI, Nigeria's electoral processes have undergone various technological shifts over the years in hopes of improving transparency while increasing efficiency.
paras.zh: 除了人工智能之外，尼日利亚的选举流程多年来还经历了各种技术变革，希望在提高效率的同时提高透明度。

paras.en: Electoral authorities first deployed electronic assistance in 2011, when Direct Data Capture Machines were introduced; the devices collect voters' biometrics by scanning fingerprints or capturing facial recognition data with webcams to stop voters from submitting multiple ballots.
paras.zh: 选举当局于 2011 年首次部署电子援助，当时引入了直接数据捕获机；这些设备通过扫描指纹或使用网络摄像头捕获面部识别数据来收集选民的生物识别信息，以阻止选民提交多张选票。

paras.en: Ten years later, a system called the Bimodal Voter Accreditation System (BVAS) was introduced as the new standard, designed to combine fingerprints with facial recognition. However, during the 2023 general election, this voting process was marred by system failures, as poor cell signals delayed these voter accreditation procedures.
paras.zh: 十年后，一种名为双模选民认证系统（BVAS）的系统作为新标准被引入，旨在将指纹与面部识别相结合。然而，在 2023 年大选期间，投票过程因系统故障而受到影响，因为手机信号不佳延迟了选民认证程序。

paras.en: However, with INEC tallying more than 103 million Nigerians registered to participate in the coming poll, disinformation, fake news and technological challenges amount to only a few of several concerns pertaining to Nigeria's democracy.
paras.zh: 然而，根据 INEC 统计，有超过 1.03 亿尼日利亚人登记参加即将举行的民意调查，虚假信息、假新闻和技术挑战只是与尼日利亚民主有关的几个问题中的一小部分。

paras.en: Voter apathy has become a particular concern, especially among the country's youth. The 2023 election recorded the lowest voter turnout since the country's return to democratic rule in 1999, with merely 27% of registered voters going to the polls.
paras.zh: 选民的冷漠已经成为一个特别令人担忧的问题，尤其是在该国的年轻人中。 2023 年的选举创下了该国 1999 年恢复民主统治以来的最低投票率，只有 27% 的登记选民参加了投票。

articles.title: Peter Magyar meets Volodymyr Zelenskyy: Hungary and Ukraine make a fresh start after the icy relations of the Viktor Orban era

paras.en: The location and the gesture were carefully chosen: Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stood side by side, laid flowers and bowed their heads at the military cemetery in the center of the Ukrainian city of Uzhhorod.
paras.zh: 地点和姿态都经过精心选择：匈牙利总理彼得·马扎尔和乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基在乌克兰乌日霍罗德市中心的军人公墓并肩站立，敬献鲜花并鞠躬。

paras.en: One of those buried there is an ethnic Hungarian who was one of the first soldiers killed in Russia's full-scale war of aggression against Ukraine.
paras.zh: 其中埋葬者之一是一名匈牙利族人，他是俄罗斯全面侵略乌克兰战争中第一批阵亡的士兵之一。

paras.en: Magyar intentionally chose not to begin his first visit to Ukraine as prime minister at a government building. Instead, his Tuesday afternoon visit began at a place where he could demonstrate his solidarity with Ukraine more clearly than anywhere else.
paras.zh: 马扎尔故意选择不在政府大楼开始他作为总理对乌克兰的首次访问。相反，他周二下午的访问是在一个比其他任何地方都能更清楚地表明他对乌克兰的声援的地方开始的。

paras.en: Uzhhorod, known as Ungvar in Hungarian, is the capital of Ukraine's Transcarpathia region, which is home to around 80,000 members of Ukraine's Hungarian minority. Thousands of ethnic Hungarians are fighting Russian occupying forces on the front lines.
paras.zh: 乌日霍罗德在匈牙利语中被称为 Ungvar，是乌克兰 Transcarpathia 地区的首府，该地区居住着大约 80,000 名乌克兰匈牙利少数民族成员。数以千计的匈牙利人正在前线与俄罗斯占领军作战。

paras.en: For Hungary, where ethnic Hungarian minorities in neighboring countries traditionally play an important role, the war is therefore closer to home than it is for other European countries.
paras.zh: 对于匈牙利来说，邻国的匈牙利少数民族传统上发挥着重要作用，因此，与其他欧洲国家相比，战争离本土更近。

paras.en: Magyar described his visit to Ukraine as a "historic day" in a Facebook post. Before the ceremony at the cemetery in Uzhhorod, he said: "I bring with me the solidarity of the Hungarian people. We stand with Ukraine against the Russian aggressor."
paras.zh: 马扎尔在脸书上发帖称他对乌克兰的访问是“历史性的一天”。在乌日霍罗德公墓举行仪式之前，他说：“我带着匈牙利人民的团结。我们与乌克兰站在一起，反对俄罗斯侵略者。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy responded on X, saying "We appreciate this gesture of respect toward those who sacrificed their lives for Ukraine's independence."
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在 X 上回应称，“我们感谢这种对那些为乌克兰独立而牺牲的人们的尊重。”

paras.en: The meeting between Magyar and Zelenskyy marked a turning point in Hungary's approach to Ukraine.
paras.zh: 马扎尔和泽连斯基之间的会面标志着匈牙利对乌克兰态度的转折点。

paras.en: The two leaders repeatedly shook hands throughout the day. Such scenes would have been unthinkable just a few months ago. The propaganda of Magyar's pro-Russian predecessor, Viktor Orban, portrayed Ukraine as a "mafia state" and "lawless country" on an almost daily basis.
paras.zh: 两国领导人全天多次握手。这样的场景在几个月前还是不可想象的。马扎尔亲俄前任维克多·欧尔班的宣传几乎每天都将乌克兰描绘成“黑手党国家”和“无法无天的国家”。

paras.en: Under Orban, relations between Hungary and Ukraine reached a historic low.
paras.zh: 在欧尔班的领导下，匈牙利和乌克兰的关系跌至历史低点。

paras.en: Now the two countries are seeking a political reset, which is important not only for Hungary and Ukraine but for Europe as a whole. After all, Orban's repeated obstruction of support for Ukraine drove the EU to the brink of despair.
paras.zh: 现在两国正在寻求政治重置，这不仅对匈牙利和乌克兰而且对整个欧洲都很重要。毕竟，欧尔班一再阻挠对乌克兰的支持，让欧盟陷入了绝望的边缘。

paras.en: During talks in Uzhhorod, the two leaders also agreed to closer economic cooperation.
paras.zh: 在乌日霍罗德会谈期间，两国领导人还同意加强经济合作。

paras.en: The talks centered on Hungarian diesel supplies to Ukraine, greater use of Ukrainian gas storage facilities by Hungarian companies, and joint infrastructure projects, including the opening of new border crossings and a direct rail link between Budapest and Kyiv.
paras.zh: 会谈的重点是匈牙利向乌克兰供应柴油、匈牙利公司更多地使用乌克兰天然气储存设施以及联合基础设施项目，包括开设新的过境点以及布达佩斯和基辅之间的直达铁路。

paras.en: Nevertheless, no formal agreements were signed on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，周二并未签署正式协议。

paras.en: At a subsequent news conference, journalists asked questions about sensitive issues between the two countries: minority rights, Ukraine's EU integration and a new EU loan for Ukraine.
paras.zh: 在随后的新闻发布会上，记者就两国之间的敏感问题提出了问题：少数民族权利、乌克兰融入欧盟以及欧盟向乌克兰提供的新贷款。

paras.en: Throughout the day, the two men were visibly keen to avoid any discord.
paras.zh: 一整天，这两个人显然都热衷于避免任何不和。

paras.en: Magyar, for example, described his angry outburst over Ukraine's "Carpathian Eight" initiative in parliament in late September as a "misunderstanding" and suggested that Hungary might, after all, take part.
paras.zh: 例如，马扎尔将他9月下旬在议会中对乌克兰“喀尔巴阡八强”倡议的愤怒情绪描述为“误解”，并暗示匈牙利最终可能会参与其中。

paras.en: Zelenskyy's cautious replies to journalists suggest that he knows his country's path to EU membership also runs through Budapest.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基对记者的谨慎回答表明，他知道他的国家加入欧盟的道路也经过布达佩斯。

paras.en: One of Magyar's statements on Tuesday was key: "We've finally put a stop to this completely unnecessary and inexplicable political escalation."
paras.zh: 马扎尔周二的声明之一至关重要：“我们终于制止了这种完全不必要且莫名其妙的政治升级。”

paras.en: Even before taking office in early May 2026, Magyar had promised to reset relations with Ukraine. But the process has not been entirely smooth.
paras.zh: 甚至在 2026 年 5 月上旬上任之前，马扎尔就已承诺重置与乌克兰的关系。但这一过程并不完全顺利。

paras.en: In many respects — but certainly not all — Magyar is distancing himself from his predecessor. He has made no bones of the fact that he sees Russia as the aggressor, but he rejects both arms deliveries to Ukraine and even the transit of weapons across Hungarian territory.
paras.zh: 在许多方面——但肯定不是全部——马扎尔正在与他的前任保持距离。他直言不讳地将俄罗斯视为侵略者，但他拒绝向乌克兰运送武器，甚至拒绝穿越匈牙利领土转运武器。

paras.en: Magyar previously accused Ukraine of treating ethnic Hungarians as second-class citizens — a claim that is not borne out by the facts. He pressed for greater minority rights and for a time blocked the opening of negotiating chapters in Ukraine's EU accession talks.
paras.zh: 马扎尔此前指责乌克兰将匈牙利族人视为二等公民，但这一说法并未得到事实证实。他敦促争取更大的少数族裔权利，并一度阻止乌克兰加入欧盟谈判的谈判章节的启动。

paras.en: Magyar also departed from diplomatic convention by choosing the location of his meeting with Zelenskyy in Ukraine: Indeed, it was Magyar who invited Zelenskyy to Transcarpathia.
paras.zh: 马扎尔还背离了外交惯例，选择在乌克兰与泽连斯基会面：事实上，正是马扎尔邀请泽连斯基前往外喀尔巴阡。

paras.en: Magyar's sometimes confrontational tone toward Ukraine can also be explained by the need to avoid appearing too pro-Ukrainian to the Hungarian public.
paras.zh: 马扎尔有时对乌克兰采取对抗性的语气也可以解释为需要避免在匈牙利公众面前显得过于亲乌克兰。

paras.en: According to a November 2026 poll conducted by the think tank Globsec, 33% of Hungarians would now support their country providing military aid to Ukraine. Although this is much more than during Orban's time in office, many Hungarians remain skeptical of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 根据智库 Globsec 2026 年 11 月进行的民意调查，33% 的匈牙利人现在支持本国向乌克兰提供军事援助。尽管这比欧尔班执政期间要多得多，但许多匈牙利人仍然对乌克兰持怀疑态度。

paras.en: That's why Olena Halushka, a Ukrainian political scientist at the International Centre for Ukrainian Victory (ICUV), sees some aspects of Magyar's visit as a concession to public opinion in Hungary.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么乌克兰胜利国际中心（ICUV）的乌克兰政治学家奥琳娜·哈卢什卡（Olena Halushka）认为马扎尔访问的某些方面是对匈牙利舆论的让步。
