paras.en: "Magyar has taken over a deeply polarized country," she told DW's Ukrainian Service. "A visit to Transcarpathia is more of a step for the Hungarian population than for Ukraine."
paras.zh: “马扎尔已经接管了一个严重两极分化的国家，”她告诉德国之声乌克兰语部。 “访问外喀尔巴阡山脉对匈牙利人民来说比对乌克兰来说更重要。”

paras.en: Ukraine accommodated not only Magyar's choice of location but also Hungary's demands for better protection of minority rights, which were set out in a 10-point plan in June. That's because EU integration is one of the country's top political priorities.
paras.zh: 乌克兰不仅满足了马扎尔的选址选择，还满足了匈牙利在6月份的十点计划中提出的更好地保护少数民族权利的要求。这是因为欧盟一体化是该国的首要政治优先事项之一。

paras.en: After planned restrictions on the use of minority languages were withdrawn in late 2023, Ukraine's parliament in early October passed a law on minority language rights that in some respects goes even further than European standards.
paras.zh: 在 2023 年底取消对少数民族语言使用的计划限制后，乌克兰议会于 10 月初通过了一项关于少数民族语言权利的法律，该法律在某些方面甚至超出了欧洲标准。

paras.en: Hungary subsequently dropped its obstruction of the opening of negotiating clusters for Ukraine's EU accession.
paras.zh: 匈牙利随后放弃了对乌克兰加入欧盟谈判小组的阻挠。

paras.en: Laszlo Zubanics, chairman of the Hungarian Democratic Federation in Ukraine (UMDSZ, one of two Hungarian political parties in Transcarpathia), told DW that the Magyar-Zelenskyy meeting was "historic."
paras.zh: 乌克兰匈牙利民主联盟（UMDSZ，外喀尔巴阡地区两个匈牙利政党之一）主席拉兹洛·祖巴尼奇（Laszlo Zubanics）告诉德国之声，马扎尔-泽连斯基的会面是“历史性的”。

paras.en: He particularly welcomed the fact that Ukraine will probably implement practical improvements in the protection of minority rights "not only by the end of 2027, but much sooner, within just a few months."
paras.zh: 他特别欢迎乌克兰可能“不仅在 2027 年底之前，而且在短短几个月内”在保护少数群体权利方面实施切实改进。

paras.en: A Hungarian diplomat who spoke to DW on condition of anonymity also called the meeting "historic," adding that after the Orban government's anti-Ukrainian policies, trust now needs to be rebuilt, and that personal meetings between the two leaders play an important role in that process.
paras.zh: 一位不愿透露姓名的匈牙利外交官也称这次会面是“历史性的”，并补充说，在欧尔班政府实施反乌克兰政策之后，现在需要重建信任，两国领导人的个人会晤在这一过程中发挥着重要作用。

paras.en: The diplomat went on to say that Hungary not only wants to ensure that the rights of the Hungarian minority are protected, it also has a strong interest in being involved in Ukraine's reconstruction.
paras.zh: 这位外交官接着说，匈牙利不仅希望确保匈牙利少数民族的权利受到保护，而且对参与乌克兰的重建也有着浓厚的兴趣。

paras.en: Overall, the diplomat concluded, both sides are very keen to expand economic cooperation.
paras.zh: 这位外交官总结道，总体而言，双方都非常渴望扩大经济合作。

paras.en: Hungarian political scientist Daniel Hegedus of the Institute for European Politics (IEP) in Berlin told DW that while the meeting was a "symbolic milestone," it will be important to see "how the two political leaders capitalize on the symbolic political capital generated by this meeting."
paras.zh: 柏林欧洲政治研究所（IEP）的匈牙利政治学家丹尼尔·赫格杜斯（Daniel Hegedus）告诉德国之声，虽然这次会议是一个“象征性的里程碑”，但重要的是要看看“两位政治领导人如何利用这次会议产生的象征性政治资本”。

paras.en: No observers have suggested that this is the grand finale of reconciliation between Hungary and Ukraine.
paras.zh: 没有观察家认为这是匈牙利和乌克兰之间和解的最终结局。

paras.en: Nevertheless, Tuesday's reset sends an important signal to Europe, namely that if the political will is there, a deep gulf that has existed for years can be transformed into a set of diverging interests that can be addressed through negotiations.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，周二的重置向欧洲发出了一个重要信号，即如果有政治意愿，多年来存在的深深鸿沟可以转化为一系列可以通过谈判解决的分歧利益。

paras.en: Or, as Zelenskyy put it, now there are "all the opportunities to build hopefully constructive relations."
paras.zh: 或者，正如泽连斯基所说，现在“有一切机会建立有希望的建设性关系”。

paras.en: This article was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表。

articles.title: What’s behind Europe’s protests?

paras.en: Europe has seen a wave of protests and industrial action in recent weeks. High living costs, energy prices and a lack of affordable housing are fuelling the unrest.
paras.zh: 最近几周，欧洲爆发了一波抗议和罢工行动。高昂的生活成本、能源价格和经济适用住房的缺乏加剧了骚乱。

paras.en: So, how deep is this crisis – and can it be fixed?
paras.zh: 那么，这场危机有多严重——可以解决吗？

paras.en: Vicky Pryce – Chief Economic Adviser at the Centre for Economics and Business Research in London and the former joint Head of the UK Government Economic Service.
paras.zh: 维琪·普赖斯 (Vicky Pryce) – 伦敦经济与商业研究中心首席经济顾问，英国政府经济服务部前联合主管。

paras.en: Evelyn Astor – Director of the European Social Observatory in Brussels.
paras.zh: 伊芙琳·阿斯特 (Evelyn Astor) – 布鲁塞尔欧洲社会观察站主任。

paras.en: Remi Bourgeot – Economist and Associate Fellow at the French Institute for International and Strategic Affairs.
paras.zh: 雷米·布尔乔 (Remi Bourgeot) – 法国国际与战略事务研究所经济学家兼副研究员。

articles.title: US Education Department probes Virginia schools after sexual abuse scandal

paras.en: The United States Department of Education says it is launching an investigation and withholding funding from a district in the state of Virginia after local officials shut down all of its schools in the wake of a child sexual abuse scandal involving its employees.
paras.zh: 美国教育部表示，在弗吉尼亚州一个学区发生涉及其员工的儿童性虐待丑闻后，当地官员关闭了该学区的所有学校，该部正在对此展开调查，并扣留该学区的资金。

paras.en: “Parents should never have to question whether their child’s school is aiding and abetting child predators,” US Secretary of Education Linda McMahon said in a statement on Tuesday. “The Trump Administration is taking decisive enforcement action to hold those responsible accountable and ensure Virginia schools are safe places for children to learn.”
paras.zh: 美国教育部长琳达·麦克马洪周二在一份声明中表示：“家长永远不应该质疑孩子的学校是否在帮助和教唆儿童掠夺者。” “特朗普政府正在采取果断的执法行动，追究责任人的责任，并确保弗吉尼亚学校成为儿童学习的安全场所。”

paras.en: Officials in Albemarle County, Virginia, announced they were closing all 29 schools in the district last week, after learning that more than 500 staff had not been subjected to a routine background screening for a history of child sexual abuse. The school system has about 2,800 employees, and only a fraction of its $284m budget comes from the federal government.
paras.zh: 弗吉尼亚州阿尔伯马尔县的官员上周宣布，在得知 500 多名教职员工没有接受儿童性虐待历史例行背景筛查后，他们将关闭该地区的所有 29 所学校。该学校系统约有 2,800 名员工，其 2.84 亿美元预算中只有一小部分来自联邦政府。

paras.en: Local officials emphasised that none of the 524 employees is suspected of abuse.
paras.zh: 当地官员强调，524 名员工中没有一人涉嫌虐待。

paras.en: Approximately 14,000 students attend the schools, and parents have scrambled to find childcare, while many who depend on free school meals for their children have had to look for other sources of food.
paras.zh: 大约有 14,000 名学生在学校就读，家长们纷纷寻找托儿所，而许多依靠免费校餐为孩子提供食物的人则不得不寻找其他食物来源。

paras.en: Bob Beard, a member of the Albemarle school board, told Al Jazeera that families were struggling to deal with the shutdown, but schools would reopen on Monday.
paras.zh: 阿尔伯马尔学校董事会成员鲍勃·比尔德告诉半岛电视台，家庭正在努力应对停课的情况，但学校将于周一重新开放。

paras.en: The child abuse allegations have shaken the county and caught the attention of the Trump administration.
paras.zh: 虐待儿童指控震惊了该县，并引起了特朗普政府的关注。

paras.en: A former elementary school teacher was arrested for possession of child sexual abuse material earlier this year, while a counsellor at another school was put on leave and later indicted on 20 counts of sexual crimes involving seven different children, according to the Albemarle County Police Department.
paras.zh: 据阿尔伯马尔县警察局称，今年早些时候，一名前小学教师因持有儿童性虐待材料而被捕，另一所学校的一名辅导员被停职，后来因涉及七名不同儿童的 20 项性犯罪罪名被起诉。

paras.en: Two county school officials and a school principal were later charged with failure to report child abuse, and the county’s superintendent of schools resigned.
paras.zh: 两名县学校官员和一名学校校长后来被指控未能举报虐待儿童行为，县学校负责人也因此辞职。

paras.en: Jason Grant, a spokesman for Albemarle County Public Schools, told Al Jazeera that none of the individuals implicated in those cases was among the 524 employees who were hired without the proper screening required to check for a history of child sexual abuse.
paras.zh: 阿尔伯马尔县公立学校发言人杰森·格兰特 (Jason Grant) 告诉半岛电视台，524 名员工中没有一个涉及这些案件的人，这些员工在没有经过适当的筛选以检查是否有儿童性虐待历史的情况下被雇用。

paras.en: “This was not about having the policies in place, this was about processes that were not followed,” Grant said. He said officials were working with the state to “make sure the processes are in place to make sure this doesn’t happen again.”
paras.zh: 格兰特说：“这不是政策是否到位的问题，而是没有遵循流程的问题。”他表示，官员们正在与州政府合作，“确保相关程序到位，以确保这种情况不会再次发生”。

paras.en: Grant said all employees in the district undergo several stages of vetting, including a criminal background check and an attestation that they have no history of child abuse or neglect. Then the school system submits their information to the Virginia Department of Social Services to verify that they are not part of the agency’s abuse and neglect database.
paras.zh: 格兰特说，该地区的所有员工都要经过几个阶段的审查，包括犯罪背景调查以及证明他们没有虐待或忽视儿童的历史。然后，学校系统将他们的信息提交给弗吉尼亚社会服务部，以验证他们不属于该机构的虐待和忽视数据库。

paras.en: For three years, it appears that vetting procedures were not consistently applied. Putting employees hired over that period on leave to carry out background checks meant schools would not be able to run, so officials decided to close them until next week.
paras.zh: 三年来，审查程序的实施似乎并不一致。让在此期间雇用的员工休假以进行背景调查意味着学校将无法运行，因此官员们决定将学校关闭到下周。

paras.en: “Those were for every range of employee, from teachers to bus drivers to substitutes and across the division, so we couldn’t get coverage for that amount of people,” Grant said.
paras.zh: 格兰特说：“这些保险适用于从教师到公交车司机到替补人员以及整个部门的各种员工，因此我们无法为这么多人提供保险。”

paras.en: All but three of the 524 employees have now been properly vetted, and none had background issues, Grant said, adding that the county will reopen schools on Monday.
paras.zh: 格兰特说，除了三名员工外，其余 524 名员工均已接受适当审查，没有人有背景问题，并补充说该县将于周一重新开放学校。

paras.en: The Trump administration has long called for the dismantling of the Department of Education. The US president signed an executive order last year that tried to set that in motion.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府长期以来一直呼吁解散教育部。美国总统去年签署了一项行政命令，试图启动这一计划。

paras.en: The department, which distributes federal funding to states for use in schools, also traditionally investigates whether local officials are complying with civil rights laws banning discrimination against minorities and marginalised groups.
paras.zh: 该部门向各州分配用于学校的联邦资金，传统上还调查地方官员是否遵守禁止歧视少数群体和边缘群体的民权法。

paras.en: Since returning to office in 2025, the Trump administration has cut more than half of the department’s staff and subjected it to wider changes it says are aimed at rooting out “diversity, equity, and inclusion” (DEI) policies.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年重新上任以来，特朗普政府已裁减了该部门一半以上的员工，并对部门进行了更广泛的改革，据称旨在根除“多元化、公平和包容”(DEI) 政策。

articles.title: Winter rains threaten 1,000 Gaza shelter sites, councils warn

paras.en: Gaza’s municipalities have warned that winter rains could flood about 1,000 camps and other sites hosting displaced Palestinians in the war-torn enclave, adding that damage to drains and sewers, and a shortage of pumps, have left their crews with little means to clear the water.
paras.zh: 加沙各市政府警告称，冬季降雨可能会淹没这片饱受战争蹂躏的飞地内约 1000 个难民营和其他收容流离失所的巴勒斯坦人的地点，并补充说，排水沟和下水道遭到破坏，加上水泵短缺，导致工作人员几乎没有办法清理积水。

paras.en: After a meeting in Gaza City on Wednesday, the Union of Gaza Strip Municipalities singled out al-Mughraqa and al-Zahra in central Gaza, where water levels in Wadi Gaza could rise suddenly. Across the territory, about 200,000 tents need replacing, and more than 2,000 damaged buildings are at risk of collapse, the union said. Gaza’s Government Media Office had warned on Tuesday that it expected another storm within days.
paras.zh: 周三在加沙城举行会议后，加沙地带市政联盟特别指出加沙中部的穆格拉卡和扎赫拉，加沙干河的水位可能会突然上升。该工会表示，全港约有20万顶帐篷需要更换，超过2000座受损建筑物面临倒塌风险。加沙政府媒体办公室周二警告称，预计几天内还会出现另一场风暴。

paras.en: This is Gaza’s fourth winter since Israel launched its war in October 2023. The union said storms in early November flooded about 70,000 tents and affected more than 350,000 displaced people. During a winter storm this November, families piled sand at tent entrances to keep out the rain. Others carried their children out and salvaged what belongings they could.
paras.zh: 这是加沙自 2023 年 10 月发动战争以来的第四个冬天。该联盟表示，11 月初的风暴淹没了约 7 万顶帐篷，影响了超过 35 万流离失所者。今年十一月的一场冬季暴风雨期间，许多家庭在帐篷入口处堆沙以防雨。其他人则带着孩子出去，并尽可能地抢救物品。

paras.en: One displaced mother said she had cut up the burial shroud she had bought for her son and used it to patch her tent. She wanted to keep the family’s bedding and clothes dry. “I couldn’t get a tarpaulin,” she said.
paras.zh: 一位流离失所的母亲说，她把为儿子买的裹尸布切碎，用来修补帐篷。她想让家里的床上用品和衣服保持干燥。 “我找不到防水布，”她说。

paras.en: When the first rains hit, Gaza’s civil defence crews reached only a minority of those who called for help. Most of the other callers received advice by phone, Al Jazeera reported.
paras.zh: 当第一场雨来临时，加沙的民防人员只接触到了少数求助者。据半岛电视台报道，大多数其他来电者都通过电话收到了建议。

paras.en: In Brussels on Wednesday, the European Commission called on Israel to reopen all Gaza crossings to humanitarian aid. Commission spokesperson Eva Hrncirova said tents were waiting on trucks outside Gaza because Israel had not allowed them or the equipment needed to put them up to enter.
paras.zh: 周三在布鲁塞尔，欧盟委员会呼吁以色列重新开放所有加沙过境点以提供人道主义援助。委员会发言人伊娃·赫尔西洛娃(Eva Hrncirova)表示，帐篷正在加沙郊外的卡车上等待，因为以色列不允许它们或搭建帐篷所需的设备进入。

paras.en: The UN said earlier this month that more than 150,000 tents were awaiting entry into Gaza.
paras.zh: 联合国本月早些时候表示，超过 15 万顶帐篷正在等待进入加沙。

paras.en: Al Jazeera’s open-source unit (Ar.) measured a queue of trucks stretching about 1.1km (0.7 miles) along the Egyptian road to the Rafah crossing in a November 17 satellite image, up from about 460 metres (1,510 feet) on October 6. The images do not establish what the trucks carried. Freight from Egypt is routed through the Karem Abu Salem crossing, known as Kerem Shalom in Israel, for inspection rather than entering Gaza through Rafah.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台的开源部门 (Ar.) 在 11 月 17 日的卫星图像中测量了沿埃及公路通往拉法过境点的卡车队列长度约为 1.1 公里（0.7 英里），而 10 月 6 日的长度约为 460 米（1,510 英尺）。这些图像并未确定卡车运载的物品。来自埃及的货物通过卡雷姆阿布萨勒姆过境点（在以色列称为凯雷姆沙洛姆）接受检查，而不是通过拉法进入加沙。

paras.en: COGAT, the Israeli military body that coordinates aid, said that nearly 100,000 tents had entered Gaza since the start of a winter aid programme. It said Israel would allow reconstruction equipment into Gaza only after Hamas had fully disarmed.
paras.zh: 负责协调援助的以色列军事机构 COGAT 表示，自冬季援助计划开始以来，已有近 10 万顶帐篷进入加沙。声明称，只有在哈马斯完全解除武装后，以色列才会允许重建设备进入加沙。

paras.en: Inside Gaza, aid workers have cleared drains, installed flood barriers and reinforced shelters. The UN’s humanitarian affairs office reported on November 20 that teams had recorded such work at 162 of the 356 flood-prone locations they had identified. Gaza’s municipalities are asking for pumps, backup generators and fuel before the next storm, as well as 10,000 tonnes of cement for emergency repairs and mobile homes that can withstand wind and rain.
paras.zh: 在加沙境内，援助人员清理了排水沟、安装了防洪堤并加固了避难所。联合国人道主义事务办公室 11 月 20 日报告称，工作组已在他们确定的 356 个洪水易发地点中的 162 个地点记录了此类工作。加沙各市政府正在要求在下一次暴风雨来临之前提供水泵、备用发电机和燃料，以及用于紧急维修的 10,000 吨水泥和能够抵御风雨的移动房屋。

articles.title: Republican wants FBI and CIA answers before questioning Nvidia chief
articles.author: Michel Martin

paras.en: Republican wants FBI and CIA answers before questioning Nvidia chief
paras.zh: 共和党人希望联邦调查局和中央情报局在质询英伟达首席执行官之前得到答案

paras.en: Jensen Huang is back at the helm of Nvidia with President Trump's backing. But the questions surrounding the AI chipmaker and its ties to China are far from settled.
paras.zh: 在特朗普总统的支持下，黄仁勋重新执掌英伟达。但围绕这家人工智能芯片制造商及其与中国的关系的问题还远未解决。

paras.en: U.S. intelligence officials told congressional staff there is no evidence that Alice Huang, the woman who had an affair with the Nvidia chief, was a Chinese spy or intelligence asset, according to a person familiar with the matter who was granted anonymity to speak about a closed-door briefing.
paras.zh: 据一位不愿透露姓名的知情人士透露，美国情报官员告诉国会工作人员，没有证据表明与英伟达首席执行官有染的女性爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 是中国间谍或情报人员。

paras.en: There is also no evidence that she initiated the affair to collect intelligence for China's government, the person told NPR's Ryan Lucas on condition of anonymity because of the sensitive nature of the matter. She is, however, believed to have passed along information after the affair began.
paras.zh: 该人士对美国国家公共广播电台的瑞安·卢卡斯表示，也没有证据表明她发起了这起事件是为了为中国政府收集情报。由于此事敏感，该人士要求匿名。然而，据信她在事件开始后就传递了信息。

paras.en: Trump has said he helped arrange Huang's return as CEO, and Nvidia's board maintains that his reinstatement presents no national security risk. Some Republican lawmakers, however, want to understand how those conclusions were reached.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他帮助安排了黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官，而英伟达董事会坚称，他的复职不会带来国家安全风险。然而，一些共和党议员想了解这些结论是如何得出的。

paras.en: Speaking to Morning Edition on Wednesday, before NPR obtained the new information, Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick, R-Pa., said he wants to hear from the FBI and CIA before Huang appears before House lawmakers next week.
paras.zh: 周三，在 NPR 获得新信息之前，宾夕法尼亚州共和党众议员布莱恩·菲茨帕特里克 (Brian Fitzpatrick) 表示，他希望在黄下周出现在众议院议员面前之前听取联邦调查局 (FBI) 和中央情报局 (CIA) 的意见。

paras.en: For Fitzpatrick, a former FBI special agent who sits on the House Intelligence Committee, the inquiry begins with what federal authorities knew and whether they warned the Nvidia chief of potential espionage threats.
paras.zh: 对于担任众议院情报委员会成员的前联邦调查局特工菲茨帕特里克来说，调查始于联邦当局所知道的情况以及他们是否警告过英伟达负责人潜在的间谍威胁。

paras.en: "What briefings did they give? When did they give them?" he asked.
paras.zh: “他们做了什么简报？什么时候做的？”他问道。

paras.en: Huang's reinstatement, Fitzpatrick said, should not put those questions to rest.
paras.zh: 菲茨帕特里克说，黄的复职不应消除这些问题。

paras.en: "The public is rightly concerned, and they deserve answers," he said.
paras.zh: “公众的担忧是正确的，他们应该得到答案，”他说。

paras.en: Fitzpatrick also wants to hear from Attorney General Todd Blanche, who on Tuesday described Nvidia as a good corporate citizen, and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, whose department faces questions over Nvidia's chip exports to China.
paras.zh: 菲茨帕特里克还希望听取司法部长托德·布兰奇（Todd Blanche）和商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克（Howard Lutnick）的意见，前者周二将英伟达描述为良好的企业公民，后者的部门面临英伟达向中国出口芯片的质疑。

paras.en: "Anytime you do an investigation, you follow the facts wherever they lead, and you report those facts with unimpeachable integrity," Fitzpatrick said. "You leave no stone unturned."
paras.zh: 菲茨帕特里克说：“无论何时进行调查，你都会遵循事实，无论事实如何，并以无可挑剔的诚信报告这些事实。” “你不遗余力。”

paras.en: The debate over Huang's reinstatement extends beyond Washington.
paras.zh: 关于黄的复职的争论超出了华盛顿范围。

paras.en: In Silicon Valley, his return has alarmed women and advocates who have spent years pushing for a better workplace culture, renewing questions about the limits of executive accountability.
paras.zh: 在硅谷，他的回归引起了女性和倡导者的警惕，她们多年来一直在推动更好的工作场所文化，并重新提出了关于高管问责制局限性的问题。

paras.en: Listen to the full interview by clicking on the blue button above.
paras.zh: 单击上面的蓝色按钮收听完整采访。

paras.en: The radio interview was edited by Ally Schweitzer.
paras.zh: 电台采访由艾莉·史怀哲 (Ally Schweitzer) 编辑。

articles.title: Army to detonate tons of lead azide after delays. And, Abrego Garcia leaves U.S.
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Army to detonate tons of lead azide after delays. And, Abrego Garcia leaves U.S.
paras.zh: 军队在延误后引爆了数吨叠氮化铅。而且，阿布雷戈·加西亚离开了美国

paras.en: The Army will detonate a huge explosion in Middletown, Iowa, this morning to safely dispose of thousands of pounds of lead azide that could spontaneously explode. The explosive has been used since WWI and was moved to the Iowa bunker 17 years ago. The detonation is happening after officials found that the lead azide had crystallized and become unstable. Authorities have evacuated a 5-mile radius, and those within 20 miles are advised to stay indoors to avoid exposure to toxins.
paras.zh: 今天早上，陆军将在爱荷华州米德尔敦引爆一次巨大爆炸，以安全处置可能自爆的数千磅叠氮化铅。这种炸药自第一次世界大战以来就一直使用，并于 17 年前被转移到爱荷华州的掩体中。爆炸是在官员发现叠氮化铅结晶并变得不稳定后发生的。当局已疏散方圆 5 英里范围内的人员，建议方圆 20 英里以内的人员留在室内，以避免接触毒素。

paras.en: - 🎧 The U.S. Army rescheduled the detonation multiple times after the public got wind of it last week, NPR's Quil Lawrence tells Up First. Purdue University's Andrew Whelton, who has worked on disaster planning, tells Lawrence the detonation caused stress for residents, businesses and farmers. The Trump administration pushed back on the notion that this planned action was a surprise, citing town hall meetings on the topic. Lawrence says the biggest danger in the detonation is to kids and pregnant people due to the lead dust in the air or on surfaces. There are also worries about potential harm to livestock and crops, as well as the cleanup duration.
paras.zh: - NPR 的奎尔·劳伦斯 (Quil Lawrence) 告诉 Up First，上周公众获悉爆炸消息后，美国陆军多次重新安排了爆炸时间。普渡大学的安德鲁·惠尔顿（Andrew Whelton）从事灾难规划工作，他告诉劳伦斯，爆炸给居民、企业和农民带来了压力。特朗普政府反驳了这一计划中的行动令人意外的观点，并引用了有关该主题的市政厅会议。劳伦斯说，爆炸中最大的危险是儿童和孕妇，因为空气或表面存在铅尘。人们还担心对牲畜和农作物的潜在危害以及清理时间。

paras.en: Kilmar Abrego Garcia has voluntarily left the U.S. after a nearly two-year legal battle. He is the Salvadoran immigrant who became emblematic of the challenges posed by President Trump's mass deportation campaign. Abrego Garcia was arrested in 2025 and mistakenly deported to El Salvador. He returned to the U.S. but departed for Spain yesterday. His lawyer, Simon Sandoval-Moshenberg, said that Abrego Garcia boarded a commercial flight to a destination of his choice and "left the United States a free man." Sandoval-Moshenberg described the move as "a temporary departure," saying that Abrego Garcia, whose wife and child are U.S. citizens, has options to return to the U.S.
paras.zh: 经过近两年的法律斗争后，基尔马·阿布雷戈·加西亚自愿离开美国。他是萨尔瓦多移民，成为特朗普总统大规模驱逐运动所带来挑战的象征。阿布雷戈·加西亚 (Abrego Garcia) 于 2025 年被捕，并被错误地驱逐到萨尔瓦多。他返回美国，但昨天启程前往西班牙。他的律师西蒙·桑多瓦尔-莫申伯格表示，阿布雷戈·加西亚登上了商业航班飞往他选择的目的地，并“以自由人的身份离开了美国”。桑多瓦尔-莫申伯格将此举描述为“暂时离开”，并表示阿布雷戈·加西亚的妻子和孩子都是美国公民，他可以选择返回美国。

paras.en: - 🎧 Abrego Garcia's attorney said that he will essentially spend two years waiting abroad. His case raises concerns about due process and the risks of sending individuals to countries where they could be harmed, NPR's Juliana Kim says. The Department of Homeland Security said they are delighted by his decision to leave the U.S. The agency, in a statement, said that "now this El Salvadoran man cannot terrorize innocents." After being mistakenly deported, upon his return to the U.S., Abrego Garcia was charged with human smuggling, an allegation he has denied.
paras.zh: - 🎧 阿布雷戈·加西亚的律师表示，他基本上会在国外等待两年。 NPR 的朱莉安娜·金 (Juliana Kim) 表示，他的案件引发了人们对正当程序以及将个人送往可能受到伤害的国家的风险的担忧。美国国土安全部表示，他们对他离开美国的决定感到高兴。该机构在一份声明中表示，“现在这个萨尔瓦多男子不能恐吓无辜者。”被错误驱逐出境后，阿布雷戈·加西亚返回美国后被指控犯有人口走私罪，但他否认了这一指控。

paras.en: Nvidia's newly reinstated CEO, Jensen Huang, apologized to his staff yesterday for his previous behavior, according to the New York Times. He reportedly denied that Trump pressured the board for his return, despite the president saying otherwise. Huang had stepped down following reports of affairs, including one with a woman reportedly suspected by U.S. intelligence agencies of being recruited by China's spy agency. Some members of Congress still have concerns about the national security scandal.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，英伟达新任首席执行官黄仁勋昨天为自己之前的行为向员工道歉。据报道，他否认特朗普向董事会施压要求他回归，尽管总统另有说法。黄在一系列的婚外情报道后辞职，其中包括一名据报道美国情报机构怀疑被中国间谍机构招募的女性。一些国会议员仍然对国家安全丑闻感到担忧。

paras.en: - 🎧 Some lawmakers are upset with Huang, while others criticized Nvidia and its board, NPR's Maham Javaid says. Democratic Sen. Elizabeth Warren says that Huang owes Congress answers about Nvidia's compliance with laws designed to keep advanced chips out of China. Republican Sen. Tom Cotton of Arkansas is calling for a congressional investigation into Huang and urging faster action on chip-control legislation. House Democratic Committee leaders sent a letter to the president after he claimed he helped with Huang's reinstatement. They asked if he prioritizes friends and allies over the nation's economic and national security interests. They demanded a response by Dec. 8 on what he knew about Huang's ties to an alleged Chinese spy. Huang will attend a closed-door hearing with House members next week, followed by testimony before a Senate committee two days later.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 Maham Javaid 表示，一些议员对黄仁勋感到不满，而另一些议员则批评 Nvidia 及其董事会。民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 表示，黄仁勋有责任向国会提供有关英伟达是否遵守旨在阻止先进芯片进入中国的法律的问题。阿肯色州共和党参议员汤姆·科顿呼吁国会对黄进行调查，并敦促加快芯片控制立法行动。在总统声称他帮助黄之复职后，众议院民主党委员会领导人致函总统。他们询问他是否将朋友和盟友置于国家经济和国家安全利益之上。他们要求在 12 月 8 日之前就他所了解的黄与一名被指控的中国间谍的关系做出回应。黄黄将于下周与众议院议员一起参加闭门听证会，两天后在参议院委员会作证。

paras.en: NPR launched the first-ever Senior Podcast Challenge this fall, inviting people over 65 to share their stories. Unlike the NPR Student Podcast Challenge, which has attracted more than 90,000 young voices since 2018, this contest focuses on the wisdom and experiences of older voices. While the contest is still open for a few more days, the judges have already listened to more than 100 submissions. Some stories explore life after retirement, dating after divorce or the loss of a partner, and coming to terms with being a senior. Take a listen to some of their favorite early entries.
paras.zh: NPR 今年秋天推出了首届高级播客挑战赛，邀请 65 岁以上的人分享他们的故事。与自 2018 年以来吸引了超过 90,000 名年轻声音的 NPR 学生播客挑战赛不同，本次比赛侧重于年长声音的智慧和经验。虽然比赛还有几天时间，但评委们已经听取了 100 多份参赛作品。有些故事探讨退休后的生活、离婚后的约会或失去伴侣，以及如何适应老年人的生活。听听他们最喜欢的一些早期作品。

paras.en: There's still time to enter. The competition will close on Nov. 30. These are the official rules for the 2026 NPR Senior Podcast Challenge and you can submit your entry here.
paras.zh: 还有时间可以进去。比赛将于 11 月 30 日结束。以下是 2026 年 NPR 高级播客挑战赛的官方规则，您可以在此处提交参赛作品。

paras.en: If you're spending your free time ruminating about work-related issues, you're essentially still on the clock, according to psychologist and author Guy Winch. Don't let workplace woes invade your home life. Winch shares techniques with Life Kit to help you reclaim your time, energy and attention when work consumes too much of your mental bandwidth.
paras.zh: 心理学家兼作家盖伊·温奇 (Guy Winch) 表示，如果你把空闲时间花在思考与工作相关的问题上，那么你基本上还是在赶时间。不要让工作场所的困境侵入你的家庭生活。 Winch 与 Life Kit 分享一些技巧，帮助您在工作占用过多精力时重新获得时间、精力和注意力。

paras.en: - 🧠 Instead of reliving the work issue, spend 15 minutes creating a plan to address the situation. Ask yourself, "How can I handle this? What outcome do I want?"
paras.zh: - 🧠 不要再重复工作问题，而是花 15 分钟制定一个计划来解决该情况。问问自己，“我该如何处理这个问题？我想要什么结果？”

paras.en: - 🧠 Adopt rituals that engage as many senses as possible to help your brain transition between tasks. For example, try changing your clothes to signal the end of the workday. The more you repeat rituals, the easier it is for your brain to shift from work to relaxation.
paras.zh: - 🧠 采用尽可能多的感官参与的仪式，以帮助您的大脑在任务之间进行转换。例如，尝试换衣服以表示工作日结束。你重复的仪式越多，你的大脑就越容易从工作转向放松。

paras.en: - 🧠 Do something that energizes you. Activities like screen time and doomscrolling may seem relaxing, but they aren't effective.
paras.zh: - 🧠 做一些让你充满活力的事情。像屏幕时间和末日滚动这样的活动可能看起来很放松，但它们并不有效。

paras.en: - 🧠 Ask yourself: "If my job disappeared tomorrow, what remains of me?" You might realize your worth isn't tied to your job title.
paras.zh: - 🧠 问问自己：“如果明天我的工作消失了，我还剩下什么？”您可能会意识到您的价值与您的职位无关。

paras.en: - Dancing with the Stars wrapped up Season 35 last night, crowning Paralympian Ezra Frech and his partner, Daniella Karagach, as the winners of this year's Len Goodman Mirrorball Trophy.
paras.zh: - 昨晚，《与星共舞》第 35 季落下帷幕，残奥会选手 Ezra Frech 和他的搭档 Daniella Karagach 成为今年 Len Goodman Mirrorball Trophy 的获得者。

paras.en: - Frailejon, a plant of Colombia's high-mountain wetlands that's vital to the country's water supply, is facing an array of threats from farmers, ranchers and climate change. Volunteers are working to save these plants, one seedling at a time.
paras.zh: - Frailejon 是哥伦比亚高山湿地的一种植物，对该国的供水至关重要，它正面临着来自农民、牧场主和气候变化的一系列威胁。志愿者正在努力拯救这些植物，一次拯救一株幼苗。

paras.en: - Doctors are combating disinformation about routine vitamin K shots for newborns, which prevent rare but life-threatening hemorrhaging. The rate of parents skipping these shots for their kids has increased from 3.1% in 2017 to 6.8% in 2025, according to new research in JAMA.
paras.zh: - 医生们正在打击有关新生儿常规注射维生素 K 的虚假信息，这种注射可以预防罕见但危及生命的出血。根据 JAMA 的最新研究，父母为孩子不注射这些疫苗的比例已从 2017 年的 3.1% 上升到 2025 年的 6.8%。

articles.title: How American Thanksgiving took root -- and evolved -- in Liberia
articles.author: Ari Daniel

paras.en: How American Thanksgiving took root — and evolved — in Liberia
paras.zh: 美国感恩节如何在利比里亚扎根并演变

paras.en: Yvonne Capehart Weah is from Liberia, a country in West Africa, and she's one of twelve siblings.
paras.zh: 伊冯·卡普哈特·维阿 (Yvonne Capehart Weah) 来自西非国家利比里亚，是十二个兄弟姐妹之一。

paras.en: "I'm the second to the last one — I'm the eleventh," she says. "We have large families in Liberia."
paras.zh: “我是倒数第二个——我是第十一个，”她说。 “我们在利比里亚有很多家庭。”

paras.en: Every year on the first Thursday in November, Weah's family gathers in Caldwell, the township where she grew up, to celebrate Liberian Thanksgiving.
paras.zh: 每年十一月的第一个星期四，维阿的家人都会聚集在她长大的小镇考德威尔，庆祝利比里亚感恩节。

paras.en: "When we come together, the group become [so] large that you are not able to sit around a dining table," she explains. "So we do it outside under the tree. And when we meet, it's almost like we're having a party."
paras.zh: “当我们聚在一起时，这个群体变得如此庞大，以至于你无法坐在餐桌旁，”她解释道。 “所以我们在外面的树下进行。当我们见面时，几乎就像我们正在举办派对一样。”

paras.en: The Liberian holiday dates back to the first half of the 19th century when the American Colonization Society established the community that would grow into the country. It was founded by Black Americans — both those born free and enslaved people who had been emancipated — whose departure was sometimes voluntary, sometimes forced. "The settlers from America brought that Thanksgiving Day tradition to Liberia," says Weah. Once transplanted, the holiday evolved over time in response to national events.
paras.zh: 利比里亚的节日可以追溯到 19 世纪上半叶，当时美国殖民协会建立了后来发展到该国的社区。它是由美国黑人创立的——包括那些生来自由的人和获得解放的奴隶——他们的离开有时是自愿的，有时是被迫的。 “来自美国的定居者将感恩节传统带到了利比里亚，”维阿说。一旦移植，这个节日就会随着时间的推移而演变，以响应全国性的事件。

paras.en: Liberia gained its independence in 1847 but the British continued trying to take swaths of territory. In 1883, President Alfred Francis Russell, an Episcopalian priest, called upon God to help halt the incursions.
paras.zh: 利比里亚于 1847 年获得独立，但英国人继续试图占领大片领土。 1883 年，圣公会牧师阿尔弗雷德·弗朗西斯·拉塞尔总统呼吁上帝帮助阻止入侵。

paras.en: That invocation was a "prayer of protection against the intruders, preventing intrusion into our territory," says Weah.
paras.zh: 维阿说，这一祈祷是“祈祷免受入侵者的侵害，防止入侵我们的领土”。

paras.en: The Liberians managed to maintain their sovereignty. And that year, the legislature officially established Thanksgiving as a national holiday steeped in the religious gratitude of the moment.
paras.zh: 利比里亚人设法维护了自己的主权。那一年，立法机关正式将感恩节定为全国性节日，充满了宗教感恩之情。

paras.en: Weah summarizes Liberian Thanksgiving this way: "It's giving thanks to God for our freedom, for divine protection. It's giving thanks to God for unity and for the harvest."
paras.zh: 维阿这样总结利比里亚的感恩节：“感谢上帝赐予我们的自由，感谢上帝的保护。感谢上帝赐予我们团结和丰收。”

paras.en: Weah says that her family's celebration, like that of many others in Liberia, starts in the morning at church. But the holiday's for people of all faiths, and other religious communities mark the occasion as well
paras.zh: 维阿说，她家人的庆祝活动和利比里亚其他许多人的庆祝活动一样，从早上在教堂开始。但这个节日适合所有信仰的人，其他宗教团体也庆祝这个节日

paras.en: "The Muslims, they go to the mosques and pray," says Sekou Muhammad Sheriff, a YouTuber who travels his home country of Liberia to showcase its offerings and cultural heritage, including Thanksgiving. "And Muslims, Christians, and others — everybody observe this day as a holiday."
paras.zh: “穆斯林会去清真寺祈祷，”YouTuber Sekou Muhammad Sheriff 说道，他前往自己的祖国利比里亚展示其产品和文化遗产，包括感恩节。 “穆斯林、基督徒和其他人——每个人都把这一天当作节日。”

paras.en: When Sheriff was a boy, this was the day that he counted on to get a new outfit.
paras.zh: 当警长还是个孩子的时候，他就指望着这一天能得到一套新衣服。

paras.en: "What my dad used to do for me," says Sheriff, was to purchase a "shirt-trouser suit, and then he'd buy me slipper." His favorite suit was a white one.
paras.zh: 警长说：“我父亲过去常常为我买一套“衬衫裤套装，然后他会给我买一双拖鞋。”他最喜欢的西装是白色的。

paras.en: Over the years on Thanksgiving, he's grown accustomed to eating different stews, including one made with sweet potato leaves and another with snails collected from the garden.
paras.zh: 多年来，他已经习惯在感恩节吃不同的炖菜，其中一种是用红薯叶做的，另一种是用从花园里收集的蜗牛做的。

paras.en: "We call it king's meat," Sheriff says with a chuckle. "It is very, very nice."
paras.zh: “我们称之为国王的肉，”警长笑着说。 “这非常非常好。”

paras.en: The mid-afternoon meal varies from household to household in Liberia.
paras.zh: 在利比里亚，每个家庭的午饭时间各不相同。

paras.en: "We don't do turkey," says Weah, "but we do chicken. We do fried chicken, smoked chicken, roasted chicken."
paras.zh: “我们不做火鸡，”维阿说，“但我们做鸡肉。我们做炸鸡、熏鸡、烤鸡。”

paras.en: Weah's family also serves jollof rice, watermelon, pineapple and a variety of stews, including one called fufu and soup. It's a mix of cassava, fish, chicken, okra, chili pepper and more. "That makes the soup very tasty," says Weah. "It has to be [at] every Thanksgiving."
paras.zh: 维阿的家人还提供乔洛夫米饭、西瓜、菠萝和各种炖菜，包括一种叫做“fufu”和“汤”的炖菜。它是木薯、鱼、鸡肉、秋葵、辣椒等的混合物。 “这使得汤非常美味，”维阿说。 “它必须是在每个感恩节。”

paras.en: (Weah doesn't especially like to cook, however. "If you tell me, 'Go in the kitchen to cook or sit in the living room and read,'" she says, "I will sit in the living room and read.")
paras.zh: （然而，维阿并不是特别喜欢做饭。“如果你告诉我，‘去厨房做饭，或者坐在客厅里读书，’”她说，“我会坐在客厅里读书。”）

paras.en: This year, Sheriff didn't have the resources to host Thanksgiving. But he says that he remains thankful to God for keeping him healthy and for keeping Liberia peaceful after civil conflict tore his country apart from 1989 to 1997 and 1999 to 2003.
paras.zh: 今年，警长没有资源举办感恩节。但他说，他仍然感谢上帝让他保持健康，并在 1989 年至 1997 年和 1999 年至 2003 年的内战使利比里亚分裂后保持利比里亚的和平。

paras.en: Weah is also grateful. "When I go for Thanksgiving," she says, "I'm thanking God for where I have come from, where I am now, and I'm also thanking Him for where He will take me because I know He holds the future."
paras.zh: 维阿也很感激。 “当我去过感恩节时，”她说，“我感谢上帝让我从哪里来，现在在哪里，我也感谢他将带我去哪里，因为我知道他掌握着未来。”

paras.en: Weah is the program manager at the We-Care Foundation, an education nonprofit that, among other things, teaches children literacy. "A reading child will become a reading elder," she says.
paras.zh: 维阿是 We-Care 基金会的项目经理，该基金会是一家教育非营利组织，其业务之一是教授儿童识字。 “一个读书的孩子将会成为一个读书的老人，”她说。

paras.en: "And we expect informed adults to make informed decisions that affect both their social and economic life" — in ways, perhaps, that they will one day be thankful for.
paras.zh: “我们希望知情的成年人能够做出明智的决定，影响他们的社会和经济生活”——也许，他们有一天会对此心存感激。

paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳整体信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它还没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，通常获得的信用额度也越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高利率。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。
