articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。 In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派别试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的形状而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰冷拌面——都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然充满活力的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答任何有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时间，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的奇妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇； of all those, this is the most stunning.

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈建议您乘船沿河游览。您可以沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时对这些古代建筑师的坚定决心啧啧称奇。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租车或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子到达老牛湾 - 这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通会比私家车多花一两个小时。

articles.title: Rams star Puka Nacua's MCL completely tore off the bone as details emerge from season-ending injury: report

paras.en: The details have come out on Puka Nacua's season-ending injury, and the details are grotesque.
paras.zh: 普卡纳库亚赛季报销的伤病细节已经曝光，而且细节很怪诞。

paras.en: The Los Angeles Rams star suffered the injury on the final offensive play of the team's 20-13 win over the Washington Commanders in Week 9. The 25-year-old sustained a grade 3 MCL tear, which means the ligament completely tore off the tibia, which is the shinbone, according to ESPN's Adam Schefter.
paras.zh: 这位洛杉矶公羊队球星在第九周球队以 20-13 战胜华盛顿指挥官队的最后一场进攻中受伤。据 ESPN 的 Adam Schefter 报道，这位 25 岁的球员遭受了 3 级内侧副韧带撕裂，这意味着韧带完全撕裂了胫骨，也就是小腿骨。

paras.en: In addition to the MCL tear, Schefter said that Nacua "had a tear off the posterior oblique portion of the MCL as well."
paras.zh: 谢夫特表示，除了内侧副韧带撕裂外，纳库亚“内侧副韧带后斜部分也有撕裂”。

paras.en: "So that wouldn’t have healed with the stability that they needed, and, essentially, it would be performance-limiting with a higher chance of earlier degenerative changes," Schefter said on "The Adam Schefter Podcast." "So they had to go in and repair the knee."
paras.zh: 谢夫特在“亚当·谢夫特播客”中表示：“因此，他们无法通过所需的稳定性得到治愈，而且从本质上讲，这将限制性能，并且更有可能出现早期退行性变化。” “所以他们必须进去修复膝盖。”

paras.en: Losing Nacua is a massive blow for a 6-4 Rams team that is fighting for a playoff spot. Although Nacua missed two games earlier this season due to injury, he has been incredibly productive when healthy. In seven games, the two-time Pro Bowler has 70 catches for 715 yards and four touchdowns.
paras.zh: 失去纳库亚对于一支6胜4负、正在争夺季后赛席位的公羊队来说是一个巨大的打击。尽管纳库阿本赛季早些时候因伤缺席了两场比赛，但他在健康的情况下却表现得非常高效。在七场比赛中，这位两届职业保龄球手完成 70 次接球，推进 715 码，并取得 4 次达阵。

paras.en: Compounding the Rams' problems, they are now without their top two wide receivers, as Davante Adams remains sidelined with a hamstring injury he suffered in Week 6. Rams coach Sean McVay said earlier in November they were targeting a return for the team's matchup against the Green Bay Packers on Wednesday, but he remains on injured reserve and is out.
paras.zh: 公羊队的问题更加复杂，他们现在失去了两名顶级外接手，因为达万特·亚当斯在第六周因腿筋受伤而继续缺阵。公羊队教练肖恩·麦克维在 11 月初表示，他们的目标是在周三对阵绿湾包装工队的比赛中回归，但他仍处于伤病储备名单中并缺席。

paras.en: In six games this season, the six-time Pro Bowler has 30 catches for 480 yards and four touchdowns. Without Nacua and Adams, the Rams are incredibly thin at wide receiver. They hope Konata Mumpfield, Tutu Atwell, CJ Daniels and Xavier Smith can step up in their absence while also leaning on their deep group of tight ends.
paras.zh: 在本赛季的六场比赛中，这位六届职业保龄球手完成了 30 次接球，推进 480 码并达阵 4 次。没有纳库阿和亚当斯，公羊队的外接手就非常薄弱。他们希望科纳塔·蒙普菲尔德、图图·阿特维尔、CJ·丹尼尔斯和泽维尔·史密斯能够在缺席期间站出来，同时依靠他们的近端锋阵容。

paras.en: However, Nacua is not the only Rams offensive weapon who is out for the season. McVay announced Monday that Ferguson's ankle injury will require season-ending surgery.
paras.zh: 然而，纳库亚并不是​​公羊队本赛季唯一缺席的进攻武器。麦克维周一宣布，弗格森的脚踝受伤需要进行赛季结束的手术。

paras.en: Matthew Stafford will try to lead a win without his top offensive weapons when they play the Packers at home Wednesday at 8:00 p.m. ET.
paras.zh: 当周三晚上 8:00 主场迎战包装工队时，马修·斯塔福德 (Matthew Stafford) 将在没有他顶级进攻武器的情况下尝试带领球队取得胜利。等。

articles.title: Thanksgiving flights booked after key hour face double the risk of major delay

paras.en: As U.S. airports brace for a brutal Thanksgiving rush, travel analysts are warning passengers about a common scheduling mistake that raises the odds of a disrupted trip: booking a flight after 9 a.m.
paras.zh: 在美国机场准备迎接残酷的感恩节高峰之际，旅行分析师警告乘客，一个常见的日程安排错误会增加旅行中断的可能性：预订上午 9 点之后的航班。

paras.en: "Flights departing after 9 a.m. are generally twice as likely to be delayed as those departing between 5 a.m. and 8 a.m.," according to Hopper data.
paras.zh: 霍珀数据显示：“上午 9 点之后起飞的航班延误的可能性通常是早上 5 点到 8 点之间起飞的航班的两倍。”

paras.en: The alert lands at an uneasy moment for American flyers, with 69% now ranking delays and cancellations as their top booking concern, according to a Hopper consumer survey.
paras.zh: Hopper 的一项消费者调查显示，这一警报正值美国旅客感到不安的时刻，69% 的旅客将延误和取消列为最关心的预订问题。

paras.en: A storm system bringing heavy rain, wind and thunderstorms has already swept across the Gulf Coast and Southeast and is bearing down on major Mid-Atlantic and Northeast hubs through Thanksgiving Day, according to the Federal Aviation Administration.
paras.zh: 据美国联邦航空管理局称，带来大雨、大风和雷暴的风暴系统已经席卷墨西哥湾沿岸和东南部，并在感恩节期间袭击大西洋中部和东北部的主要枢纽。

paras.en: Confidence has also been tested by recent technical scares.
paras.zh: 最近的技术恐慌也考验了人们的信心。

paras.en: Travelers were shaken by the Nov. 13 FAA ground stop sparked by telecommunications instability.
paras.zh: 11 月 13 日，美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 因电信不稳定而进行地面停车，旅客们对此感到震惊。

paras.en: The ground stop halted departures nationwide, resulting in more than 12,400 cancellations, according to the U.S. Department of Transportation and the FAA.
paras.zh: 据美国交通部和美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 称，地面站导致全国范围内的出发航班暂停，导致超过 12,400 趟航班取消。

paras.en: An isolated outage also prompted a brief ground stop at Chicago O'Hare International Airport on Nov. 24, as Fox News Digital previously reported.
paras.zh: 据 Fox News Digital 此前报道，11 月 24 日，一次孤立的停电还导致芝加哥奥黑尔国际机场短暂地面停留。

paras.en: Across U.S. domestic flights from 2023 through 2025, just 11% of departures scheduled before 8 a.m. arrived 15 or more minutes late, according to Bureau of Transportation Statistics data analyzed by DelayGuard.
paras.zh: DelayGuard 分析的交通统计局数据显示，从 2023 年到 2025 年，在美国国内航班中，只有 11% 的计划于上午 8 点之前起飞的航班晚点 15 分钟或更长时间。

paras.en: Because commercial jets typically fly multiple legs a day, a storm or runway bottleneck in one hub can affect later routes. Late-arriving aircraft are responsible for 41% of all U.S. delay minutes, an AirDelay analysis noted.
paras.zh: 由于商用飞机通常每天飞行多个航段，因此一个枢纽的风暴或跑道瓶颈可能会影响后续航线。 AirDelay 分析指出，美国 41% 的延误时间由飞机迟到造成。

paras.en: Sunrise departures sidestep that chain reaction.
paras.zh: 日出出发避开了连锁反应。

paras.en: "The aircraft has spent the night at the airport, so there is no late inbound flight to wait for," DelayGuard reported. Morning crews are also just beginning their shifts, so earlier snags on the schedule will not hold up boarding, according to DelayGuard.
paras.zh: DelayGuard 报道称：“飞机已在机场过夜，因此无需等待晚点的入境航班。”据 DelayGuard 称，早上的工作人员也刚刚开始轮班，因此时间表上的较早障碍不会阻碍登机。

paras.en: Passengers whose morning flights are disrupted have far more later departures available to rebook.
paras.zh: 早间航班受到干扰的乘客可以重新预订更多较晚出发的航班。

paras.en: Evening snags leave fewer options, according to AirDelay and CLEAR.
paras.zh: 根据 AirDelay 和 CLEAR 的说法，晚上的障碍留下的选择较少。

paras.en: In addition, travelers willing to brave a 4 a.m. alarm often score lower fares on a 6 a.m. flight than on a 10 a.m. departure, The Points Guy reported.
paras.zh: 此外，The Points Guy 报道称，愿意冒着凌晨 4 点闹钟响的旅客，乘坐早上 6 点的航班所获得的票价往往比上午 10 点出发的航班要低。

paras.en: "Taking a morning flight gives you a greater chance of having a plane and crew ready to go," Gary Leff, a Texas-based travel industry expert and author of the blog "View From The Wing," told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州旅游业专家、博客“View From The Wing”的作者加里·莱夫 (Gary Leff) 告诉福克斯新闻数字频道：“乘坐早间航班让您有更大的机会让飞机和机组人员做好起飞的准备。”

paras.en: "There's an opportunity to address maintenance issues overnight. So [there's] a likelihood of starting the day with an aircraft that's ready," Leff continued.
paras.zh: “有机会在一夜之间解决维护问题。因此，有可能以准备好的飞机开始新的一天，”莱夫继续说道。

paras.en: "Crew have limits in their duty day. They could run out of allowable time with late flights that get delayed," he added. "Early flights mean starting fresh, and you aren't risking your pilots or flight attendants 'timing out.'"
paras.zh: “机组人员的值勤时间是有限制的。由于航班延误，他们可能会用完允许的时间，”他补充道。 “早班航班意味着重新开始，而且您不会冒着飞行员或空乘人员‘超时’的风险。”

paras.en: Picking the right day of the week can sway the odds as well.
paras.zh: 选择一周中正确的一天也可以改变赔率。

paras.en: Tuesday consistently ranks as the most punctual day at major U.S. airports, with fewer than 19% of departures arriving late — followed closely by Wednesday, according to Bureau of Transportation Statistics records reviewed by DelayGuard.
paras.zh: 根据 DelayGuard 审查的运输统计局记录，周二一直被评为美国主要机场最准时的一天，只有不到 19% 的航班迟到，周三紧随其后。

paras.en: Sunday sits at the bottom, with a quarter of flights running behind schedule, DelayGuard reported.
paras.zh: 据 DelayGuard 报道，周日排名垫底，四分之一的航班落后于计划。

paras.en: "Delays stack throughout the day. If you're on the third or fourth flight operated by your crew or aircraft that day, there were several opportunities for them to get delayed during the day," Leff said.
paras.zh: “一整天的延误情况都会叠加。如果您乘坐的是当天由机组人员或飞机执飞的第三个或第四个航班，那么他们在白天有几次延误的机会，”莱夫说。

paras.en: During peak holiday windows, timing can protect a traveler's wallet, too.
paras.zh: 在假期高峰时段，合理安排时间也可以保护旅行者的钱包。

paras.en: Flying home on Sunday can be the costliest option, with round-trip domestic fares averaging $604 compared with roughly $350 for passengers who wait until Monday or Tuesday, according to Hopper's 2026 Holiday Travel Index.
paras.zh: 根据 Hopper 的 2026 年假日旅行指数，周日乘飞机回家可能是最昂贵的选择，国内往返票价平均为 604 美元，而等到周一或周二的乘客则约为 350 美元。

paras.en: "Early flights mean more recovery options."
paras.zh: “早班航班意味着更多的康复选择。”

paras.en: "Early flights mean more recovery options," said Leff. "Not only are there more same-day options left on the schedule, but available seats are less likely to have been taken by other passengers that were delayed."
paras.zh: “早班航班意味着更多的康复选择，”莱夫说。 “时刻表上不仅有更多当日选择，而且可用座位也不太可能被其他延误的乘客占用。”

articles.title: Shane Gillis wishes ex-girlfriend 'the best' after tell-all essay accusing him of cheating and 'red flags'

paras.en: Comedian Shane Gillis’ ex-girlfriend wrote a lengthy piece this week about their yearlong relationship, saying his controversial "Saturday Night Live" joke about women at the gym reflects how he treats women behind closed doors.
paras.zh: 喜剧演员肖恩·吉利斯的前女友本周写了一篇长文，讲述他们长达一年的关系，称他在《周六夜现场》中关于健身房女性的颇具争议的笑话反映了他在幕后对待女性的方式。

paras.en: In an essay published by The Cut, content creator Grace Brassel wrote that the comedian pressured her into quitting her job, isolated her from friends and family and cheated on her before their split in August 2025.
paras.zh: 在 The Cut 发表的一篇文章中，内容创作者格蕾丝·布拉塞尔 (Grace Brassel) 写道，这位喜剧演员向她施压，迫使她辞职，将她与朋友和家人隔离开来，并在 2025 年 8 月分手之前对她进行了欺骗。

paras.en: Speaking to Fox News Digital, Gillis responded to Brassel’s claims, saying, "Grace and I had some good times together. Breakups are tough, and I wish her the best."
paras.zh: 吉利斯在接受福克斯新闻数字频道采访时回应了布拉塞尔的说法，她说：“格蕾丝和我在一起度过了一些美好时光。分手很艰难，我祝她一切顺利。”

paras.en: In a statement to Fox News Digital, Brassel said she wrote the essay to help other women.
paras.zh: 布拉塞尔在给福克斯新闻数字频道的一份声明中表示，她写这篇文章是为了帮助其他女性。

paras.en: "I wrote this essay to help other women, and for them to know there is a life past it, these kinds of relationships. The beautiful DMs I am receiving mean so much to me. No matter what age you are, this can happen to you, and I always wished someone could have told me sooner. I hope it can help more girls speak out and stand up for themselves," Brassel said.
paras.zh: “我写这篇文章是为了帮助其他女性，让她们知道还有一种过去的生活，这种关系。我收到的美丽的私信对我来说意义重大。无论你多大，这种事都可能发生在你身上，我一直希望有人能早点告诉我。我希望它能帮助更多的女孩大声疾呼，为自己挺身而出，”布拉塞尔说。

paras.en: Brassel referenced Gillis’ recent controversial comments regarding women’s gym attire on "SNL" being that of "whores," writing that she wasn’t the "least bit surprised."
paras.zh: 布拉塞尔提到吉利斯最近在《周六夜现场》中对女性健身装的争议性评论是“妓女”，并写道她“一点也不感到惊讶”。

paras.en: "Until last August, I was in a yearlong relationship with Shane, and his comments didn’t faze me. After our time together, how do I think he feels about women? He doesn’t like them much," Brassel wrote.
paras.zh: “直到去年八月，我和肖恩已经交往了一年，他的评论并没有让我感到困扰。我们在一起之后，我认为他对女性的感觉如何？他不太喜欢她们，”布拉塞尔写道。

paras.en: The pair began talking in May 2024 after Brassel sent him direct messages on Instagram, and she initially described their whirlwind romance as a "dream." However, she explained that when they eventually moved in together, it was a "nonstop party," which made it difficult for her to keep up her day job as a social media manager.
paras.zh: 2024 年 5 月，布拉塞尔在 Instagram 上向他发送直接消息后，两人开始交往，她最初将他们旋风般的浪漫描述为“梦想”。然而，她解释说，当他们最终搬到一起时，这是一场“不间断的聚会”，这让她很难继续担任社交媒体经理的日常工作。

paras.en: She claimed Gillis encouraged her to quit, and when they moved to Pennsylvania to shoot his Netflix series "Tires," she felt as though his expectations of her changed.
paras.zh: 她声称吉利斯鼓励她辞职，当他们搬到宾夕法尼亚州拍摄他的 Netflix 连续剧《轮胎》时，她觉得他对她的期望似乎发生了变化。

paras.en: "I felt like I was turning into a 25-year-old housewife, someone who cooked, cleaned, did the laundry, and waited for her man to come home from a long day at work. I never said I was capable of all that, but it felt like an expectation," Brassel wrote. "When things weren’t exactly to his liking, he would tell me that I wasn’t ‘being good.’ You know, the way you would talk to a dog."
paras.zh: “我感觉自己正在变成一名 25 岁的家庭主妇，做饭、打扫卫生、洗衣服，等待丈夫结束一天的工作回家。我从未说过我有能力做到这一切，但这感觉就像是一种期望，”布拉塞尔写道。 “当事情不完全符合他的喜好时，他会告诉我，我没有‘表现得很好’。你知道，就像你和狗说话一样。”

paras.en: She added that she ignored many "red flags," claiming he would say something "remarkably cruel" and play it off as a joke, and noted she felt she needed to start dressing more "conservatively."
paras.zh: 她补充说，她忽略了许多“危险信号”，声称他会说一些“非常残酷”的话，并把它当作一个笑话，并指出她觉得自己需要开始穿得更“保守”。

paras.en: "I cried every day. I would call my mom in tears, telling her that I didn’t know if I was meant for this life. My six-month free trial of Sweet Shane Gillis had run out, and it was time for me to start paying," she wrote.
paras.zh: “我每天都哭。我会流着泪给妈妈打电话，告诉她我不知道自己是否适合这样的生活。我的 Sweet Shane Gillis 六个月免费试用期已经结束，是时候开始付费了，”她写道。

paras.en: Brassel alleged that things came to a head on the Fourth of July, when she said she discovered Gillis’ infidelity after going through his phone and finding explicit messages with another woman that had been going on for months.
paras.zh: 布拉塞尔声称，事情在 7 月 4 日达到了紧要关头，当时她说，她在查看吉利斯的手机并发现与另一名女子持续数月的露骨信息后，发现了吉利斯的不忠。

paras.en: "I scrolled and realized they had been sexting for months and had probably had in-person encounters as well. The floor seemed to give way beneath my feet," she recalled.
paras.zh: “我滚动了一下，意识到他们已经发色情短信好几个月了，而且可能也有过面对面的接触。地板似乎在我脚下塌陷了，”她回忆道。

paras.en: Brassel admitted she "snapped" when confronting him. She described punching a hole in the bathroom wall and throwing her phone and a chair before the two eventually went through an on-and-off breakup. She claimed they had considered reconciling, but that Gillis said they could never mend things after she began telling others how he treated her.
paras.zh: 布拉塞尔承认，当她面对他时，她“生气了”。她描述说，她在浴室的墙上打了一个洞，扔了手机和一把椅子，然后两人最终断断续续地分手。她声称他们曾考虑过和解，但吉利斯说，在她开始告诉别人他如何对待她后，他们永远无法挽回局面。

paras.en: Brassel added that the outrage over Gillis’ recent monologue on "SNL" gave her "some kind of closure."
paras.zh: 布拉塞尔补充说，吉利斯最近在《周六夜现场》中的独白引发的愤怒让她“有了某种了结”。

paras.en: "He had flown too close to the sun, and people were finally seeing the man I knew. I had spent so long protecting this part of my life, afraid to speak publicly about it, and then he just did it himself. Finally, some initiative," Brassel wrote at the end of the essay.
paras.zh: “他飞得离太阳太近了，人们终于看到了我认识的那个人。我花了很长时间保护我生命的这一部分，不敢公开谈论它，然后他就自己做了。最后，一些主动性，”布拉塞尔在文章结尾写道。

paras.en: She also addressed the attention the essay has gotten in a video posted to her 124,000 followers on Instagram, saying she’s been working on the essay for a month and was fully aware of the "discourse" it would cause.
paras.zh: 她还在Instagram上向她的124,000名粉丝发布的视频中谈到了这篇文章引起的关注，称她已经为这篇文章花了一个月的时间，并且完全意识到它会引起的“讨论”。

paras.en: "I'm well aware of the discourse that was going to happen," Brassel said. "And I weighed out my options, and I think that it is a net positive, no matter what. I can handle the heat. I'm in the kitchen, girl. I can handle the heat."
paras.zh: “我很清楚即将发生的讨论，”布拉塞尔说。 “我权衡了我的选择，我认为无论如何，这都是积极的。我可以忍受高温。我在厨房里，女孩。我可以忍受高温。”

paras.en: Gillis addressed the controversy he spurred on "SNL," telling host Joe Rogan earlier this month that he had promised the show’s producers "no controversy."
paras.zh: 吉利斯谈到了他在《周六夜现场》中引发的争议，本月早些时候告诉主持人乔·罗根，他已向节目制片人保证“不会引起争议”。

paras.en: "Not to defend ‘SNL,’ they don't approve it. I mean, they could shut it down," Gillis said on "The Joe Rogan Experience."
paras.zh: “不是为了捍卫《周六夜现场》，他们不批准它。我的意思是，他们可以关闭它，”吉利斯在“乔·罗根经历”中说道。

paras.en: "But you don't write your set and give it to them," he added. "Unless you’re not a comedian. I’m sure non-comics, they write the set for them. They have writers that write the monologue for them."
paras.zh: “但你不会写出你的一套并将其交给他们，”他补充道。 “除非你不是喜剧演员。我确信非喜剧演员会为他们写场景。他们有作家为他们写独白。”

paras.en: "The funniest part was... they were like, ‘What’s going on with the monologue?’ And I was like, ‘It’s not great, but I don’t say anything bad.’ The whole time, I was like, ‘Fellas, I’m giving you a solid C-minus of a monologue, but I promise there’s no controversy. I’m calling myself fat for f---ing 10 minutes. That’s it.'"
paras.zh: “最有趣的是……他们问，‘独白是怎么回事？’我就想，‘这不太好，但我没有说任何坏话。’整个过程中，我都在想，‘伙计们，我给你一个独白的 C 减分，但我保证不会有争议。我在 10 分钟里称自己胖了。就是这样。’”

paras.en: Gillis drew criticism from entertainment figures, including actor Dan Levy and former "SNL" cast member Ego Nwodim, after joking during his opening monologue last month that women at gyms "just dress like whores now."
paras.zh: 吉利斯上个月在开场独白中开玩笑说健身房里的女性“现在穿得像妓女”，招致了娱乐界人士的批评，包括演员丹·利维和前《周六夜现场》演员伊戈·恩沃迪姆。

paras.en: The appearance marked his third time hosting the NBC sketch seies, which briefly hired and then fired him in 2019 as a cast member over a podcast appearance where he made jokes deemed offensive.
paras.zh: 这次亮相是他第三次主持 NBC 小品系列节目，该节目曾短暂聘用他，然后在 2019 年解雇了他，因为他在一次播客节目中讲了一些被视为冒犯性的笑话。

paras.en: Fox News Digital’s Taylor Penley contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道的泰勒·彭利 (Taylor Penley) 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: At least 30 killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway

paras.en: At least 30 people have been killed and 19 others injured in a large fire on a busy highway in Cairo after a fuel tanker crashed, Egypt's health ministry says.
paras.zh: 埃及卫生部称，开罗一条繁忙高速公路上一辆油罐车相撞后发生大火，造成至少 30 人死亡、19 人受伤。

paras.en: Hospitals nearby treated patients suffering burns and smoke inhalation after the incident, which occurred on a section of a ring road in the Warraq neighbourhood, to the north of the old city centre, on Wednesday evening.
paras.zh: 周三晚间，位于旧市中心以北的沃拉克街区的环路一段发生了这起事件，事件发生后，附近的医院正在治疗烧伤和吸入烟雾的患者。

paras.en: Unverified footage circulating on social media showed billowing flames and black smoke towering high into the night sky, with multiple nearby vehicles torched.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上流传的未经证实的视频显示，滚滚火焰和黑烟直冲夜空，附近多辆汽车被烧毁。

paras.en: Officials have not given an account of how the fire broke out, but state-owned media reported the vehicle had overturned, dousing nearby vehicles with petrol.
paras.zh: 官员们没有说明火灾是如何发生的，但官方媒体报道说，车辆翻倒了，附近的车辆被汽油浇湿。

paras.en: The regional public prosecutor has launched an investigation into the incident and asked that DNA samples be taken from bodies of the dead.
paras.zh: 地区检察官已对此事件展开调查，并要求从死者尸体中提取DNA样本。

paras.en: The tanker, which belonged to a private contractor, had been travelling along the highway when a high-voltage cable fell in front of it, prompting the driver to lose control, Al-Ahram reports, citing sources with knowledge of the investigation.
paras.zh: 金字塔报援引了解调查情况的消息人士报道称，这辆油罐车属于一家私人承包商，当时它正在高速公路上行驶，一条高压电缆掉在了它前面，导致司机失去控制。

paras.en: It then crossed the central reservation, overturned and caught fire, the state-owned newspaper says.
paras.zh: 该国有报纸称，随后它穿过了中央保留区，翻倒并起火。

paras.en: Egypt has suffered several deadly fires in recent years, with informal residential areas and often run-down infrastructure making incidents more common, the response to which is often complicated by slow emergency response times and locally improvised rescue efforts, even in the sprawling Egyptian capital.
paras.zh: 近年来，埃及遭受了多起致命火灾，非正规住宅区和经常破旧的基础设施使火灾事件变得更加常见，而紧急响应时间缓慢和当地临时救援工作往往使应对工作变得复杂，即使在面积庞大的埃及首都也是如此。

paras.en: Images from the scene show a large crowd gathered on the highway after the fire had been extinguished, as emergency services blocked off entry routes.
paras.zh: 现场图像显示，大火被扑灭后，大量人群聚集在高速公路上，紧急服务部门封锁了入口路线。

paras.en: The health ministry said 39 ambulances had been dispatched to respond to the fire, while it posted images of Egypt's health minister overseeing the treatment of the injured at one of Cairo's hospitals.
paras.zh: 卫生部表示，已派出 39 辆救护车前往救火，同时发布了埃及卫生部长在开罗一家医院监督伤者治疗的照片。

paras.en: Road collisions are also common in Egypt, often attributed to lax maintenance and the widespread flouting of traffic laws.
paras.zh: 道路碰撞在埃及也很常见，通常归因于维护不严和普遍违反交通法规。

paras.en: Nearly 6,000 people died on Egypt's roads last year, official figures show, a rise of several hundred on the previous year's total.
paras.zh: 官方数据显示，去年埃及有近 6,000 人死于道路事故，比前一年的总数增加了数百人。

paras.en: Emergency responders have since cleared the highway and allowed it to reopen, state broadcaster NMA reports.
paras.zh: 据国家广播公司 NMA 报道，紧急救援人员已清理了高速公路并允许其重新开放。

paras.en: A bulldozer could earlier be seen at the scene clearing the burnt-out wrecks of cars.
paras.zh: 早些时候可以看到现场有一辆推土机正在清理烧毁的汽车残骸。

articles.title: US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify

paras.en: Big technology firms connected to AI continued to see share prices fall on Wednesday, with stock in Nvidia and Anthropic dropping sharply in early trading.
paras.zh: 周三，与人工智能相关的大型科技公司股价继续下跌，英伟达和 Anthropic 的股价在早盘交易中大幅下跌。

paras.en: The surge in Nvidia shares after boss Jensen Huang was reinstated was temporary, and the general stock sell-off continued, with all three main US stock market indices down by closing time. The tech-dominated Nasdaq closed 0.6% lower.
paras.zh: 老板黄仁勋复职后，英伟达股价的飙升是暂时的，股票普遍抛售仍在继续，截至收盘，美国三大股指均下跌。以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数收盘下跌 0.6%。

paras.en: The declines came amid concerns over the level and sustainability of AI investment, which has rattled investors in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 股价下跌之际，人们对人工智能投资的水平和可持续性感到担忧，这在最近几周令投资者感到不安。

paras.en: Shares in other major tech firms, including Amazon, Tesla and Microsoft closed the day lower, though Meta and SpaceX were in positive territory by the end of the trading day.
paras.zh: 包括亚马逊、特斯拉和微软在内的其他主要科技公司的股价当天收盘走低，尽管 Meta 和 SpaceX 在交易日结束时处于正值区域。

paras.en: Nvidia's share price was down 8% in early trading on Wednesday, extending Tuesday's slide as the boost from Huang's return eased. At close, it ended up 3.4% lower.
paras.zh: 由于黄仁勋回归带来的提振作用减弱，英伟达股价周三早盘下跌 8%，延续了周二的跌势。截至收盘，该指数下跌 3.4%。

paras.en: The resignation and subsequent reinstatement of Nvidia's CEO after revelations of his extramarital affairs has seen the market value of the world's premier AI chipmaker fluctuate wildly.
paras.zh: 英伟达首席执行官在婚外情被曝光后辞职并随后复职，导致这家全球首屈一指的人工智能芯片制造商的市值剧烈波动。

paras.en: Given Nvidia's position as both supplier and financier of many other firms involved in the AI rollout, its rocky fortnight has had a wider impact.
paras.zh: 鉴于英伟达作为许多其他参与人工智能推广的公司的供应商和融资者的地位，其动荡的两周产生了更广泛的影响。

paras.en: The US government also announced a raft of new tariffs on countries and trading partners on Wednesday as part of President Donald Trump's flagship trade policy.
paras.zh: 作为唐纳德·特朗普总统旗舰贸易政策的一部分，美国政府周三还宣布对各国和贸易伙伴征收一系列新关税。

paras.en: The value of big tech companies have sheltered the US economy from global economic shocks, including tariffs.
paras.zh: 大型科技公司的价值使美国经济免受包括关税在内的全球经济冲击。

paras.en: But share prices in recent weeks have been volatile in response to the US midterm elections and other events in the AI industry.
paras.zh: 但最近几周，受美国中期选举和人工智能行业其他事件影响，股价出现波动。

paras.en: Investors have taken fright at Democrat gains in the US midterm elections, with many having campaigned for tougher regulation of AI firms and even a moratorium on the development of new data centres.
paras.zh: 投资者对民主党在美国中期选举中的胜利感到恐惧，许多人呼吁对人工智能公司进行更严格的监管，甚至暂停新数据中心的开发。

paras.en: Questions also remain about whether the huge sums being invested in AI will eventually pay off.
paras.zh: 关于人工智能的巨额投资最终能否得到回报仍然存在疑问。

paras.en: "It seems that these companies are trying to one-up each other on the amount of money that they're spending, but you have to show that it's worth it, and that's where Wall Street is saying I don't know," said Todd Schoenberger, chief investment officer at CrossCheck Management.
paras.zh: CrossCheck Management 首席投资官托德·舍恩伯格 (Todd Schoenberger) 表示：“这些公司似乎试图在支出金额上相互比拼，但你必须证明这是值得的，而这正是华尔街所说的我不知道的地方。”

paras.en: Despite concerns, investment in AI is expected to exceed $1 trillion in 2026, according to investment bank Goldman Sachs, which said the technology will remain the "dominant driver of business investment growth" next year.
paras.zh: 投资银行高盛表示，尽管存在担忧，但 2026 年人工智能投资预计将超过 1 万亿美元，该技术仍将是明年“商业投资增长的主要驱动力”。

paras.en: Shares in Anthropic continued to trade below the $83 they debuted at last week, while Amazon shares fell by just over 3%.
paras.zh: Anthropic 的股价继续低于上周首次亮相的 83 美元，而亚马逊的股价下跌了 3% 多一点。

paras.en: The declines come ahead of the US stock market closing for Thanksgiving on Thursday before opening for a shortened session on Friday.
paras.zh: 此次下跌发生在美国股市周四感恩节收盘之前，周五开盘时间缩短。

articles.title: North Korea expels Swiss diplomat in sanctions row

paras.en: North Korea has ordered Switzerland's diplomatic representative to leave the country within 48 hours and called for the office to close, in a row over sanctions.
paras.zh: 朝鲜已下令瑞士外交代表在 48 小时内离开该国，并要求关闭该办事处，以应对制裁。

paras.en: It followed Switzerland's decision to place sanctions on the Songdowon international children's camp in the eastern city of Wonsan, which is attended by Russian and Chinese children among other nationalities.
paras.zh: 此前，瑞士决定对东部城市元山的松道园国际儿童营实施制裁，该营里有俄罗斯和中国等其他国家的儿童。

paras.en: The camp has been accused of involvement in transferring children from Russian-occupied areas of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 该营地被指控参与从俄罗斯占领的乌克兰地区转移儿童。

paras.en: North Korea's state-run news agency KCNA called the sanctions "a blatant hostile act".
paras.zh: 朝鲜官方通讯社朝中社称制裁是“公然的敌对行为”。

paras.en: Switzerland is one of the few Western nations to maintain dialogue with Pyongyang.
paras.zh: 瑞士是少数与平壤保持对话的西方国家之一。

paras.en: Confirming the expulsion, KCNA said: "The Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea) declared the head of the Swiss Diplomatic Office in the DPRK persona non grata and urged him to leave the country within 48 hours."
paras.zh: 朝中社证实了这一驱逐消息：“朝鲜民主主义人民共和国（朝鲜）外交部宣布瑞士驻朝鲜外交办公室负责人为不受欢迎的人，并敦促他在 48 小时内离开该国。”

paras.en: The diplomatic rebuke comes weeks after Swiss foreign minister Ignazio Cassis made a rare visit to North Korea, where he officially reopened the office and discussed normalising relations.
paras.zh: 此次外交谴责是在瑞士外交部长伊格纳齐奥·卡西斯罕见地访问朝鲜后几周发生的，他在那里正式重新开放了办事处并讨论了关系正常化的问题。

paras.en: Swiss authorities said relations between the two countries would be maintained through the North Korean embassy in Bern, and the Swiss embassy in Beijing.
paras.zh: 瑞士当局表示，两国关系将通过朝鲜驻伯尔尼大使馆和瑞士驻北京大使馆维持。

paras.en: Diplomatic links with North Korea were first established in 1974 and Switzerland opened a co-operation office in Pyongyang in 1997. It was closed during the pandemic and remained shut for six years.
paras.zh: 瑞士与朝鲜于1974年首次建立外交关系，1997年在平壤设立了合作办事处。该办事处在疫情期间关闭，并关闭了六年。

paras.en: Switzerland's department of foreign affairs said the country "distinguishes between its sanctions policy and its commitment to maintaining dialogue with all countries".
paras.zh: 瑞士外交部表示，该国“区分其制裁政策和与所有国家保持对话的承诺”。

paras.en: It added: "The reopening of the office in Pyongyang did not in any way affect Switzerland's implementation of UN sanctions related to North Korea's nuclear programme, nor its implementation of EU sanctions targeting North Korea in the context of Russia's war against Ukraine."
paras.zh: 它补充说：“平壤办事处的重新开放不会以任何方式影响瑞士执行与朝鲜核计划有关的联合国制裁，也不会影响瑞士在俄罗斯对乌克兰战争的背景下执行欧盟针对朝鲜的制裁。”

paras.en: Thousands of North Korean soldiers have been deployed to help support Russia's war with Ukraine.
paras.zh: 数千名朝鲜士兵已被部署来帮助支持俄罗斯与乌克兰的战争。

paras.en: In August, Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky accused Moscow of using North Korean missiles.
paras.zh: 八月，乌克兰总统泽连斯基指责莫斯科使用朝鲜导弹。

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian
paras.zh: 卓越的非公路制动和摩擦性能均来自意大利

paras.en: SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.
paras.zh: SK Wellman 是一家专门生产非公路用制动和摩擦部件的公司，拥有活跃的基因。工厂仍位于 Orzinuovi (Bs) 的历史现实中，多年来，它经历了转型和变化，从而使其成为今天的样子：一家不断发展的公司，能够不断发展对意大利当地领土的忠诚度，并在全球范围内以创造力和灵活性创新其行业。如今，作为 CentroMotion 集团及其 Carlisle 制动与摩擦部门的一部分，SK Wellman 已成为该领域的领导者，受到土方、农业和建筑机械领域主要品牌的认可和选择。摩擦工程全球总监工程师 Alessandro Gamba 向我们介绍了持续增长的情况。

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.
paras.zh: “S.K. Wellman S.R.L. 拥有 340 名员工，到 2023 年营业额将达到 1.27 亿美元，”Gamba 开始说道。在过去的五年里，强大的推动力来自于市场，但最重要的是来自 SK 的特点，如创造力、创新性、灵活性，归根结底，这些都是这家公司最大财富的结果：“人”。正是他们使这家位于布雷西亚的公司成为一家真正的、顽强的公司，以至于不仅能够成功出口他们的产品，而且能够将他们的技能和设计技能出口到卡莱尔制动和摩擦部门的其他工厂。刚刚结束的 2023 年，仅销售收入就实现了积极的表现，与上一个出色的 2022 财年相比，略有下降 -5%；对于布雷西亚和非布雷西亚经济的许多现实来说，后者可能是不可重复的一年。事实上，2023 年无疑是变革的一年，帮助人们培养了更强的能力来管理不确定性，以更强的韧性接受和处理意外情况。

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.
paras.zh: 工程师解释说：“成功的基础是通过集团治理建立了一个矩阵组织：所有职能和技能的垂直驱动，能够在全球范围内定义和指导流程并产生最佳实践。这还不是全部，”Gamba 补充道，“我们是人员流动率最低的公司之一，这使我们能够将长期与我们合作的人的经验传授给我们特别关注的年轻人。除此之外，公司人口还来自 15 个不同的国家，他们的强有力的合作创造了真正宁静的工作氛围，”人力资源经理说道。成长的方向尤其是社会责任并非巧合。

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.
paras.zh: 他指出，“SK Wellman 和 Carlisle 的主要项目中，最突出的是 Enactus，这是一家国际非营利组织，通过其活动，让大学生参与创建可持续创业项目，帮助缩小大学和企业之间的差距；然后是 Treedom，该公司承诺在三年内种植 1,600 棵树，并让利益相关者参与到该项目中”。金属加工行业还有两颗稀有宝石吗？工作事故率接近于零，人才发展处于中心地位。迈向卓越并超越。

paras.en: Source: Il Corriere della Sera – edizione Lombardia
paras.zh: 资料来源：《晚邮报》——伦巴第版

articles.title: Visit Us @ bauma CONEXPO INDIA

paras.en: Visit Carlisle Brake & Friction in Hall 15, stand No. F01 at bauma CONEXPO INDIA 2024, at the India Expo Centre, Greater Noida / Delhi NCR India. bauma CONEXPO INDIA takes place December 11-14, 2024.
paras.zh: 请参观位于印度大诺伊达/德里 NCR 印度博览中心 bauma CONEXPO INDIA 2024 15 号展厅 F01 号展位的 Carlisle Brake & Friction。印度 bauma CONEXPO 将于 2024 年 12 月 11 日至 14 日举行。

paras.zh: bauma CONEXPO INDIA 是工程机械、建材机械、采矿机械和工程车辆的国际贸易展览会，是行业的心跳和国际成功引擎、创新驱动力和市场。

articles.title: A Holiday Season of Giving

paras.en: This holiday season, Carlisle Brake & Friction’s Medina location is proud to support 15 children of our colleagues who could use a little extra cheer. Our employees have generously donated toys, clothing, and other essential items to bring joy to these young lives.
paras.zh: 这个假期，Carlisle Brake & Friction 的麦地那办事处很荣幸能够为我们同事的 15 名孩子提供支持，他们需要一点额外的欢乐。我们的员工慷慨捐赠玩具、衣服和其他必需品，为这些年轻的生命带来欢乐。

paras.en: By coming together as a team, we’re demonstrating our commitment to making a positive impact on our community. We’re grateful for the kindness and generosity of our employees, and we hope this initiative will bring warmth and happiness to the children who receive these gifts.
paras.zh: 通过作为一个团队聚集在一起，我们展示了我们对为社区产生积极影响的承诺。我们感谢员工的善意和慷慨，希望这一举措能为收到这些礼物的孩子们带来温暖和快乐。

paras.en: Want to join us in spreading holiday cheer? Consider donating to Toys for Tots. This incredible organization ensures that every child experiences the joy of Christmas. Visit their website to find a drop-off location near you.
paras.zh: 想和我们一起传播节日的欢乐吗？考虑向 Toys for Tots 捐款。这个令人难以置信的组织确保每个孩子都能体验到圣诞节的欢乐。访问他们的网站查找您附近的下车地点。

articles.title: AASP/NJ Inducts Dennis Cataldo into Hall of Fame
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Alliance of Automotive Service Providers of New Jersey (AASP/NJ) welcomed Dennis Cataldo, Jr. of D&M Auto Body (Old Bridge, N.J.) into the association’s Hall of Fame during a celebratory ceremony at its recent annual meeting.
paras.zh: 新泽西州汽车服务提供商联盟 (AASP/NJ) 在其最近的年会上举行的庆祝仪式上欢迎 D&M Auto Body（新泽西州老桥）的 Dennis Cataldo, Jr. 进入该协会的名人堂。

paras.en: A second-generation shop owner who practically grew up on the shop floor, Cataldo has been a driving force on AASP/NJ’s board of directors for well over a decade. Throughout his tenure, he has served multiple terms as collision chairman and has been an advocate on the front lines of the association’s legislative efforts.
paras.zh: Cataldo 是第二代店主，实际上是在车间长大的，十多年来一直是 AASP/NJ 董事会的推动力量。在其任职期间，他曾多次担任碰撞主席，并一直是协会立法工作第一线的倡导者。

paras.en: “He’s got it in his blood,” said Alicia Figurelli, administrator of AASP/NJ. “He’s seen how body shops and trade associations work from the inside out from a young age. Between his valuable feedback and input, legislative efforts and ability to always show up, he truly knows to get things done.”
paras.zh: “他的血液里就流淌着这种力量，”新泽西州 AASP 管理员 Alicia Figelli 说。 “他从小就了解车身修理厂和行业协会是如何从内到外运作的。在他宝贵的反馈和意见、立法努力和始终表现出来的能力之间，他真正知道要把事情做好。”

paras.en: Cataldo was humbled by the recognition. “I was shocked and awed. It was very thoughtful of the association to honor me this way. I don’t put time into the association to get awards and recognition. I do it because I want to give back to the industry and help out in any way I can.”
paras.zh: 卡塔尔多对这种认可感到谦卑。 “我感到震惊和敬畏。协会以这种方式向我致敬，是非常周到的。我投入协会的时间并不是为了获得奖项和认可。我这样做是因为我想回馈行业，并尽我所能提供帮助。”

paras.en: For more information on AASP/NJ, visit aaspnj.org.
paras.zh: 有关 AASP/NJ 的更多信息，请访问 aaspnj.org。

articles.title: CIC committee tackles suggestions for AI use in claims handling
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: AI is involved in the auto claims handling process, but regulations have yet to catch up, Jill Tuggle, Auto Body Association of Texas executive director, said during the Collision Industry Conference’s most recent meeting held in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州汽车车身协会执行董事 Jill Tuggle 在拉斯维加斯举行的碰撞行业会议最近一次会议上表示，人工智能参与了汽车索赔处理流程，但法规尚未跟上。

paras.en: The National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) approved a model bulletin in 2023 on insurer AI use that 25 states and Washington, D.C., have adopted, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，美国保险专员协会 (NAIC) 于 2023 年批准了一份关于保险公司人工智能使用的示范公告，25 个州和华盛顿特区已采用。

paras.en: None of the states that have adopted the model require a human to make the final call on claim denials, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，采用该模型的州都不需要人工对索赔拒绝做出最终决定。

paras.en: An NAIC survey also found 88% of auto insurers are using or exploring AI, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，NAIC 的一项调查还发现 88% 的汽车保险公司正在使用或探索人工智能。

paras.en: “We still have a long way to go,” Tuggle said.
paras.zh: “我们还有很长的路要走，”塔格尔说。

paras.en: AI now touches vehicle intake, photo review, estimating, valuation, and claim closure, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，人工智能现在涉及车辆摄入、照片审查、估算、估价和索赔结案。

paras.en: Currently, a vehicle is often inspected by a shop and a field adjuster who agree on the required repairs, Tuggle explained. The estimate then goes to a central review team.
paras.zh: Tuggle 解释说，目前，车辆通常由商店和现场理算员进行检查，他们同意所需的维修。然后，评估结果将提交给中央审查小组。

paras.en: “We’re not really sure who is behind that right now,” Tuggle said. “AI is scrubbing the files in many cases, and these algorithms are built by the companies who are reviewing them. We’re not totally sure what the parameters are that are being set and how they’re writing the algorithms to take a look at these files.”
paras.zh: “我们现在还不确定谁是幕后黑手，”塔格尔说。 “在很多情况下，人工智能正在清理文件，这些算法是由审查这些文件的公司构建的。我们并不完全确定正在设置的参数是什么以及他们如何编写算法来查看这些文件。”

paras.en: There are examples of automatic overrides for estimates that include more than eight hours of repair, Tuggle said.
paras.zh: Tuggle 说，有一些自动覆盖估计的例子，其中包括超过八小时的维修。

paras.en: A shop will reach out to a field adjuster to discuss the changes to the estimate, she adds. The shop is told the adjuster is no longer on the claim and the shop must call customer service.
paras.zh: 她补充说，商店将联系现场理算员讨论估算的变化。该商店被告知理算员不再参与索赔，商店必须致电客户服务部。

paras.en: “That’s when we start hitting brick walls,” Tuggle said. “So who actually made the final decision? So the issue here is the attribution gap. Who observed the car, the field adjuster? Who modified the estimate? The central team and their AI scrubbers? Who knows? That’s often very unclear. But the field adjuster is still named at the bottom.”
paras.zh: “从那时起，我们就开始碰壁了，”塔格尔说。 “那么谁真正做出了最终决定？所以这里的问题是归因差距。谁观察了汽车，现场调整员？谁修改了估计？中央团队和他们的人工智能洗涤器？谁知道？这通常很不清楚。但现场调整员仍然在底部命名。”

paras.en: The CIC Governmental Committee found an example of an AI-handled claim where the shop estimate was about $2,500, Tuggle said. It came back from the central review team at $438.
paras.zh: Tuggle 表示，CIC 政府委员会发现了一个由人工智能处理的索赔示例，商店估价约为 2,500 美元。中央审查小组以 438 美元的价格返回。

paras.en: The claim was closed because it was lower than the deductible, Tuggle said. She added there was no recourse for the customer on the claim decision.
paras.zh: 塔格尔说，索赔因低于免赔额而被关闭。她补充说，客户对索赔决定没有追索权。

paras.en: “What consumers should be able to count on is knowing when AI material has shaped their claim and know who made the decision and how to reach out to them,” Tuggle said.
paras.zh: “消费者应该能够信赖的是知道人工智能材料何时形成了他们的主张，并知道谁做出了决定以及如何与他们联系，”塔格尔说。

paras.en: When asked, 67% of the CIC audience also believed consumers should know when AI is used in the claim handling process.
paras.zh: 当被问及时，67% 的 CIC 观众还认为消费者应该知道何时在索赔处理过程中使用人工智能。

paras.en: NAIC’s AI model is built on the existing Unfair Claims Settlement Practices Act, she explains. It covers claims and fraud detection; states controls should scale with potential harm to consumers; and states that decisions cannot be inaccurate, arbitrary, or unfairly discriminatory.
paras.zh: 她解释说，NAIC 的人工智能模型建立在现有的《不公平索赔和解实践法》的基础上。它涵盖索赔和欺诈检测；各州的控制措施应根据对消费者的潜在危害而扩大；并指出决定不能是不准确的、任意的或不公平的歧视。

paras.en: It also requires insurance companies to set clear decision authority and escalation paths, test data and models, monitor for drifts, keep records, notify consumers of AI use, and oversee vendors.
paras.zh: 它还要求保险公司设定明确的决策权限和升级路径、测试数据和模型、监控偏差、保存记录、通知消费者人工智能的使用以及监督供应商。

paras.en: Tuggle said the bulletin doesn’t require claim-level notice that AI shaped the estimate. It also doesn’t require a change log or final author on the estimate, a named accountable reviewer, or duties for shops or vendors.
paras.zh: 图格尔表示，该公告不需要索赔级别的通知，表明人工智能影响了估算。它还不需要更改日志或估算的最终作者、指定的负责审阅者或商店或供应商的职责。

paras.en: There should be more oversight depending on the consequence, Tuggle said.
paras.zh: 塔格尔说，应该根据后果进行更多的监督。

paras.en: For example, disclosure isn’t necessary for administrative work such as scheduling, transcription, and document searching.
paras.zh: 例如，日程安排、转录和文档搜索等行政工作不需要披露。

paras.en: Perhaps there should be AI disclosure for AI drafts with review by a qualified person and the ability to change the draft, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，也许应该对人工智能草案进行人工智能披露，并由合格人员进行审查并有权更改草案。

paras.en: In a third scenario, insurance companies should provide a disclosure with a named approver and a reason when AI removes repairs, totals a vehicle, or flags fraud, Tuggle said.
paras.zh: Tuggle 表示，在第三种情况下，保险公司应在人工智能删除维修、清点车辆或标记欺诈行为时提供披露信息，并提供指定批准者和原因。

paras.en: A meaningful human review needs to meet five criteria, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，有意义的人工审查需要满足五个标准。

paras.en: - “Competence: Can spot the technical error;
paras.zh: - “能力：能够发现技术错误；

paras.en: - “Evidence: Sees the photos, not just AI summary;
paras.zh: - 《证据：看照片，不只是AI总结；

paras.en: - “Time: Not racing a productivity quota;
paras.zh: - “时间：不与生产力配额竞争；

paras.en: - “Authority: Can override without layers of approval; and
paras.zh: - “权威：无需层层批准即可推翻；以及

paras.en: - “Permission: Can disagree without penalty.”
paras.zh: - “许可：可以不同意而不受惩罚。”

paras.en: Tuggle asked, “At the end of the day, when you’ve got an estimate where so many different entities and people have influenced it, who owns it?”
paras.zh: 图格尔问道：“归根结底，当你得到了这么多不同实体和人影响它的估计时，谁拥有它？”

paras.en: ”That’s kind of one of the major issues,” she continued. “You have your data provider who supplies the inputs and your AI vendor; they’re building the models, the algorithms for the scrubbing software that they’re using at the central review areas. And then we’ve got our estimating platform, which embeds it into the workflow. Insurers approve or deny the claim, and the repair facilities perform the repair.”
paras.zh: “这是主要问题之一，”她继续说道。 “你有提供输入的数据提供商和人工智能供应商；他们正在为他们在中央审查区域使用的清理软件构建模型和算法。然后我们有我们的估算平台，它将其嵌入到工作流程中。保险公司批准或拒绝索赔，维修机构执行维修。”

paras.en: Tuggle asked whether there could be shared responsibility that is also symmetrical in the process.
paras.zh: 图格尔询问是否可以在这个过程中分担责任，同时也是对称的。

paras.en: The committee also suggests duties for consequential AI. This includes AI disclosing material and preserving every estimate version.
paras.zh: 该委员会还建议了相应人工智能的职责。这包括人工智能披露材料并保存每个估计版本。

paras.en: It should also attribute credit to who inspected the estimate, which system was used, changes made, and who made the changes, Tuggle said. She added that insurance companies should explain the basis for each change and provide an escalation option to a human who can reverse it.
paras.zh: 塔格尔说，它还应该归功于谁检查了估算、使用了哪个系统、进行了更改以及谁进行了更改。她补充说，保险公司应该解释每项变更的依据，并为可以逆转变更的人员提供升级选项。

paras.en: The name also must mean something, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，这个名字也一定有某种含义。

paras.en: “The field adjuster’s name at the bottom of the file is not enough, and it’s not really getting us anywhere right now,” she said. “So, proposed again, a human decides the safety and critical items.”
paras.zh: “文件底部的现场调整员的名字还不够，而且现在并没有真正让我们有任何进展，”她说。 “因此，再次提出，由人类来决定安全和关键项目。”

paras.en: The committee also proposes that a qualified human must approve any cuts to procedures such as structural repairs, airbags, seatbelts, restraints, scans, ADAS calibration, fraud flags, and other safety-critical items.
paras.zh: 该委员会还建议，对结构维修、安全气囊、安全带、约束装置、扫描、ADAS 校准、欺诈标志和其他安全关键项目等程序的任何削减都必须由合格的人员批准。

paras.en: “AI can advise it, but it can’t be the only reason for denial,” Tuggle said.
paras.zh: “人工智能可以提供建议，但这不能成为拒绝的唯一原因，”塔格尔说。

paras.en: James Spears, Tractable head of automotive AI, said during a panel discussion that it would be difficult to imagine all the ways that AI touches insurance claims.
paras.zh: Tractable 汽车人工智能负责人 James Spears 在一次小组讨论中表示，很难想象人工智能涉及保险索赔的所有方式。

paras.en: “AI begins at policy acquisition,” Spears said. “AI begins before they even have a customer, right? AI is used in the way that you market. AI is used once you close a policy. AI is used in underwriting. AI is used all throughout in a number of ways.”
paras.zh: “人工智能始于政策获取，”斯皮尔斯说。 “人工智能在他们拥有客户之前就开始了，对吗？人工智能以营销的方式使用。一旦你关闭保单，人工智能就会被使用。人工智能被用于承保。人工智能以多种方式贯穿始终。”

paras.en: Many assume AI has evil intent, but it can increase claim speed and accuracy, Spears said.
paras.zh: 斯皮尔斯说，许多人认为人工智能有邪恶的意图，但它可以提高索赔速度和准确性。

paras.en: He explained that the AI models the general public uses aren’t as advanced as the models insurance companies use. However, he said AI will advance significantly in the coming years.
paras.zh: 他解释说，公众使用的人工智能模型并不像保险公司使用的模型那么先进。不过，他表示人工智能将在未来几年取得显着进步。

paras.en: Jerry McNee of Ultimate Collision agreed that AI benefits the user.
paras.zh: Ultimate Collision 的 Jerry McNee 同意人工智能对用户有利。

paras.en: Before AI, a shop manually went through everything and took time pulling the repair processes. It took additional time to verify, he added.
paras.zh: 在人工智能出现之前，商店需要手动完成所有工作，并花费时间来完成维修流程。他补充说，需要额外的时间来验证。

paras.en: Humans also have errors and miss procedures, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，人类也会犯错误和错过程序。

paras.en: “We have to get ahead of it, and we have to understand it, and we have to put it to work,” McNee said. “There still has to be some human interaction and touch on it, in order to proof it and make sure.”
paras.zh: “We have to get ahead of it, and we have to understand it, and we have to put it to work,” McNee said. “仍然需要进行一些人际互动并触摸它，以证明并确定这一点。”

paras.en: “The best way to employ AI is to only use it as a tool that takes some mundane task off of your team,” Spears said. “Then push that team towards the customer. That’s where you really make a difference.”
paras.zh: 斯皮尔斯说：“使用人工智能的最佳方法就是仅将其用作一种工具，帮助您的团队承担一些平凡的任务。” “然后推动团队走向客户。这才是你真正发挥作用的地方。”

paras.en: He added that he disagrees with “straight-through” processing where a human never touches a claim.
paras.zh: 他补充说，他不同意“直接”处理，即人类从不接触索赔。

paras.en: The insurance and repair industries should work together to create rules AI can work within, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，保险和维修行业应该共同努力制定人工智能可以运行的规则。

paras.en: “Ninety-five percent of AI will get you to yes with shared rules very quickly,” Spears said. “The other 5%, that’s going to be your escalation, and that’s when you get humans talking about it. That’s the way I would play the game. If I was sitting in a carrier’s chair right now, I would have shared rules with every one of my DRPs.”
paras.zh: “百分之九十五的人工智能会让你很快同意共享规则，”斯皮尔斯说。 “另外 5%，这将是你的升级，那时你就会让人们谈论它。这就是我玩游戏的方式。如果我现在坐在运营商的椅子上，我会与我的每一个 DRP 共享规则。”

paras.en: AI can help speed up parts and rental car deliveries, Spears added.
paras.zh: 斯皮尔斯补充说，人工智能可以帮助加快零件和租赁汽车的交付速度。

paras.en: When Tuggle asked whether consumers should be notified of AI use, Spears said they should.
paras.zh: 当塔格尔询问消费者是否应该被告知人工智能的使用时，斯皮尔斯说他们应该这样做。

paras.en: “But here’s the deal: It’s not going to shock a consumer,” Spears said. “Because everything in their life has AI.”
paras.zh: “但事情是这样的：它不会让消费者感到震惊，”斯皮尔斯说。 “因为他们生活中的一切都有人工智能。”

paras.en: “Absolutely, consumers should be informed, especially on the decision-making when it comes to their vehicle or their policy or returning the car back to its previous condition,” McNee said.
paras.zh: 麦克尼说：“当然，消费者应该被告知，特别是在涉及他们的车辆或政策或将汽车恢复到之前的状态时的决策。”

paras.en: Jill Tuggle, Auto Body Association of Texas executive director, James Spears, Tractable head of automotive AI, Jerry McNee of Ultimate Collision during CIC in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: Jill Tuggle，德克萨斯州汽车车身协会执行董事；James Spears，Tracable 汽车人工智能负责人；Jerry McNee，拉斯维加斯 CIC 期间的 Ultimate Collision。

articles.title: What Tire Wear Reveals About Suspension and Alignments
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: A driver rolls into the shop complaining that their tires are wearing out faster than expected. The vehicle drives reasonably well, and there are no obvious suspension noises. But a closer look at the tread tells a different story.
paras.zh: 一名司机冲进商店，抱怨他们的轮胎磨损得比预期的要快。车辆行驶起来还算不错，没有明显的悬挂异响。但仔细观察胎面却发现了不同的情况。

paras.en: Uneven tire wear can reveal problems with alignment, suspension components, tire inflation and ride control. Learning how to recognize these patterns gives technicians a valuable diagnostic advantage.
paras.zh: 轮胎磨损不均匀会揭示定位、悬架部件、轮胎充气和行驶控制方面的问题。学习如何识别这些模式为技术人员提供了宝贵的诊断优势。

paras.en: The key is understanding what each wear pattern means and knowing which components to inspect next.
paras.zh: 关键是了解每种磨损模式的含义并知道接下来要检查哪些部件。

paras.en: Start With Tire Pressure and Tread Depth
paras.zh: 从轮胎压力和胎面深度开始

paras.en: Before recommending an alignment or replacing suspension components, check the basics.
paras.zh: 在建议对准或更换悬架部件之前，请先检查基础知识。

paras.en: Inspect all four tires. Measure and record tread depth across the inner, center and outer portions of each tire. Compare the readings to identify differences in wear.
paras.zh: 检查所有四个轮胎。测量并记录每个轮胎的内部、中心和外部部分的胎面深度。比较读数以识别磨损差异。

paras.en: Next, check inflation pressure against the vehicle manufacturer’s specifications. Underinflation often increases wear along both shoulders, while sustained overinflation can increase center tread wear.
paras.zh: 接下来，根据车辆制造商的规格检查充气压力。充气不足通常会增加两侧胎肩的磨损，而持续的充气过多会增加胎面中央的磨损。

paras.en: Don’t overlook the tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS). A warning light, damaged sensor or incorrect pressure setting may contribute to a problem that has gone unnoticed.
paras.zh: 不要忽视轮胎压力监测系统（TPMS）。警告灯、损坏的传感器或不正确的压力设置可能会导致未被注意到的问题。

paras.en: Also look for mismatched tires, damaged wheels and evidence of missed tire rotations.
paras.zh: 还要查找不匹配的轮胎、损坏的车轮以及错过轮胎换位的证据。

paras.en: These initial checks help determine whether the cause is tire maintenance, vehicle geometry or a mechanical problem.
paras.zh: 这些初步检查有助于确定原因是否是轮胎维护、车辆几何形状或机械问题。

paras.en: Inner-Edge Wear: Check Camber, Toe and Ride Height
paras.zh: 内缘磨损：检查外倾角、前束角和行驶高度

paras.en: When the inside shoulder wears faster than the rest of the tread, alignment geometry should be one of the first areas to investigate.
paras.zh: 当内侧胎肩比胎面其余部分磨损得更快时，对齐几何形状应该是首先要研究的领域之一。

paras.en: Negative camber means the top of the wheel tilts inward relative to the vehicle. Excessive negative camber can place additional load on the inner shoulder.
paras.zh: 负外倾角意味着车轮顶部相对于车辆向内倾斜。过大的负外倾角会给内胎肩带来额外的负载。

paras.en: Toe settings also matter. When wheels point too far inward or outward relative to the vehicle’s direction of travel, the tires scrub against the road instead of rolling cleanly.
paras.zh: 脚趾设置也很重要。当车轮相对于车辆行驶方向过于向内或向外时，轮胎会摩擦路面，而不是干净地滚动。

paras.en: - Problems with an air suspension system
paras.zh: - 空气悬架系统存在问题

paras.en: Independent rear suspensions deserve particular attention. Worn bushings can change wheel geometry during acceleration, braking and cornering.
paras.zh: 独立后悬架值得特别关注。磨损的衬套会在加速、制动和转弯过程中改变车轮的几何形状。

paras.en: Shop tip: Measure ride height before performing an alignment. If the suspension is sitting below specification, adjusting alignment angles alone may not solve the problem.
paras.zh: 商店提示：在进行对准之前测量行驶高度。如果悬架低于规格，仅调整对准角度可能无法解决问题。

paras.en: Outer-Edge Wear: Inspect Alignment and Body Control
paras.zh: 外缘磨损：检查对准和车身控制

paras.en: Excessive wear on the outside shoulder may indicate an alignment problem or excessive loading during cornering.
paras.zh: 外侧肩部过度磨损可能表明存在对准问题或转弯时负载过大。

paras.en: Positive camber, incorrect toe settings and worn suspension components can contribute to outer-edge wear.
paras.zh: 正外倾角、不正确的前束设置和磨损的悬架部件都会导致外缘磨损。

paras.en: Consider how the vehicle is driven. Crossovers and SUVs have relatively high centers of gravity, which can increase weight transfer during turns.
paras.zh: 考虑车辆的驾驶方式。跨界车和 SUV 的重心相对较高，这可以增加转弯时的重量转移。

paras.en: When springs, shocks or struts no longer control suspension movement effectively, the tire may experience additional loading and irregular wear.
paras.zh: 当弹簧、减震器或支柱不再有效控制悬架运动时，轮胎可能会承受额外的负载和不规则磨损。

paras.en: Diagnostic reminder: Outer-edge wear does not automatically mean the shocks are bad. Verify alignment and mechanical condition before recommending replacement parts.
paras.zh: 诊断提醒：外缘磨损并不自动意味着冲击不良。在建议更换零件之前，请验证对准和机械状况。

paras.en: Feathering occurs when the tread blocks develop a sharp edge on one side and a smoother, rounded edge on the other.
paras.zh: 当胎面花纹块的一侧形成尖锐边缘而另一侧形成更光滑的圆形边缘时，就会出现羽化现象。

paras.en: You may not notice feathering immediately during a visual inspection. Carefully running your hand across the tread in opposite directions can help identify the pattern.
paras.zh: 在目视检查期间您可能不会立即注意到羽化。小心地以相反的方向用手抚过胎面有助于识别花纹。

paras.en: Feathering commonly indicates an incorrect toe setting.
paras.zh: 羽化通常表明脚趾位置不正确。

paras.en: However, toe can change when worn steering or suspension components move under load. That means the alignment readings may not tell the entire story.
paras.zh: 然而，当磨损的转向或悬架部件在负载下移动时，前束可能会发生变化。这意味着对齐读数可能无法说明全部情况。

paras.en: Check for looseness in tie rods, control arm bushings and other steering components before making adjustments.
paras.zh: 在进行调整之前，检查横拉杆、控制臂衬套和其他转向部件是否松动。

paras.en: Remember that changing camber or caster can affect toe. That’s why toe is normally adjusted after other applicable alignment angles.
paras.zh: 请记住，改变外倾角或后倾角会影响前束。这就是为什么通常在其他适用的对准角度之后调整前束的原因。

paras.en: Cupping and Scalloping: Look Beyond Alignment
paras.zh: 杯形和扇形：超越对齐

paras.en: Cupping creates irregular high and low spots around the tire’s circumference. The pattern may resemble a series of shallow dips in the tread.
paras.zh: 拔罐会在轮胎圆周上产生不规则的高点和低点。该图案可能类似于胎面中的一系列浅凹陷。

paras.en: - Loose or damaged suspension components
paras.zh: - 悬挂部件松动或损坏

paras.en: Shocks and struts help control wheel movement as the vehicle travels over bumps. If they lose damping ability, the tire may move excessively and develop irregular wear.
paras.zh: 当车辆行驶在颠簸路面时，后减震器和前减震器有助于控制车轮的运动。如果它们失去阻尼能力，轮胎可能会过度移动并出现不规则磨损。

paras.en: However, wheel imbalance can create similar symptoms.
paras.zh: 然而，车轮不平衡也会产生类似的症状。

paras.en: Shop example: A driver complains of a humming noise that increases with road speed. The rear tires show scalloped wear, but there is no obvious wheel-bearing play.
paras.zh: 商店示例：一位司机抱怨嗡嗡声随着行驶速度而增加。后轮胎出现扇形磨损，但没有明显的车轮轴承间隙。

paras.en: Before replacing a bearing, inspect the tire surfaces, check wheel balance and evaluate suspension condition. Tire noise can sometimes resemble a failing wheel bearing.
paras.zh: 更换轴承之前，请检查轮胎表面、检查车轮平衡并评估悬架状况。轮胎噪音有时类似于车轮轴承故障。

paras.en: A vehicle’s suspension geometry is designed around a specified operating height.
paras.zh: 车辆的悬架几何形状是围绕指定的操作高度设计的。

paras.en: When springs weaken or suspension components wear, ride height can change. That affects camber, toe and the position of suspension control arms.
paras.zh: 当弹簧减弱或悬架部件磨损时，行驶高度可能会发生变化。这会影响外倾角、前束和悬架控制臂的位置。

paras.en: A small height difference may have a meaningful impact on tire wear.
paras.zh: 微小的高度差可能会对轮胎磨损产生有意义的影响。

paras.en: Measure ride height using the manufacturer’s procedure and compare the results against specification. Don’t assume that springs are healthy simply because the vehicle appears level.
paras.zh: 使用制造商的程序测量行驶高度，并将结果与​​规格进行比较。不要仅仅因为车辆看起来水平就认为弹簧是健康的。

paras.en: On vehicles with electronic air suspension, check for leaks and verify that ride-height sensors and calibration are operating correctly.
paras.zh: 对于配备电子空气悬架的车辆，检查是否有泄漏并验证行驶高度传感器和校准是否正常运行。

paras.en: Don’t Forget Rear Alignment and Thrust Angle
paras.zh: 不要忘记后部对准和推力角

paras.en: Tire wear problems aren’t always limited to the front axle.
paras.zh: 轮胎磨损问题​​并不总是局限于前轴。

paras.en: The thrust angle describes the direction the rear wheels point relative to the vehicle’s centerline. If the rear wheels are not aligned correctly, the driver may need to compensate with the steering wheel to keep the vehicle moving straight.
paras.zh: 推力角描述了后轮相对于车辆中心线的方向。如果后轮未正确对准，驾驶员可能需要用方向盘进行补偿以保持车辆直线行驶。

paras.en: That condition can contribute to unusual tire wear and a steering wheel that appears off-center.
paras.zh: 这种情况可能会导致轮胎异常磨损和方向盘出现偏心。

paras.en: A four-wheel alignment can help identify these problems, particularly on vehicles with independent rear suspension.
paras.zh: 四轮定位可以帮助识别这些问题，特别是对于具有独立后悬架的车辆。

paras.en: When uneven tire wear enters the shop, use a consistent inspection process.
paras.zh: 当轮胎磨损不均匀进入车间时，请使用一致的检查流程。

paras.en: - Verify the complaint. Ask when the wear started and whether the vehicle pulls, vibrates or makes noise.
paras.zh: - 核实投诉。询问磨损何时开始以及车辆是否拉动、振动或发出噪音。

paras.en: - Inspect the tires. Record tread depths, tire sizes, inflation pressures and visible wear patterns.
paras.zh: - 检查轮胎。记录胎面深度、轮胎尺寸、充气压力和可见磨损模式。

paras.en: - Check the suspension. Inspect steering components, bushings, springs, shocks and struts.
paras.zh: - 检查悬架。检查转向部件、衬套、弹簧、减震器和支柱。

paras.en: - Measure ride height. Compare measurements with factory specifications.
paras.zh: - 测量行驶高度。将测量值与工厂规格进行比较。

paras.en: - Check alignment. Review camber, caster, toe and thrust angle where applicable.
paras.zh: - 检查对齐情况。如果适用，检查外倾角、主销后倾角、前束角和推力角。

paras.en: - Verify the repair. Correct the cause, evaluate tire safety and explain the findings to the customer.
paras.zh: - 验证修复情况。纠正原因，评估轮胎安全并向客户解释结果。

paras.en: The Takeaway: Let the Tires Guide Your Diagnosis
paras.zh: 要点：让轮胎指导您的诊断

paras.en: Tires are more than replaceable wear items. They provide clues about how the vehicle’s steering, suspension and alignment systems are working together.
paras.zh: 轮胎不仅仅是可更换的磨损物品。它们提供了有关车辆的转向、悬架和定位系统如何协同工作的线索。

paras.en: Recognizing those clues helps technicians diagnose problems earlier, protect customers’ tire investments and avoid unnecessary repairs.
paras.zh: 识别这些线索有助于技术人员更早地诊断问题、保护客户的轮胎投资并避免不必要的维修。

paras.en: The next time a vehicle comes into the bay, take a closer look at its tires. What is the tread trying to tell you?
paras.zh: 下次车辆驶入海湾时，请仔细检查其轮胎。胎面想告诉你什么？

paras.en: The thrust angle describes the direction the rear wheels point relative to the vehicle’s centerline. If the rear wheels are not aligned correctly, the driver may need to compensate with the steering wheel to keep the vehicle moving straight.
paras.zh: 推力角描述了后轮相对于车辆中心线的方向。如果后轮未正确对准，驾驶员可能需要用方向盘进行补偿以保持车辆直线行驶。

paras.en: That condition can contribute to unusual tire wear and a steering wheel that appears off-center.
paras.zh: 这种情况可能会导致轮胎异常磨损和方向盘出现偏心。

paras.en: A four-wheel alignment can help identify these problems, particularly on vehicles with independent rear suspension.
paras.zh: 四轮定位可以帮助识别这些问题，特别是对于具有独立后悬架的车辆。

paras.en: When uneven tire wear enters the shop, use a consistent inspection process.
paras.zh: 当轮胎磨损不均匀进入车间时，请使用一致的检查流程。

paras.en: - Verify the complaint. Ask when the wear started and whether the vehicle pulls, vibrates or makes noise.
paras.zh: - 核实投诉。询问磨损何时开始以及车辆是否拉动、振动或发出噪音。

paras.en: - Inspect the tires. Record tread depths, tire sizes, inflation pressures and visible wear patterns.
paras.zh: - 检查轮胎。记录胎面深度、轮胎尺寸、充气压力和可见磨损模式。

paras.en: - Check the suspension. Inspect steering components, bushings, springs, shocks and struts.
paras.zh: - 检查悬架。检查转向部件、衬套、弹簧、减震器和支柱。

paras.en: - Measure ride height. Compare measurements with factory specifications.
paras.zh: - 测量行驶高度。将测量值与工厂规格进行比较。

paras.en: - Check alignment. Review camber, caster, toe and thrust angle where applicable.
paras.zh: - 检查对齐情况。如果适用，检查外倾角、主销后倾角、前束角和推力角。

paras.en: - Verify the repair. Correct the cause, evaluate tire safety and explain the findings to the customer.
paras.zh: - 验证修复情况。纠正原因，评估轮胎安全并向客户解释结果。

paras.en: The Takeaway: Let the Tires Guide Your Diagnosis
paras.zh: 要点：让轮胎指导您的诊断

paras.en: Tires are more than replaceable wear items. They provide clues about how the vehicle’s steering, suspension and alignment systems are working together.
paras.zh: 轮胎不仅仅是可更换的磨损物品。它们提供了有关车辆的转向、悬架和定位系统如何协同工作的线索。

paras.en: Recognizing those clues helps technicians diagnose problems earlier, protect customers’ tire investments and avoid unnecessary repairs.
paras.zh: 识别这些线索有助于技术人员更早地诊断问题、保护客户的轮胎投资并避免不必要的维修。

paras.en: The next time a vehicle comes into the bay, take a closer look at its tires. What is the tread trying to tell you?
paras.zh: 下次车辆驶入海湾时，请仔细检查其轮胎。胎面想告诉你什么？
