paras.zh: “我们准备在需要时加大赌注。如果加拿大不能可信地将其国防支出承诺转化为对北美国防重要的投资，我们将别无选择，只能开始考虑更重要的缓解措施。”

paras.en: The official did not spell out what those measures might look like, but suggested there's a sense of urgency.
paras.zh: 这位官员没有详细说明这些措施可能是什么样的，但表示有一种紧迫感。

paras.en: "Prudence demands the department explore how we protect the United States in a situation where we cannot rely on Canada to prioritize military optimization and meet its obligations in a meaningful time frame," the official said.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示：“谨慎要求国防部探讨如何在我们不能依赖加拿大优先考虑军事优化并在有意义的时间范围内履行其义务的情况下保护美国。”

paras.en: "Canada has dismissed a lot of our concerns, including in NORAD, for many years. So, we want to communicate in a credible but also intelligent way that the current situation is not acceptable."
paras.zh: “多年来，加拿大一直对我们的许多担忧不予理睬，包括北美防空司令部的担忧。因此，我们希望以可靠但明智的方式进行沟通，表明目前的情况是不可接受的。”

paras.en: The pressure began building over the weekend with a leaked report in The Washington Post that said the U.S. military now had restrictions for interacting with Canadians. On Monday, the Pentagon publicly released a fact sheet that said Canada is not a credible defence partner and pointed to subpar Canadian military readiness statistics.
paras.zh: 周末，《华盛顿邮报》泄露的一篇报道称，美国军方现在与加拿大人的互动受到限制，压力开始增大。周一，五角大楼公开发布了一份情况说明书，称加拿大不是可靠的国防伙伴，并指出加拿大的军事准备统计数据低于标准。

paras.en: "Canadian political leadership continues to pursue unfocused global commitments, resulting in personnel and platform overextension, deferred modernizations for key equipment and low readiness rates," said the fact sheet.
paras.zh: 情况说明书称：“加拿大政治领导层继续追求没有重点的全球承诺，导致人员和平台过度扩张、关键设备现代化推迟以及准备率低。”

paras.en: "Ottawa's prioritization of parochial economic and commercial interests over military optimization introduces further uncertainty for NORAD and will further burden our Joint Force and the American taxpayer."
paras.zh: “渥太华将狭隘的经济和商业利益置于军事优化之上，这给北美防空司令部带来了进一步的不确定性，并将进一步加重我们的联合部队和美国纳税人的负担。”

paras.en: The fact sheet accused Canada of not being able to meet its NORAD and NATO commitments.
paras.zh: 该情况说明书指责加拿大无法履行其对北美防空司令部和北约的承诺。

paras.en: In the background remarks, the senior U.S. official went further, saying when it comes to delivering to allies "the gap between rhetoric and reality in Ottawa is the widest in all of NATO."
paras.zh: 这位美国高级官员在背景讲话中进一步表示，在向盟友提供服务方面，“渥太华的言辞与现实之间的差距是整个北约组织中最大的”。

paras.en: The official pointed to Germany as a model ally that quickly turned around its defence spending and is on track to deliver.
paras.zh: 这位官员指出，德国是一个模范盟友，它迅速扭转了国防开支，并有望实现目标。

paras.en: The official also said there are a group of European countries that are on track to meet NATO's five per cent of gross domestic product defence spending target by the end of the decade — five years ahead of the timeline agreed to by allies last year.
paras.zh: 这位官员还表示，一些欧洲国家有望在本世纪末实现北约国防开支占国内生产总值 5% 的目标，比盟国去年商定的时间表提前了五年。

paras.en: "Canada has an extraordinarily long way to go," the senior official said. "We are encouraged by the modest progress thus far, but we need to see much more credibility in terms of spending commitments."
paras.zh: 这位高级官员表示：“加拿大还有很长的路要走。” “我们对迄今为止取得的微小进展感到鼓舞，但我们需要看到支出承诺更加可信。”

paras.en: Going into cabinet on Tuesday, Defence Minister David McGuinty was peppered with questions about the Pentagon's fact sheet.
paras.zh: 周二，国防部长戴维·麦坚蒂进入内阁，他被问及有关五角大楼情况说明书的问题。

paras.en: "Canada's a sovereign nation. I'll be very direct: We don't report to the United States," said McGuinty.
paras.zh: “加拿大是一个主权国家。我会非常直接：我们不向美国报告，”麦坚蒂说。

paras.en: He pointed to the recent federal budget, which laid out a defence spending path to four per cent of GDP by 2030.
paras.zh: 他提到了最近的联邦预算，该预算规划了到 2030 年国防支出占 GDP 4% 的目标。

paras.en: In its fact sheet on Monday, the Pentagon said Canada needs to be more specific about how it's going to meet the five per cent target.
paras.zh: 五角大楼在周一的情况说明书中表示，加拿大需要更具体地说明如何实现 5% 的目标。

paras.en: The federal budget was vague on spending beyond 2030 and both McGuinty and Prime Minister Mark Carney said much will depend on NATO's planned review of the goal in 2029.
paras.zh: 联邦预算对 2030 年以后的支出含糊其辞，麦坚蒂和总理马克·卡尼都表示，很大程度上将取决于北约计划在 2029 年对目标进行审查。

paras.en: Kerry Buck, Canada's former NATO ambassador, said there's obviously more at play in the Pentagon's complaints than defence spending.
paras.zh: 加拿大前北约大使克里·巴克表示，五角大楼的抱怨显然比国防开支更重要。

paras.en: She acknowledged the U.S. concerns about Canada's military readiness and its effect on NORAD, but said decades of underinvestment will not be rectified overnight.
paras.zh: 她承认美国对加拿大的军事准备及其对北美防空司令部的影响感到担忧，但她表示，数十年的投资不足不会在一夜之间得到纠正。

paras.en: The fact that Carney is pulling Canada closer to Europe and has made buying military equipment from suppliers other than the United States a priority seems to be the subtext of some of the arguments she's seeing.
paras.zh: 卡尼正在拉近加拿大与欧洲的距离，并将从美国以外的供应商购买军事装备作为优先事项，这一事实似乎是她所看到的一些论点的潜台词。

paras.en: "Maybe the U.S. complaints aren't really about what we're doing at NATO," said Buck. "Maybe the U.S. complaints are about what our focus is and the fact that we're diversifying away from an overreliance on the U.S. military, including buying American."
paras.zh: 巴克说：“也许美国的抱怨并不是真正针对我们在北约所做的事情。” “也许美国的抱怨是关于我们的重点是什么，以及我们正在多元化，摆脱对美国军事的过度依赖，包括购买美国产品。”

paras.en: Steve Saideman, a defence expert at Carleton University, also acknowledged military readiness is a problem in Canada, but he sees U.S. domestic politics at play.
paras.zh: 卡尔顿大学国防专家史蒂夫·赛德曼也承认加拿大的军事准备度是一个问题，但他认为美国国内政治在发挥作用。

paras.en: "This is about [U.S. Secretary of War] Pete Hegseth," said Saideman. "He's trying to do something he thinks of as being manly … bullying allies as opposed to actually getting his own house in order."
paras.zh: “这是关于（美国战争部长）皮特·赫格斯的，”赛德曼说。 “他试图做一些他认为有男子气概的事情……欺凌盟友，而不是真正让自己的房子井然有序。”

paras.en: In Washington, Hegseth is facing intense congressional scrutiny and recently survived a bipartisan effort to impeach him.
paras.zh: 在华盛顿，赫格塞斯正面临国会的严格审查，并且最近在两党弹劾他的努力中幸存下来。

paras.en: That pressure is only expected to increase as Democrats take both the U.S. House of Representatives and Senate in the new year.
paras.zh: 随着民主党在新的一年同时拿下美国众议院和参议院，这种压力预计只会增加。

articles.title: How cautious investors are struggling to avoid the AI bubble

paras.en: The tech-heavy Nasdaq stock index roared back to life this week after a worrying sell-off recently that saw huge falls in technology and artificial intelligence (AI)-related stocks.
paras.zh: 以科技股为主的纳斯达克股指在最近经历了令人担忧的抛售，科技和人工智能 (AI) 相关股票大幅下跌后，本周重新焕发活力。

paras.en: After suffering its worst week since the pandemic crash of March 2020, the Nasdaq opened Monday (November 23) nearly 1,700 points, or 7%, higher.
paras.zh: 在经历了 2020 年 3 月大流行崩盘以来最糟糕的一周后，纳斯达克指数周一（11 月 23 日）开盘上涨近 1,700 点，即 7%。

paras.en: The AI trade received a further boost after Nvidia reinstated CEO Jensen Huang on Monday, just 11 days after he was forced to resign amid a scandal involving extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 英伟达周一恢复首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 的职位后，人工智能行业得到了进一步提振，而就在 11 天前，黄仁勋因涉及婚外情的丑闻而被迫辞职，其中包括一名涉嫌与中国间谍的婚外情丑闻。

paras.en: The chipmaker's stock rose more than 30% on the news, opening at nearly $170 (€155.5) per share and recovering most of the losses since last month, when the affair was first reported.
paras.zh: 消息传出后，这家芯片制造商的股价上涨了 30% 以上，开盘价接近 170 美元（155.5 欧元），收复了上个月事件首次被报道以来的大部分跌幅。

paras.en: The surge helped propel US stock indices to their best day since last year. But in premarket trading on Tuesday, Nvidia fell about 5%, underscoring the volatility of the market and the risks facing the AI sector and the broader tech industry.
paras.zh: 此次飙升帮助美国股指创下去年以来的最佳表现。但在周二的盘前交易中，英伟达股价下跌约 5%，凸显了市场的波动性以及人工智能行业和更广泛的科技行业面临的风险。

paras.en: How passive investing is fueling the AI trade
paras.zh: 被动投资如何推动人工智能贸易

paras.en: The recent volatility around AI, memory chips and other technology stocks has unnerved even the most experienced and bullish investors.
paras.zh: 最近围绕人工智能、存储芯片和其他科技股的波动甚至让最有经验和最乐观的投资者感到不安。

paras.en: Yet, those seeking a haven away from the United States stock market, which has enjoyed the majority of the AI hype — along with Taiwan and South Korea — are increasingly finding few places to shelter.
paras.zh: 然而，那些寻求远离美国股市（以及台湾和韩国）的避风港的人越来越找不到庇护所。美国股市在人工智能炒作中占据了大部分份额。

paras.en: Economists warn that this is partly due to the way index funds, including exchange-traded funds (ETFs), work. These funds hold the pensions and other savings of hundreds of millions of passive investors.
paras.zh: 经济学家警告说，这在一定程度上是由于包括交易所交易基金（ETF）在内的指数基金的运作方式造成的。这些基金持有数亿被动投资者的养老金和其他储蓄。

paras.en: These indices have become increasingly exposed to the AI boom.
paras.zh: 这些指数越来越受到人工智能热潮的影响。

paras.en: Riding the winners works — until it doesn't
paras.zh: 骑在胜利者身上是有效的——直到它不起作用为止

paras.en: Most flagship index funds are keen to ride winners, so they automatically buy stocks according to a company's market value. The bigger a company grows, the more of it they hold.
paras.zh: 大多数旗舰指数基金都热衷于追逐赢家，因此它们会自动根据公司的市值购买股票。公司规模越大，他们持有的股份就越多。

paras.en: The values of Nvidia, Microsoft, Apple, Alphabet and other US technology giants have benefited from this effect, with many soaring after ChatGPT was first released in late 2022.
paras.zh: 英伟达、微软、苹果、Alphabet 等美国科技巨头的股价都受益于这一效应，在 ChatGPT 于 2022 年底首次发布后，许多公司的股价飙升。

paras.en: The US also has an outsized position in funds that track the global economy. Nine of the top 10 holdings of the MSCI All Country World Index (ACWI), an index of more than 2,400 firms across 47 developed and emerging markets, are US Big Tech names.
paras.zh: 美国在跟踪全球经济的基金中也拥有大量头寸。 MSCI 所有国家世界指数 (ACWI) 涵盖 47 个发达市场和新兴市场的 2,400 多家公司，其中排名前 10 的股票中有 9 个是美国大型科技公司。

paras.en: The other is TSMC, a Taiwanese chipmaker that produces 90% of the high-end AI semiconductors.
paras.zh: 另一个是台积电，这是一家台湾芯片制造商，生产 90% 的高端人工智能半导体。

paras.en: Together, these 10 holdings make up nearly a quarter of the index.
paras.zh: 这 10 只股票合计占该指数的近四分之一。

paras.en: Although it's a global index, nearly two-thirds of MSCI ACWI's value is in US-listed companies, even though they make up only around a fifth of its firms.
paras.zh: 尽管它是一个全球指数，但 MSCI ACWI 价值的近三分之二来自美国上市公司，尽管它们仅占该指数公司的五分之一左右。

paras.en: "A well-diversified portfolio should ... reasonably represent the entire global economy," Gerd Kommer, founder of the Munich-based asset manager Gerd Kommer Invest, told DW.
paras.zh: 慕尼黑资产管理公司 Gerd Kommer Invest 的创始人 Gerd Kommer 告诉德国之声：“充分多元化的投资组合应该……合理地代表整个全球经济。”

paras.en: "That's not the case if 70% of the portfolio is concentrated in just one country — the US. The global economy is more resilient than any national economy."
paras.zh: “如果 70% 的投资组合只集中在一个国家——美国，情况就不是这样了。全球经济比任何国家经济都更有弹性。”

paras.en: Kommer, who is known as Germany's "ETF pope," said investors need exposure to all economic sectors and that no single sector should make up more than a quarter of a portfolio.
paras.zh: 被称为德国“ETF教皇”的科默表示，投资者需要投资于所有经济部门，并且任何单一部门所占投资组合的比例不应超过四分之一。

paras.en: Yet, even if investors want to avoid US-dominated World funds altogether, the AI trade still overshadows several other top index funds.
paras.zh: 然而，即使投资者希望完全避开美国主导的世界基金，人工智能交易仍然让其他几只顶级指数基金黯然失色。

paras.en: In MSCI's Emerging Market index, for example, the top 10 make up 37.5% of its value and TSMC alone accounts for almost 16%. Tech, chip and internet firms make up eight of the largest holdings, alongside two banks — one Chinese, one Indian.
paras.zh: 例如，在 MSCI 新兴市场指数中，前 10 名就占其价值的 37.5%，仅台积电就占了近 16%。科技、芯片和互联网公司构成了最大的八家持股公司，此外还有两家银行——一家是中国的，一家是印度的。

paras.en: That matters, according to Dimitri Vayanos, a finance professor at the London School of Economics who studies how passive investing pushes up the prices of the biggest firms.
paras.zh: 伦敦经济学院金融学教授迪米特里·瓦亚诺斯（Dimitri Vayanos）认为，这一点很重要，他研究被动投资如何推高最大公司的价格。

paras.en: "My model suggests that the effects of flows into index funds are larger when the large stocks happen to be in the same industry," Vayanos told DW.
paras.zh: 瓦亚诺斯告诉德国之声：“我的模型表明，当大型股票恰好属于同一行业时，流入指数基金的影响更大。”

paras.en: When some investors get over-optimistic about a company and push the stock price up, index funds add to that price pressure.
paras.zh: 当一些投资者对一家公司过于乐观并推高股价时，指数基金就会增加价格压力。

paras.en: Professional investors then often bet against overpriced stocks, a practice known as "shorting," which helps pull prices back down. But that's far riskier with, say, a tech giant than with a small firm.
paras.zh: 然后，专业投资者经常做空价格过高的股票，这种做法被称为“做空”，这有助于拉低价格。但对于一家科技巨头来说，这比一家小公司的风险要大得多。

paras.en: "Being short 1% of SpaceX involves much more risk than being short 1% of a small company," said Vayanos.
paras.zh: Vayanos 表示：“做空 SpaceX 1% 的股份所带来的风险比做空小公司 1% 的股份要大得多。”

paras.en: The problem gets worse when the biggest firms are all in the same sector, as they are now. As short-sellers hold back, the biggest stocks climb further, creating what he calls an "amplification-overpricing spiral."
paras.zh: 当最大的公司都在同一行业时，问题会变得更糟，就像现在一样。随着卖空者的抑制，最大的股票进一步攀升，形成了他所说的“放大-定价过高的螺旋”。

paras.en: To cut exposure to AI-related stocks, investors may have to turn to developed market funds outside the US and Southeast Asia. These funds have offered lower returns over the past decade.
paras.zh: 为了减少对人工智能相关股票的投资，投资者可能不得不转向美国和东南亚以外的发达市场基金。这些基金在过去十年中提供了较低的回报。

paras.en: In the MSCI Europe, Australasia and Far East (EAFE) index fund, the top 10 holdings make up about 14.5% of the index, about 40% lower than the all-country world index.
paras.zh: 在 MSCI 欧洲、澳大拉西亚和远东 (EAFE) 指数基金中，前 10 名持股约占该指数的 14.5%，比全国世界指数低约 40%。

paras.en: EAFE's major holdings include healthcare giant Roche, oil major Shell, HSBC bank and Nestle — the world's largest food and beverage company.
paras.zh: EAFE 的主要控股公司包括医疗保健巨头罗氏公司、石油巨头壳牌公司、汇丰银行和全球最大的食品和饮料公司雀巢公司。

paras.en: However, its biggest holding, ASML, is still very much part of the AI trade. The Dutch tech firm sells the equipment that firms such as TSMC, Samsung, Intel, SK Hynix and Micron need to make their chips.
paras.zh: 然而，其最大的控股公司 ASML 仍然是人工智能行业的重要组成部分。这家荷兰科技公司销售台积电、三星、英特尔、SK 海力士和美光等公司制造芯片所需的设备。

paras.en: If Monday's rebound in the AI trade is sustained, stock prices may move sharply higher over the next few months. Yet if history is a guide, the bubble will eventually burst, leaving both institutional and passive investors nursing heavy losses.
paras.zh: 如果周一人工智能交易的反弹持续下去，未来几个月股价可能会大幅走高。然而，如果以史为鉴，泡沫最终将破裂，让机构投资者和被动投资者蒙受重大损失。

paras.en: Kommer warned that if the AI bubble bursts, "in all likelihood it will drag down the global stock market," though the damage would be most severe in tech and AI stocks.
paras.zh: Kommer 警告说，如果人工智能泡沫破裂，“很可能会拖累全球股市”，尽管科技和人工智能股票受到的损害最为严重。

paras.en: Those hit hardest would be retail investors "with heavy portfolio weights in tech and AI stocks," he said, including "a lot of people who have bought individual AI-related stocks on top of their equity ETFs."
paras.zh: 他表示，受影响最严重的将是“在科技和人工智能股票投资组合中拥有大量投资”的散户投资者，其中包括“许多在股票 ETF 基础上购买了个人人工智能相关股票的人”。

paras.en: LSE's Vayanos thinks it is still "certainly safer to hold an ETF than to hold individual stocks."
paras.zh: 伦敦证券交易所的 Vayanos 认为“持有 ETF 肯定比持有个股更安全”。

paras.en: But as index providers add mega-IPOs such as SpaceX and Claude-maker Anthropic to benchmarks within weeks of their debut, and money continues to pour into passive funds, he warned that "the conditions are present for the effects of our theory to be even stronger."
paras.zh: 但随着指数提供商将 SpaceX 和 Claude-maker Anthropic 等大型 IPO 在首次亮相后几周内纳入基准，并且资金继续涌入被动型基金，他警告说，“我们的理论的影响力已经具备了更强的条件。”

articles.title: Is North Korea holding back on sending Russia more troops?

paras.en: Over the summer, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that he expected between 30,000 and 50,000 North Korean soldiers would be deployed to Russia as part of Pyongyang's ongoing support of Moscow's war effort.
paras.zh: 今年夏天，乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，他预计将向俄罗斯部署 3 万至 5 万名朝鲜士兵，作为平壤持续支持莫斯科战争努力的一部分。

paras.en: However, it now appears that troop buildup has yet to materialize, and it is unclear whether North Korea will continue sending large numbers of troops to Russia.
paras.zh: 但目前看来，增兵行动尚未落实，朝鲜是否会继续向俄罗斯派遣大量军队还不得而知。

paras.en: Writing on Telegram on November 9, Andrii Kovalenko, who resigned in September as head of Ukraine's Center for Countering Disinformation, said an August intelligence assessment indicated that the Kremlin had requested more than 30,000 additional North Korean troops for an autumn offensive.
paras.zh: 11 月 9 日，安德里·科瓦连科 (Andrii Kovalenko) 辞去乌克兰反虚假信息中心主任一职，于 11 月 9 日在 Telegram 上撰文称，8 月份的情报评估显示，克里姆林宫已要求增派 3 万多名朝鲜军队，用于秋季攻势。

paras.en: He said a summit between North Korean leader Kim Jong Un and Russian President Vladimir Putin was expected in September, but did not happen. Kviy has claimed that North Korea previously sent thousands of troops to Russia's Kursk region in 2024, where Moscow was fighting to repel a Ukrainian incursion.
paras.zh: 他表示，朝鲜领导人金正恩和俄罗斯总统普京预计将于 9 月举行峰会，但并未举行。科维声称，朝鲜此前于 2024 年向俄罗斯库尔斯克地区派遣了数千名士兵，莫斯科当时正在该地区奋力击退乌克兰的入侵。

paras.en: Kovalenko believes Pyongyang turned down Moscow's request because taking part in offensive operations in Russian-occupied parts of Ukraine's Donetsk region may still be a red line for North Korea.
paras.zh: 科瓦连科认为，平壤拒绝了莫斯科的请求，因为参与乌克兰顿涅茨克地区俄罗斯占领地区的进攻行动可能仍然是朝鲜的红线。

paras.en: However, Kovalenko added that Russia still relies on North Korean material support, particularly ammunition, while assessing that another major deployment of North Korean combat troops was unlikely this winter.
paras.zh: 不过，科瓦连科补充说，俄罗斯仍然依赖朝鲜的物资支持，特别是弹药，同时评估朝鲜今年冬天不太可能再次大规模部署作战部队。

paras.en: No need for North Korean reinforcements?
paras.zh: 不需要朝鲜增援吗？

paras.en: Han Ki-bum, a former deputy director of South Korea's National Intelligence Service, told DW that the lull in fighting and the onset of winter give Pyongyang little immediate reason to send reinforcements.
paras.zh: 韩国国家情报院前副局长韩基范告诉德国之声，战斗的平息和冬季的到来让平壤没有立即派遣增援的理由。

paras.en: He added that a visit this week to Moscow by Jo Yong-won, a senior North Korean official and close aide to Kim, could shed light on any future plans.
paras.zh: 他补充说，朝鲜高级官员、金正恩的亲密助手赵甬元本周访问莫斯科，可能会揭示未来的计划。

paras.en: Han said it remained to be seen whether the visit was intended to deepen political ties between the ruling parties, building on their military cooperation, or to lay the groundwork for a visit by Kim himself.
paras.zh: 韩国瑜表示，此次访问是为了深化执政党之间的政治关系、加强军事合作，还是为金正恩本人的访问奠定基础，还有待观察。

paras.en: Ahn Chan-il, a former North Korean soldier who defected to South Korea in 1979 and now heads the World Institute for North Korea Studies in Seoul, said Moscow also had reasons to limit the deployment.
paras.zh: 1979 年叛逃到韩国、现任首尔世界朝鲜研究所所长的前朝鲜士兵安赞日 (Ahn Chan-il) 表示，莫斯科也有理由限制部署。

paras.en: He told DW that he expects Russia to weigh its battlefield needs against the costs of bringing in more North Korean troops. Unless the war expands, he said, Moscow is unlikely to request a larger contingent.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声，他预计俄罗斯将权衡其战场需求与引进更多朝鲜军队的成本。他说，除非战争扩大，否则莫斯科不太可能要求派遣更大规模的特遣队。

paras.en: Ukrainian official Kovalenko said North Korea still had a missile unit in Russia's Voronezh region and around 8,500 support personnel in rear areas, including drone operators, engineers and sappers.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员科瓦连科表示，朝鲜在俄罗斯沃罗涅日地区仍有一支导弹部队，并在后方部署了约 8,500 名支援人员，包括无人机操作员、工程师和工兵。

paras.en: He added that Pyongyang was ramping up ammunition production and showcasing new drones and missiles.
paras.zh: 他补充说，平壤正在提高弹药生产并展示新型无人机和导弹。

paras.en: In a post on X on November 17, Zelenskyy said that Russia was receiving dozens of North Korean ballistic missiles each month.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在 11 月 17 日的 X 帖子中表示，俄罗斯每个月都会收到数十枚朝鲜弹道导弹。

paras.en: He warned that their use in Ukraine was helping Pyongyang refine its weapons and creating security risks for countries around the Korean Peninsula. Battle-testing weaponry is one of North Korea's primary advantages from military cooperation with Russia
paras.zh: 他警告说，在乌克兰使用这些武器正在帮助平壤改进其武器，并给朝鲜半岛周边国家带来安全风险。实战测试武器是朝鲜与俄罗斯军事合作的主要优势之一

paras.en: Kovalenko said Pyongyang appeared to have adopted what he called a "containment strategy," limiting its military commitment to Russia's war while maintaining ties with both Moscow and Beijing.
paras.zh: 科瓦连科表示，平壤似乎采取了他所说的“遏制战略”，限制其对俄罗斯战争的军事承诺，同时保持与莫斯科和北京的关系。

paras.en: In his assessment, this approach allows Pyongyang to retain the benefits of its alliance with Russia while reducing its exposure to the outcome of the war.
paras.zh: 他认为，这种做法可以让平壤保留与俄罗斯联盟的好处，同时减少其对战争结果的影响。

paras.en: Analyst Ahn said he expects Pyongyang's military cooperation with Moscow to continue because Russian assistance is crucial to North Korea's efforts to develop drone technology and strengthen its navy.
paras.zh: 分析师安表示，他预计平壤与莫斯科的军事合作将继续下去，因为俄罗斯的援助对于朝鲜发展无人机技术和加强海军的努力至关重要。

paras.en: Nevertheless, the extent of this cooperation may be more limited in the future, and Pyongyang is also able to turn to China as a hedge.
paras.zh: 不过，未来这种合作的程度可能会更加有限，平壤也可以向中国求助。

paras.en: Ahn said that if Russia limits the deployment of North Korean troops, Pyongyang's foreign currency earnings from those deployments would have less room to grow, giving it another reason to seek more support from Beijing
paras.zh: 安说，如果俄罗斯限制朝鲜军队的部署，平壤从这些部署中获得的外汇收入的增长空间就会缩小，这给了它寻求北京更多支持的另一个理由

paras.en: Jeong Joon Hee, a former South Korean Unification Ministry spokesperson, told DW that recent moves towards building better ties with Beijing may also reflect Pyongyang's dissatisfaction with what Moscow has offered in return for North Korea's help.
paras.zh: 韩国统一部前发言人郑俊熙告诉德国之声，最近与北京建立更好关系的举措也可能反映出平壤对莫斯科为换取朝鲜帮助而提供的条件的不满。

paras.en: By strengthening its relationship with China while keeping ties with Russia steady, he said, Pyongyang could also be trying to persuade Moscow to give it more.
paras.zh: 他说，通过加强与中国的关系，同时保持与俄罗斯的稳定关系，平壤也可能试图说服莫斯科给予更多支持。

paras.en: Kim Hyung Suk, a former South Korean vice minister of unification, told DW that North Korea needs China's economic, political and diplomatic backing alongside the support it receives from Russia. He expects Pyongyang to keep pursuing China's support regardless of how it manages its role in the war.
paras.zh: 韩国前统一部副部长金亨硕(Kim Hyung Suk)告诉德国之声，朝鲜除了需要俄罗斯的支持外，还需要中国的经济、政治和外交支持。他预计平壤将继续寻求中国的支持，无论其如何处理自己在战争中的角色。

articles.title: Is Russia really aiming for a new European security architecture?

paras.en: How do you stop the Ukraine war after nearly five years of bloodshed and destruction? The administration of United States President Donald Trump seems to believe the path forward is mediation between Moscow and Kyiv.
paras.zh: 在经历了近五年的流血和破坏之后，您如何阻止乌克兰战争？美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的政府似乎认为前进的道路是莫斯科和基辅之间的调解。

paras.en: Earlier this month, it restarted three-way talks with a meeting in Abu Dhabi. But instead of some outline of a deal, what we got was Russia adding yet another item of disagreement by bringing up European security architecture.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，它在阿布扎比举行会议，重启三方会谈。但我们得到的不是一些协议大纲，而是俄罗斯提出了欧洲安全架构，增加了另一个分歧点。

paras.en: To stop pounding Ukrainian cities and critical infrastructure, Russia is demanding far-reaching concessions by both the US and Europe. The wish-list includes NATO withdrawing forces from allies on the eastern flank and committing not to accept new members.
paras.zh: 为了停止袭击乌克兰城市和关键基础设施，俄罗斯要求美国和欧洲做出深远的让步。北约的愿望清单包括从东翼盟国撤军，并承诺不接受新成员。

paras.en: At some level, there is nothing new about the Russian demands. In December 2021, weeks before the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, Russia presented the US and NATO with two draft treaties which spelled out similar conditions.
paras.zh: 从某种程度上来说，俄罗斯的要求并不新鲜。 2021 年 12 月，在全面入侵乌克兰之前几周，俄罗斯向美国和北约提交了两份条约草案，其中阐述了类似的条件。

paras.en: The US rejected the far-reaching demands, which included scrapping NATO’s open-door policy, rolling back defence infrastructure and deployments in the east to the levels of 1997, and withdrawing US nuclear arms from Europe. Yet Washington was ready to engage on certain issues, including negotiations on intermediate and short-range missiles stationed in Europe, as well as transparency, risk reduction, and arms control.
paras.zh: 美国拒绝了影响深远的要求，其中包括废除北约的门户开放政策、将东部的国防基础设施和部署缩减至1997年的水平，以及从欧洲撤回美国核武器。然而，华盛顿准备参与某些问题，包括关于驻扎欧洲的中短程导弹的谈判，以及透明度、降低风险和军备控制。

paras.en: Future historians may argue whether the acceptance of the entire package would have averted the war. But Russia’s ambition to recast the European security and political order was already there, in stark display, in late 2021. Ever since, Moscow has stuck to its guns – repeating at every twist and turn that “the root causes” of the conflict have to be addressed in a settlement.
paras.zh: 未来的历史学家可能会争论接受整个计划是否会避免战争。但俄罗斯重塑欧洲安全和政治秩序的雄心早在 2021 年底就已经显现出来。从那时起，莫斯科就一直坚持自己的立场 — — 反复强调必须通过解决方案解决冲突的“根源”。

paras.en: One might agree or disagree about the merits of Russia’s perspective – blaming the war fully on the US and NATO and portraying its own actions as purely defensive. However, there is no denying how radical a cure the Kremlin prescribes to the alleged ills of Western expansion.
paras.zh: 人们可能同意或不同意俄罗斯观点的优点——将战争完全归咎于美国和北约，并将自己的行动描述为纯粹的防御性行为。然而，不可否认的是，克里姆林宫为所谓的西方扩张弊病开出了多么激进的治疗方法。

paras.en: One would think that the failure to subdue Ukraine would have injected a dose of realism. A de facto partition of Ukrainian territory, with a ceasefire freezing the front lines, and gradual lifting of Western sanctions, is fully within Putin’s grasp. That is the message he is getting from both Trump and European leaders.
paras.zh: 人们可能会认为，未能制服乌克兰将会注入一剂现实主义的药剂。事实上，乌克兰领土的分割、前线的停火以及西方制裁的逐步解除，完全在普京的掌握之中。这是他从特朗普和欧洲领导人那里得到的信息。

paras.en: But at least officially, the Kremlin is having none of it. Instead, it is piling up new conditions: the cessation of European military support for Kyiv, no deployment of forces on Ukrainian soil, Finland exiting NATO and reverting to neutrality, prohibition of Ukraine’s participation in the European Union’s budding defence initiatives, no extension of the British and French nuclear umbrella to their European allies, etc.
paras.zh: 但至少在官方层面上，克里姆林宫对此一无所知。相反，它正在提出新的条件：欧洲停止对基辅的军事支持，不在乌克兰领土上部署军队，芬兰退出北约并恢复中立，禁止乌克兰参与欧盟新兴的防御计划，英国和法国的核保护伞不得扩大到其欧洲盟友，等等。

paras.en: In other words, nearly all gains Europe has made since February 2022 in terms of strengthening its collective defence have to go in order for Russia to stop fighting. It seems Putin’s ambitions know no bounds.
paras.zh: 换句话说，为了让俄罗斯停止战斗，欧洲自 2022 年 2 月以来在加强集体防御方面取得的几乎所有成果都必须付之东流。看来普京的野心是无止境的。

paras.en: Obviously, such an overhaul of European security arrangements is, to put it politely, not very likely. Even Trump, however eager he might be to cut a deal with “his friend” Putin, will not be willing, much less able, to deliver Europe on a silver platter.
paras.zh: 显然，客气地说，对欧洲安全安排进行这样的彻底改革不太可能。即使是特朗普，无论他多么渴望与“他的朋友”普京达成协议，都不愿意、更不用说能够让欧洲轻松实现。

paras.en: Ukraine will not stop fighting – it made that abundantly clear with the successful strikes against the Kerch bridge and Russian ships in the Baltic and off Libya’s coast in the Mediterranean. Nor will Europe – for all the uncertainty about funding and the rise of Ukraine-sceptical parties and leaders in key countries – stop supporting Kyiv.
paras.zh: 乌克兰不会停止战斗——它成功地袭击了刻赤大桥以及波罗的海和利比亚地中海沿岸的俄罗斯船只，清楚地表明了这一点。尽管资金存在不确定性，而且关键国家对乌克兰持怀疑态度的政党和领导人不断崛起，欧洲也不会停止支持基辅。

paras.en: The Russian side is fully aware of the limits and constraints, and yet it hammers on with the same talking points over and over again. The question is why.
paras.zh: 俄方充分意识到这些限制和制约，但仍反复强调同样的论点。问题是为什么。

paras.en: The more benign interpretation of Russia’s overly ambitious demands has to do with basic negotiation strategy. Russia is setting a very high asking price in order to extract as much as is realistically possible in the talks with the US and the Europeans.
paras.zh: 对俄罗斯过于雄心勃勃的要求的更温和的解释与基本谈判策略有关。俄罗斯设定了非常高的要价，以便在与美国和欧洲的谈判中获得尽可能多的利益。

paras.en: Once the guns fall silent, there will be practical issues of managing the Cold War-like standoff between NATO and Russia as well as between a Western-backed Ukraine and Russia. Some guardrails would probably be welcomed by both sides on transparency of troop and equipment movements and joint exercises.
paras.zh: 一旦枪声平息，北约与俄罗斯之间以及西方支持的乌克兰与俄罗斯之间类似冷战的对峙就会出现实际问题。在部队和装备调动以及联合演习的透明度方面，一些护栏可能会受到双方的欢迎。

paras.en: There could be military-to-military dialogue or an open line between security and intelligence agencies. It is even possible that there could be some common understandings on hybrid warfare – acts of sabotage, espionage, disinformation and the like, which have recently been on the rise.
paras.zh: 安全和情报机构之间可能会进行军事对话或开放路线。甚至有可能对混合战争有一些共同的理解——破坏、间谍、虚假信息等行为，这些行为最近有所增加。

paras.en: Trying to prevent and/or manage escalation through a new security regime could be possible. The Organisation for Security and Co-operation in Europe (OSCE), in which both EU member states and Russia participate, could get a new lease of life in such a scenario.
paras.zh: 尝试通过新的安全制度来防止和/或管理升级是可能的。在这种情况下，欧盟成员国和俄罗斯共同参与的欧洲安全与合作组织（欧安组织）可能会获得新的生机。

paras.en: A return to summits involving Russia, on one side, and the US and major European countries on the other might also be a possibility, especially after Putin is gone.
paras.zh: 重返峰会也有可能，一方面是俄罗斯，另一方面是美国和欧洲主要国家，特别是在普京下台之后。

paras.en: The more sceptical interpretation of Russia’s demands is that it is trying to dilute the agenda and in effect divert attention away from Ukraine in order to gain extra advantage on the battlefield.
paras.zh: 对俄罗斯要求的更持怀疑态度的解释是，它试图淡化议程，实际上转移人们对乌克兰的注意力，以便在战场上获得额外优势。

paras.en: In Moscow’s thinking, strategic-level relations between great powers have priority over regional issues. Vladimir Medinsky, Putin’s aide and chief negotiator, put it bluntly: “Essentially, the whole body is sick, and in the Ukraine, there was just a cyst that burst.”
paras.zh: 在莫斯科的思维中，大国战略层面的关系优先于地区问题。普京的助手兼首席谈判代表弗拉基米尔·梅丁斯基直言：“本质上是整个身体都病了，而在乌克兰，只是一个囊肿破裂了。”

paras.en: The same logic informed the much-hyped summit in Shenzhen between Putin, Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. The Russian leader basked in his top-dog status in global geopolitics, with nuclear stability and the global price of energy on the agenda.
paras.zh: 同样的逻辑也体现在普京、特朗普和中国国家主席习近平在深圳举行的大肆宣传的峰会上。这位俄罗斯领导人洋溢着自己在全球地缘政治中的霸主地位，核稳定和全球能源价格都被提上日程。

paras.en: The US is prepared to indulge Putin. This in turn gives Russia sufficient political licence to shower ballistic missiles and drones on Ukraine through another winter, aiming for a victor’s peace rubber-stamped by the Americans and swallowed as a fait accompli by Europe.
paras.zh: 美国准备纵容普京。这反过来又给了俄罗斯足够的政治许可，可以在另一个冬天向乌克兰发射弹道导弹和无人机，旨在实现被美国盖上橡皮图章、被欧洲视为既成事实的胜利者和平。

paras.en: The fact that the Europeans are still not at the diplomatic table – partly because of internal squabbling but also because of Russia’s reluctance to have them included – is telling. Thus, the talk about repairing European security architecture may be little more than another fig leaf for the Russians.
paras.zh: 欧洲人仍未坐上外交谈判桌的事实 — — 部分原因是内部争吵，但也因为俄罗斯不愿让他们参与 — — 这一事实很能说明问题。因此，有关修复欧洲安全架构的讨论可能只不过是俄罗斯人的另一块遮羞布。

paras.en: If that is the case, it would be a shame. At the end of the day, avoiding war in Europe should be a goal that all actors – the US, the Europeans, Ukraine, and Russia itself – should be converging on. It may not be the rethink of the continent’s security architecture Moscow has been appealing for but a meaningful contribution to security, nonetheless.
paras.zh: 如果真是这样，那就太可惜了。归根结底，避免欧洲战争应该成为美国、欧洲、乌克兰和俄罗斯本身等所有参与者共同努力的目标。这可能不是莫斯科一直呼吁的对非洲大陆安全架构的重新思考，但仍然是对安全的有意义的贡献。

paras.en: The views expressed in this article are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect Al Jazeera’s editorial stance.
paras.zh: 本文表达的观点是作者自己的观点，并不一定反映半岛电视台的编辑立场。

articles.title: Countries that thrive on global cooperation must help sustain it

paras.en: “For thriving states, international peace and stability are not a luxury. They are the foundation of our national stories.”
paras.zh: “对于繁荣的国家来说，国际和平与稳定并不是奢侈品。它们是我们国家故事的基础。”

paras.en: Qatar’s Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani made this point at the Oxford Union earlier this month. For countries such as Qatar, prosperity rests on connections extending far beyond their borders. Energy exports, shipping routes and overseas investments depend on international predictability. Their security policy has to reflect that.
paras.zh: 卡塔尔总理谢赫·穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜拉赫曼·本·贾西姆·阿勒萨尼本月早些时候在牛津联盟发表了这一观点。对于卡塔尔这样的国家来说，繁荣依赖于远远超出其边界的联系。能源出口、航线和海外投资取决于国际可预测性。他们的安全政策必须反映这一点。

paras.en: The meeting of the presidents of the United States, China and Russia – Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin – in Shenzhen on November 19 brought the problem into focus. Their declaration covered nuclear risks, energy supplies and reform of the United Nations. These are matters that affect every country. A few powers retain disproportionate influence over the outcome.
paras.zh: 11 月 19 日，美国、中国和俄罗斯三国总统——唐纳德·特朗普、习近平和弗拉基米尔·普京在深圳举行的会议使这个问题成为焦点。他们的宣言涵盖核风险、能源供应和联合国改革。这些都是影响每个国家的问题。少数权力对结果保留着不成比例的影响力。

paras.en: Dialogue among these powers is welcome. We should, however, have no illusions that their willingness to sit together signals the end of their competition. They can reach agreements while continuing to contest influence and access to resources. For countries outside the room, the consequences may arrive through a disrupted shipping route, a new restriction on trade or a security decision they had no part in making.
paras.zh: 欢迎这些大国之间进行对话。然而，我们不应该抱有任何幻想，认为他们愿意坐在一起意味着他们的竞争结束。他们可以达成协议，同时继续争夺影响力和资源获取权。对于会议之外的国家来说，后果可能是通过中断的航线、新的贸易限制或他们没有参与制定的安全决策来实现的。

paras.en: The prime minister’s concept of thriving states offers a way to think about their response. He described agile, stable and prosperous countries that have built influence beyond their size. Economic strength, adaptable institutions and trusted relationships give them room to act. Their exposure to decisions taken elsewhere gives them a reason to act together. Economic importance is no guarantee of security.
paras.zh: 总理关于繁荣国家的概念提供了一种思考他们的反应的方法。他描述了敏捷、稳定和繁荣的国家，这些国家的影响力超出了其规模。经济实力、适应性强的机构和值得信赖的关系为他们提供了行动的空间。他们了解其他地方的决定使他们有理由共同行动。经济重要性并不能保证安全。

paras.en: Thriving states can also help bridge the gaps between competing great powers. By maintaining diplomatic and economic ties with all sides, they can keep channels open when relations deteriorate. This gives them room to facilitate dialogue, support conflict resolution and identify areas where rivals still have an interest in cooperating.
paras.zh: 繁荣的国家还可以帮助缩小相互竞争的大国之间的差距。通过与各方保持外交和经济联系，他们可以在关系恶化时保持渠道畅通。这为他们提供了促进对话、支持解决冲突以及确定竞争对手仍有合作兴趣的领域的空间。

paras.en: The familiar classifications are of limited help here. The Global North and the Global South tell us little about which countries can work together on a particular problem. Developed and developing say something about economic conditions, but much less about diplomatic reach or the ability to support a peace process. A country may be small in population and still possess capabilities that larger states need.
paras.zh: 熟悉的分类在这里的帮助有限。全球北方和全球南方几乎没有告诉我们哪些国家可以在某个特定问题上进行合作。发达国家和发展中国家只能说明经济状况，但更不用说外交影响力或支持和平进程的能力了。一个国家可能人口较少，但仍然拥有大国所需的能力。

paras.en: Negotiations still have to take place. Aid needs access, ceasefires need monitoring, and agreements need someone to keep working on them after the announcement. Thriving states should take greater responsibility for this work. Their diplomatic access and financial resources are increasingly necessary to sustain functions that international institutions struggle to perform consistently.
paras.zh: 谈判仍需进行。援助需要准入，停火需要监督，协议需要有人在宣布后继续努力。繁荣的国家应该对这项工作承担更大的责任。为了维持国际机构难以持续履行的职能，它们的外交渠道和财政资源变得越来越必要。

paras.en: Qatar is already doing this through its mediation between Washington and Tehran and its work on implementing the Gaza agreement. The limits of these efforts are visible. Agreements are violated, talks stall and violence continues. Maintaining a channel nevertheless preserves the possibility of a negotiated outcome. That channel has to survive setbacks if it is to be useful when an opening appears.
paras.zh: 卡塔尔已经通过华盛顿和德黑兰之间的调解以及执行加沙协议的工作来做到这一点。这些努力的局限性是显而易见的。协议遭到违反，谈判陷入僵局，暴力仍在继续。尽管如此，维持渠道仍保留了达成谈判结果的可能性。如果该渠道要在出现机会时发挥作用，就必须经受住挫折。

paras.en: At Oxford, the prime minister pointed to Qatar’s cooperation with Norway and Switzerland on the situation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Such partnerships bring different relationships and experience to mediation. They offer a practical basis for cooperation among states that share an interest in a settlement, even when their wider foreign policies differ.
paras.zh: 在牛津，首相提到了卡塔尔与挪威和瑞士在刚果民主共和国局势上的合作。这种伙伴关系为调解带来了不同的关系和经验。它们为在解决问题上有共同利益的国家之间的合作提供了务实的基础，即使它们的更广泛的外交政策存在差异。

paras.en: Regional organisations remain essential. In eastern DRC, Qatari facilitation of negotiations between the Congolese government and the AFC/M23 rebel alliance has worked alongside efforts by the African Union, the US and Switzerland. Continued fighting and limited implementation show how much remains to be done. Thriving states should strengthen these partnerships and support the regional institutions involved.
paras.zh: 区域组织仍然至关重要。在刚果民主共和国东部，卡塔尔在非洲联盟、美国和瑞士的努力下，为刚果政府与 AFC/M23 叛乱联盟之间的谈判提供便利。持续的战斗和有限的实施表明还有多少工作要做。繁荣的国家应该加强这些伙伴关系并支持相关的区域机构。

paras.en: The work also requires money and a longer view of what makes peace last. Preliminary OECD figures put Qatar’s official development assistance in 2025 at more than $900m. Restoring services, supporting institutions and creating economic opportunities are all critical for the settlement of conflicts. People need to see that an agreement changes something in their lives.
paras.zh: 这项工作还需要资金和对如何使和平持久的更长远的看法。经合组织的初步数据显示，卡塔尔 2025 年的官方发展援助将超过 9 亿美元。恢复服务、支持机构和创造经济机会对于解决冲突都至关重要。人们需要看到协议改变了他们的生活。

paras.en: Commercial investment matters for a related reason. A 2025 Federal Reserve staff study documented how foreign direct investment is fragmenting along ideological and geographical lines. A government seeking finance for infrastructure or technology increasingly has to consider the strategic dependencies that may accompany it. Control of a port or a critical supply chain can give an outside power influence well beyond the original investment.
paras.zh: 商业投资的重要性也有相关的原因。 2025 年美联储工作人员的一项研究记录了外国直接投资如何按照意识形态和地域划分。为基础设施或技术寻求融资的政府越来越必须考虑可能伴随的战略依赖性。对港口或关键供应链的控制可以带来远远超出原始投资的外部影响力。

paras.en: Thriving states have an opportunity to offer investment with fewer demands for geopolitical alignment. For a country with limited coercive reach and an economy dependent on international exchange, keeping markets open may be more valuable than drawing other countries into an exclusive sphere of influence. The benefit to recipients is greater choice over both their economic partners and their foreign policy.
paras.zh: 繁荣的国家有机会提供投资，而对地缘政治联盟的要求较少。对于一个强制力有限且经济依赖国际贸易的国家来说，保持市场开放可能比将其他国家纳入专属势力范围更有价值。受援国的好处是对其经济伙伴和外交政策有更多的选择。

paras.en: That difference has to be demonstrated. Thriving states have interests, and their investments also generate influence.
paras.zh: 必须证明这种差异。繁荣的国家有利益，他们的投资也会产生影响力。

paras.en: The next step is to organise sustained cooperation among willing thriving states. Their economies are already connected through trade and investment. Their diplomatic cooperation should acquire comparable depth. A standing partnership would allow them to combine capabilities around particular problems while retaining their own priorities. Agreement on every international dispute is an unrealistic condition for useful work.
paras.zh: 下一步是在有意愿的繁荣国家之间组织持续的合作。它们的经济已经通过贸易和投资联系在一起。他们的外交合作应该具有相当的深度。长期的伙伴关系将使他们能够结合解决特定问题的能力，同时保留自己的优先事项。就每一个国际争端达成一致对于开展有用的工作来说是不现实的条件。

paras.en: The same layered and networked approach I have advocated for Gulf security applies here: different partners undertake different tasks, and their efforts need to connect. In a peace process, one country may have access to the parties while another can support monitoring or implementation. Governments should agree how to bring those contributions together before the next crisis demands them.
paras.zh: 我为海湾安全主张的分层和网络化方法也适用于此：不同的合作伙伴承担不同的任务，他们的努力需要相互联系。在和平进程中，一个国家可以接触各方，而另一个国家可以支持监督或实施。各国政府应就如何在下一次危机需要之前汇集这些捐款达成一致。

paras.en: Development agencies should pool resources for implementing agreements, with priorities established in consultation with local institutions and affected communities. Commercial investors can support recovery where viable opportunities exist. Financing and implementation arrangements should be prepared during negotiations, so that a signed agreement is followed by work people can see. Leaving those questions until later risks losing the opening that diplomacy has created.
paras.zh: 发展机构应集中资源执行协议，并与当地机构和受影响社区协商确定优先事项。商业投资者可以在存在可行机会的情况下支持复苏。谈判期间应准备好融资和实施安排，以便签署协议后工作人员能够看到。把这些问题留到以后再回答可能会失去外交创造的机会。

paras.en: The partnership should support the UN and regional organisations with funding, expertise and coordinated diplomacy. It will also need consistency. Sovereignty and civilian protection must matter when a partner violates them. Countries asking for a greater role in international security should be prepared to defend the principles that make their own prosperity possible. And we saw this very clearly when Qatar defended itself against Iranian aggression earlier this year.
paras.zh: 这种伙伴关系应为联合国和区域组织提供资金、专业知识和协调一致的外交支持。它还需要一致性。当合作伙伴侵犯主权和平民保护时，它们必须发挥重要作用。要求在国际安全中发挥更大作用的国家应该准备好捍卫使本国繁荣成为可能的原则。当卡塔尔今年早些时候抵御伊朗侵略时，我们清楚地看到了这一点。

paras.en: Shenzhen is a reminder that major powers will continue to negotiate over the shape of the international order. Thriving states have their own resources and interests to bring to that discussion. They should begin by organising the work they already do and committing to sustain it together. Acting separately gives them less influence than their combined capabilities should permit.
paras.zh: 深圳提醒人们，大国将继续就国际秩序的形态进行谈判。繁荣的国家有自己的资源和利益可以参与讨论。他们应该首先组织已经开展的工作并致力于共同维持它。单独行动所产生的影响力小于其综合能力应有的影响力。

paras.en: The views expressed in this article are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect Al Jazeera’s editorial stance.
paras.zh: 本文表达的观点是作者自己的观点，并不一定反映半岛电视台的编辑立场。

articles.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts Houthi attacks after Hodeidah strike

paras.en: Saudi Arabia says its air defences have intercepted several drones launched by Yemen’s Houthi rebels, a day after the Saudi-led coalition supporting the Yemeni government carried out an air strike on the rebel-held port city of Hodeidah.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯表示，其防空系统拦截了也门胡塞叛军发射的几架无人机，此前一天，沙特领导的支持也门政府的联盟对叛军控制的港口城市荷台达进行了空袭。

paras.en: The coalition’s spokesman Turki Al-Maliki said that Saudi air defence systems destroyed four drones in Ras Tanura in Saudi Arabia’s east on Wednesday morning, adding that fragments fell due to the interception, with no casualties reported in the initial assessment.
paras.zh: 该联盟发言人图尔基·马利基表示，沙特防空系统周三上午在沙特阿拉伯东部的拉斯坦努拉摧毁了四架无人机，并补充说，碎片因拦截而落下，初步评估中没有人员伤亡报告。

paras.en: Al-Maliki said earlier that three drones were also shot down in the Eastern province.
paras.zh: 马利基早些时候表示，东部省份也有三架无人机被击落。

paras.en: The interceptions came after the Saudi-led coalition, which backs Yemen’s internationally recognised government, said it had struck Yemen’s Hodeidah.
paras.zh: 此次拦截行动是在支持国际公认的也门政府的沙特领导的联军表示袭击了也门荷台达之后进行的。

paras.en: The Houthi armed group earlier threatened to retaliate against the kingdom’s Red Sea ports, including Jeddah in the event of an attack.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装组织早些时候威胁称，如果发生袭击，将对包括吉达在内的沙特红海港口进行报复。

paras.en: In a statement issued by Houthi spokesperson Yahya Saree, the Iran-aligned rebel group urged employees and workers at the ports, as well as people nearby, to evacuate immediately and called on shipping companies to withdraw their vessels.
paras.zh: 在胡塞武装发言人叶海亚·萨里发表的一份声明中，与伊朗结盟的反叛组织敦促港口的员工和工人以及附近的人们立即撤离，并呼吁航运公司撤回船只。

paras.en: The attacks are the latest further escalation in the confrontation between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia, with attacks increasingly targeting strategic infrastructure on both sides.
paras.zh: 这些袭击是胡塞武装和沙特阿拉伯之间对抗的最新进一步升级，袭击越来越多地针对双方的战略基础设施。

paras.en: On Tuesday, a Houthi drone struck the tallest tower in Riyadh, injuring at least 11 people, according to Saudi authorities.
paras.zh: 据沙特当局称，周二，一架胡塞武装无人机袭击了利雅得最高的塔楼，造成至少 11 人受伤。

paras.en: Qatar and Pakistan, which have been mediating efforts to end the wider war in the region between Iran and the United States, both “strongly” condemned the attack on the tower, which houses the Saudi sovereign wealth fund.
paras.zh: 卡塔尔和巴基斯坦一直在调解努力，以结束伊朗和美国之间该地区更广泛的战争，两国都“强烈”谴责对沙特主权财富基金所在地塔楼的袭击。

paras.en: The building had already been attacked last Thursday and is one of several high-profile targets hit since fighting with the Iran-backed Yemeni group reignited in July.
paras.zh: 该建筑上周四已遭到袭击，是自 7 月与伊朗支持的也门组织的战斗重新爆发以来遭受的几个引人注目的目标之一。

paras.en: The Saudi-led coalition fighting the Houthis promised a firm response to the attack.
paras.zh: 沙特领导的打击胡塞武装的联军承诺对此次袭击做出坚决回应。

paras.en: The Saudi-led coalition targeted operational capabilities at Hodeidah and destroyed several targets in the Yemeni governorates of Saada and Amran, al-Maliki said.
paras.zh: 马利基说，沙特领导的联军瞄准了荷台达的作战能力，并摧毁了也门萨达省和阿姆兰省的多个目标。

paras.en: Hodeidah, on Yemen’s Red Sea coast, is the main port through which food and other essential supplies enter Houthi-controlled northern Yemen.
paras.zh: 荷台达位于也门红海沿岸，是食品和其他必需品进入胡塞武装控制的也门北部的主要港口。

paras.en: It has long served as a key entry point for humanitarian aid and commercial imports, making it a lifeline for millions of Yemenis in a country heavily dependent on imported food.
paras.zh: 长期以来，它一直是人道主义援助和商业进口的关键切入点，使其成为这个严重依赖进口食品的国家数百万也门人的生命线。

paras.en: Renewed fighting between the two sides has intensified since the Houthis announced a blockade on Saudi ports in July. In September, the Iran-aligned group launched a lightning offensive, seizing territory from Yemeni government forces near the Bab al-Mandeb strait, a strategic shipping chokepoint at the southern entrance to the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 自胡塞武装7月宣布封锁沙特港口以来，双方战事再度激化。 9月，与伊朗结盟的组织发起闪电攻势，从也门政府军手中夺取了曼德海峡附近的领土，曼德海峡是红海南部入口的战略航运咽喉要道。

paras.en: Yemeni government forces launched a counteroffensive last month, reclaiming some territory as fighting continues to rage on several fronts.
paras.zh: 也门政府军上个月发动反攻，收复了一些领土，因为多条战线的战斗仍在继续。

paras.en: The Houthis have also stepped up strikes on Saudi airports, ports and oil facilities, while Saudi Arabia has ramped up air strikes on Houthi targets in Yemen in response.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装还加大了对沙特机场、港口和石油设施的打击力度，而沙特阿拉伯则加大了对也门胡塞武装目标的空袭力度作为回应。

articles.title: Ukraine war spilling into NATO territory
articles.author: Teri Schultz

paras.en: Ukraine war spilling into NATO territory
paras.zh: 乌克兰战争蔓延至北约领土

paras.en: The war between Russia and Ukraine once again creeps onto European territory – from attacks on ships to missiles in Poland and fresh allegations of Russian operations inside Denmark.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争再次蔓延到欧洲领土——从波兰的船只袭击到导弹袭击，再到俄罗斯在丹麦境内行动的新指控。

paras.en: A Russian ship was set ablaze after it was struck by a drone in the Baltic Sea. Yet another sign that the war in Ukraine is, at times, spilling over into the rest of Europe. This comes just days after President Trump called Russian President Vladimir Putin his friend. Teri Schultz joins us now from Brussels. Teri, let's start in the Gulf of Finland. A Russian cargo ship was hit by a drone there Saturday and caught fire. What's the latest on that?
paras.zh: 一艘俄罗斯船只在波罗的海被无人机击中后起火。另一个迹象表明，乌克兰战争有时会蔓延到欧洲其他地区。就在几天前，特朗普总统称俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京为朋友。泰瑞·舒尔茨 (Teri Schultz) 现在从布鲁塞尔加入我们。泰瑞，我们从芬兰湾开始吧。周六，一艘俄罗斯货船在那里被一架无人机击中并起火。最新消息是什么？

paras.en: TERI SCHULTZ, BYLINE: Well, a few hours ago, Rob, Russia took control of this cargo ship, the Sparta II, and towed it out of Finnish waters a day after, as you mentioned, it was hit by a drone. The crew was rescued by another Russian vessel traveling nearby at the time of the strike. Now, the attack is presumed to have come from Ukraine, but Kyiv has not yet claimed responsibility. Finnish President Alexander Stubb referred to the incident as an unfortunate reminder that the, quote, "consequences of Russia's war of aggression are also visible in our region." Interestingly, teams from both Finland and neighboring Estonia came Saturday and helped Russian ships try to put out the fire on board. Stubb thanked all of those involved for what he called responsible and professional actions.
paras.zh: 泰瑞·舒尔茨连线：几个小时前，罗布，俄罗斯控制了这艘货船“斯巴达二号”，并在一天后将其拖离芬兰水域，正如您提到的，它被一架无人机击中。袭击发生时，船员被附近行驶的另一艘俄罗斯船只救起。现在，袭击被推测来自乌克兰，但基辅尚未声称对此负责。芬兰总统亚历山大·斯塔布称这一事件不幸地提醒人们，“俄罗斯侵略战争的后果在我们地区也显而易见”。有趣的是，来自芬兰和邻国爱沙尼亚的团队周六抵达，帮助俄罗斯船只试图扑灭船上的大火。斯塔布感谢所有相关人员采取的负责任和专业的行动。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: So if the Sparta II was in the service of the Russian military, why didn't Finland seize the ship to put it out of business?
paras.zh: 施密茨：那么，如果斯巴达二号是为俄罗斯军队服务的，为什么芬兰没有扣押这艘船并使其停业呢？

paras.en: SCHULTZ: There was a lot of talk about this in Finland because this ship transports weapons and other supplies to Russia to use against Ukraine. And the vessel itself is under U.S. and U.K. sanctions, and its owner is under European Union sanctions. But the conclusion this time was that it would create too big an environmental hazard to keep it in Finnish waters. Here's how it was described in a press conference by Jukka-Pekka Lumilahti, the director of sea operations for the Finnish Border Guard.
paras.zh: 舒尔茨：芬兰对此进行了很多讨论，因为这艘船向俄罗斯运送武器和其他物资，用于对抗乌克兰。该船本身受到美国和英国的制裁，其船东也受到欧盟的制裁。但这次的结论是，将其留在芬兰水域会造成太大的环境危害。芬兰边防卫队海上行动总监尤卡-佩卡·卢米拉蒂 (Jukka-Pekka Lumilahti) 在新闻发布会上是这样描述的。

paras.en: JUKKA-PEKKA LUMILAHTI: (Through interpreter) If we would let the vessel burn, it would most likely sink. And after that, it would cause a major environmental risk for Finland and Estonia.
paras.zh: JUKKA-PEKKA LUMILAHTI：（通过翻译）如果我们让船只燃烧，它很可能会沉没。此后，这将对芬兰和爱沙尼亚造成重大环境风险。

paras.en: SCHULTZ: So as much as Finland would be pleased to take a military cargo ship out of Moscow's arsenal, in this case, they were basically saying good riddance.
paras.zh: 舒尔茨：尽管芬兰很乐意从莫斯科的军火库中取出一艘军用货船，但在这种情况下，他们基本上是在说好摆脱。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: So Ukraine is not the only one launching far-reaching strikes. Last Friday, Russia launched missiles into Polish territory. And I understand that you were there covering a nearby military exercise involving nearly a dozen countries, and it was that that was suspected to be Russia's reason for doing this, right?
paras.zh: 施密茨：所以乌克兰并不是唯一发动影响深远的袭击的国家。上周五，俄罗斯向波兰境内发射了导弹。据我了解，你当时正在现场报道附近有近十几个国家参加的军事演习，这被怀疑是俄罗斯这样做的原因，对吧？

paras.en: SCHULTZ: Yeah, that's right. There were three Russian cruise missiles that landed between 30 and 60 miles from this military exercise, which was training forces for what's envisioned to eventually be a peace-monitoring mission in post-war Ukraine. At the time, all we knew on the ground was that there were multiple air alerts, at one time even telling us to take cover. And that happens often in Poland, especially at that location just over a hundred miles from the Ukrainian border. But this is particularly risky for the Russians, as they never know whether they'll kill people from a NATO country on the ground. NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte was asked by a crowd of reporters in Warsaw whether the alliance can do anything to stop these Russian incursions.
paras.zh: 舒尔茨：是的，没错。三枚俄罗斯巡航导弹落在距这次军事演习 30 至 60 英里的地方，此次演习旨在训练部队，以执行最终在战后乌克兰执行的和平监测任务。当时，我们只知道地面上有多次空中警报，甚至有一次告诉我们要隐蔽。这种情况在波兰经常发生，尤其是在距离乌克兰边境仅一百多英里的地方。但这对俄罗斯人来说尤其危险，因为他们永远不知道自己是否会杀死来自北约国家的人。北约秘书长马克·吕特在华沙被一群记者询问北约是否可以采取措施阻止俄罗斯的入侵。

paras.en: MARK RUTTE: I cannot guarantee you that it will not happen. But I can guarantee you is that NATO will defend every inch of Polish territory, that as a collective alliance, we impose immense costs on Russians.
paras.zh: 马克·鲁特：我不能向你保证这不会发生。但我可以向你们保证，北约将保卫每一寸波兰领土，作为一个集体联盟，我们给俄罗斯人带来了巨大的代价。

paras.en: SCHULTZ: Now, Rob, NATO ambassadors will meet Monday morning in a special session to discuss what more their countries may be able to do to protect Poland.
paras.zh: 舒尔茨：现在，罗布，北约大使将于周一上午召开特别会议，讨论他们的国家可以采取哪些措施来保护波兰。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: That is Teri Schultz in Brussels. Teri, thanks so much for your reporting.
paras.zh: 施密茨：那是布鲁塞尔的泰瑞·舒尔茨。泰瑞，非常感谢您的报告。
