paras.en: More Research Needed on Long-Term Cannabis Exposure
paras.zh: 需要对长期大麻接触进行更多研究

paras.en: The researchers say further studies are necessary to understand the biological processes that might explain why the association between cannabis use and earlier psychosis becomes more pronounced with age.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，需要进一步的研究来了解生物过程，这可能解释为什么大麻使用和早期精神病之间的关联随着年龄的增长而变得更加明显。

paras.en: In particular, they want to investigate whether repeated or prolonged cannabis exposure produces cumulative changes that influence when psychotic symptoms emerge.
paras.zh: 特别是，他们想调查反复或长期接触大麻是否会产生累积变化，从而影响精神病症状的出现。

paras.en: They also recommend additional research focusing on older cannabis users, an increasingly important population as medical cannabis becomes more common and products containing high concentrations of THC become more widely available.
paras.zh: 他们还建议针对老年大麻使用者进行更多研究，随着医用大麻变得越来越普遍，含有高浓度 THC 的产品变得越来越广泛，这一人群变得越来越重要。

paras.en: Another priority is improving how cannabis exposure is measured. The researchers argue that future studies need clearer and more consistent methods for recording cannabis consumption so that findings can be compared more reliably.
paras.zh: 另一个优先事项是改进大麻暴露的测量方式。研究人员认为，未来的研究需要更清晰、更一致的方法来记录大麻消费量，以便更可靠地比较研究结果。

paras.en: Ultimately, the new analysis highlights an important gap in public understanding of cannabis and mental health. While warnings have traditionally concentrated on teenage use, the findings suggest that potential psychiatric risks deserve attention throughout adulthood, particularly among people who continue using cannabis over many years.
paras.zh: 最终，新的分析凸显了公众对大麻和心理健康的理解存在重大差距。虽然警告传统上集中在青少年吸食大麻，但研究结果表明，潜在的精神风险值得在整个成年期引起关注，特别是对于多年来继续吸食大麻的人。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of New South Wales. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由新南威尔士大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Carly Stevens, Hannah Pincham, Matthew Large. Cannabis Use and Age-Related Acceleration of Psychosis Onset: A Meta-Analysis. Biological Psychiatry, 2026; DOI: 10.1016/j.biopsych.2026.06.025
paras.zh: - 卡莉·史蒂文斯、汉娜·平查姆、马修·拉奇。大麻的使用和与年龄相关的精神病发作加速：荟萃分析。生物精神病学，2026； DOI：10.1016/j.biopsych.2026.06.025

articles.title: 2,200-year-old Roman shipwreck reveals an ingenious waterproofing trick

paras.en: 2,200-year-old Roman shipwreck reveals an ingenious waterproofing trick
paras.zh: 2200年前的罗马沉船揭示了巧妙的防水技巧

paras.en: A 2,200-year-old Roman shipwreck has revealed sophisticated waterproofing techniques involving pine tar and beeswax. Microscopic pollen grains trapped in the ancient coatings are now helping scientists reconstruct where the vessel may have traveled and undergone repairs more than two millennia ago.
paras.zh: 一艘拥有 2,200 年历史的罗马沉船揭示了涉及松焦油和蜂蜡的复杂防水技术。古代涂层中捕获的微观花粉粒现在正在帮助科学家重建两千年前船只可能行驶和接受修复的地方。

paras.en: A 2,200-year-old Roman shipwreck off the coast of Croatia is revealing how ancient shipbuilders protected their vessels from the destructive forces of the sea. Researchers have discovered two distinct waterproofing recipes, including one that combined pine tar with beeswax. Even more remarkably, microscopic pollen grains preserved in the sticky coatings offer clues to where the ship was built and repaired during its lifetime.
paras.zh: 克罗地亚海岸附近一艘拥有 2,200 年历史的罗马沉船残骸揭示了古代造船商如何保护他们的船只免受海洋破坏力的侵害。研究人员发现了两种不同的防水配方，其中一种将松焦油与蜂蜡结合在一起。更值得注意的是，粘性涂层中保存的微观花粉粒为这艘船在其使用寿命期间的建造和维修地点提供了线索。

paras.en: For as long as humans have traveled by sea, shipbuilders have faced the challenge of keeping water out while protecting vessels from saltwater, microorganisms, and marine creatures such as shipworms. Despite their name, shipworms are actually marine mollusks that burrow into wood and can cause extensive structural damage.
paras.zh: 自从人类通过海上旅行以来，造船商就面临着防水的挑战，同时保护船只免受盐水、微生物和船蛆等海洋生物的侵害。尽管名称如此，船蛆实际上是海洋软体动物，它们会钻入木材中，并可能造成广泛的结构损坏。

paras.en: Yet until the mid-20th century, archaeological studies of ancient vessels largely concentrated on their wooden components. The protective materials that made these ships seaworthy received comparatively little attention, and waterproofing substances remain an understudied aspect of ancient maritime technology.
paras.zh: 然而直到20世纪中叶，对古代器皿的考古研究主要集中在其木制部件上。使这些船只适航的防护材料相对较少受到关注，而防水物质仍然是古代航海技术中未被充分研究的一个方面。

paras.en: In a new study published in Frontiers in Materials, researchers from France and Croatia investigated the protective coatings of Ilovik-Paržine 1, a ship dating to the Roman Republic that sank approximately 2,200 years ago off the coast of modern Croatia.
paras.zh: 在《材料前沿》上发表的一项新研究中，来自法国和克罗地亚的研究人员调查了 Ilovik-Paržine 1 号的防护涂层，这艘船的历史可以追溯到罗马共和国，大约 2,200 年前在现代克罗地亚海岸沉没。

paras.en: "In archaeology little attention is paid to organic waterproofing materials. Yet they are essential for navigation at sea or on rivers and are true witnesses of past naval technologies," said first author Dr. Armelle Charrié, an archaeometrist at the Laboratory of Mass Spectrometry of Interactions and Systems in Strasbourg. "Studying the coatings, we found two different kinds on this vessel: one made of pine tar, also called pitch, and the other of a mixture of pine tar and beeswax. Analysis of pollen in the coating made it possible to identify the plant taxa present in the immediate environment during the construction or repairs of the ship."
paras.zh: “在考古学中，有机防水材料很少受到关注。然而，它们对于海上或河流上的航行至关重要，并且是过去海军技术的真实见证，”第一作者、斯特拉斯堡相互作用与系统质谱实验室的考古学家 Armelle Charrié 博士说。 “通过研究涂层，我们在这艘船上发现了两种不同的涂层：一种由松焦油（也称为沥青）制成，另一种由松焦油和蜂蜡的混合物制成。对涂层中的花粉进行分析，可以识别船舶建造或维修过程中直接环境中存在的植物类群。”

paras.en: Since its discovery in 2016, the shipwreck and its cargo have been the subject of several scientific investigations. However, this is the first study to combine molecular analysis with the examination of ancient pollen to determine both the composition of the ship's waterproofing materials and the types of vegetation growing nearby when those coatings were produced or applied.
paras.zh: 自 2016 年发现以来，这艘沉船及其货物一直是多项科学调查的对象。然而，这是第一项将分子分析与古代花粉检查相结合的研究，以确定船舶防水材料的成分以及在生产或应用这些涂层时附近生长的植被类型。

paras.en: The research brought together specialists from the Department for Underwater Archaeology of the Croatian Conservation Institute and the 'ADRIBOATS' program of the Centre Camille Jullian at Aix-Marseille University in France.
paras.zh: 这项研究汇集了克罗地亚保护研究所水下考古学系和法国艾克斯-马赛大学卡米尔朱利安中心“ADRIBOATS”项目的专家。

paras.en: "Some regions throughout the Adriatic have particular characteristics that led local populations to develop a specific shipbuilding style," said Charrié. "Only studies like ours offer an overview into these traditions which bear witness to genuine know-how and diverse traditions."
paras.zh: 查里说：“亚得里亚海的一些地区具有独特的特征，导致当地居民发展出特定的造船风格。” “只有像我们这样的研究才能对这些传统进行概述，这些传统见证了真正的专业知识和多样化的传统。”

paras.en: To uncover the ancient waterproofing recipes, the researchers examined the physical structure, molecular composition, and pollen content of the coatings. Among the techniques they employed was mass spectrometry, a powerful analytical method that allows scientists to identify substances and measure their abundance based on the masses of their molecular or atomic components.
paras.zh: 为了揭示古老的防水配方，研究人员检查了涂层的物理结构、分子组成和花粉含量。他们采用的技术之一是质谱法，这是一种强大的分析方法，使科学家能够识别物质并根据其分子或原子成分的质量测量其丰度。

paras.en: An Ingenious Combination of Pine Tar and Beeswax
paras.zh: 松焦油和蜂蜡的巧妙组合

paras.en: The team analyzed 10 samples of the ship's protective coating to determine the biological origins of the ingredients. Distinctive chemical signatures characteristic of pine trees appeared throughout the samples, revealing that the primary waterproofing material was pitch derived from heated conifer resin or tar.
paras.zh: 该团队分析了船舶保护涂层的 10 个样本，以确定成分的生物来源。整个样品中都出现了松树特有的化学特征，表明主要的防水材料是从加热的针叶树树脂或焦油中提取的沥青。

paras.en: Pitch is a thick, sticky substance that has been used for centuries to seal wooden vessels and protect them from water. When heated, it becomes easier to spread over surfaces and into gaps between wooden components.
paras.zh: 沥青是一种粘稠的物质，几个世纪以来一直被用来密封木制容器并防水。加热后，它更容易散布在表面和木质部件之间的间隙中。

paras.en: One sample, however, contained evidence of a different recipe. Ancient shipbuilders had combined the pine tar with beeswax, creating a protective substance known to Greek shipbuilders as zopissa.
paras.zh: 然而，一个样本包含了不同配方的证据。古代造船商将松焦油与蜂蜡结合在一起，创造出一种被希腊造船商称为“zopissa”的保护物质。

paras.en: The addition of beeswax made the coating more flexible and easier to apply while hot. Flexibility would have been a valuable property aboard wooden ships, whose timbers could shift and flex as they encountered waves and changing environmental conditions.
paras.zh: 蜂蜡的添加使涂层更加柔韧并且更容易在热时涂抹。灵活性是木船上的一项宝贵财产，木船的木材在遇到波浪和不断变化的环境条件时可能会移动和弯曲。

paras.en: Ancient Pollen Preserves a Record of the Ship's Past
paras.zh: 古代花粉保存了这艘船过去的记录

paras.en: The sticky nature of pitch gave it another remarkable property that ancient shipbuilders probably never considered. It could capture tiny airborne pollen grains from surrounding vegetation and preserve them for thousands of years.
paras.zh: 沥青的粘性赋予了它另一个古代造船商可能从未考虑过的非凡特性。它可以从周围的植被中捕获空气中微小的花粉粒，并将其保存数千年。

paras.en: Different plants produce pollen with distinctive shapes and structures, allowing scientists to identify the types of vegetation present in an area long after the plants themselves have disappeared. By examining both the variety and relative abundance of pollen grains embedded in the ship's coatings, the researchers narrowed down the possible locations where the pitch was manufactured or applied during repairs.
paras.zh: 不同的植物产生具有独特形状和结构的花粉，使科学家能够在植物本身消失很久之后识别该地区存在的植被类型。通过检查船舶涂层中嵌入的花粉粒的种类和相对丰度，研究人员缩小了在维修过程中制造或使用沥青的可能位置。

paras.en: The pollen preserved aboard Ilovik-Paržine 1 pointed to a surprisingly diverse range of landscapes. Some of the plant species were characteristic of Mediterranean and Adriatic coastal areas and valleys, including forests dominated by holly oak and pine. Others were associated with matorral, a type of Mediterranean shrubland that can contain olive and hazel trees.
paras.zh: Ilovik-Parzine 1 号上保存的花粉显示出令人惊讶的多样化景观。一些植物物种具有地中海和亚得里亚海沿海地区和山谷的特征，包括以冬青橡树和松树为主的森林。其他则与马托拉尔有关，这是一种地中海灌木丛，可以种植橄榄树和榛树。

paras.en: The discovery of alder and ash pollen suggested the presence of vegetation growing near rivers or coastlines, either close to the sea or farther inland. Smaller quantities of fir and beech pollen pointed to mountainous environments. Such vegetation is characteristic of the northeastern Adriatic coast, where the mountains of Istria and Dalmatia rise not far from the shoreline.
paras.zh: 桤木和白蜡木花粉的发现表明，河流或海岸线附近存在植被，要么靠近大海，要么更远的内陆。少量的冷杉和山毛榉花粉表明是山区环境。这种植被是亚得里亚海东北部海岸的特征，伊斯特拉山脉和达尔马提亚山脉就在离海岸线不远的地方升起。

paras.en: Evidence of Multiple Repairs Across the Mediterranean
paras.zh: 地中海地区多次修复的证据

paras.en: The distribution and composition of the protective materials also revealed that the vessel likely received four or five distinct batches of waterproofing coatings.
paras.zh: 保护材料的分布和成分还表明，该船可能接受了四到五批不同的防水涂料。

paras.en: The stern, or rear of the ship, and its central section shared the same coating. At the bow, or front of the vessel, researchers identified three batches that differed from one another. These variations suggest that the ship may have undergone a series of repairs using materials obtained from different locations around the Mediterranean.
paras.zh: 船尾或船的后部及其中央部分共享相同的涂层。在船头或船头，研究人员发现了三批彼此不同的产品。这些变化表明，这艘船可能使用从地中海各地不同地点获得的材料进行了一系列维修。

paras.en: Earlier investigations of the ship's ballast, the heavy material carried aboard a vessel to improve its stability, identified the ancient city of Brundisium as its likely place of construction. Known today as Brindisi, the port city lies on the southeastern coast of Italy and was an important maritime center in the ancient Roman world.
paras.zh: 早期对船舶压舱物（船上用于提高稳定性的重物）的调查发现，古城布伦迪西姆可能是其建造地点。这座港口城市今天被称为布林迪西，位于意大利东南海岸，是古罗马世界重要的航海中心。

paras.en: The new pollen evidence suggests that some of the waterproofing coatings were applied in the vicinity of Brundisium. Other layers may have been added along the northeastern Adriatic coast, near the region where the vessel ultimately sank.
paras.zh: 新的花粉证据表明，一些防水涂料是在布伦迪西姆附近使用的。沿着亚得里亚海东北部海岸，靠近船只最终沉没的区域，可能还增加了其他层。

paras.en: The findings demonstrate how microscopic biological traces can reveal aspects of ancient maritime history that might otherwise remain hidden. Even when waterproofing materials appear chemically identical, the pollen trapped within them can preserve evidence of separate repair events and the environments in which they occurred.
paras.zh: 这些发现证明了微观生物痕迹如何能够揭示古代海洋历史的各个方面，否则这些历史可能会被隐藏。即使防水材料的化学成分看起来相同，其中捕获的花粉也可以保留单独修复事件及其发生环境的证据。

paras.en: "While it seems obvious that ships sailing long distances need repairs, it's simply not easy to demonstrate this," concluded Charrié. "Pollen has been very useful in identifying different coatings where the molecular profiles were identical."
paras.zh: “虽然长距离航行的船舶需要维修似乎是显而易见的，但要证明这一点并不容易，”查理总结道。 “花粉对于识别分子特征相同的不同涂层非常有用。”

paras.en: - Armelle Charrie-Duhaut, Quentin Couillebault, Igor Miholjek, Giulia Boetto. articles.title: A simple metal is hiding a strange new form of magnetism

paras.en: A simple metal is hiding a strange new form of magnetism
paras.zh: 一种简单的金属隐藏着一种奇怪的新形式的磁性

paras.en: Max Planck Institute for Chemical Physics of Solids
paras.zh: 马克斯·普朗克固体化学物理研究所

paras.en: Scientists have discovered a strange form of magnetism in an ordinary-looking metal that has no overall magnetization yet profoundly changes how electrons behave. The breakthrough offers a promising new path toward understanding exotic quantum materials and developing future electronic technologies.
paras.zh: 科学家们在一种看似普通的金属中发现了一种奇怪的磁性，这种金属没有整体磁化，但却深刻地改变了电子的行为方式。这一突破为理解奇异量子材料和开发未来电子技术提供了一条有前途的新途径。

paras.en: A surprisingly simple metal has revealed an unusual form of magnetism that could open new possibilities for quantum technology. Researchers have found compelling evidence of a rare magnetic state in which electrons behave in unexpected ways, even though the material produces no overall magnetization.
paras.zh: 一种令人惊讶的简单金属揭示了一种不寻常的磁性形式，可以为量子技术开辟新的可能性。研究人员发现了一种罕见的磁性状态的令人信服的证据，在这种状态下，即使材料不产生整体磁化，电子也会以意想不到的方式表现出来。

paras.en: The material, known as europium silicide (EuSi), contains an intricate magnetic structure that influences how electrons move and how their spins are oriented. This behavior is associated with a phenomenon called p-wave magnetism, an emerging area of research that could eventually help scientists develop new approaches to controlling electronic properties.
paras.zh: 这种材料被称为硅化铕 (EuSi)，包含复杂的磁性结构，会影响电子的移动方式及其自旋方向。这种行为与一种称为 p 波磁性的现象有关，这是一个新兴的研究领域，最终可以帮助科学家开发出控制电子特性的新方法。

paras.en: The discovery is particularly significant because EuSi is a relatively simple metallic compound. Unlike many materials previously considered for studying this exotic form of magnetism, it offers researchers a practical way to investigate the underlying physics in detail.
paras.zh: 这一发现特别重要，因为EuSi是一种相对简单的金属化合物。与之前考虑用于研究这种奇异形式磁性的许多材料不同，它为研究人员提供了一种详细研究基础物理的实用方法。

paras.en: An Unexpected Discovery in a Simple Metal
paras.zh: 简单金属中的意外发现

paras.en: The research began about three years ago at the Max Planck Institute for Chemical Physics of Solids (MPI CPfS) in Dresden, Germany. Dr. Erjian Cheng successfully grew high-quality single crystals of EuSi, providing the material needed for detailed experiments.
paras.zh: 这项研究大约三年前在德国德累斯顿的马克斯·普朗克固体化学物理研究所 (MPI CPfS) 开始。程二建博士成功生长出高质量的EuSi单晶，为详细实验提供了所需的材料。

paras.en: When researchers first examined the crystals using photoemission techniques, which probe the energies and behavior of electrons inside materials, they noticed something unexpected. The magnetic arrangement of the atoms had a remarkably strong influence on the electronic band structure, which describes the energy levels electrons can occupy and helps determine how a material conducts electricity.
paras.zh: 当研究人员首次使用光电发射技术检查晶体时，该技术探测材料内部电子的能量和行为，他们注意到了一些意想不到的事情。原子的磁性排列对电子能带结构有非常大的影响，电子能带结构描述了电子可以占据的能级，并有助于确定材料如何导电。

paras.en: That observation raised an intriguing possibility. Could this simple compound contain an unconventional form of magnetism in which the spin of an electron is connected to the direction it travels?
paras.zh: 这一观察提出了一个有趣的可能性。这种简单的化合物是否可能包含一种非常规形式的磁性，其中电子的自旋与其运动方向相关？

paras.en: "When we first measured the electronic structure of EuSi, we were surprised by the exceptionally large effect of magnetism on the electrons," explains Cheng. "That observation led us to investigate whether this simple compound could host a much more unusual magnetic state. The combination of crystal growth, neutron scattering and spin-resolved spectroscopy now provides compelling evidence for p-wave magnetism."
paras.zh: “当我们第一次测量 EuSi 的电子结构时，我们对磁性对电子的巨大影响感到惊讶，”Cheng 解释道。 “这一观察结果引导我们研究这种简单的化合物是否可以具有更不寻常的磁性状态。晶体生长、中子散射和自旋分辨光谱的结合现在为 p 波磁性提供了令人信服的证据。”

paras.en: Answering that question required an international collaboration involving 38 scientists from 19 institutions. Participants included researchers from ShanghaiTech University, the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, the Max Planck Institute for the Physics of Complex Systems and Oak Ridge National Laboratory.
paras.zh: 回答这个问题需要来自 19 个机构的 38 名科学家的国际合作。参与者包括来自上海科技大学、香港科技大学、马克斯普朗克复杂系统物理研究所和橡树岭国家实验室的研究人员。

paras.en: A Strange Form of Magnetism That Cancels Itself Out
paras.zh: 一种奇怪的磁力会自行消失

paras.en: Ordinary magnets, such as those attached to refrigerators, typically rely on a magnetic arrangement called ferromagnetism. In these materials, many electron spins align in the same direction, producing an overall magnetic field.
paras.zh: 普通磁铁（例如附在冰箱上的磁铁）通常依赖于称为铁磁性的磁性排列。在这些材料中，许多电子自旋沿同一方向排列，产生整体磁场。

paras.en: At temperatures between approximately 33 and 62 kelvin, the magnetic moments of its europium atoms organize themselves into a repeating spiral pattern. These temperatures correspond to roughly minus 400 to minus 348 degrees Fahrenheit.
paras.zh: 在大约 33 到 62 开尔文的温度下，铕原子的磁矩会自行组织成重复的螺旋图案。这些温度大约相当于负 400 到负 348 华氏度。

paras.en: Each europium atom has a substantial magnetic moment, but their orientations balance one another across the spiral. As a result, the material has no net magnetization in this magnetic phase.
paras.zh: 每个铕原子都具有很大的磁矩，但它们的方向在螺旋上相互平衡。因此，材料在该磁相中没有净磁化强度。

paras.en: However, the absence of overall magnetization does not mean magnetism has stopped influencing the electrons. In fact, the researchers found that the spiral arrangement produces a highly unusual electronic structure.
paras.zh: 然而，整体磁化强度的缺失并不意味着磁性已停止影响电子。事实上，研究人员发现螺旋排列产生了一种非常不寻常的电子结构。

paras.en: In the proposed p-wave magnetic state, electrons traveling in opposite directions have opposite spin polarizations. Electron spin is a quantum property that gives electrons magnetic characteristics, although it should not be understood as an electron literally spinning like a tiny ball.
paras.zh: 在所提出的 p 波磁态中，沿相反方向行进的电子具有相反的自旋极化。电子自旋是一种赋予电子磁性特征的量子特性，尽管它不应该被理解为像小球一样旋转的电子。

paras.en: The relationship between an electron's direction of motion and its spin is called an odd-parity spin texture. This means that reversing the electron's momentum also reverses the associated spin polarization.
paras.zh: 电子运动方向与其自旋之间的关系称为奇宇称自旋结构。这意味着反转电子动量也会反转相关的自旋极化。

paras.en: Other materials can display spin-dependent energy differences because of a phenomenon known as spin-orbit coupling, which connects an electron's motion to its spin. In EuSi, however, the unusual spin structure appears to arise mainly from interactions between magnetic moments and the specific symmetry of their spiral arrangement.
paras.zh: 由于一种称为自旋轨道耦合的现象，其他材料可以表现出与自旋相关的能量差异，这种现象将电子的运动与其自旋联系起来。然而，在 EuSi 中，不寻常的自旋结构似乎主要是由磁矩和其螺旋排列的特定对称性之间的相互作用产生的。

paras.en: Experiments Reveal Evidence of Rare P-Wave Magnetism
paras.zh: 实验揭示了稀有 P 波磁性的证据

paras.en: To determine whether EuSi truly exhibits the predicted magnetic state, the scientists combined several sophisticated experimental methods with theoretical calculations.
paras.zh: 为了确定 EuSi 是否真正表现出预测的磁态，科学家们将几种复杂的实验方法与理论计算结合起来。

paras.en: First, they used neutron diffraction, a technique that reveals how atoms and magnetic moments are arranged inside a material. These measurements confirmed that the europium magnetic moments form a spiral structure with the symmetry required for p-wave magnetism.
paras.zh: 首先，他们使用中子衍射，这是一种揭示原子和磁矩在材料内部如何排列的技术。这些测量证实铕磁矩形成螺旋结构，具有 p 波磁性所需的对称性。

paras.en: Next, the researchers examined the material using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. This method measures the energies and momenta of electrons, allowing scientists to map the electronic structure.
paras.zh: 接下来，研究人员使用角分辨光电子能谱检查了该材料。这种方法测量电子的能量和动量，使科学家能够绘制电子结构图。

paras.en: The results showed that magnetic ordering substantially reorganizes the electron energy levels. In particular, the team observed magnetically driven energy separations exceeding 100 millielectronvolts, indicating an unusually strong influence of magnetism on electron behavior.
paras.zh: 结果表明，磁排序实质上重组了电子能级。特别是，该团队观察到磁性驱动的能量分离超过 100 毫电子伏，这表明磁性对电子行为的影响异常强烈。

paras.en: The most decisive evidence came from spin-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, which allowed the researchers to examine electron spin polarization directly.
paras.zh: 最决定性的证据来自自旋分辨光电子能谱，它使研究人员能够直接检查电子自旋极化。

paras.en: They observed that the sign of the spin polarization changed across successive magnetic Brillouin zones. These zones are regions of momentum space used by physicists to describe how electrons behave within a repeating magnetic structure.
paras.zh: 他们观察到自旋极化的符号在连续的磁性布里渊区中发生了变化。这些区域是动量空间的区域，物理学家用来描述电子在重复磁性结构中的行为方式。

paras.en: The team also found that spin polarization became much weaker near locations where theoretical calculations predicted the p-wave spin texture should disappear.
paras.zh: 研究小组还发现，在理论计算预测 p 波自旋结构应该消失的位置附近，自旋极化变得更弱。

paras.en: Taken together, the measurements provide compelling experimental evidence consistent with the predicted p-wave magnetic state in EuSi.
paras.zh: 总而言之，这些测量结果提供了令人信服的实验证据，与预测的 EuSi 中的 p 波磁态一致。

paras.en: A Hidden Magnetic Spiral With Two Different Orientations
paras.zh: 具有两个不同方向的隐藏磁螺旋

paras.en: The researchers uncovered another unusual feature of EuSi involving chirality, a scientific term describing handedness.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现了 EuSi 的另一个不寻常特征，涉及手性，这是一个描述旋手性的科学术语。

paras.en: A familiar example is the difference between a left hand and a right hand. They are mirror images, but they cannot be perfectly superimposed.
paras.zh: 一个熟悉的例子是左手和右手的区别。它们是镜像，但不能完美叠加。

paras.en: Something similar happens with the magnetic spiral inside EuSi. Although the underlying crystal has a centrosymmetric structure, meaning its atomic arrangement is unchanged by inversion through a central point, the magnetic spiral can twist in either of two opposite directions.
paras.zh: EuSi 内部的磁螺旋也会发生类似的情况。尽管底层晶体具有中心对称结构，这意味着通过中心点反转其原子排列不会改变，但磁性螺旋可以沿两个相反方向之一扭转。

paras.en: These different spiral orientations create magnetic regions, or domains, with opposite handedness.
paras.zh: 这些不同的螺旋方向产生了具有相反旋向的磁性区域或磁域。

paras.en: Using magnetic force microscopy and spatially resolved photoemission spectroscopy, the scientists identified domains measuring approximately ten micrometers across. For perspective, ten micrometers is about one-tenth the thickness of a typical human hair.
paras.zh: 使用磁力显微镜和空间分辨光电子能谱，科学家们确定了直径约为十微米的域。从透视角度来看，十微米约为典型人类头发厚度的十分之一。

paras.en: When the researchers examined these regions using circularly polarized light, they detected different electronic responses depending on the handedness of the magnetic spiral.
paras.zh: 当研究人员使用圆偏振光检查这些区域时，他们根据磁螺旋的旋向性检测到不同的电子响应。

paras.en: This finding demonstrates that the direction in which the magnetic structure twists is linked to the material's electronic properties.
paras.zh: 这一发现表明，磁性结构扭曲的方向与材料的电子特性有关。

paras.en: "What makes EuSi particularly exciting is that an unconventional electronic spin structure emerges from the magnetic order of a chemically simple metal," says Prof. Claudia Felser, Director at MPI CPfS. "This demonstrates how the discovery of new materials can reveal entirely new electronic phenomena. EuSi now gives us an experimental platform to investigate how magnetic symmetry and chirality can be used to control electronic properties, with potential implications for future spintronics and unconventional superconductivity."
paras.zh: MPI CPfS 主任 Claudia Felser 教授表示：“EuSi 特别令人兴奋的是，一种非常规的电子自旋结构是从化学简单金属的磁序中产生的。” “这证明了新材料的发现如何能够揭示全新的电子现象。EuSi 现在为我们提供了一个实验平台，可以研究如何利用磁对称性和手性来控制电子特性，这对未来的自旋电子学和非常规超导具有潜在的影响。”

paras.en: Why This Discovery Matters for Quantum Technology
paras.zh: 为什么这一发现对量子技术很重要

paras.en: One of the biggest challenges in studying p-wave magnetism has been finding materials that display the necessary magnetic properties while remaining practical for detailed experiments.
paras.zh: 研究 p 波磁性的最大挑战之一是找到既能表现出必要的磁性，又能对详细实验保持实用性的材料。

paras.en: Earlier candidates have included insulating materials, as well as metals that develop the required magnetic order only at extremely low temperatures or have complicated symmetries that make their behavior difficult to interpret.
paras.zh: 早期的候选材料包括绝缘材料，以及仅在极低温度下产生所需磁序或具有复杂对称性使其行为难以解释的金属。

paras.en: EuSi offers a particularly useful combination of characteristics.
paras.zh: EuSi 提供了特别有用的特性组合。

paras.en: It is a stoichiometric metal, meaning its constituent elements occur in a fixed chemical ratio. Researchers can also grow high-quality single crystals of the material, and its spiral magnetic arrangement has the symmetry associated with p-wave magnetism.
paras.zh: 它是一种化学计量金属，意味着其组成元素以固定的化学比例存在。研究人员还可以生长出高质量的单晶材料，其螺旋磁性排列具有与p波磁性相关的对称性。

paras.en: Together, these features make EuSi a promising experimental platform for exploring how exotic magnetic states influence the behavior of electrons.
paras.zh: 这些特征共同使 EuSi 成为探索奇异磁态如何影响电子行为的有前途的实验平台。

paras.en: Theoretical studies suggest that metallic p-wave magnets could display several remarkable properties. For example, they may allow electrons with particular spin orientations to carry electrical currents without requiring an external magnetic field.
paras.zh: 理论研究表明金属 p 波磁体可以表现出多种显着的特性。例如，它们可以允许具有特定自旋方向的电子在不需要外部磁场的情况下携带电流。

paras.en: They could also produce strong changes in spin polarization when an electric current is applied, potentially offering new ways to manipulate electronic behavior.
paras.zh: 当施加电流时，它们还可以产生自旋极化的强烈变化，这有可能提供操纵电子行为的新方法。

paras.en: These possibilities are especially relevant to spintronics, a field of technology that seeks to use electron spin, rather than electrical charge alone, to process and store information.
paras.zh: 这些可能性与自旋电子学尤其相关，自旋电子学是一个寻求使用电子自旋而不是单独使用电荷来处理和存储信息的技术领域。

paras.en: Another intriguing possibility involves unconventional superconductivity, in which electrical current flows without resistance through superconducting states that differ from those found in conventional superconductors.
paras.zh: 另一个有趣的可能性涉及非常规超导，其中电流无阻力地流过与传统超导体不同的超导状态。

paras.en: Importantly, these predicted effects have not yet been demonstrated in EuSi. The discovery does not establish that the material can already perform these functions, but it gives researchers a promising system in which to test the predictions.
paras.zh: 重要的是，这些预测的效应尚未在 EuSi 中得到证实。这一发现并没有证明该材料已经能够执行这些功能，但它为研究人员提供了一个有前途的系统来测试预测。

paras.en: More broadly, the findings highlight how much of a material's behavior can remain hidden beneath an apparently simple chemical composition.
paras.zh: 更广泛地说，这些发现强调了材料的行为有多少可以隐藏在看似简单的化学成分之下。

paras.en: A solid's properties depend on more than the elements it contains or how its atoms are positioned. The arrangement of magnetic moments, the symmetries they create, and the quantum behavior of electrons can also produce entirely unexpected effects.
paras.zh: 固体的属性不仅仅取决于它所包含的元素或其原子的位置。磁矩的排列、磁矩产生的对称性以及电子的量子行为也会产生完全意想不到的效果。

paras.en: By revealing compelling evidence of p-wave magnetism in EuSi, researchers have gained a new opportunity to investigate these relationships and explore how unusual magnetic structures might eventually be used to control the electronic properties of future materials.
paras.zh: 通过揭示 EuSi 中 p 波磁性的令人信服的证据，研究人员获得了一个新的机会来研究这些关系，并探索如何最终使用不寻常的磁性结构来控制未来材料的电子特性。

paras.en: Materials provided by Max Planck Institute for Chemical Physics of Solids. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由马克斯·普朗克固体化学物理研究所提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: 'Blade Runner 2099' executive producers talk architectural easter eggs and franchise continuity for Prime Video's new sci-fi series (interview)
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: Prime Video's new "Blade Runner 2099" series arrives Nov. 25, 2026, and it flips the cyberpunk universe on its head. The new show casts replicants as the dominant species on Earth, with humans relegated to second-class citizens after a global uprising.
paras.zh: Prime Video 的全新《银翼杀手 2099》系列将于 2026 年 11 月 25 日上映，彻底颠覆了赛博朋克宇宙。新剧将复制人视为地球上的主导物种，而人类在全球起义后沦为二等公民。

paras.en: This dreary dystopian cyberpunk realm originates from sci-fi legend Phillip K. Dick's 1968 novel, "Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?," and was then so vividly brought to life in Ridley Scott’s seminal 1982 adaptation, "Blade Runner." The 2017 sequel, "Blade Runner 2049," was directed by "Arrival’s" and "Dune’s" Denis Villeneuve.
paras.zh: 这个沉闷的反乌托邦赛博朋克世界源自科幻传奇人物菲利普·K·迪克 1968 年的小说《仿生人会梦见电子羊吗？》，并在雷德利·斯科特 1982 年的开创性改编作品《银翼杀手》中生动地呈现出来。 2017 年的续集《银翼杀手 2049》由《降临》和《沙丘》的丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦执导。

paras.en: Starring Michelle Yeoh, Hunter Schafer, Matthew Needham, Dimitri Abold, and Lewis Gribben, "Blade Runner 2099" hails from creator and showrunner Silka Louisa and Alcon Entertainment founders Andrew Kosove and Broderick Johnson, who executive produce with Ridley Scott's Scott Free Productions.
paras.zh: 《银翼杀手 2099》由杨紫琼、亨特·谢弗、马修·尼达姆、迪米特里·阿伯德和刘易斯·格里本主演，由创作者兼剧集主管西尔卡·路易莎和 Alcon Entertainment 创始人安德鲁·科索夫和布罗德里克·约翰逊打造，他们是雷德利·斯科特旗下 Scott Free Productions 的执行制片人。

paras.en: Here, Yeoh's dying replicant blade runner Olwen unites with Schafer’s Cora, a human masquerading as a synthetic, to hunt down a dangerous rogue replicant that holds the key to a dark secret.
paras.zh: 在这里，杨紫琼饰演的垂死的复制人刀锋战士奥尔文与谢弗饰演的伪装成合成人的人类科拉联合起来，追捕掌握着黑暗秘密钥匙的危险的流氓复制人。

paras.en: We spoke to Kosove and Johnson about being respectful keepers of "Blade Runner's" creative flame, the pitch that sold them, and dipping back into Dick's original novel.
paras.zh: 我们采访了科索夫和约翰逊，谈论了如何尊重《银翼杀手》创意火焰的守护者、推销它们的宣传，以及重新审视迪克的原著小说。

paras.en: "When the original film came out in 1982, and even when "2049" came out about a decade ago, a lot of things that these movies envisioned seemed far, far away and hard to comprehend," Kosovo tells Space. "The creation of artificial sentient beings. Today, sitting here in November of 2026, the world is catching up quicker to the world of 'Blade Runner,' with artificial technology and concerns of how do humans use this technology for our benefit without it taking over."
paras.zh: “当原版电影于 1982 年上映时，甚至当《2049》在大约十年前上映时，这些电影设想的很多事情都显得遥远而难以理解，”科索沃告诉《太空》。 “人工智能的创造。今天，2026 年 11 月，世界正在更快地赶上《银翼杀手》的世界，人工智能技术以及人类如何利用这项技术为我们谋福利而不被它接管。”

paras.en: "Silka came in several years ago and pitched her very simple idea, which was, the next chapter of 'Blade Runner' should be what happens when the replicants overtake their creators." explains Kosovo.
paras.zh: “西尔卡几年前进来，提出了她非常简单的想法，那就是，《银翼杀手》的下一章应该是复制人超越他们的创造者时发生的事情。”科索沃解释道。

paras.en: "We thought that idea was going to be particularly resonant. It was simple to understand so new fans could enter the world without being steeped in the first two movies. And we thought it had logical continuity to the story canon that came before it. It checked a number of key boxes for us. Even though we talked to a number of showrunners who were much more established in their careers than Silka was at that point, she won the day with the most elegant idea in our opinion."
paras.zh: “我们认为这个想法会特别引起共鸣。它很容易理解，这样新粉丝就可以进入这个世界，而不必沉迷于前两部电影。而且我们认为它与之前的故事经典具有逻辑连续性。它为我们检查了许多关键框。尽管我们采访了一些在职业生涯中比西尔卡当时更成熟的剧集制片人，但她以我们认为最优雅的想法赢得了胜利。”

paras.en: Johnson admits that Louisa's pitch approval was just the opening round of a multitude of responsible decisions to be ruminated over as the production process advanced.
paras.zh: 约翰逊承认，随着制作流程的推进，路易莎的推介批准只是众多负责任决策的第一轮，需要反复思考。

paras.en: "Once you agree that this is the story we’re telling, then it becomes a multi-year partnership in honoring all the artists and visionaries that came before as it relates to visual design and music," he notes. "Everything needs to be of the highest quality. Even though it's a TV show we feel it has theatrical level visual effects. It’s practical and tactile and analog. There’s a lot of things that come along with how you produce the show. At its core that becomes a partnership when you decide these are the characters I’m going to spend hours with and you go down that journey."
paras.zh: “一旦你同意这就是我们正在讲述的故事，那么它就成为一种多年的合作伙伴关系，以纪念之前与视觉设计和音乐相关的所有艺术家和梦想家，”他指出。 “一切都需要达到最高质量。即使这是一部电视节目，我们也觉得它具有戏剧级别的视觉效果。它是实用的、触觉的和模拟的。有很多东西与你如何制作节目有关。其核心是，当你决定这些是我要花几个小时与之相处的角色，然后你就开始了这段旅程时，就成为了一种合作关系。”

paras.en: With nearly 60 years of "Blade Runner" material to play with, there’s bound to be easter eggs dropped into the tale over the course of "Blade Runner 2099's" 8-episode season.
paras.zh: 凭借近 60 年的《银翼杀手》素材，在《银翼杀手 2099》的 8 集季中，故事中一定会加入复活节彩蛋。

paras.en: "You’ve got Tyrell as a critical aspect of our story, but Wallace creeps into the story as well," Kosove teases. "One of the keys things was, from an architectural standpoint, things that exist in "2049" had to exist in this. You see the Wallace spires when you see the Tyrell pyramid. You have the sea wall when they're going south with the spinner.
paras.zh: “泰瑞尔是我们故事的一个重要方面，但华莱士也渗透到了故事中，”科索夫开玩笑说。 “关键的事情之一是，从建筑的角度来看，《2049》中存在的东西必须存在于其中。当你看到泰瑞尔金字塔时，你会看到华莱士尖顶。当他们带着旋转器向南行驶时，你会看到海堤。

paras.en: "There’s some story easter eggs too. Silka did something really cool which has not been done in either movie. She brought in concepts that go back to Philip K. Dick's novel, "Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?" That was really interesting. We’re really excited for people to see it and see how they respond.”
paras.zh: “还有一些故事彩蛋。西尔卡做了一些非常酷的事情，这在两部电影中都没有做过。她引入了菲利普·K·迪克小说《机器人会梦见电子羊吗？》中的概念，这真的很有趣。我们真的很高兴人们能看到它并看到他们的反应。”

paras.en: "Blade Runner 2099" arrives on Nov. 25, 2026 exclusively on Prime Video.
paras.zh: 《银翼杀手 2099》将于 2026 年 11 月 25 日在 Prime Video 独家上映。

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 24, 1947: The US Navy launches the 1st Aerobee sounding rocket, but it didn't reach space
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 24, 1947, the U.S. Navy launched the first Aerobee rocket into the sky, but it never reached space.
paras.zh: 1947 年 11 月 24 日，美国海军向天空发射了第一枚 Aerobee 火箭，但它从未到达太空。

paras.en: Aerobee was a suborbital sounding rocket designed to study Earth's atmosphere.
paras.zh: Aerobee 是一种亚轨道探空火箭，旨在研究地球大气层。

paras.en: After World War 2, the United States started reusing erman V-2 rockets for this kind of research. When they started running out of V-2 rockets, the United States constructed its own rockets that were similar but cheaper to build and to launch. In the weeks leading up to the first Aerobee mission, three test flights were launched.
paras.zh: 第二次世界大战后，美国开始重复使用埃尔曼V-2火箭进行此类研究。当 V-2 火箭开始耗尽时，美国建造了自己的火箭，这些火箭与 V-2 火箭类似，但制造和发射成本更低。在第一次 Aerobee 任务之前的几周内，启动了三次试飞。

paras.en: Those tests used a dummy version of Aerobee with a live booster to see if the two stages would separate properly. On Aerobee's first real flight, the rocket flew about 35 miles high. That's below the 62-mile (100 kilometers) upper limit for the boundary of space. (NASA and the U.S. military typically consider 50 miles the edge of space.) Mission control cut the flight short after about 30 seconds, because Aerobee started to yaw, and they wanted to keep it from going completely out of control.
paras.zh: 这些测试使用了带有实时助推器的 Aerobee 虚拟版本，以查看两个阶段是否能够正确分离。在 Aerobee 的第一次真正飞行中，火箭飞行高度约为 35 英里。这低于 62 英里（100 公里）的太空边界上限。 （美国宇航局和美国军方通常认为 50 英里是太空边缘。）大约 30 秒后，任务控制中心缩短了飞行时间，因为 Aerobee 开始偏航，他们希望防止其完全失控。

paras.en: Billed as the "most successful sounding rocket of the space age," the initial Aerobee rocket was suborbital rocket designed to launch experment payload of up to 100 pounds (45 kilograms) to an altitude of 75 miles (121 kilometers) or so.
paras.zh: 最初的 Aerobee 火箭被誉为“太空时代最成功的探空火箭”，它是亚轨道火箭，设计用于将重达 100 磅（45 公斤）的实验有效载荷发射到 75 英里（121 公里）左右的高度。

paras.en: "The Aerobee was designed to carry instruments aloft to collect data on the upper atmosphere and to place small animals in a weightless condition for physiological studies," the U.S. National Museum of the United States Air Force wrote in a mission overview. "It was launched by a solid-propellant booster engine of 18,000 pounds thrust that burned for only two and a half seconds."
paras.zh: 美国空军美国国家博物馆在任务概述中写道：“Aerobee 的设计目的是在高空携带仪器来收集高层大气的数据，并将小动物置于失重状态下进行生理研究。” “它是由推力为 18,000 磅的固体推进剂助推发动机发射的，燃烧时间仅为两秒半。”

paras.en: While the first Aerobee rocket did not reach space, many more made successful launches in the decades that followed.
paras.zh: 虽然第一枚 Aerobee 火箭没有进入太空，但在接下来的几十年里，更多的火箭成功发射。

paras.en: Engineers made a steady stream of upgrades to the the Aerobee rocket, allowing to fly higher and launch heavier payloads into space. It was an Aerobee rocket that launched two Phillipine monkeys on a mission to study how the effects of rapid launch acceleration might affect their bodies, an experiment that was among the frst human physiology tests that paved the way for human spaceflight.
paras.zh: 工程师们对 Aerobee 火箭进行了源源不断的升级，使其能够飞得更高，并向太空发射更重的有效载荷。这是一枚 Aerobee 火箭，发射了两只菲律宾猴子，其任务是研究快速发射加速对它们身体的影响，这项实验是最早的人类生理学测试之一，为人类太空飞行铺平了道路。

paras.en: More than 1,000 Aerobee rockets have launched since then, and the last one flew in January of 1985.
paras.zh: 此后，已经发射了 1,000 多枚 Aerobee 火箭，最后一枚火箭于 1985 年 1 月升空。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: SpaceX launches secretive spy satellites from California for US Space Force (video)
articles.author: Josh Dinner

paras.en: SpaceX launched another classified mission for the U.S. Space Force (USSF) today (Nov. 24), sending an unknown payload toward orbit from California.
paras.zh: 今天（11 月 24 日），SpaceX 为美国太空军 (USSF) 发射了另一项机密任务，从加利福尼亚州向轨道发射未知有效载荷。

paras.en: A Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from Vandenberg Space Force Base's Space Launch Complex-4E at TK11:08 a.m. ET (1508 GMT), carrying the U.S. Space Force's USSF-266 mission. It was the fourth mission SpaceX has launched for the military branch this month.
paras.zh: 美国东部时间上午 11 点 08 分（格林尼治标准时间 1508），一枚猎鹰 9 号火箭从范登堡太空部队基地的太空发射综合体 4E 升空，运载着美国太空部队的 USSF-266 任务。这是 SpaceX 本月为军事部门执行的第四次任务。

paras.en: While details about the mission's payload weren't disclosed, it's the fifth space launch in support of U.S. national security in the last two weeks, and comes amid efforts by the Space Force to expand its communications and tracking capabilities.
paras.zh: 虽然有关该任务有效载荷的详细信息尚未披露，但这是过去两周内支持美国国家安全的第五次太空发射，并且是在太空部队努力扩大其通信和跟踪能力的背景下进行的。

paras.en: About two and a half minutes after liftoff, Falcon 9's first-stage booster separated from the rocket's upper stage, which continued toward low Earth orbit with the classified payload. The booster, meanwhile, began a descent toward SpaceX's Of Course I Still Love You droneship in the Pacific Ocean, where it touched down approximately eight and a half minutes after launch.
paras.zh: 升空后大约两分半钟，猎鹰 9 号的第一级助推器与火箭的上级分离，火箭继续带着机密有效载荷飞向近地轨道。与此同时，助推器开始向 SpaceX 在太平洋上的“当然我仍然爱你”无人机降落，并在发射后大约八分半钟着陆。

paras.en: Tuesday's launch marked the 29th flight for this Falcon 9 booster, B1081, which previously launched NASA's Crew-7 astronaut mission to the International Space Station, the PACE and EarthCARE science satellites, two other classified Space Force launches (USSF-153 and USSF-481), and 16 Starlink missions.
paras.zh: 周二的发射标志着猎鹰 9 号助推器 B1081 的第 29 次飞行，此前该助推器曾发射过 NASA 前往国际空间站的 Crew-7 宇航员任务、PACE 和 EarthCARE 科学卫星、另外两次机密太空部队发射（USSF-153 和 USSF-481）以及 16 次星链任务。

paras.en: Previous classified Space Force launches have fueled speculation about the possible deployment of SpaceX's Starshield satellites, which are designed for national security applications. Starshield is an adapted spacecraft design developed from SpaceX's Starlink internet constellation that supports military operations with capabilities like Earth observation and secure communications. SpaceX has not confirmed whether USSF-266 is carrying Starshield spacecraft.
paras.zh: 此前太空部队的机密发射引发了人们对 SpaceX 星盾卫星可能部署的猜测，这些卫星是为国家安全应用而设计的。 Starshield 是一种改编自 SpaceX 的 Starlink 互联网星座的航天器设计，可通过地球观测和安全通信等功能支持军事行动。 SpaceX尚未确认USSF-266是否搭载了Starshield飞船。

paras.en: USSF-266 follows three other classified Space Force missions launched by SpaceX from Vandenberg earlier this month: USSF-432 on Nov. 6, USSF-627 on Nov. 11 and USSF-317 on Nov. 20, as well as a National Reconnaissance Office (NRO) launch, NROL-136, on Nov. 22. Those missions were also launched aboard Falcon 9 rockets, also with undisclosed payloads.
paras.zh: USSF-266 是在本月早些时候 SpaceX 从范登堡发射的另外三项机密太空军任务之后进行的：11 月 6 日的 USSF-432、11 月 11 日的 USSF-627 和 11 月 20 日的 USSF-317，以及 11 月 22 日国家侦察办公室 (NRO) 的发射 NROL-136。这些任务也是由猎鹰 9 号火箭发射的，发射的火箭也未公开。有效负载。

paras.en: Josh Dinner is Space.com's Spaceflight Staff Writer and a photographer with a passion for science and exploration. He has worked the space beat since 2016, covering the evolution of NASA's commercial spaceflight partnerships and crewed missions, planetary science missions, the Artemis program and humanity's return to the moon. He also enjoys building 1:144-scale model rockets and spacecraft. Find some of Josh's launch photography on Instagram, and follow him on X, where he mostly posts in haiku.
paras.zh: 乔什·丁纳 (Joshdinner) 是 Space.com 的 Spaceflight 特约撰稿人，也是一位热衷于科学和探索的摄影师。自 2016 年以来，他一直致力于太空领域的研究，报道了 NASA 商业航天合作伙伴关系和载人任务、行星科学任务、阿尔忒弥斯计划和人类重返月球的演变。他还喜欢建造 1:144 比例的火箭和航天器模型。在 Instagram 上查找 Josh 的一些首发照片，并在 X 上关注他，他主要在 X 上发布俳句。
