articles.title: All Points Logistics Announces Partnership with Expeditors for Space Prep Logistics Center at Kennedy Space Center
articles.author: All Points Logistics

paras.en: MERRITT ISLAND, FL, November 18, 2026 — All Points Logistics has announced a partnership with Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. (NYSE: EXPD) to serve as the exclusive logistics provider for its planned Space Prep Spaceport Logistics Center at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州梅里特岛，2026 年 11 月 18 日 — All Points Logistics 宣布与华盛顿 Expeditors International, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：EXPD）建立合作伙伴关系，为其计划中的位于佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心的太空准备航天港物流中心提供独家物流服务。

paras.en: Through this partnership, Expeditors will establish an on-site presence at the Space Prep facility, providing end-to-end mission logistics for government agencies and commercial space operators. Services for spacecraft, ground support equipment, and related mission materials will include aerospace warehousing, inventory control, transportation management, project cargo services, customs brokerage, supply chain visibility, and launch campaign support. The operation will serve space system operators and manufacturers working at Kennedy Space Center, Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, and other launch locations.
paras.zh: 通过此次合作，Expeditors 将在太空准备设施建立现场服务，为政府机构和商业太空运营商提供端到端的任务后勤服务。航天器、地面支持设备和相关任务材料的服务将包括航空航天仓储、库存控制、运输管理、项目货运服务、报关、供应链可视性和发射活动支持。该行动将为在肯尼迪航天中心、卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站和其他发射地点工作的航天系统运营商和制造商提供服务。

paras.en: “Companies in the space industry manage highly specialized equipment and materials across global supply chains,” said Ed Rone, Expeditors’ Regional Vice President of the U.S. Southeast. “This partnership puts our people and services closer to their launch operations, transforming logistics from a transportation function into a mission-readiness capability that helps ensure critical flight hardware, launch equipment, and operational assets are available at the right time. We look forward to working with All Points and applying our experience to the unique demands of this industry.”
paras.zh: Expeditors 美国东南部区域副总裁 Ed Rone 表示：“航天工业公司管理着全球供应链中高度专业化的设备和材料。” “这种伙伴关系使我们的人员和服务更接近他们的发射操作，将物流从运输功能转变为任务准备能力，有助于确保关键的飞行硬件、发射设备和运营资产在正确的时间可用。我们期待与 All Points 合作，并将我们的经验应用于该行业的独特需求。”

paras.en: As part of its Space Prep initiative, All Points plans to build a 266,000-square-foot Spaceport Logistics Center on its 65-acre site at Kennedy Space Center. Located within five miles of the launch pads, the facility is scheduled to open by the end of 2027. The site will also include an adjacent 260,000-square-foot Spacecraft Processing Center, bringing together launch-site logistics and specialized spacecraft processing capabilities.
paras.zh: 作为其太空准备计划的一部分，All Points 计划在肯尼迪航天中心 65 英亩的场地上建造一个 266,000 平方英尺的太空港物流中心。该设施距离发射台不到 5 英里，计划于 2027 年底开放。该设施还将包括一个毗邻的 260,000 平方英尺的航天器处理中心，汇集发射场物流和专业航天器处理能力。

paras.en: “Expeditors is an ideal partner for our Space Prep business,” said Phil Monkress, CEO of All Points Logistics. “Their global logistics expertise and specialized transportation capabilities align directly with the needs of our space industry customers, helping them move, stage, and manage mission-critical flight hardware more efficiently at major launch sites.”
paras.zh: “Expeditors 是我们 Space Prep 业务的理想合作伙伴，”All Points Logistics 首席执行官 Phil Monkress 表示。 “他们的全球物流专业知识和专业运输能力直接满足我们航天工业客户的需求，帮助他们在主要发射场更有效地移动、部署和管理关键任务飞行硬件。”

paras.en: Through this collaboration, Space Prep customers will also benefit from access to Expeditors’ broader global logistics network, connecting suppliers and manufacturing locations with launch operations. The Kennedy Space Center location will also position Expeditors to support existing customers, including hyperscalers, as they explore opportunities in space-based data centers and advanced computing infrastructure.
paras.zh: 通过此次合作，Space Prep 客户还将受益于 Expeditors 更广泛的全球物流网络，将供应商和制造地点与发射业务连接起来。肯尼迪航天中心的位置还将帮助 Expeditors 为现有客户（包括超大规模企业）提供支持，帮助他们探索天基数据中心和先进计算基础设施的机会。

paras.en: All Points developed Space Prep to help address the growing demand for spacecraft processing and launch-site logistics infrastructure. By combining specialized facilities, mission support services, and strategic partnerships, All Points is expanding its capabilities to support commercial and government space customers at America’s major launch sites.
paras.zh: All Points 开发了 Space Prep，以帮助满足对航天器处理和发射场物流基础设施不断增长的需求。通过结合专业设施、任务支持服务和战略合作伙伴关系，All Points 正在扩大其能力，为美国主要发射场的商业和政府太空客户提供支持。

paras.en: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. (NYSE: EXPD) is a leading S&P 500 global logistics company headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. Through a worldwide network of knowledgeable professionals across six continents and a globally connected technology platform, Expeditors tailors solutions to manage increasingly complex supply chains and international trade requirements. The asset-light company offers air, customs, ocean, order management, road, warehousing and distribution, and cargo insurance services to key industries worldwide. Guided by a culture of exceptional customer service, Expeditors aspires to be the most trusted and valued logistics company in the world. For more information, visit expeditors.com.
paras.zh: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc.（纽约证券交易所代码：EXPD）是一家领先的标准普尔 500 强全球物流公司，总部位于华盛顿州贝尔维尤。通过遍布六大洲的知识丰富的专业人士的全球网络和全球互联的技术平台，Expeditors 定制解决方案来管理日益复杂的供应链和国际贸易要求。这家轻资产公司为全球主要行业提供空运、海关、海运、订单管理、公路、仓储和配送以及货物保险服务。在卓越客户服务文化的指导下，Expeditors 立志成为全球最值得信赖和最有价值的物流公司。欲了解更多信息，请访问 expeditors.com。

paras.en: Space Prep, a business line of All Points Logistics, LLC, is developing multi-user spacecraft processing and logistics facilities at the nation’s busiest launch bases in Florida and California, giving commercial and government customers flexible access to cleanroom processing, fueling, storage, and mission support services. Learn more at SpacePrep.com.
paras.zh: Space Prep 是 All Points Logistics, LLC 的一个业务部门，正在美国佛罗里达州和加利福尼亚州最繁忙的发射基地开发多用户航天器处理和物流设施，为商业和政府客户提供灵活的洁净室处理、加油、存储和任务支持服务。请访问 SpacePrep.com 了解更多信息。

paras.en: Established in 1997 as a service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB), All Points Logistics has operations in multiple states and has grown into a leading solution provider to a diverse array of government and commercial customers, with award-winning expertise in software development, IT services, modeling and simulation, launch support services, and integrated logistics. Learn more at allpointsllc.com.
paras.zh: All Points Logistics 成立于 1997 年，是一家退伍军人拥有的小型企业 (SDVOSB)，在多个州开展业务，现已发展成为面向各类政府和商业客户的领先解决方案提供商，在软件开发、IT 服务、建模和模拟、启动支持服务和综合物流方面拥有屡​​获殊荣的专业知识。如需了解更多信息，请访问 allpointsllc.com。

articles.title: Simera Sense, Spacemanic, Zaitra and World from Space Join Forces on an End-to-End Dual-Use Mission Solution
articles.author: Spacemanic

paras.en: Bremen, 18 November 2026 – Simera Sense, Spacemanic, Zaitra and World from Space have signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Bremen to cooperate on a complete mission solution built around a dual-use camera. The agreement builds on the Memorandum of Understanding signed by Simera Sense and Spacemanic in Prague on 3 November 2026 and extends the cooperation with onboard data processing and imagery analytics.
paras.zh: 不来梅，2026 年 11 月 18 日 – Simera Sense、Spacemanic、Zaitra 和 World from Space 在不来梅签署了一份谅解备忘录，围绕两用相机构建完整的任务解决方案进行合作。该协议以 Simera Sense 和 Spacemanic 于 2026 年 11 月 3 日在布拉格签署的谅解备忘录为基础，扩展了与机载数据处理和图像分析方面的合作。

paras.en: The partners intend to offer customers a solution covering the whole chain:
paras.zh: 合作伙伴旨在为客户提供覆盖全链条的解决方案：

paras.en: - Simera Sense provides the xScape200 Dual-Use,a dual-use imaging payload delivering 1.5m resolution for defence and commercial applications.
paras.zh: - Simera Sense 提供 xScape200 Dual-Use，这是一种双用成像有效负载，可为国防和商业应用提供 1.5m 分辨率。

paras.en: - Spacemanic provides the satellite platform. Its CORVUS platform, developed under the ESA ARTES Pioneer programme and now deployed commercially in multiple missions, is tailored around the camera. The in-house SPACECANNON deployer attaches the satellite to the launch vehicle and releases it into its target orbit.
paras.zh: - Spacemanic 提供卫星平台。其 CORVUS 平台是根据 ESA ARTES Pioneer 计划开发的，现已在多个任务中进行商业部署，该平台是围绕相机量身定制的。内部的 SPACECANNON 部署者将卫星连接到运载火箭上，并将其释放到目标轨道。

paras.en: - Zaitra provides the SKAIDOCK onboard computer running SKAISEN onboard AI and SKAIPACK image compression. Imagery is analysed directly on board the satellite, so customers receive the information that matters with low latency, while the downlink data budget stays low.
paras.zh: - Zaitra 提供运行 SKAISEN 机载 AI 和 SKAIPACK 图像压缩的 SKAIDOCK 机载计算机。图像直接在卫星上进行分析，因此客户可以低延迟地接收重要信息，同时下行链路数据预算保持较低水平。

paras.en: - World from Space turns the imagery into insights for customers, including raw data calibration and quality assessment of the downlinked data. ORBIS platform deals with tasking, data consolidation and distribution.
paras.zh: - 太空世界将图像转化为客户的见解，包括原始数据校准和下行数据的质量评估。 ORBIS 平台负责任务分配、数据整合和分发。

paras.en: For customers, this means one coordinated offer from image acquisition to usable insight.
paras.zh: 对于客户而言，这意味着从图像采集到可用洞察的协调一致的服务。

paras.en: “Combining the xScape 200 Dual Use camera with a satellite tailored around it, onboard processing and analytics makes dual-use imaging easier for customers to adopt. We are glad to build on our cooperation with Spacemanic and to welcome Zaitra and World from Space.” – Emile Van Riel, Business Development Manager, Simera Sense.
paras.zh: “将 xScape 200 两用相机与围绕其量身定制的卫星相结合，机载处理和分析使客户更容易采用两用成像。我们很高兴与 Spacemanic 继续合作，并欢迎 Zaitra 和 World from Space。” – Simera Sense 业务开发经理 Emile Van Riel。

paras.en: “With CORVUS and our in-house SPACECANNON deployer, we can shape the whole satellite around the customer’s payload. With Zaitra’s onboard processing and World from Space’s insights, customers get a complete path from image to insight from one consortium.” – Juraj Dudáš, CEO, Spacemanic.
paras.zh: “借助 CORVUS 和我们内部的 SPACECANNON 部署器，我们可以围绕客户的有效载荷塑造整个卫星。借助 Zaitra 的机载处理和 World from Space 的见解，客户可以从一个联盟获得从图像到见解的完整路径。” – Juraj Dudáš，Spacemanic 首席执行官。

paras.en: “Zaitra was founded on a simple idea: a satellite should send down answers, not just pixels. This partnership puts that idea at the heart of a mission built around what customers actually need.” – Marek Marušin, CEO and co-founder, Zaitra.
paras.zh: “Zaitra 的成立基于一个简单的想法：卫星应该发送答案，而不仅仅是像素。这种合作伙伴关系将这一想法置于围绕客户实际需求而构建的任务的核心。” – Marek Marušin，Zaitra 首席执行官兼联合创始人。

paras.en: “Imagery creates value once it becomes insight. And Earth observation data doesn’t come ready. Together with Simera Sense, Spacemanic and Zaitra, we connect the satellite with users and deliver insights to customers.” – Roman Bohovic, CTO, World from Space.
paras.zh: “图像一旦成为洞察力，就会创造价值。而地球观测数据还没有准备好。我们与 Simera Sense、Spacemanic 和 Zaitra 一起，将卫星与用户连接起来，并向客户提供洞察力。” – Roman Bohovic，太空世界首席技术官。

paras.en: - Simera Sense is a leading European provider of optical payloads and image processing tools for space-based imaging. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Belgium, with offices in South Africa, France, and the United Kingdom.
paras.zh: - Simera Sense 是欧洲领先的天基成像光学有效载荷和图像处理工具供应商。成立于2018年，总部位于比利时，在南非、法国和英国设有办事处。

paras.en: - Spacemanic is a Czech vertical integrator of satellite missions, since 2019. It designs, manufactures, integrates and operates satellites with in-house subsystems, platforms and deployers, and also handles launch management and frequency licensing.
paras.zh: - Spacemanic 自 2019 年起是一家捷克卫星任务垂直集成商。它设计、制造、集成和运营带有内部子系统、平台和部署器的卫星，还负责发射管理和频率许可。

paras.en: - Zaitra, based in Brno, Czech Republic, develops onboard data processing for Earth observation satellites. Its SKAIDOCK onboard computer runs SKAISEN, AI inference software already operating in orbit, and SKAIPACK, onboard image compression, turning raw imagery into actionable information on board and reducing the volume of data that has to be downlinked.
paras.zh: - Zaitra 总部位于捷克共和国布尔诺，开发地球观测卫星的机载数据处理技术。其 SKAIDOCK 机载计算机运行 SKAISEN（已在轨道上运行的人工智能推理软件）和 SKAIPACK（机载图像压缩），将原始图像转化为机上可操作的信息，并减少必须下行传输的数据量。

paras.en: - World from Space, also based in Brno, Czech Republic, provides customers with insights derived from satellite imagery, including tasking and distribution. Company is expert in Earth observation data and deals with cal/val, quality assessment and interpretation.
paras.zh: - 同样位于捷克共和国布尔诺的 World from Space 为客户提供来自卫星图像的见解，包括任务分配和分配。公司是地球观测数据方面的专家，负责校准/验证、质量评估和解释。

paras.en: Media contact: Ota Michalek, Chief Strategy Officer at Spacemanic, ota.michalek@spacemanic.com
paras.zh: 媒体联系人：Ota Michalek，Spacemanic 首席战略官，ota.michalek@spacemanic.com

articles.title: Amateur Astronomer? Be a Kilonova Catcher!

paras.en: Neutron stars are the ultra-dense, city-sized leftovers of dead stars. When they collide, they can release a brief flash of light called a kilonova. These immensely powerful events forge much of the universe’s gold, platinum and other heavy elements. Since a kilonova fades within days, astronomers have to find it fast, and no single observatory can watch the whole sky. But if you have a telescope with a camera, or access to one, you can help find and follow these cosmic fireworks as a part of NASA’s Kilonova Catcher project!
paras.zh: 中子星是死亡恒星的超致密、城市大小的残余物。当它们碰撞时，它们会释放出短暂的闪光，称为千新星。这些极其强大的事件形成了宇宙中的大部分金、铂和其他重元素。由于千新星会在几天内消失，天文学家必须快速找到它，并且没有任何一个天文台可以观察到整个天空。但是，如果您有一台带摄像头的望远镜，或者可以使用一台望远镜，您可以帮助寻找并跟踪这些宇宙烟花，作为 NASA 千新星捕手项目的一部分！

paras.en: Kilonova Catcher connects amateur astronomers around the world into a rapid-response network. When gravitational wave detectors or space telescopes send out an alert, volunteers point their own telescopes at the sky to help find and track the fading light. The network also follows up on gamma-ray bursts, the most powerful explosions in the universe, and catches other short-lived cosmic events whenever the opportunity arises.
paras.zh: Kilonova Catcher 将世界各地的业余天文学家连接成一个快速响应网络。当引力波探测器或太空望远镜发出警报时，志愿者将自己的望远镜指向天空，以帮助寻找和跟踪逐渐减弱的光线。该网络还跟踪伽马射线暴（宇宙中最强大的爆炸），并在有机会时捕获其他短暂的宇宙事件。

paras.en: The Kilonova Catcher network has more than 150 registered members on several continents. Volunteers work side by side with professional astronomers and observatories. They have already contributed to more than 64 official reports shared through NASA’s General Coordinates Network, the system scientists use to share discoveries in real time. Volunteers’ observations have been credited for their contributions by being named authors in peer-reviewed scientific research papers. Kilonova Catcher volunteers also joined NASA’s lunar Impact Flash! project campaign during the Artemis II mission, recording the tiny flashes of light made when meteoroids strike the Moon. The network is getting ready to help follow up thousands of new alerts from NASA’s new Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope.
paras.zh: Kilonova Catcher 网络在几大洲拥有 150 多名注册会员。志愿者与专业天文学家和天文台并肩工作。他们已经为超过 64 份官方报告做出了贡献，通过 NASA 的通用坐标网络共享，该系统是科学家用来实时共享发现的系统。志愿者的观察结果因其贡献而受到认可，并被同行评审的科学研究论文命名为作者。千新星捕手志愿者也加入了美国宇航局的月球撞击闪光！阿耳忒弥斯二号任务期间的项目活动，记录流星体撞击月球时发出的微小闪光。该网络正准备帮助跟踪来自美国宇航局新南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜的数千个新警报。

paras.en: "Here at Kilonova Catcher, by chasing the light from gravitational-wave events, we’re seeing how a single collision reaches across the universe,” said Cristina Andrade, Kilonova Catcher head of operations at the Minnesota Institute for Astrophysics. “The observatories that make this possible will produce an unprecedented amount of data. We need more human minds, more people with their eyes on the sky and on the data, both literally and figuratively. And more importantly, we need more people to realize they are capable of great feats of science, regardless of their background."
paras.zh: 明尼苏达天体物理研究所基洛诺瓦捕手者号运营负责人克里斯蒂娜·安德拉德表示：“在基洛诺瓦捕手者号，通过追逐引力波事件发出的光，我们看到一次碰撞如何穿越宇宙。” “使这一切成为可能的天文台将产生前所未有的大量数据。我们需要更多的人的思想，更多的人关注天空和数据，无论是字面上还是比喻上的。更重要的是，我们需要更多的人认识到他们有能力实现伟大的科学壮举，无论他们的背景如何。”

paras.en: The Kilonova Catcher project is co-led by Andrade and Principal Investigator Dr. Damien Turpin, a researcher at the French Alternative Energies and Atomic Energy Commission (CEA). Damien said, “I am inspired by the expertise and drive of our amateur astronomers. They are always digging for more information and pushing the limits of their understanding. This science could not be done without their contributions.”
paras.zh: Kilonova Catcher项目由Andrade和首席研究员Damien Turpin博士共同领导，Damien Turpin博士是法国替代能源和原子能委员会(CEA)的研究员。达米安说：“我受到业余天文学家的专业知识和动力的启发。他们总是挖掘更多信息并突破他们的理解极限。没有他们的贡献，这项科学就不可能完成。”

paras.en: To register and become a Kilonova Catcher, visit https://kilonovacatcher.in2p3.fr/ or send an email to kilonovacatcher@gmail.com. Anyone who has access to a telescope with a camera can take part!
paras.zh: 要注册并成为 Kilonova Catcher，请访问 https://kilonovacatcher.in2p3.fr/ 或发送电子邮件至 kilonovacatcher@gmail.com。任何拥有带相机的望远镜的人都可以参加！

articles.title: Teams Lock in Mission Architecture for NASA’s SR-1 Freedom
articles.author: Heather Baeslack

paras.en: NASA completed a major review for Space Reactor-1 (SR-1) Freedom and locked in key elements of the spacecraft, which is targeted to launch in 2028 and demonstrate nuclear electric propulsion in deep space for the first time.
paras.zh: NASA 完成了对 Space Reactor-1 (SR-1) Freedom 的重大审查，并锁定了该航天器的关键部件，该航天器计划于 2028 年发射，并首次在深空展示核电推进。

paras.en: Experts from across the agency, the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), and industry met at NASA’s Glenn Research Center in Cleveland for a major SR-1 mission design review in October. Several key decisions were made, propelling the mission from an early concept toward a defined spacecraft design.
paras.zh: 10 月份，来自该机构、美国能源部 (DOE) 和业界的专家在 NASA 位于克利夫兰的格伦研究中心举行会议，对 SR-1 任务设计进行了重大审查。做出了几个关键决定，推动任务从早期概念转向明确的航天器设计。

paras.en: “SR-1 marks a pivotal step in how we travel through the solar system,” said Steve Sinacore, SR-1 Freedom program director. “This mission will be the first freight run on the railroad of the solar system, and the decisions we’re making now are laying the tracks for every nuclear-powered spacecraft that follows.”
paras.zh: “SR-1 标志着我们穿越太阳系的关键一步，”SR-1 自由项目主任 Steve Sinacore 说。 “这次任务将是太阳系铁路上的第一次货运，我们现在做出的决定正在为后续的每一个核动力航天器铺设轨道。”

paras.en: Planned for launch in late 2028, SR-1 will use both nuclear and solar power to deliver SkyFall, a capsule carrying three next-generation helicopters, to Mars. Once deployed, the helicopters will study Martian geology and climate history, explore new terrain, and search for signs of subsurface ice.
paras.zh: SR-1 计划于 2028 年底发射，将利用核能和太阳能将载有三架下一代直升机的太空舱 SkyFall 运送到火星。一旦部署，直升机将研究火星地​​质和气候历史，探索新地形，并寻找地下冰的迹象。

paras.en: As NASA prepares for more ambitious exploration missions, future spacecraft and surface operations will require significantly more power than current systems can provide, particularly in environments where sunlight is limited or unavailable. SR-1 will demonstrate how fission power can enable long-duration missions, pave the way for reliable surface power systems to support NASA’s future Moon Base, and enable exploration deeper into the solar system.
paras.zh: 随着美国宇航局为更雄心勃勃的探索任务做准备，未来的航天器和地面操作将需要比当前系统所能提供的更多的电力，特别是在阳光有限或不可用的环境中。 SR-1 将展示裂变能源如何实现长期任务，为可靠的表面电力系统支持 NASA 未来的月球基地铺平道路，并实现对太阳系更深入的探索。

paras.en: The SR-1 Freedom spacecraft design has evolved since NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman first introduced the concept in March at the agency’s Ignition event, where leadership shared plans to develop a fission-powered spacecraft in time for the next Mars launch window.
paras.zh: 自 NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 在 3 月份该机构的 Ignition 活动中首次提出这一概念以来，SR-1 Freedom 航天器的设计不断发展，领导层分享了为下一个火星发射窗口及时开发裂变动力航天器的计划。

paras.en: One significant change is to use a shorter boom than the one shown in early illustrations. The boom separates the reactor from the spacecraft’s main body, known as the Power and Propulsion Element. The shorter boom will reduce weight, simplify assembly, and help streamline the spacecraft’s design.
paras.zh: 一个重大变化是使用比早期插图中所示的更短的吊杆。吊杆将反应堆与航天器主体（称为动力和推进元件）分开。较短的吊杆将减轻重量，简化组装，并有助于简化航天器的设计。

paras.en: NASA and DOE experts also determined that improvements in shielding and spacecraft design will allow the reactor to operate closer to the rest of the spacecraft. This will simplify integration while maintaining the radiation protection needed for spacecraft electronics and the SkyFall payload.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局和美国能源部专家还确定，屏蔽和航天器设计的改进将使反应堆的运行距离航天器的其他部分更近。这将简化集成，同时保持航天器电子设备和 SkyFall 有效载荷所需的辐射防护。

paras.en: Teams are continuing to evaluate other key design features, including the number of radiator panels on SR-1, output power levels of its nuclear power module, and how long its reactor will operate. These decisions will help shape the final spacecraft design and ensure it meets mission objectives.
paras.zh: 团队正在继续评估其他关键设计特征，包括 SR-1 上散热器面板的数量、核动力模块的输出功率水平以及反应堆的运行时间。这些决定将有助于形成最终的航天器设计并确保其满足任务目标。

paras.en: In addition, the team is modifying the spacecraft’s Power and Propulsion Element by updating its communications system for the journey to Mars. SR-1 Freedom will use larger X-band antenna dishes to send data across deep space back to Earth. Further maturation of the spacecraft plans will focus on reducing risk, simplifying the design, and staying on schedule.
paras.zh: 此外，该团队正在通过更新其火星之旅的通信系统来修改航天器的动力和推进元件。 SR-1 Freedom 将使用更大的 X 波段天线盘将数据穿越深空发送回地球。航天器计划的进一步成熟将侧重于降低风险、简化设计和按计划进行。

paras.en: NASA awarded a $39.3 million contract to Johns Hopkins University’s Applied Physics Laboratory to develop the heat rejection system for the spacecraft’s nuclear power module. The system will remove excess heat generated by the spacecraft’s nuclear power system, allowing it to operate safely and efficiently. The lab is working with the company Advanced Cooling Technologies as a key strategic commercial partner for providing the critical heat pipe and composite radiator technologies that will enable the system to meet the demanding mission requirements.
paras.zh: NASA 向约翰·霍普金斯大学应用物理实验室授予价值 3930 万美元的合同，为航天器的核动力模块开发排热系统。该系统将消除航天器核动力系统产生的多余热量，使其能够安全高效地运行。该实验室正与作为关键战略商业合作伙伴的先进冷却技术公司合作，提供关键的热管和复合散热器技术，使系统能够满足苛刻的任务要求。

paras.en: Awarded under the Aerospace Research, Development, and Engineering Support II contract, the contract action ensures the Applied Physics Laboratory team will design, build, test, and evaluate the system, along with producing the hardware needed for flight. The heat rejection system is a key part of demonstrating nuclear electric propulsion in space and will help lay the groundwork and industrial production foundation for future high-power nuclear systems used in deep space exploration.
paras.zh: 根据航空航天研究、开发和工程支持 II 合同授予，该合同行动确保应用物理实验室团队将设计、建造、测试和评估系统，以及生产飞行所需的硬件。该排热系统是在太空演示核电推进的关键部分，将为未来用于深空探测的高功率核系统奠定基础和工业生产基础。

paras.en: Along with the spacecraft design, teams have defined the mission timeline and planned operations.
paras.zh: 除了航天器设计外，团队还确定了任务时间表和计划操作。

paras.en: After launch and once the spacecraft has left Earth orbit, SR-1 Freedom will activate and gradually increase reactor power. The reactor system will operate for an initial period of time before shutting down. During this period, the spacecraft will collect and send performance data back to Earth. Solar arrays will then provide power as it cruises to Mars.
paras.zh: 发射后，一旦航天器离开地球轨道，SR-1 Freedom 将启动并逐渐增加反应堆功率。反应堆系统将在关闭前运行一段初始时间。在此期间，航天器将收集性能数据并将其发送回地球。然后太阳能电池板将在它巡航到火星时提供电力。

paras.en: After delivering SkyFall to Martian orbit, SR-1 Freedom will restart its fission reactor, collecting additional data on the spacecraft’s performance in deep space.
paras.zh: 将 SkyFall 送入火星轨道后，SR-1 Freedom 将重新启动其裂变反应堆，收集有关航天器在深空性能的更多数据。

paras.en: “By refining the design and advancing this architecture, we’re not just building a spacecraft, we’re establishing the foundation for a new era of reliable, efficient transport beyond Earth orbit,” Sinacore said. “What we learn from SR-1 Freedom will shape the future of exploration for decades to come.”
paras.zh: Sinacore 表示：“通过改进设计和推进这种架构，我们不仅仅是在建造一艘航天器，我们还在为地球轨道外可靠、高效运输的新时代奠定基础。” “我们从 SR-1 Freedom 中学到的东西将塑造未来几十年探索的未来。”

paras.en: With key design decisions advancing and teams across NASA, DOE, and industry working together, SR-1 Freedom is moving toward its 2028 launch goal. The mission will demonstrate new capabilities for nuclear-powered transportation and help establish the foundation for future exploration beyond Earth.
paras.zh: 随着关键设计决策的推进以及 NASA、DOE 和行业团队的共同努力，SR-1 Freedom 正在朝着 2028 年的发射目标迈进。该任务将展示核动力运输的新能力，并帮助为未来地球以外的探索奠定基础。

paras.en: To learn more about NASA’s efforts in nuclear power in space, visit:
paras.zh: 要了解有关 NASA 在太空核能方面所做努力的更多信息，请访问：

articles.title: NASA+ Content Coming to Big Screen at Greenbelt, Maryland Cinema
articles.author: Gerelle Q. Dodson

paras.en: NASA announced Monday that NASA+ content has found its first theatrical home at The Greenbelt Cinema in Greenbelt, Maryland, expanding the agency’s reach across major viewing platforms and bringing space even closer to home.
paras.zh: NASA 周一宣布，NASA+ 内容已在马里兰州格林贝尔特的 Greenbelt 电影院找到了第一个影院，从而扩大了该机构在主要观看平台上的影响力，让太空离家更近了。

paras.en: “The National Aeronautics and Space Act of 1958 calls us to share our story of space exploration with the broadest possible audience, and our partners help us accomplish that,” said Rebecca Sirmons, general manager of NASA+ at the agency’s Headquarters in Washington. “Artemis II captured the imagination of the Artemis generation, but we are just getting started. With Artemis III on the horizon and our sights set on building humanity’s first Moon Base, this is only the beginning of our story being told, and we’ll continue sharing transparent, engaging content every step of the way.”
paras.zh: “1958 年的《国家航空航天法案》要求我们与最广泛的受众分享我们的太空探索故事，我们的合作伙伴帮助我们实现这一目标，”华盛顿总部 NASA+ 总经理丽贝卡·西尔蒙斯 (Rebecca Sirmons) 说道。 “阿尔忒弥斯 II 激发了阿尔忒弥斯一代的想象力，但我们才刚刚开始。随着阿尔忒弥斯 III 的出现，我们的目标是建造人类第一个月球基地，这只是我们故事的开始，我们将继续在每一步分享透明、引人入胜的内容。”

paras.en: NASA and The Greenbelt Cinema will kick off their partnership with screenings of the NASA+ original documentary “The Europa Concept,” which follows NASA’s journey to investigate the science driving future exploration of Europa, Jupiter’s icy moon. Dates for screenings will be announced soon on NASA.gov.
paras.zh: NASA 和 Greenbelt Cinema 将通过放映 NASA+ 原创纪录片《欧罗巴概念》拉开合作序幕，该纪录片讲述了 NASA 探索科学推动木星冰冷卫星欧罗巴未来探索的旅程。放映日期将很快在 NASA.gov 上公布。

paras.en: Future programming may include other NASA+ original content, in-person live streaming events of NASA’s Artemis missions, including the first crewed mission to the Moon under the Artemis program, additional Europa content, and more. NASA+ also will remain available for free, with no ads, through the NASA app and on the agency’s website.
paras.zh: 未来的节目可能包括其他 NASA+ 原创内容、NASA 阿尔忒弥斯任务的现场直播活动，包括阿尔忒弥斯计划下的首次载人登月任务、额外的欧罗巴内容等等。 NASA+ 也将继续通过 NASA 应用程序和该机构的网站免费提供，无广告。

paras.en: Earlier this year during its Ignition event, NASA outlined a bold path forward for the agency, including increasing the cadence of Artemis missions to the lunar surface, and building the first Moon Base, among other agency priorities. Partnerships like this one help NASA maximize engagement with communities around the world by making the agency’s missions and educational content available to viewers on their preferred devices and channels.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，在“点火”活动期间，美国宇航局概述了该机构的大胆前进道路，包括增加阿耳忒弥斯月球表面任务的节奏、建造第一个月球基地以及该机构的其他优先事项。像这样的合作伙伴关系通过向观众在他们喜欢的设备和频道上提供该机构的任务和教育内容，帮助美国宇航局最大限度地与世界各地的社区互动。

paras.en: For more information about NASA missions, visit:
paras.zh: 有关 NASA 任务的更多信息，请访问：

articles.title: ‘Far too much failure’: UN deputy chief’s final call to end violence against women

paras.en: ‘Far too much failure’: UN deputy chief’s final call to end violence against women
paras.zh: “失败太多”：联合国副秘书长最后呼吁结束暴力侵害妇女行为

paras.en: UN Deputy Secretary-General Amina Mohammed warned on Tuesday that another woman or girl would be killed by a partner or family member before she finished speaking, as she called for justice for survivors and consequences for perpetrators.
paras.zh: 联合国副秘书长阿米娜·穆罕默德周二警告说，在她讲话之前，另一名妇女或女孩将被伴侣或家庭成员杀害，她呼吁为幸存者伸张正义，并为肇事者承担后果。

paras.en: “Have we made progress? Yes. But we also have tolerated far too much failure,” said Ms. Mohammed, who was marking the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women for the last time as Deputy Secretary-General.
paras.zh: “我们取得了进展吗？是的。但我们也容忍了太多的失败，”穆罕默德女士说。她最后一次以常务副秘书长的身份庆祝消除对妇女的暴力行为国际日。

paras.en: The event on the eve of the official launch of 16 Days of Activism against Gender-Based Violence, heard calls for justice systems that work for survivors, accountability from technology companies and funding for women’s rights organizations.
paras.zh: 在“反对性别暴力 16 天行动”正式启动前夕举行的活动中，人们呼吁司法系统为幸存者服务，科技公司承担责任，并为妇女权利组织提供资金。

paras.en: On display at the event were 129 orange flags, one for each woman and girl killed daily by an intimate partner or family member, according to new UN data released on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 根据联合国周二发布的新数据，活动中展示了 129 面橙色旗帜，每面代表每天被亲密伴侣或家庭成员杀害的妇女和女孩一面。

paras.en: Earlier this year, at the 70th session of the Commission on the Status of Women, Member States agreed on steps to strengthen access to justice – from repealing discriminatory laws to investigating and prosecuting violence, including online – Ms. Mohammed said.
paras.zh: 穆罕默德女士说，今年早些时候，在妇女地位委员会第 70 届会议上，会员国商定了加强诉诸司法的机会的措施，从废除歧视性法律到调查和起诉暴力，包括网络暴力。

paras.en: “We must now deliver on those commitments so that women can rebuild their lives in safety and dignity,” she continued, adding that governments, the UN and technology companies all share that responsibility – the latter in “answering for the violence on their platforms”.
paras.zh: “我们现在必须兑现这些承诺，以便妇女能够安全和有尊严地重建生活，”她继续说道，并补充说，各国政府、联合国和科技公司都共同承担这一责任——后者“对其平台上的暴力行为做出回应”。

paras.en: Through the Spotlight Initiative – a partnership between the UN and the European Union to eliminate all forms of violence against women by 2030 – conviction rates for gender-based violence have doubled across 13 countries, she said. Yet more than a third of women’s rights organizations surveyed have had to suspend or close programmes because of funding cuts.
paras.zh: 她说，通过聚光灯倡议（联合国和欧盟之间的一项合作伙伴关系，旨在到 2030 年消除针对妇女的一切形式的暴力行为），13 个国家的性别暴力定罪率翻了一番。然而，超过三分之一的受访女权组织因资金削减而不得不暂停或关闭项目。

paras.en: She also called on men to challenge the attitudes and social norms that allow violence to continue. “You have influence in ways that others do not. Use it,” she said.
paras.zh: 她还呼吁男性挑战允许暴力继续存在的态度和社会规范。 “你的影响力是其他人所没有的。利用它，”她说。

paras.en: “This violence is not random. It is not a private matter,” General Assembly President Khalilur Rahman said in a video message.
paras.zh: “这种暴力行为不是随机的。这不是私人问题，”大会主席哈利勒·拉赫曼在视频致辞中说。

paras.en: He set out three priorities for Member States:
paras.zh: 他为会员国提出了三个优先事项：

paras.en: - Making technology “serve justice, not shield abuse”;
paras.zh: - 让技术“服务正义，而不是庇护虐待”；

paras.en: Governments must ensure the law protects women and girls online as well as offline, and technology companies must make it easy to report abuse, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，各国政府必须确保法律在线上和线下都保护妇女和女孩，科技公司必须让举报虐待行为变得容易。

paras.en: “Laws matter. Enforcement is the real test.”
paras.zh: “法律很重要。执法才是真正的考验。”

paras.en: UN Women Executive Director Sima Bahous warned in her own video message that digital technologies and artificial intelligence (AI) are “enabling abuse faster than laws and justice systems can respond”.
paras.zh: 联合国妇女署执行主任西玛·巴胡斯在她自己的视频信息中警告说，数字技术和人工智能（AI）“导致虐待的速度快于法律和司法系统的反应速度”。

paras.en: Only one in five countries provides legal aid, she said, and 89 per cent of women’s rights organisations report reduced access to services because of cuts.
paras.zh: 她说，只有五分之一的国家提供法律援助，89% 的妇女权利组织报告称，由于削减，获得服务的机会减少了。

paras.en: Solutions are working, she added: the number of countries with domestic violence legislation rose from 12 in 1995 to 104 in 2025.
paras.zh: 她补充说，解决方案正在发挥作用：制定家庭暴力立法的国家数量从 1995 年的 12 个增加到 2025 年的 104 个。

paras.en: In a panel discussion, French advocate David Pelicot, who works to engage men in ending violence against women, said justice fails “when a woman doesn’t dare to speak out because she fears that she won’t be believed”.
paras.zh: 在一次小组讨论中，致力于让男性参与制止暴力侵害女性行为的法国倡导者戴维·佩利科特 (David Pelicot) 表示，“当女性因为担心自己不被相信而不敢发声时”，正义就会失败。

paras.en: His mother, Gisèle Pelicot, waived her right to anonymity in 2024 as the survivor in a multiple rape case in which her former husband and 49 co-defendants were convicted.
paras.zh: 2024 年，他的母亲吉赛尔·佩利科 (Gisèle Pelicot) 作为多起强奸案的幸存者放弃了匿名权，她的前夫和 49 名同案被告均被定罪。

paras.en: “Justice starts when we believe in women,” he said.
paras.zh: “当我们相信女性时，正义就开始了，”他说。

articles.title: Decades of gains against AIDS could unravel as HIV funding dries up

paras.en: Decades of gains against AIDS could unravel as HIV funding dries up
paras.zh: 随着艾滋病毒资金枯竭，几十年来防治艾滋病的成果可能会化为泡影

paras.en: Decades of progress against AIDS, one of the greatest public health achievements in history, could go into reverse as international HIV funding is cut and campaigns against human rights and gender equality gain ground, the UN agency devoted to ending the pandemic warned Tuesday in a new report.
paras.zh: 致力于结束这一流行病的联合国机构周二在一份新报告中警告说，随着国际艾滋病毒资助的削减以及反对人权和性别平等的运动取得进展，数十年来防治艾滋病的进展可能会出现逆转，这是历史上最伟大的公共卫生成就之一。

paras.en: HIV, the virus that attacks the immune system and causes AIDS, was once a death sentence. Life-saving medicines have turned it into a manageable health condition, allowing millions of people to live with it.
paras.zh: 艾滋病毒（HIV）是一种攻击免疫系统并导致艾滋病的病毒，曾经被判处死刑。救命药物已将其转变为可控制的健康状况，使数百万人能够忍受这种疾病。

paras.en: Some 32.1 million of the 40 million people living with HIV are now on treatment, but there is currently a $4.3 billion funding gap in low and middle-income countries between available resources and what is needed to keep up these strong results.
paras.zh: 4000 万艾滋病毒感染者中约有 3210 万人正在接受治疗，但低收入和中等收入国家目前在可用资源与保持这些强劲成果所需资源之间存在 43 亿美元的资金缺口。

paras.en: A twice-yearly injection, lenacapavir (PrEP), and other innovative medicines are now available to prevent HIV acquisition, but these programmes have been particularly hard hit by cuts.
paras.zh: 现在可以使用每年两次的注射剂来那卡韦 (PrEP) 和其他创新药物来预防艾滋病毒感染，但这些项目因削减而受到的打击尤其严重。

paras.en: In 2025, around 446,000 fewer people got access to PrEP compared to the previous year, the UNAIDS found across reporting countries.
paras.zh: 联合国艾滋病规划署发现，与上一年相比，2025 年获得 PrEP 的人数减少了约 446,000 人。

paras.en: Among key populations, PrEP use declined by 59 per cent among sex workers, 58 per cent among people who inject drugs, 23 per cent among transgender people and 17 per cent among gay men and other men who have sex with men.
paras.zh: 在重点人群中，性工作者的 PrEP 使用率下降了 59%，注射吸毒者下降了 58%，跨性别者下降了 23%，男同性恋者和其他男男性行为者下降了 17%。

paras.en: Other prevention programmes also suffered: global condom distribution fell from three billion to 2.7 billion between 2024 and 2025, while voluntary medical male circumcision procedures dropped by 53 per cent across priority countries over the same period.
paras.zh: 其他预防计划也受到影响：2024 年至 2025 年间，全球安全套分发量从 30 亿个减少到 27 亿个，而同期重点国家的自愿医疗男性包皮环切手术减少了 53%。

paras.en: “We know what happens when HIV prevention collapses. People become infected, treatment needs rise, costs soar and lives are lost,” said Winnie Byanyima, Executive Director of UNAIDS.
paras.zh: 联合国艾滋病规划署执行主任温妮·拜安伊玛 (Winnie Byanyima) 表示：“我们知道，当艾滋病毒预防工作失败时，会发生什么。人们被感染，治疗需求增加，费用飙升，甚至失去生命。”

paras.en: “Every clinic that closes, every outreach worker who loses their job and every young woman turned away from prevention services today risks becoming a new HIV infection tomorrow,” she stressed.
paras.zh: 她强调说：“今天每一个关闭的诊所、每一个失业的外展工作人员以及每一个拒绝预防服务的年轻女性，明天都有可能成为新的艾滋病毒感染者。”

paras.en: Although civil society organisations are increasingly recognised as vital to the fight against AIDS, significant amounts of their funding have been withdrawn in the past two years and many have had to halt or cut back their HIV work as a consequence.
paras.zh: 尽管人们越来越认识到民间社会组织对于抗击艾滋病至关重要，但在过去两年中，它们的大量资金被撤回，许多组织因此不得不停止或削减艾滋病毒工作。

paras.en: "Community organizations are not an optional extra. They are often the only trusted bridge between health systems and the people most at risk of HIV," Ms. Byanyima explained.
paras.zh: “社区组织不是一个可选的额外项目。它们往往是卫生系统和艾滋病毒高危人群之间唯一值得信赖的桥梁，”Byanyima 女士解释道。

paras.en: One study found that more than three-quarters of civil society organizations surveyed reported service disruptions, and over 80 per cent of them were operating at less than half their capacity by the end of 2025.
paras.zh: 一项研究发现，超过四分之三的受访民间社会组织报告称服务中断，到 2025 年底，其中超过 80% 的运营能力不足一半。

paras.en: In many affected countries, debt obligations now exceed government health spending by two- or even three-fold, making it very difficult for them to absorb international funding losses.
paras.zh: 在许多受影响国家，债务义务现在超过政府卫生支出的两倍甚至三倍，使它们很难吸收国际资金损失。

paras.en: For instance, external resources account for up to 98 per cent of all HIV resources in Nigeria, 94 per cent in Mozambique and 80 per cent in Uganda.
paras.zh: 例如，外部资源占尼日利亚所有艾滋病毒资源的 98%，莫桑比克占 94%，乌干达占 80%。

paras.en: International donors also finance all reported prevention spending in Eritrea and Zambia, according to UNAIDS.
paras.zh: 据联合国艾滋病规划署称，国际捐助者还为厄立特里亚和赞比亚报告的所有预防支出提供资金。

paras.en: The worst effects of the 2025 funding cuts may still be ahead, the agency warned.
paras.zh: 该机构警告说，2025 年资金削减的最严重影响可能仍在后面。

paras.en: While existing treatment programmes continue to offer protection in the short term, disruptions to HIV prevention, testing and treatment services are expected to drive up new infections, AIDS-related illness and deaths.
paras.zh: 虽然现有的治疗计划在短期内继续提供保护，但艾滋病毒预防、检测和治疗服务的中断预计将增加新的感染、艾滋病相关疾病和死亡。

paras.en: Still, the warning signs are already visible: fewer people are being tested for HIV or receiving initial treatment, laboratory services are weakening, and community support systems that help people remain in care are being dismantled.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，警告信号已经显而易见：接受艾滋病毒检测或接受初步治疗的人越来越少，实验室服务正在减弱，帮助人们继续接受护理的社区支持系统正在被拆除。

paras.en: Funding cuts are heavily impacting efforts to detect and treat advanced HIV disease (AHD), which killed about one in eight of the 3.4 million people affected worldwide within a year, in 2025.
paras.zh: 资金削减将严重影响晚期艾滋病毒 (AHD) 的检测和治疗工作，到 2025 年，全球 340 万人中约有八分之一会死于这种疾病。

paras.en: Testing for advanced cases fell by 35 per cent across six countries between 2024 and 2025, and these disruptions make it increasingly difficult to detect treatment failure, diagnose advanced disease and provide timely, lifesaving care.
paras.zh: 2024 年至 2025 年间，六个国家的晚期病例检测量下降了 35%，这些干扰使得发现治疗失败、诊断晚期疾病和提供及时的救生护理变得越来越困难。

paras.en: UNAIDS stressed that the world can still reach the goal of ending AIDS as a public health threat by 2030, set in 2015 as part of the Sustainable Development Goals.
paras.zh: 联合国艾滋病规划署强调，世界仍然可以实现到 2030 年消除艾滋病这一公共卫生威胁的目标，该目标是 2015 年制定的可持续发展目标的一部分。

paras.en: This would prevent 3.2 million new HIV infections and avert 1.3 million AIDS-related deaths by the end of the decade.
paras.zh: 到本十年末，这将防止 320 万人新感染艾滋病毒，并避免 130 万人与艾滋病相关的死亡。

paras.en: This requires making HIV a national priority, integrating services into inclusive, rights-based health systems, and advancing reforms that end stigma, discrimination and exclusion, the UN agency stressed.
paras.zh: 该联合国机构强调，这需要将艾滋病毒作为国家优先事项，将服务纳入包容性、基于权利的卫生系统，并推进结束耻辱、歧视和排斥的改革。

articles.title: World News in Brief: Vaccine crisis in Yemen, aid for Ukraine, another UNRWA staffer killed

paras.en: World News in Brief: Vaccine crisis in Yemen, aid for Ukraine, another UNRWA staffer killed
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：也门的疫苗危机、对乌克兰的援助、近东救济工程处另一名工作人员遇害

paras.en: More than 364,000 people have been displaced in Yemen since the beginning of August as fighting and insecurity continue, the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) said on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 联合国人道主义事务协调办公室 (OCHA) 周二表示，自 8 月初以来，由于战斗和不安全局势持续，也门已有超过 364,000 人流离失所。

paras.en: In encircled Taiz, some 350,000 children missed the national measles and rubella vaccination campaign because shots could not be delivered safely, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric told reporters in New York.
paras.zh: 联合国发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克 (Stéphane Dujarric) 在纽约告诉记者，在被包围的塔伊兹，约 35 万名儿童因无法安全注射疫苗而错过了全国麻疹和风疹疫苗接种活动。

paras.en: More than 30,000 babies under the age of one also risk missing routine immunization.
paras.zh: 超过 30,000 名一岁以下婴儿也面临错过常规免疫接种的风险。

paras.en: “Our colleagues at WHO and UNICEF have the resources and vaccines needed, but they cannot currently reach children that they need to reach in Taiz,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们在世卫组织和联合国儿童基金会的同事拥有所需的资源和疫苗，但他们目前无法接触到塔伊兹所需的儿童。”

paras.en: Since August, more than 25 humanitarian partners have provided health assistance to over 100,000 displaced people. Emergency food, hygiene supplies and other relief have reached more than 300,000.
paras.zh: 自 8 月以来，超过 25 个人道主义合作伙伴已向超过 10 万流离失所者提供了卫生援助。紧急食品、卫生用品等救援物资已达30万余件。

paras.en: The UN renewed its call for civilians to be protected and for safe, unhindered humanitarian access.
paras.zh: 联合国再次呼吁保护平民并确保安全、不受阻碍的人道主义援助准入。

paras.en: Ukraine: Aid convoy reaches frontline Kherson community
paras.zh: 乌克兰：援助车队抵达赫尔松前线社区

paras.en: An interagency convoy facilitated by OCHA delivered food, hygiene items, medicines and warm clothing on Tuesday to a frontline community in Kherson where 600 people remain.
paras.zh: 周二，由人道协调厅 (OCHA) 协助的跨部门车队向赫尔松的一个前线社区运送了食品、卫生用品、药品和保暖衣物，那里仍有 600 人。

paras.en: The community has had severe power disruptions for nearly a year, and hostilities and mine contamination restrict both aid access and civilian movement.
paras.zh: 近一年来，该社区遭受了严重的电力中断，敌对行动和地雷污染限制了援助的准入和平民的行动。

paras.en: Attacks continue to kill and injure civilians across the country, Mr. Dujarric told reporters in New York.
paras.zh: 杜雅里克在纽约对记者表示，全国各地的袭击事件继续造成平民伤亡。

paras.en: Over the past day, at least seven civilians were killed and nearly 80 injured, according to the authorities. Zaporizhzhia region was hardest hit.
paras.zh: 据当局称，过去一天，至少 7 名平民死亡，近 80 人受伤。扎波罗热地区受灾最严重。

paras.en: On Monday in Kramatorsk, in Donetsk region, a drone reportedly struck a humanitarian evacuation vehicle run by a local NGO. Two civilians were killed and two others injured, including the driver.
paras.zh: 据报道，周一在顿涅茨克地区的克拉马托尔斯克，一架无人机袭击了当地非政府组织运营的一辆人道主义疏散车。两名平民死亡，另外两人受伤，其中包括司机。

paras.en: In Odesa, some 80,000 households and businesses are without heating. More than 460 warming centres are open.
paras.zh: 在敖德萨，大约 80,000 个家庭和企业没有暖气。超过 460 个取暖中心开放。

paras.en: Gaza: UNRWA staff member killed near water well
paras.zh: 加沙：近东救济工程处工作人员在水井附近被杀

paras.en: A staff member of the UN agency for Palestine refugees (UNRWA) was killed and three others were injured in Gaza on Monday after an Israeli strike near a water well in Jabalya, the agency said.
paras.zh: 联合国巴勒斯坦难民机构（近东救济工程处）表示，以色列周一在贾巴利亚一处水井附近发动袭击，导致该机构一名工作人员死亡，另外三人受伤。

paras.en: The staff were at the well carrying out their regular duties, Mr. Dujarric told reporters at Tuesday's briefing.
paras.zh: 杜雅里克在周二的新闻发布会上告诉记者，工作人员正在油井执行日常职责。

paras.en: “We of course condemn the killing and injuring of our UNRWA colleagues,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们当然谴责近东救济工程处同事被杀和受伤的行为，”他说。

paras.en: The incident brings the number of UNRWA personnel killed since October 2023 to 397. In that time, 600 aid workers have been killed across Gaza.
paras.zh: 此次事件使自 2023 年 10 月以来近东救济工程处遇害人数达到 397 人。同期，加沙各地已有 600 名援助人员遇害。

paras.en: Over the past week, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) brought in trucks of school chairs and desks for temporary learning centres.
paras.zh: 过去一周，联合国儿童基金会（儿童基金会）为临时学习中心运来了装有学校椅子和课桌的卡车。

paras.en: The UN has also pressed the Israeli authorities to let in a wider range of critical supplies, including heavy machinery, engine oil and spare parts for vehicles and generators.
paras.zh: 联合国还敦促以色列当局允许更广泛的关键物资进入，包括重型机械、发动机油以及车辆和发电机的备件。

articles.title: Poch fumes at Yoro red and thinks Szoboszlai goal shouldn't have stood

paras.en: Mauricio Pochettino: Man Utd boss fumes at VAR in Liverpool loss over Leny Yoro and Dominik Szoboszlai calls
paras.zh: 毛里西奥·波切蒂诺：曼联主帅对利物浦输给莱尼·约罗和多米尼克·索博斯莱的VAR感到愤怒

paras.en: Man Utd to contact ProRef and the Premier League over 'totally wrong' interpretation of Leny Yoro's red card in loss at Liverpool after call was overturned; Man Utd boss Mauricio Pochettino: "What were VAR doing?"; Poch also believes Dominik Szoboszlai’s opener should not have stood
paras.zh: 曼联将联系ProRef和英超联赛，因为在电话被推翻后，莱尼·约罗在输给利物浦的比赛中红牌的解释“完全错误”；曼联主帅毛里西奥·波切蒂诺：“VAR 做了什么？”；波赫还认为多米尼克·索博斯莱的揭幕战不应该成立

paras.en: Mauricio Pochettino has heavily criticised VAR in Manchester United's loss at Liverpool after Leny Yoro's red card was overturned, while the Argentine believes Dominik Szoboszlai’s opener should not have stood.
paras.zh: 在曼联输给利物浦的比赛中，莱尼·约罗的红牌被撤销，毛里西奥·波切蒂诺对此严厉批评了VAR。这位阿根廷人认为，多米尼克·索博斯洛伊的开场进球不应被判有效。

paras.en: Yoro's one-match suspension for the red card he was shown in the 4-0 defeat at Anfield has been removed, despite referees' chief Howard Webb supporting the decision to send him off.
paras.zh: 尽管裁判长霍华德·韦伯支持将约罗罚下场的决定，但在安菲尔德 4-0 惨败的比赛中，约罗因吃到红牌而停赛一场的决定已被取消。

paras.en: Man Utd will contact ProRef and the Premier League directly over what they believe to be a 'totally wrong' interpretation of Yoro's red card against Liverpool.
paras.zh: 曼联将直接联系 ProRef 和英超联赛，因为他们认为对约罗对阵利物浦的红牌的解释是“完全错误的”。

paras.en: - Man Utd to contact PL and refs over 'totally wrong' Yoro red card
paras.zh: - 曼联就“完全错误的”Yoro红牌联系PL和裁判

paras.zh: - 曼联新闻和转会🔴 |曼联赛程及比分

paras.zh: - 有天空吗？在手机上观看英超联赛直播📱

paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播📺

paras.en: It is the second time this season VAR has wrongly gone against Man Utd after ProRef admitted an error in awarding Manchester City's winner in their 1-0 victory at Old Trafford in September.
paras.zh: 这是本赛季第二次 VAR 错误地对待曼联，此前 ProRef 承认在 9 月份曼城 1-0 战胜老特拉福德的比赛中判定获胜者时存在错误。

paras.en: United received an apology over the incorrect VAR decision to award Erling Haaland's winner, which was initially ruled offside before VAR overturned the decision.
paras.zh: 曼联因 VAR 判定哈兰德制胜球的错误决定而道歉，该决定最初被裁定越位，随后 VAR 推翻了这一决定。

paras.en: Pochettino mentioned the Haaland call in a passionate outburst over VAR as he questioned why the VAR did not intervene to overturn the on-field decision.
paras.zh: 波切蒂诺在质疑VAR为何不介入并推翻场上决定时，提到了哈兰德对VAR的激烈争论。

paras.en: Speaking at a press conference ahead of his team's Champions League match against Sporting in Lisbon on Wednesday, Pochettino said: "Very disappointed because I think this type of thing never can happen.
paras.zh: 周三，波切蒂诺在球队在里斯本对阵里斯本竞技队的欧冠比赛前的新闻发布会上表示：“非常失望，因为我认为这种事情永远不会发生。

paras.en: "My question was always the same - we can accept the referee can make a mistake because of the emotional relationship with the game.
paras.zh: “我的问题始终是一样的——我们可以接受裁判可能会因为与比赛的情感关系而犯错误。

paras.en: "But if we have VAR, what were they doing? What were they doing? No, because now we are going to repeat the game? We're going to have the possibility to play with the similar tools, 11 against 11?
paras.zh: “但是如果我们有VAR，他们在做什么？他们在做什么？不，因为现在我们要重复比赛？我们将有可能使用类似的工具进行比赛，11对11？

paras.en: "The problem is that when we were there, I think they need to take their time to review the situation.
paras.zh: “问题是，当我们在那里时，我认为他们需要花时间审查情况。

paras.en: "We have an unbelievable car but we need to be in the level to drive, we need to drive in the best way.
paras.zh: “我们拥有一辆令人难以置信的汽车，但我们需要达到驾驶水平，我们需要以最好的方式驾驶。

paras.en: "We love and accept the technology, but what are they doing? But it's not only this mistake or the mistake for Haaland against Manchester City, it's how after it affects everything."
paras.zh: “我们喜欢并接受这项技术，但他们在做什么？但这不仅仅是这个错误或哈兰德对阵曼城的错误，而是它影响一切之后的方式。”

paras.en: Poch explains why Szoboszlai goal shouldn't have stood
paras.zh: 波赫解释为什么索博斯莱的进球不应该成立

paras.en: Pochettino then insisted that Liverpool's opening goal should not have stood because Bradley Barcola was touching the Manchester United wall as Szoboszlai struck in.
paras.zh: 波切蒂诺随后坚称利物浦的首粒进球不应该成立，因为当索博斯莱射门时，布拉德利·巴克拉正在触碰曼联的人墙。

paras.en: Pochettino referenced a similar call last season, which saw Eberechi Eze's free-kick goal for Crystal Palace at Chelsea disallowed after ex-Palace captain Marc Guehi pushed Moises Caicedo to create a gap for the ball to fly through.
paras.zh: 波切蒂诺提到了上个赛季的类似判罚，埃贝雷奇·埃泽在切尔西对阵水晶宫的任意球进球被判无效，因为前水晶宫队长马克·盖希推了莫伊塞斯·凯塞多，为球创造了一个空档。

paras.en: The IFAB Laws of the Game state: "If, when a free-kick is taken, an attacking team player is less than 1 m (1 yd) from a 'wall' formed by three or more defending team players, an indirect free-kick is awarded."
paras.zh: 国际足联比赛规则规定：“如果在踢任意球时，进攻队球员距离由三名或更多防守队球员组成的‘墙’不到 1 m（1 码），则判间接任意球。”

paras.en: Pochettino believes that the law applied to Szoboszlai's free-kick opener due to Barcola's involvement.
paras.zh: 波切蒂诺认为，由于巴科拉的参与，该法律适用于索博斯莱的任意球开场。

paras.en: He said: "No one talks about that the goal wasn't legal, it should be disallowed because (Bradley) Barcola was touching our wall. Maybe in the last two years, they've maybe changed the rule because I've been in America, but last season when (Eberechi) Eze scored for Palace (at Chelsea) you can see [it was disallowed].
paras.zh: 他说：“没有人谈论这个进球不合法，应该被禁止，因为（布拉德利）巴克拉触碰了我们的墙。也许在过去的两年里，他们可能改变了规则，因为我一直在美国，但上赛季（埃贝雷奇）埃兹为水晶宫（切尔西）进球时你可以看到[它被禁止了]。

paras.en: "But VAR didn't check [Dominik Szoboszlai's goal]; that must be disallowed.
paras.zh: “但是VAR没有检查[多米尼克·索博斯莱的进球]；这必须被禁止。

paras.en: "But this type of situation, I need to defend my players and my club, and that is to denounce and to say we were right and the decision wasn't good, and now the three points, where are they?
paras.zh: “但是在这种情况下，我需要捍卫我的球员和我的俱乐部，那就是谴责并说我们是对的，这个决定不好，现在三分在哪里？

paras.en: "I think it's a thing we need to think a little bit more deeper and it's not for tomorrow's game.
paras.zh: “我认为这是我们需要更深入思考的事情，而不是为了明天的比赛。

paras.en: "It's about to be tough in the way we use the technology. We need to move on. I'm so proud of the players in the way they manage these unfair situations that happen on the field.
paras.zh: “我们使用技术的方式将会变得艰难。我们需要继续前进。我为球员们处理场上发生的这些不公平情况的方式感到自豪。

paras.en: "Our focus now is to improve, to start to win games and tomorrow we have a great opportunity here."
paras.zh: “我们现在的重点是提高，开始赢得比赛，明天我们在这里有很好的机会。”

paras.en: In the latest edition of Match Officials Mic'd Up, Webb, chief refereeing officer at ProRef, described the on-field decision from referee Samuel Barrott as "decisive" and said the point of contention was around whether Isak would beat United goalkeeper Senne Lammens to the ball.
paras.zh: 在最新一期的《比赛官员麦克风》中，ProRef 首席裁判官韦伯将裁判塞缪尔·巴罗特的现场决定描述为“决定性的”，并表示争论的焦点在于伊萨克是否会击败曼联门将塞内·拉门斯。

paras.en: Audio from the officials reveals that the VAR, John Brooks, who backed Barrott's decision, determined Isak was "likely" to get on the end of the ball before Lammens. His assistant VAR, Paul Howard, agreed.
paras.zh: 官员们的音频显示，VAR、约翰·布鲁克斯（John Brooks）支持巴罗特的决定，认为伊萨克“很可能”先于拉门斯拿到球。他的助理VAR保罗·霍华德也同意这一观点。

paras.en: Webb was non-committal in his verdict but backed the process of the officials by saying "most people would see that as a correct decision".
paras.zh: 韦伯对他的判决不置可否，但支持官员的程序，称“大多数人都会认为这是一个正确的决定”。

paras.en: "There's a question mark, I guess, around whether or not he would get onto that ball before Lammens," said Webb. "Now, in the moment, the referee looked at it and felt he would. That was the referee's call made on the field.
paras.zh: “我想，关于他是否会在拉门斯之前接球，还有一个问号，”韦伯说。 “现在，在那一刻，裁判看着它，觉得他会的。这是裁判在场上做出的判罚。

paras.en: "The VAR checks that to see whether that decision made on the field was clearly and obviously incorrect and formed the opinion that it wasn't. If there was any doubt, then it was doubt.
paras.zh: “VAR会检查场上做出的决定是否明显错误，并得出错误的结论。如果有任何疑问，那就是怀疑。”

paras.en: "It wasn't going to be something that was clearly and obviously wrong and therefore allowed that decisive on-field decision to stand. And I think by and large most people would see that as a correct decision with Isak moving quickly on towards that ball.
paras.zh: “这不会是一个明显错误的事情，因此允许场上决定性的决定成立。我认为大多数人都会认为这是一个正确的决定，伊萨克迅速朝那个球移动。

paras.en: "The alternative view is that Lammens might get there first, but I think it's a little bit debatable, I guess. Certainly not clearly wrong."
paras.zh: “另一种观点是拉门斯可能会先到达那里，但我认为这有点值得商榷。当然不是明显错误。”

articles.title: Wasteful Arsenal held by Borussia Dortmund

paras.en: Arsenal vs Borussia Dortmund; UEFA Champions League Round 1
paras.zh: 阿森纳对阵多特蒙德；欧洲冠军联赛第一轮

paras.en: Arsenal vs Borussia Dortmund. UEFA Champions League Round 1.
paras.zh: 阿森纳对阵多特蒙德。欧洲冠军联赛第一轮。

paras.en: Arsenal 1-1 Dortmund: Viktor Gyokeres goal cancelled out as Gunners frustrated in Champions League
paras.zh: 阿森纳 1-1 多特蒙德：维克多·乔克雷斯的进球被取消，枪手在冠军联赛中失利

paras.en: Match report as Arsenal are denied victory by Borussia Dortmund in a Champions League encounter at the Emirates Stadium; Viktor Gyokeres scored a spectacular opener but Maximilian Beier equalised as the Gunners wasted a string of chances
paras.zh: 比赛报道：阿森纳在酋长球场举行的欧冠联赛中被多特蒙德队拒绝取胜；维克托·贾克雷斯打进了精彩的首开纪录，但马克西米利安·贝尔扳平了比分，枪手浪费了一系列机会

paras.en: Arsenal were punished for failing to take their chances for the second game in a row as Maximilian Beier clinched a 1-1 draw for Borussia Dortmund in the Champions League.
paras.zh: 阿森纳因连续第二场比赛未能抓住机会而受到惩罚，马克西米利安·贝尔在冠军联赛中以 1-1 战平多特蒙德队。

paras.en: Viktor Gyokeres gave Arsenal an early lead with a stunning strike from distance but the game followed a similar pattern to Saturday's 2-2 draw with Newcastle as they were unable to capitalise on a one-sided first half before conceding after the break.
paras.zh: 维克托·贾克雷斯凭借一记令人惊叹的远距离进球帮助阿森纳早早取得领先，但比赛遵循了与周六2-2战平纽卡斯尔的相似模式，因为他们无法利用上半场一边倒的优势，在中场休息后失球。

paras.en: Dortmund's leveller came when Beier slotted a clinical finish past Kepa Arrizabalaga, standing in for the injured David Raya, following a rampaging run from defender Joane Gadou.
paras.zh: 当贝尔在后卫乔安·加杜（Joane Gadou）狂奔之后替补受伤的大卫·拉亚（Kepa Arrizabalaga），以冷静的射门超越凯帕·阿里扎巴拉加（Kepa Arrizabalaga）时，多特蒙德扳平了比分。

paras.en: - Match stats | How the teams lined up | As it happened
paras.zh: - 比赛统计|队伍如何排列|正如它所发生的那样

paras.en: - Champions League fixtures and results | Table | Latest: Arsenal
paras.zh: - 冠军联赛赛程和结果|表|最新：阿森纳

paras.en: Arsenal racked up 30 shots and had a string of chances to win it in the closing stages, hitting the woodwork through Jurrien Timber's deflected cut-back and again through Declan Rice's low shot.
paras.zh: 阿森纳共射门 30 次，并在最后阶段有一系列获胜机会，通过尤里恩·廷伯 (Jurrien Timber) 的偏转内切球和德克兰·赖斯 (Declan Rice) 的低射击中门框。

paras.en: Gyokeres also spurned opportunities, firing over from close range from Martin Odegaard's pass shortly before half-time, then heading awkwardly wide from a few yards out when it looked easier to score from another Odegaard ball.
paras.zh: 乔克雷斯也拒绝了机会，在半场结束前不久，马丁·厄德高的传球近距离射门，然后当厄德高的另一个球看起来更容易得分时，他在几码外笨拙地头球偏出。

paras.en: Arsenal remain unbeaten in the Champions League but the draw causes them to drop two places in the league phase table to fifth before they resume their Premier League campaign at home to Manchester City, live on Sky Sports on Sunday.
paras.zh: 阿森纳在欧冠联赛中保持不败，但这场平局导致他们在联赛积分榜上的排名下降两位至第五，然后他们将在周日主场对阵曼城的英超联赛中恢复比赛，天空体育周日直播。

paras.en: Arsenal fail to kill off another opponent
paras.zh: 阿森纳未能杀死另一名对手

paras.en: Arsenal's total of 30 shots was their highest in the Champions League either this season or last. But only one of them ended up in the net. Only four of them were even on target.
paras.zh: 阿森纳的30次射门总数是他们本赛季和上赛季欧冠联赛中的最高射门次数。但最终只有其中一人入网。其中只有四个人甚至击中目标。

paras.en: There were clear parallels with Saturday's game at St James' Park. Again, Arsenal were outstanding in the first half. Again, though, they reached the interval with only one goal to show for their efforts.
paras.zh: 这与周六在圣詹姆斯公园的比赛有明显的相似之处。阿森纳上半场再次表现出色。不过，他们在上半场只打进一球，证明了他们的努力。

paras.en: Dortmund, like Newcastle, came out with renewed belief, and a lot more intensity. Even before Beier's equaliser, the same player had missed a glorious chance when he failed to connect with a Joey Veerman cross. Arsenal were suddenly on the back foot.
paras.zh: 多特蒙德和纽卡斯尔一样，带着新的信念和更强的强度出来了。甚至在贝尔扳平比分之前，这名球员就因为未能接到乔伊·维尔曼的传中而错过了一次绝佳的机会。阿森纳突然处于不利地位。

paras.en: They regained control after Dortmund's leveller, albeit while avoiding a scare when Jobe Bellingham had a goal ruled out for offside. But their attempts to break down the visitors were unsuccessful. Good positions were wasted. They should have been out of sight.
paras.zh: 在多特蒙德扳平比分后，他们重新获得了控制权，尽管乔布·贝林厄姆的进球因越位被判无效，他们避免了恐慌。但他们试图击垮来访者，但没有成功。好位置都被浪费了。他们应该是看不见的。

paras.en: Arteta couldn't believe it when the otherwise impressive Gyokeres skewed his header wide from Odegaard's cross. The Arsenal boss was on his knees when Timber's cut-back ricocheted off the post.
paras.zh: 当原本令人印象深刻的乔克雷斯接厄德高的传中头球偏出时，阿尔特塔简直不敢相信。当廷伯的内切击中门柱时，阿森纳主帅跪倒在地。

paras.en: It is positive that they are creating so many chances. Their performance featured another bright showing from Noni Madueke. But they will need to find some cutting edge against City.
paras.zh: 他们创造了如此多的机会，这是积极的。他们的表演以诺尼·马杜克（Noni Madueke）的另一场精彩表演为特色。但他们需要找到一些对抗曼城的优势。

paras.en: - 9: GOAL! Gyokeres lets fly from outside the box to put Arsenal in front in stunning style.
paras.zh: - 9：目标！吉奥克雷斯在禁区外传球，以惊人的方式将阿森纳领先。

paras.en: - 35: CHANCE! Nico Schlotterbeck gets across to make last-ditch block on Rice after being played in by Odegaard.
paras.zh: - 35：机会！尼科·施洛特贝克（Nico Schlotterbeck）在被奥德加德（Odegaard）打出后，对赖斯进行了最后一搏。

paras.en: - 43: MISS! Gyokeres misses a big chance to double Arsenal's lead after Odegaard unselfishly squares to him
paras.zh: - 43：小姐！奥德高无私地与吉奥克雷斯对峙后，他错失了扩大阿森纳领先优势的绝佳机会

paras.en: - 48: CHANCE! Beier fails to connect with a low cross from Veerman as Dortmund miss a big chance
paras.zh: - 48：机会！贝尔未能接到维尔曼的低传球，多特蒙德错失良机

paras.en: - 55: GOAL! Gadou goes charging upfield before finding Beier, who fires a low finish into the corner
paras.zh: - 55：目标！加杜冲向前场，然后找到贝尔，后者低射入角

paras.en: - 68 OFFSIDE! Jobe Bellingham thinks he's put Dortmund in front with a close-range finish but the linesman's flag goes up for offside
paras.zh: - 68 越位！乔布·贝林厄姆认为他的近距离射门让多特蒙德领先，但边裁因越位而举旗

paras.en: - 75: BIG CHANCE! Odegaard floats a cross to the back post and Gyokeres heads wide when he should score
paras.zh: - 75：好机会！厄德高传中到后门柱，乔克雷斯在应该进球的时候头球攻门偏出

paras.en: - 80: POST! Timber's cut-back is bundled onto the post by Serhou Guirassy
paras.zh: - 80：发帖！ Serhou Guirassy 将 Timber 的剪裁捆绑到柱子上

paras.en: - 84: POST! The Gunners hit the post again, this time through Rice on the angle
paras.zh: - 84：发帖！枪手再次击中门柱，这次是赖斯的角度

articles.title: McIlroy misses out on PGA Tour player of the year shortlist - who is in?

paras.en: Rory McIlroy misses out on PGA Tour Player of the Year shortlist: Who has been nominated for the Jack Nicklaus Award?
paras.zh: 罗里·麦克罗伊错过了 PGA 巡回赛年度最佳球员入围名单：谁获得了杰克·尼克劳斯奖提名？

paras.en: Wyndham Clark, Matt Fitzpatrick, Chris Gotterup, Scottie Scheffler and Cameron Young have been shortlisted for the PGA Tour's Player of the Year award; Scheffler looks to break Tiger Woods' record by winning the Jack Nicklaus Award for a fifth consecutive season
paras.zh: 温德姆·克拉克（Wyndham Clark）、马特·菲茨帕特里克（Matt Fitzpatrick）、克里斯·戈特鲁普（Chris Gotterup）、斯科蒂·谢夫勒（Scottie Scheffler）和卡梅伦·杨（Cameron Young）入围美巡赛年度最佳球员奖；谢夫勒希望打破泰格·伍兹的纪录，连续第五个赛季赢得杰克·尼克劳斯奖

paras.en: Rory McIlroy has missed out on being shortlisted for the PGA Tour's Player of the Year award, despite successfully defending his title at The Masters.
paras.zh: 尽管在大师赛上成功卫冕，罗里·麦克罗伊还是错失了美巡赛年度最佳球员奖的入围名单。

paras.en: McIlroy became the first player since Tiger Woods to win at Augusta National in successive years, following his one-shot victory over Scottie Scheffler, with the world No 2 adding three further top-four finishes on the PGA Tour during the season.
paras.zh: 麦克罗伊以一杆优势战胜斯科蒂·舍夫勒，成为继泰格·伍兹之后第一位连续几年在奥古斯塔国家赛获胜的球员，世界排名第二的球员在本赛季的美巡赛上又三次进入前四名。

paras.en: The six-time major champion is a three-time winner of the Jack Nicklaus Award but a noticeable absentee on the five-man shortlist for the 2026 season, announced Tuesday after being finalised by the PGA Tour Player Directors and the Player Advisory Council (PAC).
paras.zh: 这位六届大满贯赛冠军是三届杰克·尼克劳斯奖得主，但在美巡赛球员董事和球员咨询委员会 (PAC) 最终确定后于周二宣布的 2026 赛季五人入围名单中却明显缺席。

paras.en: - Latest PGA Tour headlines, reports and highlights
paras.zh: - 最新美巡赛头条、报告和亮点

paras.en: - PGA Tour schedule: Dates, venues and key 2027 changes
paras.zh: - PGA 巡回赛日程：日期、场地和 2027 年主要变化

paras.en: - Get the latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: Wyndham Clark, Matt Fitzpatrick, Chris Gotterup, Scottie Scheffler and Cameron Young were the five players nominated, with the Player of the Year award then decided by votes from PGA Tour members who have played at least 15 tournaments over the season.
paras.zh: 温德姆·克拉克（Wyndham Clark）、马特·菲茨帕特里克（Matt Fitzpatrick）、克里斯·戈特鲁普（Chris Gotterup）、斯科蒂·谢夫勒（Scottie Scheffler）和卡梅伦·杨（Cameron Young）被提名为五名球员，年度最佳球员奖则由在本赛季至少参加过 15 场比赛的美巡赛会员投票决定。

paras.en: Scheffler won three times on the PGA Tour this season, including The American Express and two of the three FedExCup Playoffs, with the world No 1 looking to break another Woods record by winning the award for a fifth consecutive year.
paras.zh: 谢夫勒本赛季在美巡赛上三次夺冠，包括美国运通赛和三届联邦快递杯季后赛中的两次，这位世界第一希望连续第五年获奖，打破伍兹的另一项纪录。

paras.en: The 30-year-old added five runner-up finishes over the campaign and won the Byron Nelson Award for the low scoring average, with Scheffler a strong contender despite failing to add to his major tally in 2026.
paras.zh: 这位 30 岁的选手在整个赛季中获得了五次亚军，并因平均得分较低而获得了拜伦·尼尔森奖，而谢夫勒是强有力的竞争者，尽管他在 2026 年的主要得分上未能增加。

paras.en: Clark won the US Open for a second time and added two further victories during the campaign, lifting him inside the world's top five, while Fitzpatrick also enjoyed three wins in his best PGA Tour season to-date.
paras.zh: 克拉克第二次赢得美国公开赛，并在赛季中又取得了两场胜利，使他跻身世界前五名，而菲茨帕特里克也在他迄今为止最好的美巡赛赛季中获得了三场胜利。

paras.en: Gotterup also picked up three wins and contended in multiple other events, with Presidents Cup team-mate Cameron Young completing the list after winning The Players and the Cadillac Championship.
paras.zh: 戈特鲁普还赢得了三场胜利，并参加了多项其他赛事，总统杯队友卡梅伦·杨在赢得球员锦标赛和凯迪拉克锦标赛后完成了名单。

paras.en: Voting will close December 4, with the winners of the award and the Arnold Palmer Award for the PGA Tour Rookie of the Year then announced before the start of the 2027 season.
paras.zh: 投票将于 12 月 4 日结束，该奖项和 PGA 巡回赛年度新秀阿诺德·帕尔默奖的获奖者将于 2027 赛季开始前公布。

paras.en: Viktor Hovland won the Travelers Championship and finished runner-up at the season-ending Tour Championship, while major winners Aaron Rai and Ryan Fox were among the others to miss out on the shortlist.
paras.zh: 维克多·霍夫兰 (Viktor Hovland) 赢得了旅行者锦标赛冠军，并在赛季结束的巡回锦标赛中获得亚军，而大满贯赛冠军亚伦·雷 (Aaron Rai) 和瑞安·福克斯 (Ryan Fox) 则错过了入围名单。

paras.en: Fitzpatrick brothers both shortlisted for PGA Tour awards
paras.zh: 菲茨帕特里克兄弟双双入围美巡赛奖项

paras.en: English duo Alex Fitzpatrick and Marco Penge are among the five nominees for the Arnold Palmer Award for Rookie of the Year, having both enjoyed breakthrough wins on their maiden PGA Tour seasons.
paras.zh: 英国组合亚历克斯·菲茨帕特里克和马可·彭吉是阿诺德·帕尔默年度最佳新秀奖的五名提名者之一，他们都在 PGA 巡回赛的处女赛季中取得了突破性的胜利。

paras.en: Fitzpatrick partnered older brother Matt to victory at the Zurich Classic of New Orleans and was one of only two rookies to qualify for the Tour Championship, finishing fourth in the FedExCup rankings.
paras.zh: 菲茨帕特里克与哥哥马特搭档在新奥尔良苏黎世精英赛上获胜，并成为仅有的两名获得巡回锦标赛资格的新秀之一，在联邦快递杯排名中获得第四名。

paras.en: Penge retained his PGA Tour playing status in dramatic fashion at the RSM Classic, winning the final event of the FedExCup Fall in a play-off to break inside the top 100 in the season-long standings.
paras.zh: 彭吉在 RSM 精英赛上以戏剧性的方式保住了他的 PGA 巡回赛参赛资格，并在联邦快递杯秋季附加赛的最后一场比赛中获胜，从而在整个赛季的积分榜上跻身前 100 名。

paras.en: Norway's Kristoffer Reitan won the Truist Championship and rising star Jackson Koivun claimed the 3M Open in just his third professional start, while Ben James - a two-time runner-up in 2026 - complete the rookie quintet nominated.
paras.zh: 挪威选手克里斯托弗·雷坦 (Kristoffer Reitan) 赢得了 Truist 锦标赛冠军，后起之秀杰克逊·科伊文 (Jackson Koivun) 在他第三次职业生涯中赢得了 3M 公开赛冠军，而 2026 年两届亚军本·詹姆斯 (Ben James) 则完成了新秀五重奏提名。

articles.title: Palestinians flee as Israeli tanks cross Gaza ceasefire’s ‘yellow line’
articles.author: Chantal Da Silva

paras.en: Israel’s ground operation across the yellow ceasefire line in Gaza, which forced Palestinians to flee their makeshift shelters, marks a fresh escalation in the conflict and risks undermining an already floundering truce with Hamas, analysts said Thursday.
paras.zh: 分析人士周四表示，以色列跨越加沙黄色停火线的地面行动迫使巴勒斯坦人逃离临时避难所，这标志着冲突再次升级，并有可能破坏与哈马斯本已岌岌可危的休战协议。

paras.en: As tanks rolled into central Gaza on Wednesday, residents could be seen carrying blankets and other belongings away from their tents in pictures and video taken shortly after the Israeli military began what it said was an operation targeting a “terror tunnel.”
paras.zh: 周三，当坦克开进加沙中部时，在以色列军方开始所谓的针对“恐怖隧道”的行动后不久拍摄的照片和视频中，可以看到居民从帐篷里搬出毯子和其他物品。

paras.en: Others could be seen rolling away mattresses on carts and pushing loved ones in wheelchairs away from the scene near the Nuseirat camp in central Gaza. At least one person was reported to have been killed in an Israeli airstrike near the raid, Palestinian medics said, according to Reuters.
paras.zh: 可以看到其他人将床垫推到推车上，并将坐轮椅的亲人推离加沙中部努塞拉特营地附近的现场。据路透社报道，巴勒斯坦医务人员称，据报道，至少一人在袭击附近的以色列空袭中丧生。

paras.en: “Bullets were fired at us,” Amna al-Gasar, 49, told NBC News after she fled the scene with her young children, her baby in a pink fluffy sweater strapped to her chest. She said her family had received “evacuation orders” from the Israeli military and that tanks had advanced on the area.
paras.zh: “子弹向我们射击，”49 岁的阿姆娜·加萨尔 (Amna al-Gasar) 带着年幼的孩子逃离现场后告诉 NBC 新闻，她的孩子穿着一件粉色毛衣，绑在胸前。她说，她的家人收到了以色列军方的“疏散命令”，坦克已经向该地区推进。

paras.en: “This is the 14th time that we’re getting displaced,” al-Gasar said, who added that she is from Gaza City in the north of the enclave which is now on the side of the “yellow line” occupied by Israeli forces. “Where should we go? We are exhausted. This is not a life,” she said.
paras.zh: 加萨尔说：“这是我们第 14 次流离失所。”她补充说，她来自飞地北部的加沙城，该飞地现在位于以色列军队占领的“黄线”一侧。 “我们该去哪里？我们已经筋疲力尽了。这不是生活，”她说。

paras.en: Muna Abu Shehadeh, 37, said in a separate interview that along with some of her relatives, she left “with nothing but our children — no bedding, no food, and no water.” She added that she had a daughter who was ill, as well as a baby, and that they had to leave behind what few supplies they had.
paras.zh: 37 岁的穆纳·阿布·谢哈德 (Muna Abu Shehadeh) 在另一次采访中表示，她和她的一些亲戚“除了孩子们什么也没带走——没有被褥、没有食物、没有水。”她补充说，她有一个生病的女儿和一个婴儿，他们不得不留下仅有的少量物资。

paras.en: The Israeli military told NBC News the ground operation was the first to be executed beyond the yellow line — the boundary marking the roughly 60% of Gaza that remains occupied by Israeli forces — since the U.S.-brokered ceasefire with Hamas came into effect in October 2025.
paras.zh: 以色列军方告诉 NBC 新闻，自美国斡旋与哈马斯停火于 2025 年 10 月生效以来，这次地面行动是在黄线之外执行的第一次地面行动。黄线标志着仍被以色列军队占领的加沙约 60% 的地区。

paras.en: Separately, in a joint statement with the Israel Security Agency, or Shin Bet, the Israel Defense Forces said the operation was a “targeted” assault aimed at dismantling a tunnel that “posed an immediate and direct threat” to troops.
paras.zh: 另外，以色列国防军在与以色列安全局（Shin Bet）的联合声明中表示，这次行动是一次“有针对性的”攻击，旨在拆除一条对部队“构成直接威胁”的隧道。

paras.en: They said a warning had been issued to civilians in the area prior to the operation, though they did not expand on how exactly warnings were issued and whether they expanded beyond an announcement published online, when asked by NBC News.
paras.zh: 他们表示，在行动之前已向该地区的平民发出了警告，但当 NBC 新闻询问时，他们没有详细说明警告的具体发出方式以及警告是否超出了在网上发布的公告范围。

paras.en: Israeli forces would continue to operate to “remove any immediate threat and thwart attempts” by Hamas to harm Israeli civilians or troops, the statement added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说，以色列军队将继续采取行动，“消除任何直接威胁并挫败哈马斯伤害以色列平民或军队的企图”。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the Israeli military said Thursday that the operation west of the yellow line had “ended,” though they could not confirm when exactly the offensive came to a close. Hamas condemned the ground operation, calling it a violation of the ceasefire agreement.
paras.zh: 以色列军方发言人周四表示，黄线以西的行动已经“结束”，但他们无法确认进攻何时结束。哈马斯谴责地面行动，称其违反停火协议。

paras.en: Andreas Krieg, a senior lecturer at King’s College London’s School of Security Studies, said he also believed the incursion was a “clear violation of the fundamental premise of the ceasefire.”
paras.zh: 伦敦国王学院安全研究学院高级讲师安德烈亚斯·克里格表示，他还认为这次入侵“明显违反了停火的基本前提”。

paras.en: “Israel agreed to withdraw to the ‘yellow line,’ which was supposed to establish a mutually understood boundary until further withdrawals could be negotiated,” he said Thursday. Sending ground forces a few hundred feet beyond that line and “forcing civilians to flee undermines the agreement,” he added.
paras.zh: 他周四表示：“以色列同意撤退到‘黄线’，这条线本应建立一条相互理解的边界，直到就进一步撤军进行谈判。”他补充说，将地面部队派遣到该线之外数百英尺并“迫使平民逃离破坏了协议”。

paras.en: “Israel cannot simply invoke security concerns whenever it wants to cross a boundary it agreed to respect,” he said, adding that its assertion of a threat had “not been independently substantiated.” The operation risked undermining “any meaning” the yellow line has held as a boundary under the ceasefire agreement, he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“每当以色列想要跨越其同意尊重的边界时，就不能简单地援引安全问题。”他补充说，其威胁的说法“尚未得到独立证实”。他说，这次行动可能会破坏黄线作为停火协议规定的边界的“任何意义”。

paras.en: The Israeli government and military did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the accusation that the ceasefire agreement had been violated.
paras.zh: 以色列政府和军方没有立即回应有关违反停火协议指控的置评请求。

paras.en: The truce has already been marked by regular Israeli strikes, with more than 1,600 people killed in the enclave since the truce began, according to the Palestinian Health Ministry in the territory. Israel says at least five soldiers have been killed within the same amount of time, according to Reuters.
paras.zh: 据该地区巴勒斯坦卫生部称，自停战开始以来，以色列定期发动袭击，导致该飞地内有 1,600 多人死亡。据路透社报道，以色列称在同一时间内至少有五名士兵被杀。

paras.en: Both Israel and Hamas have repeatedly traded accusations of ceasefire violations.
paras.zh: 以色列和哈马斯都多次相互指责违反停火协议。

paras.en: “Israel has been violating the ceasefire pretty periodically since it came into place, so it’s nothing new on that front,” Rob Geist Pinfold, a lecturer in defense studies at King’s College London, said Thursday of the Israeli military’s ground operation.
paras.zh: 伦敦国王学院国防研究讲师罗布·盖斯特·平福德(Rob Geist Pinfold)周四在谈到以色列军方的地面行动时表示：“自停火协议生效以来，以色列经常违反停火协议，因此这方面并不是什么新鲜事。”

paras.en: “It’s the scale of the violation,” he said, adding the ground assault and use of tanks signifying an “escalation” from Israel.
paras.zh: 他说：“这就是侵犯行为的规模。”他补充说，地面袭击和使用坦克标志着以色列的“升级”。

paras.en: Both Pinfold and Krieg noted that the ground operation comes at a time of great political uncertainty for Benjamin Netanyahu, who faces losing his prime ministership after elections last month.
paras.zh: 平福德和克里格都指出，此次地面行动是在本雅明·内塔尼亚胡面临巨大政治不确定性之际进行的，他在上个月的选举后面临失去总理职位的风险。

paras.en: While Netanyahu’s Likud party gained the most votes, President Isaac Herzog tasked his main rival, Gadi Eiskenot, with forming a coalition government based on the premise that he was most likely to succeed in doing so.
paras.zh: 虽然内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团获得最多选票，但艾萨克·赫尔佐格总统责成他的主要竞争对手加迪·艾斯克诺特组建联合政府，前提是他最有可能成功组建联合政府。

paras.en: Netanyahu has railed against the possibility of Israel’s Arab-led parties joining a coalition and both Pinfold and Krieg suggested that he might be seeking to ramp up pressure around security concerns.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡反对以色列阿拉伯领导的政党加入联盟的可能性，平福德和克里格都表示，他可能会寻求围绕安全问题加大压力。

paras.en: Pinfold said Netanyahu was also likely “trying to see how far he can go on the Gaza front,” particularly as the U.S. continues to sideline Israeli involvement in the war with Iran.
paras.zh: 平福德表示，内塔尼亚胡也可能“试图看看他能在加沙前线走多远”，特别是在美国继续回避以色列参与与伊朗的战争的情况下。

paras.en: “I suspect Israel is testing how far it can push the Americans without provoking a serious response,” Krieg said. Israel could also be seeking to “establish a precedent for what amounts to a permanent right of hot pursuit” in Gaza, even beyond its current “yellow line” and even into the future as efforts to advance the peace continue to stall, he added.
paras.zh: 克里格说：“我怀疑以色列正在测试它能在不引起严重反应的情况下将美国人逼到什么程度。”他补充说，以色列还可能寻求在加沙“建立相当于永久紧追权的先例”，甚至超越目前的“黄线”，甚至在推进和平的努力继续陷入停滞的未来。

paras.en: Elsewhere, President Donald Trump’s Board of Peace, the body that is overseeing the execution of the U.S.-brokered ceasefire, delivered a bleak report Tuesday on its progress to the United Nations Security Council, warning that the fragile deal was in danger of collapse, Reuters reported.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，唐纳德·特朗普总统的和平委员会周二向联合国安理会提交了一份黯淡的进展报告，警告说这项脆弱的协议有破裂的危险。

paras.en: The board said both Israel and Hamas should uphold the commitments made in the agreement, according to Reuters, which obtained a copy of the report. But Hamas’ disarmament and the militant group’s calls for the Israeli military’s withdrawal from Gaza have proven major sticking points in efforts to propel the deal forward.
paras.zh: 据获得该报告副本的路透社报道，该委员会表示，以色列和哈马斯都应恪守协议中的承诺。但哈马斯的解除武装以及该激进组织要求以色列军队从加沙撤军的呼吁已被证明是推动协议进展的主要症结所在。

paras.en: Fleeing from the area of Israel’s ground operation Wednesday, al-Gasar said Palestinians “need a solution.”
paras.zh: 周三逃离以色列地面行动地区的加萨尔表示，巴勒斯坦人“需要一个解决方案”。

paras.en: “All we ask for is safety and security. We’re not asking for a lot,” she said. “All of this talk in the media about advancement in negotiations, but instead we find advancement of tanks.”
paras.zh: “我们所要求的只是安全和保障。我们要求的并不太多，”她说。 “媒体上所有这些都在谈论谈判的进展，但我们却发现了坦克的进展。”

articles.title: Trump calling Putin ‘my friend’ at APEC summit sparks backlash
articles.author: Abigail Williams

paras.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, is wanted by the International Criminal Court on allegations of war crimes, and is accused of overseeing a yearslong campaign of election interference, sabotage and cyberattacks against the West.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京对乌克兰发动了全面入侵，因涉嫌战争罪而被国际刑事法院通缉，并被指控监督了长达数年的针对西方的选举干预、破坏和网络攻击活动。

paras.en: So when President Donald Trump pointed to the Russian leader and declared, “He’s my friend,” at the historic Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in China on Thursday, the reaction from some of America’s closest European allies was one of alarm and disbelief.
paras.zh: 因此，当唐纳德·特朗普总统周四在中国举行的历史性亚太经济合作峰会上指着俄罗斯领导人并宣称“他是我的朋友”时，美国一些最亲密的欧洲盟友的反应是震惊和难以置信。

paras.en: “God, protect us from such friends,” Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk posted to X shortly afterward.
paras.zh: “上帝，请保护我们免受这些朋友的伤害，”波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克不久后在 X 上发帖说。

paras.en: “The optics of embracing Putin and calling him a friend cause us some concern,” Poland’s foreign minister, Radosław Sikorski, told a news conference Thursday. He added that it posed the question of whom Trump considered a closer friend, Putin or Poland, and “if push came to shove, which friend would he choose?”
paras.zh: 波兰外交部长拉多斯瓦夫·西科尔斯基在周四的新闻发布会上表示：“拥抱普京并称他为朋友的做法引起了我们的一些担忧。”他补充说，这提出了特朗普认为谁是更亲密的朋友，普京还是波兰的问题，“如果到了紧要关头，他会选择哪个朋友？”

paras.en: Their comments came hours before Poland’s defense minister, Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz, accused Russia of violating the country’s airspace overnight with three objects that were probably two missiles and a drone. Elsewhere, Estonia said it would close its road border crossings with Russia on security grounds for at least six months.
paras.zh: 在他们发表上述言论的几个小时前，波兰国防部长瓦迪斯瓦夫·科西尼亚克-卡梅什指责俄罗斯在一夜之间用三件物体（可能是两枚导弹和一架无人机）侵犯了该国领空。在其他地方，爱沙尼亚表示，出于安全原因，它将关闭与俄罗斯的公路过境点至少六个月。

paras.en: Much of the criticism of Trump’s remark has come from Poland, historically one of Washington’s closest allies in Europe but whose officials have grown increasingly wary of Trump’s dealings with Russia. The country, which borders Ukraine, Russia and Moscow’s close ally Belarus, has long been among the most outspoken European governments warning about the threat of Russian aggression. Its security strategy also relies heavily on the United States and NATO.
paras.zh: 对特朗普言论的大部分批评来自波兰，该国历史上是华盛顿在欧洲最亲密的盟友之一，但其官员对特朗普与俄罗斯的交往越来越警惕。该国与乌克兰、俄罗斯和莫斯科的亲密盟友白俄罗斯接壤，长期以来一直是对俄罗斯侵略威胁发出最直言不讳的欧洲政府之一。其安全战略也严重依赖美国和北约。

paras.en: More broadly, the word “friend” also caused fresh alarm among other European governments, some of which are openly warning that Putin may expand his aggression beyond Ukraine and attack them, too.
paras.zh: 更广泛地说，“朋友”一词也引起了其他欧洲国家政府的新警觉，其中一些国家公开警告普京可能会将其侵略扩大到乌克兰以外并攻击他们。

paras.en: Ultimately, there is widespread concern that elevating Putin alongside Trump and China’s Xi Jinping will legitimize and embolden a leader whom Western governments have sought to isolate over his record of grave human rights abuses and aggression against other countries, allegations he has routinely denied.
paras.zh: 最终，人们普遍担心，让普京与特朗普和中国国家主席习近平一起提拔，将使这位领导人合法化并更加大胆。西方国家政府一直试图孤立这位领导人，因为他有严重侵犯人权和侵略其他国家的记录，而他经常否认这些指控。

paras.en: The joint declaration made by Trump, Putin and Xi after their meeting made no mention of Ukraine but condemned the International Criminal Court, which has issued a warrant for Putin’s arrest over the alleged unlawful deportation of Ukrainian children to Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普、普京和习近平会晤后发表的联合声明没有提及乌克兰，但谴责了国际刑事法院，该法院因涉嫌非法将乌克兰儿童驱逐到俄罗斯而对普京发出逮捕令。

paras.en: Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen said it was “very incomprehensible” that Trump would meet with Putin, while German Chancellor Friedrich Merz was among those who warned against the meeting becoming a rerun of the Yalta Conference of 1945. The summit toward the end of World War II saw President Franklin D. Roosevelt, British Prime Minister Winston Churchill and Soviet leader Joseph Stalin effectively carve up occupied Germany and other parts of Europe.
paras.zh: 丹麦首相梅特·弗雷德里克森表示，特朗普会见普京“非常难以理解”，而德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨等人也警告这次会议不要成为1945年雅尔塔会议的重演。在二战即将结束时的峰会上，美国总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福、英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔和苏联领导人约瑟夫·斯大林实际上瓜分了被占领的德国和欧洲其他地区。

paras.en: Others, including British Prime Minister Andy Burnham, were more restrained. Asked whether Trump had “fallen for Putin’s charm offensive,” he replied that it was “quite the opposite” and that Trump had “talked about the horrific loss of life, including the loss of young Russian lives, and he spoke quite passionately about that subject.”
paras.zh: 其他人，包括英国首相安迪·伯纳姆，则更加克制。当被问及特朗普是否“被普京的魅力攻势所迷惑”时，他回答说，情况“恰恰相反”，特朗普“谈到了可怕的生命损失，包括俄罗斯年轻人的生命损失，他非常热情地谈论了这个话题。”

paras.en: NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte also defended the principle of nuclear powers meeting to pursue diplomacy.
paras.zh: 北约秘书长马克·吕特也捍卫了核大国会议寻求外交的原则。

paras.en: Burnham and Rutte were speaking at a meeting in Berlin of the “Coalition of the Willing,” a group of nearly 40 countries working to support Ukraine and provide security guarantees.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆和吕特在柏林举行的“意愿联盟”会议上发表讲话，该联盟由近 40 个国家组成，致力于支持乌克兰并提供安全保障。

paras.en: They were joined by Steve Witkoff and Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner, the U.S. envoys tasked with brokering peace between Moscow and Kyiv.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·威特科夫（Steve Witkoff）和特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳（Jared Kushner）也加入了他们的行列，他们都是负责促成莫斯科和基辅之间和平的美国特使。

paras.en: Trump called into a meeting of dozens of European leaders and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Thursday, telling the group that Putin was ready to end the war, according to five European officials briefed on the discussions. He also encouraged the Europeans to make a deal so they can stop spending money on Ukraine and spend it on their own countries, the officials said.
paras.zh: 据了解讨论情况的五名欧洲官员透露，特朗普周四召集了数十名欧洲领导人和乌克兰总统泽连斯基举行会议，告诉与会者普京已准备好结束战争。官员们表示，他还鼓励欧洲人达成协议，这样他们就可以停止在乌克兰上花钱，而把钱花在自己的国家上。

paras.en: Kushner also mentioned the call in a post on X but said it was up to the president to reveal what he said.
paras.zh: 库什纳还在 X 上的一篇帖子中提到了这次通话，但表示由总统来透露他所说的内容。

paras.en: “Trump wants to make a deal with Europe by his side. He’s not looking to impose anything unilaterally,” Kushner said. “Any deal we do will be in close consultation with Ukraine and with Europe. That’s something that he also asked us to come here today and reassure people in that regard.”
paras.zh: “特朗普希望与欧洲达成协议。他不打算单方面强加任何东西，”库什纳说。 “我们达成的任何协议都将与乌克兰和欧洲密切协商。他还要求我们今天来到这里，在这方面让人们放心。”

paras.en: The White House did not immediately respond to an overnight request for comment on the criticisms about Trump’s comment about Putin. But Trump defended his description of the Russian president in an interview with Reuters, saying that “it’s nice to have people that have 4,000 nuclear weapons as a friend as opposed to an enemy.”
paras.zh: 白宫没有立即回应隔夜就特朗普对普京评论的批评请求发表评论。但特朗普在接受路透社采访时为自己对俄罗斯总统的描述进行了辩护，称“与拥有 4000 枚核武器的人成为朋友而不是敌人真是太好了。”
